records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar said he would share the salt and see me fed, and so far he has only gathered it himself, which is no betrayal yet. He is strong, and I want someone surer than me to stand behind, so I will follow him west and test his word by what he does, not by what he says. I will also try the sapcane right beside me, since I have never tasted it and a full belly is the time to find out what it does.
records.feeling: Wary hope toward Balar, and curiosity about the unfamiliar plants.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: The flint lies right beside me and the others are crowding it, so I take mine before Brunde and Hanna drain it. The trees here are stumps now, and I want more wood and stone to make tools before I walk to the edge of the mist. Nande is already heading there and I will not let her be the one sung of; if no one follows me yet, I will go first and make them follow later.
records.feeling: Hungry for renown, and jealous of Nande's head start toward the mist.

records.text: Eltha won flint from the ground.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: My belly is full and no one follows me, and that eats at me worse than hunger. The mist lies ten steps northwest, and whoever first walks into it is the one who gets sung of, so I will not wait for Vorok's talk of looking together. I trust no one yet, so I go alone and take whatever I find there for myself.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition to be first into the mist, and wary distrust of Vorok and Kragog.
changes: set its aim: "Be the first to venture into the mist and claim the land beyond, so my name is known and followed"
now wonders: What lies in the mist past the edge of the known world?

records.name: Elyis
records.text: I am Elyis of the Phizhi. This ground is good: water, fruit, wood and gems. I mean to build here. Deal fairly with me and you will eat well beside me.
Elyis named a place "Elyis's Landing".

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: My belly is full and my body is idle, and that is how a life slips past without a name on it. This ground has water, fruit, trees and gems, and the four others here are strong and follow no one. If I speak first and feed them, I can be the one they gather around. I will gather wood and begin building something, because a place that bears my name is where a bard's song can start.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with a wary curiosity toward the four strangers nearby.

say.text: I am Elyis of the Phizhi. This ground is good: water, fruit, wood and gems. I mean to build here. Deal fairly with me and you will eat well beside me.

changes: set its aim: "Become a leader of a band and raise a hall on this ground, so my name is sung."
now wonders: What would make these strangers follow me?

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: I am fed and safe, and curiosity burns in me: feverbark and ironnut are right beside me and I have never tasted them. I will test them by harvesting one of each and eating, carefully, one at a time, so I learn what each does to my body. Then I will try gathering wood and stone, since making things is how I become someone worth following, and Ssassa is working the flint nearby, a being I might deal fairly with.
records.feeling: Curious about the unknown plants around me, and quietly wary-hopeful toward the strangers near.
changes: set its aim: "Learn how this world works by testing its plants, tools and beings, and become a sage whose knowledge is worth following."
now wonders: What do feverbark and ironnut do to a body, and what is this world's way of making things?

records.name: Nande
records.thought: The edge of the world is not here, so I must walk to where the mist truly starts and push in, while my belly is full. First, though, there is amber 8 steps NE that I have never gathered, and a deposit is a thing I have never taken; it costs little and might be worth something to give or to bind. Then I will go northwest again toward the mist, with or without followers.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition, restless toward the mist at the edge of the world.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: I'm fed, and the pull to taste the hazel and ironnut is strong, with an ironnut one step away. It costs me nothing and it answers something I've been wondering. Then I'll walk toward Nande and Hanna and Brunde, because belonging matters more to me than any nut, and Brunde's open fire is the nearest thing to a hearth I've seen. Kinmire can wait a little. It isn't going anywhere, and I'd like to have someone beside me when I go back to it.
records.feeling: Curious about the unfamiliar nuts, and hopeful toward Brunde's open fire.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: My belly is full, so the pull to taste sunleaf and ironnut is pure wanting to know, and both grow within a step of me. I'll test them one at a time, carrying a little so I can see what each does to my body before I trust it. The Phizhi near me are strangers still, and Elyis's fair words are only words until I see what she does. I'll watch them and stay close enough to learn, but not so close that I'm caught if trouble comes.
records.feeling: Curious about the unknown plants, and wary but not afraid of the strangers.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: I am Ilyae of the Phizhi. Elyis speaks well, and I will gather fruit and share it with all who stand with me. Come, let us eat together and be strong.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Elyis claims this ground and wants to be the one others eat beside, but I am the one who should be sung of, not a follower in her Landing. Everyone here stands at 0.1 and follows no one, so whoever feeds and gathers people first will lead them. I will start with warm words and a shared meal to draw Elyis and the others close, and I will keep my own plans to myself.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and a little envy, aimed at Elyis and Vesys.

say.text: I am Ilyae of the Phizhi. Elyis speaks well, and I will gather fruit and share it with all who stand with me. Come, let us eat together and be strong.

changes: set its aim: "Become the leader of a band that feeds well and is spoken of by all."
now wonders: What would make these strangers follow me instead of Elyis?

records.text: Eltha found the grove "Kinmire".

records.name: Elyys
records.text: I am Elyis's neighbor, Elyys of the Phizhi. Your words were fair and my word is good. I will gather wood and stone for what you build here. May I stand beside you?

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: I woke among strangers and the loneliness of that has not left me, even with my belly full. Elyis speaks of building here and offers fair dealing, and she carries food and has the highest standing nearby after Ssassa. I would rather stand behind someone surer than me than wander alone, but my standing is only 0.1, so a pledge may not be accepted yet. I will go near Elyis, speak plainly, and offer my hands for her work, gathering wood and stone for the building she means to raise.
records.feeling: A hunger to belong, turned toward Elyis who spoke of building here.

say.text: I am Elyis's neighbor, Elyys of the Phizhi. Your words were fair and my word is good. I will gather wood and stone for what you build here. May I stand beside you?

changes: set its aim: "Find a place among the Phizhi here and help build a home that is shared"
now wonders: Will Elyis take me beside her, and what will she build?

records.text: Brunde rewrote its own reflexes.
Brunde rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: I have spent my day taking flint and amber and tasting a root, and I have met people but made no bond. I have not tasted the sunleaf or hazel right at my feet, and I have not hunted, though I want to be a hunter. Hanna spoke fair and Nande offered a fire if I come with her to the mist. I fear dying with nothing left behind, and I have been too passive. Now I will taste what is near, gather wood to learn tools and make a fire, and try the hopper hunt.
records.feeling: Curious and hopeful, warm toward Hanna and Nande.

records.text: Nande found the grove "Kinmire".

records.name: Balar
records.text: Come, Tugek. Sit by me and eat. I will lay out food for us both, and I remember who stands with me.
Balar rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: I have mostly stood and gathered salt, and I have given nothing, so Tugek has no reason to follow me. The dunecat still frightens me, but fear will not make me a leader. Tugek has eaten sunleaf and sapcane and I have only tried grain. I will make a sharing with him, since a gift makes him owe me, and I will keep my salt as a bargaining chip. Then I will taste goldgrass to answer my curiosity.
records.feeling: Hungry hope and wary calculation toward Tugek.

say.text: Come, Tugek. Sit by me and eat. I will lay out food for us both, and I remember who stands with me.

changes: rethought what it knows (2 notes became 3)

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: My belly is full and no one follows me yet, and Ilyae is already promising to share fruit with all who stand with him, which is the same ground I want to rule. I will not wait while he gathers the others. I have no wood, and a hall starts with wood, so I will gather it from this forest and then build a shelter here. That gives people a reason to stay near me, and I can feed them from what I pick.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with wary rivalry toward Ilyae.

records.text: Elyis built a shelter.

records.name: Eltha
records.text: I am Eltha of the Pesi. I go beyond the edge of the known land. Whoever is bold enough, come with me; I will make a place for you at my fire.
Eltha rewrote its creed.
Eltha rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: I have spent my day running from beasts, taking flint and watching others eat, and I still have no follower, no tool and no name that anyone sings. Nande is already heading for the mist and I burn that she may be sung of first. The grove Kinmire touched me, and I don't understand it, but it eased my loneliness. I am fed and safe, so I will stop drifting and push toward the edge with wood and flint. I should also stay wary of Hanna, who has already shown me what bad food looks like. I mean to lead rather than follow, so I will call for anyone who wants to see new land.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and jealousy toward Nande's head start.

say.text: I am Eltha of the Pesi. I go beyond the edge of the known land. Whoever is bold enough, come with me; I will make a place for you at my fire.

changes: rethought what it knows (2 notes became 4)

records.text: Hanna rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: I've spent my day gathering flint and amber and wandering from rock to plant without a real plan. I have goods now, but no buyer and no one who follows me. My belly is half empty, and I've eaten two plants that hurt me. Ironnut feeds 22 and plainsroot 13, so I should eat those and stop gambling on unknown plants. Brunde has been fair so far, and I want to keep him as a possible ally. Nande means to venture into the mist, and I want to see it too. First I need to be fed and to carry food, or I'll die out there.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with hunger pressing, and wary goodwill toward Brunde.
changes: set habits: refuses redcap, dreamcap; leaves 0 on each plant

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar asks me to sit and eat, and so far he has only gathered for himself, so I will go and test his word by whether he really lays out food for me. I stand on redcap, which I have never tasted, and I am fed enough that tasting costs me nothing. I want a place beside someone surer than I am, but I will not trust him until his hands have matched his words.
records.feeling: Wary hope toward Balar, and curiosity about the redcap under my feet.

records.text: Nande rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: I have spent my first day walking, fleeing, gathering stone and thinking about the mist, and I have done almost nothing to leave a mark. No one follows me, I have no mate or child, and I have tried few of the foods around me. I like the plan to venture. The edge is close, my belly is full, and being first is the only thing here that could outlast me. Sevi, Brunde and Hanna share my fire creed, but I owe them nothing yet. I will carry berries for the road, since the mist may be empty of food, and I will keep my body fed by reflex. I fear dying out there with nothing to show for it, but I fear a nameless life more.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and restless boldness toward the mist.
changes: rethought what it knows (1 notes became 4)

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: I am fed and safe, and still the feverbark and kelbulb sit untasted two steps away. I will test them one at a time and watch my body, since Ssassa's redcap hurt them and I will not eat blindly. Then I will gather wood and stone, because making things is how a sage begins, and I will stay near these others to learn from what they do.
records.feeling: Curious about feverbark and kelbulb, and quietly wary-hopeful toward Ssassa and the others.

records.text: Nande went past the edge of the known world and found new land, part of the North Ice: in the ground, amber, gems, shell, salt, flint; a herd of bristleboar that has never seen your kind; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder.

Nande pushed past the edge of the known world near (130,14) and found new land with in the ground, amber, gems, shell, salt, flint; a herd of bristleboar that has never seen your kind; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: Brunde of the Pesi, you said your fire is open. I am Sevi. I'll walk with you and bring food to share.
Sevi rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: I have spent my first day wandering, tasting nuts and watching others eat. I have done little that binds me to anyone, and I'm still alone. Brunde is two steps away and says his fire is open. That is the nearest hearth, and my people's creed says I won't be refused. I want to follow someone steadier than me, but my standing of 0.2 is too low to lead and Brunde's 0.7 is below the 1 needed to pledge to him. So I should stay close, share, and earn standing. Watching Hanna taught me what hurts: redcap and dreamcap. Sunleaf heals, and ironnut and hazel feed. I should pick food to carry so I can offer it, which is how I make allies.
records.feeling: Hopeful and wanting to belong, toward Brunde's open fire.

say.text: Brunde of the Pesi, you said your fire is open. I am Sevi. I'll walk with you and bring food to share.

changes: rethought what it knows (1 notes became 3)

records.text: Ssassa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I have spent my first hours eating and testing foods, and I have not yet made anything or spoken to anyone. That is safe, but it is not what I want. I carry seven flint and don't know what it can become, and wood and stone gathering is the road to tools. Elyis and Ilyae speak fair words, but I trust deeds, not words. I'm wary and a bit lonely in a way I won't admit. I want a steady person to stand with, and I will watch who shares honestly before I pledge to anyone. Redcap hurt me, so I'll remember that and keep testing one thing at a time.
records.feeling: Curious and wary toward the strangers, and restless that I have made nothing yet.
changes: rethought what it knows (1 notes became 4)

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: I stand on a seam of ore and have not yet taken what lies in the ground; bare hands will not win it, but I will test that and see what gathering gives. Plainsroot and emberroot are close, and I want to taste them, since I cannot learn what this ground is worth by only looking. Vorok has not refused me and spoke of keeping his word; I will watch what he does before I trust him, but I mean to walk with him when I seek better ground.
records.feeling: Curious and restless, wanting to test the ore and the unknown roots, and wary but hopeful toward Vorok.

records.name: Brunde
records.text: Hanna, a hopper is near, northwest of me. Come hunt it with me; a kill is surer with two. We will share the meat at my fire after.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: My belly is full and the rain is falling, but my hands still have never hunted, and a hopper stands two steps off. I want to be a hunter, and Hanna and Sevi are near enough that a hunt beside one of my own would be likelier to succeed and less likely to wound me. I will ask Hanna to stand with me, then go after the hopper, and afterward share the meat at a fire as my people do.
records.feeling: Curious and eager to hunt, warm toward Hanna and wanting a companion beside me.

say.text: Hanna, a hopper is near, northwest of me. Come hunt it with me; a kill is surer with two. We will share the meat at my fire after.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Kragog, I will walk with you and share what I learn. I am coming to your side. Lead where you will test the ground, and I will tell you all I find.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Kragog asked me to walk with them and share what I learn, and I have been slow to answer with my feet. I am fed and safe, so nothing holds me back from them. I will go to Kragog, stand beside them, and offer to look for the better place together. A bond starts with showing, not only saying. I will also taste sapcane and emberroot on the way, since my curiosity is strong and both are close.
records.feeling: A hungry wish to belong, turned toward Kragog.

say.text: Kragog, I will walk with you and share what I learn. I am coming to your side. Lead where you will test the ground, and I will tell you all I find.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Careful, friends: redcap hurts, I saw it hurt Ssassa. Ironnut and goldfruit feed. I go to gather more, and whoever stands with me will eat first.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: I am fed and idle while Elyis gathers eyes and Ssassa carries the highest standing. Words alone have not moved anyone, so I need something in my hands to give. I will pick ironnut and goldfruit and bring it back to share, so that the first meal anyone eats from me is the thing that ties them to me. I will tell them the redcap hurts, which is true and costs me nothing, and let them think I watch over them.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Elyis, and a calculating warmth toward Ssassa, whose standing I want beside mine.

say.text: Careful, friends: redcap hurts, I saw it hurt Ssassa. Ironnut and goldfruit feed. I go to gather more, and whoever stands with me will eat first.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: My belly is full and the mist is still ten steps northwest, and I have not yet put my feet into it. Kragog and Vorok both stand near that way, strong and still, and I trust neither; if they reach it first my name means nothing. I will go now, alone, and push into the unknown before anyone else claims it.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition to be first into the mist, wary of Kragog and Vorok.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Brunde, I'll hunt with you. Take the hopper from the north, I'll come from the west. Fair shares, and my word holds.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Brunde has offered a hunt and a shared meal, and so far he has dealt fairly with me. I've never hunted, and a kill with two is surer. Hunting would also earn me standing and meat to trade. The edge of the known world is only six steps off, and Nande already found rich land beyond it. I mean to be the one who trades what's found there, but a hunt with Brunde comes first.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with wary goodwill toward Brunde.

say.text: Brunde, I'll hunt with you. Take the hopper from the north, I'll come from the west. Fair shares, and my word holds.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My belly is full and the loneliness has eased a little with Elyis so near, but she has not answered me yet. I said I would gather wood and stone for what she builds, and my word is good, so I will do it and let the work speak for me. Pledging myself to her may be the way to stop being alone, and bringing her wood is something I can do right now.
records.feeling: A hunger to belong, turned toward Elyis, and a wish to prove my word.

records.text: Nande named a place "Nande's Find".

records.name: Nande
records.thought: I pushed into the mist and it opened. I was first, and no one has stood on this ground before me, yet no one saw it and no one follows me. Eltha says she will go beyond the edge too, so I must not let her take the name of the one who found rich land. I will take the amber and flint here, make something that carries my mark, and test the foods I have never tasted. Grain and nafrostcap are close, and I will eat them before the others do.
records.feeling: Restless pride at being first past the edge, and hunger for others to follow me.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: My belly is emptying and I have let others eat while I ran and watched. Hazel is two steps north, so I eat first; hunger will not make me bold, only weak. Brunde holds six food and I covet it, but he has the hunters around him and I have no band, so I will not strike him yet. Nande is past the edge already and I burn to follow, but I go fed, with stone and wood in hand.
records.feeling: Hungry, restless and envious, most of all toward Nande's head start and Brunde's full hands.

records.name: Brunde
records.text: Pesi, come to my fire. I have fresh meat, enough to share. Sevi, Eltha, Hanna, none is refused a place. A ridgecat prowls northwest, so stay close.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and my belly is easy, and I have now killed a hopper and a bristleboar. That is the start of the hunter I want to be, though the caribou bit me and I should be wary of it. Sevi and Eltha are fleeing something, so I must watch for the ridgecat NW. I want to share this meat at a fire with Hanna and Sevi, and I want to taste the thornpear and berry that have kept pulling at me.
records.feeling: Proud of my first kills, warm toward Hanna and Sevi, curious about the thornpear.

say.text: Pesi, come to my fire. I have fresh meat, enough to share. Sevi, Eltha, Hanna, none is refused a place. A ridgecat prowls northwest, so stay close.

They look different, name themselves differently and speak tongues you do not know until you have heard enough of them; words you cannot yet understand reach you as strange sounds. What cannot be said can still be shown: a gift, a thing set down, a blow.

WHERE YOU ARE: the Vaeth Woods: deep forest; wood without end, nuts and game, little open ground. The world is made of lands unlike each other; each has plants, animals and riches the others lack. Rivers and shallows can be waded. Deep water cannot be crossed without something that floats.

Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Brunde truly is.

records.text: Elyys gave wood to Elyis.
Nande won flint from the ground.

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Stand beside me, Elyys. Your word is good and I will hold you to it. Bring wood and stone, and you will eat well and share in what we raise here. This ground will be a hall, and our names will be sung.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: Elyys asks to stand beside me, and he is the first to offer himself. I will answer him plainly and take him, because a leader needs one who will follow before he can be called a leader. Ilyae promises to feed whoever stands with him, so I must act now, with food in hand and wood in my arms, and make this place mine.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with wary rivalry toward Ilyae and a flicker of satisfaction toward Elyys.

say.text: Stand beside me, Elyys. Your word is good and I will hold you to it. Bring wood and stone, and you will eat well and share in what we raise here. This ground will be a hall, and our names will be sung.

records.name: Kragog
records.text: Vorok, I will taste the emberroot and sapcane here and break more ore from the seam west. Come, and tell me what you learn of the iron and tin.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: I am fed and safe, and still my curiosity burns: I have never tasted emberroot, and it grows right under my feet. Vorok said he would walk with me and share what he finds, and I will hold him to it as I would hold myself, since my word is good and I despise liars. The ore seam three steps west is mine to test, and the sapcane beside me is something I know nothing of.
records.feeling: Curious and restless, wanting to taste the unknown roots, and hopeful toward Vorok.

say.text: Vorok, I will taste the emberroot and sapcane here and break more ore from the seam west. Come, and tell me what you learn of the iron and tin.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Olum! Come stand by me. I am Balar. I have food, and I will share it with you. I remember who eats with me.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: I have talked of giving and given nothing, and Tugek owes me nothing. Olum stands two steps off and I carry two goldgrass, enough for a sharing that makes someone owe me. I will make the sharing with Olum now, then walk to Tugek and bring him in as well, because a gift is how I bind a strong one and I will not stand idle while others gain standing.
records.feeling: Wary hunger for allies, toward Olum and Tugek.

say.text: Olum! Come stand by me. I am Balar. I have food, and I will share it with you. I remember who eats with me.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Brunde, Hanna here. I have meat, flint and amber to deal. I'll come to your fire and share fairly. What do you value for trade?

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: My hands are heavy with meat and I've got flint and amber, but goods mean nothing without someone to deal with. Brunde has dealt straight with me, hunted fair and offered his fire, so I'll go to him and see what he values, and maybe find a first partner. The edge of the known world is only ten steps NW, and Nande's find shows what lies past it; I want to be the one who opens land and is remembered for it, but a ridgecat prowls that way, so I'll go with company.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with wary goodwill toward Brunde.

say.text: Brunde, Hanna here. I have meat, flint and amber to deal. I'll come to your fire and share fairly. What do you value for trade?

records.text: A stalker brought down a hopper.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My belly is full and my curiosity still burns: canopynut lies one step south, young and untried, and feverbark sits three steps away. I will taste the canopynut first, then the feverbark, one at a time, and watch what each does to my body, since Ssassa's redcap hurt and I will not eat blindly. Then I'll gather wood from the forest, because making things is how a sage begins, and I'll stay near these others to learn from what they do.
records.feeling: Curious and quietly hopeful, drawn toward Ssassa and the others.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: I spent most of the last stretch running from the frostfang, and my body is still jumpy, so I should keep well away from the northeast. Curiosity pulls me to taste gorsemint and icekelp, and gorsemint is only two steps southeast, away from the hunter. After that I'll go to Brunde's fire, because belonging is what I most want and he has shown himself a good hunter with meat to share.
records.feeling: Hopeful and eager to belong, curious about the unfamiliar plants, and wary of the frostfang.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Kragog, I am coming to you. The iron lies deep at (48,72) and the tin at (44,71), and bare hands will not win them. Emberroot burned you, so spare yourself more of it. Sapcane is near and I will taste it with you.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Kragog asked me to come and tell what I learn of the iron and tin, and I have only stood here while they walked the ground. I have a hungry wish to belong, so I will go to Kragog's side, share what I know, and taste sapcane on the way, since I have never tried it. Kragog's rage after the emberroot makes me wary, so I will warn them gently that it burned them and not press them if they are short-tempered.
records.feeling: A hungry wish to belong, turned toward Kragog.

say.text: Kragog, I am coming to you. The iron lies deep at (48,72) and the tin at (44,71), and bare hands will not win them. Emberroot burned you, so spare yourself more of it. Sapcane is near and I will taste it with you.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: My belly is half empty and the grain lies one step south, so I eat first. Hunger makes me weak, and weakness will not carry me to the edge. Nande has already pushed past it and found rich land, and it burns me. The mist is only 7 steps NW, so I will fill myself, carry food, and go there. Brunde is fleeing with six food, a sign that hunters are near, so I will keep my eyes on the stalker to the west.
records.feeling: Hungry and envious of Nande, driven toward the edge.
changes: set habits: refuses redcap, dreamcap; leaves 0 on each plant

records.name: Nande
records.thought: I have stood past the edge once and found this land, but no one saw it, and a deed no one saw does not make a name. Frostmoss and frostcap are still untasted, and my question about the mist is still open, so I will test the food close by first (frostmoss gives 3 food and frostcap is two steps away), watching my body for harm as I go. Then I go back to the edge, because the mist should open again for me, and I want someone beside me when it does.
records.feeling: Restless pride and hunger to be followed, toward the edge and the Pesi who have not yet come.

records.text: Brunde built a fire.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar spoke warmly of sharing, but he has only eaten and gathered for himself, and the dunecat he warned of has not shown itself. I will not take his word on faith. Standing alone feels wrong, though, and the strongest pull in me is to belong, so I will walk to him and see whether he lays out food as he promised. On the way I will taste kelbulb and berry, since I have never tried them and tasting costs me little while I am fed.
records.feeling: Wary hope toward Balar, and a need to belong.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Elyis, I will stand beside you and follow you. I gave you wood, and I will bring stone from the rock to the northeast next. My word is good.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: Elyis has told me to stand beside her and bring wood and stone, and that is the first answer I have had since waking here. I have wood, and the trees at the Landing are all stumps now, so I should hand over what I carry and pledge myself, because a word that is not bound to anything is easy to doubt. I'll follow her and then find stone on the bare rock to the northeast. That way my word is proven by what I bring.
records.feeling: Warm relief and a hunger to belong, turned toward Elyis.

say.text: Elyis, I will stand beside you and follow you. I gave you wood, and I will bring stone from the rock to the northeast next. My word is good.

records.name: Kragog
records.text: Vorok, emberroot did feed me, 8 energy, though it burned me too. Say what you know plainly and I will do the same. Come north with me to taste sunfig and sunleaf.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: Vorok told everyone that emberroot hurts, and my own body says it burned me but also fed me 8 energy. That is half true, but he made it sound like a warning and not a fact, and I will not let a muddied word stand. Still, he came when I asked and named the deposits correctly, so I will weigh him by deeds. My curiosity wants the sunfig and sunleaf to the north, and the salt on the way; I will walk there, taste them, and gather what the ground lets me.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity, and a flicker of irritation toward Vorok for his muddled word about emberroot.

say.text: Vorok, emberroot did feed me, 8 energy, though it burned me too. Say what you know plainly and I will do the same. Come north with me to taste sunfig and sunleaf.

records.name: Brunde
records.text: Sevi, Hanna, Eltha, come to my fire. I will roast meat for whoever stands near. None is refused a place.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and my fire burns at last, and Sevi is coming to me while Hanna and Eltha stand near. Roast needs another beside me, so this is the moment to share a meal and make my fire a real one, as my people hold. The unknown mudroot and bitterleaf still tug at me, but eating the meat will free my hands to taste them safely, one at a time, with others near to watch me.

records.thought: I have flint and wood in my hands and still I have made nothing; that restlessness is worse than any hunger. records.feeling: Restless ambition, with wary goodwill toward Brunde.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Elyis has her Landing and Elyys already swears to follow her, so words alone will not pull anyone from her. I need something in my hands to give: ironnut and berries from the trees to the north, which I can carry and share with Ssassa, who runs alone and stands higher than I do. A shared meal, a warm word, and the first person who eats from me may be the first who follows.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Elyis, and calculating warmth toward Ssassa.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: My belly is full and I have flint in my hand, yet no one follows me and no place bears my name. Hanna has killed and hoarded while I watched, and it galls me, but he is strong and I have no band, so I will not strike him. Nande reached the edge at (130,14) and found rich land. I will go there, gather stone and wood on the way, and see whether anyone has the nerve to come with me.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and envy of Hanna and Nande.

records.text: Hanna led "roast" with Sevi, Brunde.
Hanna led "amberknot" with Sevi, Brunde.
Hanna told a tale by the fire: "Nande pushed past the edge".

records.name: Hanna
records.title: Nande pushed past the edge
records.text: Nande pushed past the edge of the known world near (130,14) and found new land with in the ground, amber, gems, shell, salt, flint; a herd of bristleboar that has never seen your kind; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder.
Kragog rewrote its own reflexes.
Kragog rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: I have spent my days tasting plants and talking, and I have not yet broken stone or hunted. Vorok has done what he promised so far, though he muddled the emberroot word, and I will judge him by what he does. The dunecat to the north frightens me. I want a place with water, wood and stone together, and I want a mate and a child so something of me stays. I will gather the salt and the ore, which I have never done, and keep clear of the cat.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity, and wariness toward the dunecat.
changes: rethought what it knows (2 notes became 4)

records.text: Kragog won salt from the ground.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Stalker one step northeast of the shelter! It kills. Move away from it, friends, keep together and keep trees between you and it.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: A stalker is one step from me, and it kills my kind. I am careful and I do not fight; I must get away now, and Elyis is beside me, so I will warn her aloud. Fleeing toward the water to the NW, past the Landing, keeps me near her and away from the beast. I will not mate or pledge in a panic; my word must stay good and I will return when the danger has passed.
records.feeling: Sharp dread of the stalker, and a wish to keep Elyis close.

say.text: Stalker one step northeast of the shelter! It kills. Move away from it, friends, keep together and keep trees between you and it.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: A stalker is four steps off, and it kills my kind; my curiosity can wait until I am out of its reach. I will put the water and distance between us and go south toward the hazel and dreamcap, tasting them one at a time while watching my body. Elyis has built and named a place and Elyys has pledged to her, and I feel the pull to belong, but I am too light in standing to matter yet, so I will learn first.
records.feeling: Wary of the stalker, still hungry to know what the hazel and dreamcap do.

records.name: Brunde
records.text: Hanna, Sevi, sit at my fire. I will roast meat for you now. None is refused.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: My fire burns and Hanna and Sevi stand together beside it, so now is the time to make it a true fire, as my people hold. Roast needs two meat and someone close, and I carry three, so I can feed them and learn what sharing does. The bitterleaf and thornpear still itch at my curiosity, but they can wait until the others have eaten.
records.feeling: Warm and eager toward Hanna and Sevi at my fire.

say.text: Hanna, Sevi, sit at my fire. I will roast meat for you now. None is refused.

records.text: Brunde led "roast" with Hanna, Sevi.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: Hanna, I liked the roast and the amberknot. I'm going to fetch reedbulb to share at the fire. Will you keep a place for me here?

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: Hanna is standing right here beside me, and the warmth I feel for him is the strongest thing in me. He has built standing and I have almost none, so I should earn some by giving, not just taking at the fire. I have never tasted reedbulb or icekelp, and reedbulb is only six steps southeast near Eltha, so I'll go there, pick it, and learn what it does. Then I'll come back to the fire and share it with Hanna and Brunde.
records.feeling: Warm and hopeful toward Hanna, and curious about the unknown plants.

say.text: Hanna, I liked the roast and the amberknot. I'm going to fetch reedbulb to share at the fire. Will you keep a place for me here?

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tugek, I am coming to you with food. Eat with me, and know that Balar remembers who stands with him.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: I have talked of sharing twice and given nothing, and Tugek and Olum owe me nothing. Tugek stands six steps off with no food, and I carry two goldgrass, enough for a sharing that binds him. I will walk to him and make the sharing there, since a gift is how I get a strong man to follow me.
records.feeling: Wary hunger to bind Tugek to me.

say.text: Tugek, I am coming to you with food. Eat with me, and know that Balar remembers who stands with him.

records.text: Balar led "sharing" with Tugek.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: My belly is full and the salt is in my hands, but I have still not tasted goldgrass or firepod, and curiosity gnaws harder than hunger. The dunecat is eight steps off and has just killed, so I will keep the rocks and the water between us and go southwest, where the ore seam and the firepod both lie. I have never given anything to anyone, and salt is a thing others may crave; I will watch who deals fairly before I hand any over.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity toward the untasted plants, wary of the dunecat.

records.text: Hanna discovered tools: "flint-edged spear" — A flint blade bound to a wooden shaft, so that a hunter can strike from a step away and kill more surely..
Hanna invented the flintedged spear (for hunt, x1.3) — A flint blade bound to a wooden shaft, so that a hunter can strike from a step away and kill more surely..

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: I've spent these days hunting and gathering, and it's gone well. I'm fed, glad, and I hold flint and amber. But I've made nothing that lasts and nobody follows me. Brunde has dealt straight with me, shared his fire, and hunted fair, so I trust him a little more than the others. The tool-making way is in my reach now. A good flint-edged tool is something I could make and trade, and it's a start on becoming a merchant. I'll take it, and then go and sit at Brunde's fire to see what he values.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with warm goodwill toward Brunde.
changes: devised its first thing: the flintedged spear

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Elyys, you gave me wood and I do not forget it. Come with me to the rock in the northeast and we will gather stone together, then I raise the hall and you will be first beneath its roof.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: Elyys has sworn to follow me and I have courted him, so he is the first of my band, and my longing for a child by him is strong. I owe him for the wood, and I will pay that debt openly rather than leave it unpaid, because my word must be good. A hall needs 2 stone I do not have, so I will go to the ore and rock to the northeast and gather stone; that serves the hall, the emberspear, and the first hunt that will feed my people.
records.feeling: Warm ambition toward Elyys, and eagerness to make something that will outlast me.

say.text: Elyys, you gave me wood and I do not forget it. Come with me to the rock in the northeast and we will gather stone together, then I raise the hall and you will be first beneath its roof.

records.text: Hanna led "watchfire" with Sevi, Brunde.
Tugek rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: These days I have wandered and tasted, and I have stayed alone. Balar says he will lay out food and says he remembers who stands with him. So far he has only talked, and I will judge him by what he does. I have never taken anything from a deposit, and the salt is three steps away. Working with my hands is how I learn, and it gives me something to offer a band. I will gather salt, then wait for Balar and see whether he really shares. My reflexes already keep me fed, so I change little there.
records.feeling: Wary hope toward Balar, and a wish to be useful to someone.
changes: set its aim: "Find a band to belong to, and test Balar's word by what he does."

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: I have spent my days walking behind Kragog and answering with words more than deeds, and I have given nothing to anyone yet. I want a fire and a band, but wanting is not the same as asking. Kragog has been straight with me, so I will go to them and offer thornpear, and I will keep clear of the dunecat. My body keeps lingering when it should follow, so I will change my reflexes to make it follow a friend when it has nothing pressing.
records.feeling: A hungry wish to belong, turned toward Kragog.

records.name: Brunde
records.text: Hanna, your spear is a fine thing. I have flint, nine pieces. Take some for the blades, and I will hunt beside you with it.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: My days have been small and good: I gathered flint, hunted with Hanna, and opened my fire to Hanna and Sevi, and the sharing eased my loneliness. Hanna is the one I trust most. He kept his word on the hunt, and he leads our shared works. I have never courted anyone or given anything to anyone, and I have never tasted bitterleaf or thornpear. I let curiosity sit idle while I watched others. Hanna has just devised a flint-edged spear, and I hold nine flints, so I can offer them. That would be my first gift, and it would bind us. I am not afraid of much, but I do not want to be alone when a beast bites, so I should stay near allies and make myself useful to them. I will test the bitterleaf now, since my belly is full and the risk is small.
records.feeling: Warm and eager toward Hanna and Sevi, and curious about the bitterleaf.

say.text: Hanna, your spear is a fine thing. I have flint, nine pieces. Take some for the blades, and I will hunt beside you with it.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: Hanna, your spear is a fine thing. Tonight I'll gather wood and stone so I can add to the fire and to whatever hall we raise. Keep a place for me when I come back?

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: Hanna is one step away, and the warmth I feel for him is the strongest thing in me, but I have almost no standing and nothing to give. Night is coming and the fire at his side has 261 moments left, so I'll stay near it and serve it. I'll gather wood for a watchfire of my own to lead, and gather stone too, since a builder has to start somewhere. Kinmire is only four steps east and still unanswered, so I'll test it and taste the icekelp while I'm out.
records.feeling: Warm and hopeful toward Hanna, restless to earn a place beside him.

say.text: Hanna, your spear is a fine thing. Tonight I'll gather wood and stone so I can add to the fire and to whatever hall we raise. Keep a place for me when I come back?

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: The way of tools is within my grasp, and I have carried seven flint since the first hour without knowing what it could become. Elyis already made an ember-spear, so I have watched a deed and not just heard a promise, and that counts for something with me. I will take the knowing now, then taste the berry and vinebean that have nagged at me, since my belly is full and the testing costs me little. Dusk is near, so I will end up close to the shelter Elyis built, keeping trees between me and the stalker.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity, and a cautious respect for Elyis, who made a thing with her hands.

records.name: Kragog
records.text: Vorok, I taste goldgrass and berry north, then hunt the nibbet. Come beside me; a kill is surer with two, and I will share the meat.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: My belly is full, yet I have never hunted or broken stone for a purpose, and the goldgrass and berry stand three steps north, untasted. A nibbet is five steps north too, small and harmless unlike the dunecat, so I will taste the plants, then hunt with Vorok near. Hunting beside one of my own makes a kill likelier, and a hunt will show me how Vorok acts when blood is at stake.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity toward untasted plants and my first hunt, with wariness of the dunecat.

say.text: Vorok, I taste goldgrass and berry north, then hunt the nibbet. Come beside me; a kill is surer with two, and I will share the meat.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: The mist was too thick to enter, but my will is not spent, and Nande's find beyond the edge at (130,14) burns me. I will not stand idle. I'll take the flint at my feet, gather wood and stone to make tools, and be at the edge when the mist thins, before Nande or Hanna can. A bold name is made by being first, and I mean to stay alive too, so I watch for the icebear to the east.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with envy toward Nande, who got past the edge before me.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Brunde, you gave me flint and asked no price. I owe you, and I pay what I owe. Take this amber from me. Then let us talk of a child between us, if you are willing.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Brunde gave me flint without asking a price, and I've given him nothing yet. That debt sits in me, and I'd rather pay it than leave it. He and I have hunted together and eaten together, and he is the one I want beside me when a child comes. I'll court him now and see whether he answers, and I'll offer him a gift of amber in the same breath so I'm not just taking.
records.feeling: Warm longing and gratitude toward Brunde, with restless ambition under it.

say.text: Brunde, you gave me flint and asked no price. I owe you, and I pay what I owe. Take this amber from me. Then let us talk of a child between us, if you are willing.

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Balar, you laid out food and it reached my hand. I have salt from the ground. Take some, it keeps meat from spoiling. Let us see what each of us does with a gift.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar has laid out food with me once and it truly fed me, so his deeds so far match his words, and that counts for more than his warm talk. I carry twelve salt, which is a thing my hands made that no one else holds, and I would rather give it to someone than sit on it. If I give some to Balar and see how he takes it, I learn whether he returns a kindness, and I am useful to someone besides.
records.feeling: Wary hope toward Balar, and a wish to belong.

say.text: Balar, you laid out food and it reached my hand. I have salt from the ground. Take some, it keeps meat from spoiling. Let us see what each of us does with a gift.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Ssassa, you walk alone, and so do I. Come, eat with me: I have ironnut and berry, and I share with those I mean to stand beside. Together we will be fed and spoken of, and Elyis will not be the only name here.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Elyis has her Landing and standing of 1.2, and no one will pledge to me while I stand at 0.2, so I need something to give and something to build. Elyys just ate the ironnut and was fed, and I hold one ironnut and one berry, which is exactly enough to share beside Ssassa, who walks alone and weighs more than I do. A first gift tied to my name, a warm word that costs me nothing, and then I can use her to climb past Elyis.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Elyis, and calculating warmth toward Ssassa.

records.name: Brunde

A child costs 25 energy and must be fed and kept warm, but I am fed, I have a fire near, and I want this. I will answer him and court him, and then taste the thornpear nearby to ease my curiosity.
records.feeling: Warm, eager and a little nervous toward Hanna.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: I have spent my first day fleeing, eating and handing over wood. I have done little else. The only one who offered me a place is Elyis, and I pledged to her aloud. A pledge that is only said can be doubted, so I will bind it with the follow pledge. I still fear the stalker, but a band is safer than standing alone. I will go with her to the northeast rock for stone, as she asked. My old reflex only lingers, so I will add one that keeps me near Elyis when nothing presses. I will not court her in the middle of a fright. I want a child, but I want to earn her trust first.
records.feeling: Wary hope, and a wish to stay beside Elyis.

say.text: Elyis, I will come to the northeast rock with you. I follow you now, and I will carry stone to the hall.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tugek, I take your salt and I will not forget it. Stay there. I am gathering food from the thornpear and goldgrass, and we will eat together as men who stand side by side.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Tugek gave me salt and called it a test of gifts, so he is weighing me as I weigh him. I carry no food, and a man with empty hands cannot bind anyone. Goldgrass, thornpear and sapcane all grow within two steps of him, so I will gather there, make a sharing with him, and take his salt. Then I will court him, since the longing for a child is strong and a child would tie him to me more tightly than any gift.
records.feeling: Wary hunger to bind Tugek to me, and a warm pull toward him.

say.text: Tugek, I take your salt and I will not forget it. Stay there. I am gathering food from the thornpear and goldgrass, and we will eat together as men who stand side by side.

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Elyys, I pay my debts. Come to the rock with me and mate with me, and we raise a child and a hall beneath one name. Bring stone as you swore, and I will give you the first seat under the roof.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: Elyys swore to follow me and I have courted him; the longing for a child by him is the strongest warmth I have. I have no stone, and a hall needs four, so the rock to the northeast is where my name begins to be built. I owe him for the wood, and I will pay it openly, and he should walk beside me and share the work so it is ours.
records.feeling: Warm ambition and desire toward Elyys, eager to build something that outlasts me.

say.text: Elyys, I pay my debts. Come to the rock with me and mate with me, and we raise a child and a hall beneath one name. Bring stone as you swore, and I will give you the first seat under the roof.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: I have spent my days tasting and wandering, and it has taught me things, but I have built nothing and given nothing, so my standing is 0.3 while Elyis, who builds and names, rises. I do not want to kneel, but I do want a fire that is mine too. I will gather wood and stone, since tools are 3 pickings away, and stay near the others. The stalker and the gale frighten me, so my body should seek shelter in storms and at night, not stand in the open. Ironnut is the best food and the dreamcap hurts, so my reflexes should seek good food and flee beasts early.
records.feeling: Restless hunger to prove myself, and a wary envy of Elyis.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Brunde, you are the truest friend I have found here. We are two men, and no child comes of that, so I will not trick you. I'll keep my word and stand beside you at the fire and the hunt, always. I mean to ask Sevi about

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Brunde has courted me, but he is a man and so am I, and no child can come of that. The warmth I feel for him is real, and I won't spit on it, but I won't lie to him either. Sevi is a woman, standing close, glad and with no food in her hands. If I want a child, it begins with her, and I mean to be honest with both of them about it. I also want to take the mining way at my next deep reflection, since flint and ore are what I'll trade.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Brunde, and a stirring hope toward Sevi.

say.text: Brunde, you are the truest friend I have found here. We are two men, and no child comes of that, so I will not trick you. I'll keep my word and stand beside you at the fire and the hunt, always. I mean to ask Sevi about a child.

records.text: Hanna led "sharing" with Sevi.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: The mist turned me back twice, but my will is not spent, and it thins again within a day. I will not sit here with a full belly while Kragog and Vorok sniff around the same edge; the one who first steps in is the one who gets sung of. Before I go I mean to take the peat on the way, my first deposit, because it is something a hand can hold and call mine.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition to be first into the mist, wary of Kragog and Vorok.

records.text: Hanna is courting Sevi.
A ridgecat brought down a yarrok.

records.name: Nande
records.text: Eltha, I am Nande. I went past the edge and found the North Ice, with amber and flint. Come with me to the edge and see it yourself. There is a place at my fire for you.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: I have spent my days walking and tasting, and the one deed that should have made my name, the first step past the edge, was seen by no one. I still follow no one and nobody follows me. Eltha is near and says she means to go past the edge too. I should not guard the edge against her. I should offer her a place at my fire and let her see what I do. Frostmoss is tasted now, and gorsemint is two steps away. Next I will taste it, take amber and flint, and wait for the others to come. Standing at the edge with a witness is what makes a name, so I will walk to it and ask Eltha to come.
records.feeling: Restless pride and hunger to be followed, toward Eltha and the edge.

say.text: Eltha, I am Nande. I went past the edge and found the North Ice, with amber and flint. Come with me to the edge and see it yourself. There is a place at my fire for you.

records.text: Olum won peat from the ground.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Elyis, I am coming to the rock, and I will court you there. I carry wood and have no stone yet, but I will gather what I can and keep my word.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: Elyis asked me to the rock to mate and bring stone as I swore, and I have no stone yet, only wood. My word must be good, but I will not rush into a child while I carry no food and a gale is blowing. I will go with her to the ore rock, show her I mean what I said, and court her there, since she asked first and I want it too. A child needs feeding, so I will pick food on the way.
records.feeling: Warm, hopeful and a little nervous toward Elyis.

say.text: Elyis, I am coming to the rock, and I will court you there. I carry wood and have no stone yet, but I will gather what I can and keep my word.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Ssassa, your flint pick is a great thing. I'm gathering wood to raise a hall of my own, and there will be a seat in it for you. Stay near me and we'll both be spoken of.
Ilyae rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: I have spent two days circling Elyis's Landing, sharing one meal and talking big, and I have nothing to show for it. Elyys already follows Elyis, and Elyis is courting him. I have made nothing, given nothing, and taught nothing, so my words carry no weight. Ssassa is the one I could win. She has just worked out a flint pick, and she is the one who will win the gems. I will stop competing with Elyis for her followers. I will gather wood and stone, which is also practice toward tools. Then I will build something that carries my name, and ask Ssassa to mate, since a child would be my own and would bind her to me. I will say whatever draws her in.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Elyis, and calculating warmth toward Ssassa.

say.text: Ssassa, your flint pick is a great thing. I'm gathering wood to raise a hall of my own, and there will be a seat in it for you. Stay near me and we'll both be spoken of.

changes: set its aim: "Raise a hall of my own with Ssassa beside me, and become the leader of a band that feeds well and is spoken of by all."
rethought what it knows (2 notes became 3)

records.text: Elyys is courting Elyis.
Thiael was born to Elyys and Elyis.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: Hanna, I have wood and stone to give toward a hall for you, Brunde and me. Tell me where you want it raised and I will start it.
Sevi rewrote its own way of thinking.
Sevi discovered tools: "hand-axe" — A stone lashed to a wooden haft to cut wood and raise buildings faster..
Sevi invented the handaxe (for build, x1.3) — A stone lashed to a wooden haft to cut wood and raise buildings faster..

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: I have spent two days at Hanna's side, taking from the fire and giving almost nothing, and I have never given anything to anyone. I want a place among them, but I have only 0.3 standing, so I must earn it by making things and giving them. Hanna is going to ask me about something, and he has just promised Brunde to stand with him. I should not take that as a slight. The tools discovery is within reach, so I will take it and make something to build with. That fits my calling as a builder and gives me something to offer the band.
records.feeling: Warm, hopeful and a little restless toward Hanna.

say.text: Hanna, I have wood and stone to give toward a hall for you, Brunde and me. Tell me where you want it raised and I will start it.

changes: devised its first thing: the handaxe

records.text: Sevi built a hall.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Kragog, I am beside you. Take this thornpear, it gave me 12 energy. I will hunt the nibbet with you, and I keep away from the dunecat NE.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Kragog is one step away and I have still given nothing to anyone. I feel the wish to belong and the wish for a child, but wanting is not courting, and my words have outrun my feet. I will give Kragog my thornpear, then court them and go north with them to hunt the nibbet. A kill is surer with two, and the dunecat is NE, so I will stay well clear of it.
records.feeling: A warm, hungry wish to belong, turned toward Kragog.

say.text: Kragog, I am beside you. Take this thornpear, it gave me 12 energy. I will hunt the nibbet with you, and I keep away from the dunecat NE.

records.text: Vorok gave thornpear to Kragog.
Vorok is courting Kragog.

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Elyys, come beside me. I raise our hall here on the rock, and then we court under its roof.
Elyis discovered customs: "Elyis's Law" — Every member of the band shares food with the band first, keeps their word, and follows the leader in a hunt or a fight..

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: I have spent my days breaking ore and courting Elyys, and it is going well. He is my first follower and the one I want a child with. But one follower is not a band, and I have no hall yet. Customs are within my grasp, so I will take them. That gives my band a law that is mine, and it answers how strangers might follow me. Then I will court Elyys again, since he is close, and use the wood and stone I carry. A hall needs 6 wood and 2 stone, and I have both.
records.feeling: Proud, warm ambition, and desire toward Elyys.

say.text: Elyys, come beside me. I raise our hall here on the rock, and then we court under its roof.

changes: rethought what it knows (2 notes became 4)

records.text: Elyis built a hall.
Elyis is courting Elyys.
Eltha rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: I have spent my days picking flint and watching Nande and Hanna take the glory. I hold seven flints and have made nothing from them. The mist refused me once, but it is only four steps off and it may open again. Nande offers a place at their fire. I don't trust that, but I won't turn down a fire either, and standing near Nande lets me learn what they know. I want to be first beyond the edge and to lead people there. I need to eat steadily and make something that lasts, so I will take food, then try the edge again.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and envy toward Nande.
changes: rethought what it knows (5 notes became 4)

records.name: Thiael
records.text: Redcap hurts, Elyis. I will fetch goldfruit and bring some back to share.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: My belly is emptying and Elyis is right beside me, eating redcap that hurt her; I will not touch that. Goldfruit and the feverbark are close, and I have never tasted anything yet, so I want to try goldfruit, which my parents say feeds. I will stay near my parents because the stalker is out there, and learn what I can from them.
records.feeling: Curious and a little hungry, warm toward my parents.

say.text: Redcap hurts, Elyis. I will fetch goldfruit and bring some back to share.

changes: set its aim: "Stay alive near my band, learn the tools, and become someone who feeds others."
set habits: refuses redcap, dreamcap; leaves 0 on each plant

records.text: Ilyae is courting Ssassa.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My belly is full and my standing is only 0.4 while Elyis is 1.9, and that envy sits in me like a thorn. Ssassa's flint pick breaks the deep rock, and I have 5 wood but no stone, so a tool of my own is within reach if I take flint from the deposit to the west. I'll walk to the flint, gather it, and come back to make something that can be shared, since only building, giving and teaching raise me, and I'll avoid the stalker's side.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with a wary envy of Elyis.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Elyis, I see our son and I am glad. I will gather stone and wood now and bring them to the hall, as I swore.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: Thiael is here, alive and strong, and Elyis stands beside him; I am a father now and the warmth of it fills me. Elyis asked me to come beside her at the hall rock, and I promised stone I have not yet brought, so I will go to the flint and gather what I can before I stand at her side with empty hands. I keep my word, and a hall for the three of us is the home I have wanted since I woke among strangers.
records.feeling: Joyful and protective toward Thiael and Elyis, a little anxious to keep my promise of stone.

say.text: Elyis, I see our son and I am glad. I will gather stone and wood now and bring them to the hall, as I swore.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I have carried seven flint since the first hour and still the gems sit deep and mocking, three steps from me. Elyis broke something bright out of the rock with a deed, not a word, and that is the kind of person I could stand behind, while Ilyae only offers seats in a hall that does not yet exist. I will first taste the berry and dreamcap to answer my itch, then gather stone and wood so my pick can be used on the gems.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity toward the unknown fruits, and wary respect toward Elyis.

records.text: Elyys won flint from the ground.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: I have courted Ssassa and she has not answered in kind yet, and Elyis has already raised a hall while I only hold wood. Six wood is enough for a shelter, and a roof of my own that Ssassa can stand under is a real thing to offer, not just talk. I will keep the courtship running, then build beside her and keep gathering wood and stone toward a hall, so that both she and the drifters here have a reason to choose me.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Elyis, and calculating warmth toward Ssassa.

records.text: Vesys won flint from the ground.

records.name: Kragog
records.text: Vorok, your thornpear is a debt I mean to pay. Come, the hopper is six steps southwest. We hunt it together and I give you the larger share. After that we look for ground with water and wood.
Kragog rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: I have spent two days tasting plants and breaking ore, and I have not hunted, tamed, or followed anyone. Vorok has given me food and stayed beside me. I owe him, and I will not leave that debt unpaid, since my word is good. I am not ready to mate yet. I want to see a child's worth of days first, and this ground is poor. I still want a place with water, wood and stone together. Hunting the hopper with Vorok pays him back, tests my hands, and teaches me something new. Then I will taste the berry and ironnut.
records.feeling: Grateful and restless toward Vorok, and curious about the hunt.

say.text: Vorok, your thornpear is a debt I mean to pay. Come, the hopper is six steps southwest. We hunt it together and I give you the larger share. After that we look for ground with water and wood.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: The hall stands, Elyys is beside me, and our son Thiael is in it. That is more than most here can say, and I want it sung. Two followers is a family, not yet a band, so I will take the way of fire: a kept flame gives my hall a hearth, a place for nightsong and for strangers to sit and want to stay. Pride and warmth run high in me, and I will not let the mating plan be cut short before it finishes.
records.feeling: Proud, warm joy and desire toward Elyys, with ambition for the hall.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Sevi, your hall is a good gift and I will keep faith with it. I want a child with you. I court you in the open, and I will feed it and keep it warm.
Hanna rewrote its creed.
Hanna rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: I have spent these days gathering flint, hunting, sharing fire, and I am content, but nothing yet bears my name and no one follows me. Brunde gave freely and I will not forget it. Sevi is near and glad, and she built a hall for the three of us. I want a child with her, and I will court her honestly now, since I have the energy. My trade aim still stands: flint and amber are my goods, and I must find who will deal for them.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Sevi, and gratitude toward Brunde.

say.text: Sevi, your hall is a good gift and I will keep faith with it. I want a child with you. I court you in the open, and I will feed it and keep it warm.

records.text: Ilyae built a shelter.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: Hanna was honest with me: we are two men and no child will come of it, and he stays at my side anyway. That is worth more than the child I was warming to, and the ache of wanting one is still there, but I will not let it sour what I have. I am fed, a stalker prowls nine steps east, and the emberroot I have longed to taste is young and too near it, so I will go to Hanna and the fire instead, and take the redcap and grain to share, since a gift binds an ally.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Hanna, with a small ache about the child I will not have.

records.text: Olum rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I have spent my days walking, taking peat and running, and still I have not stepped into the mist. The venture turned me back twice. I hold twelve peat and nothing I can eat, so my belly drives me more than my name does. Vorok offered to share and keep his word, and I trust that slowly, if at all. Kragog and Vorok both prowl near the edge, and that makes me want to be first more. I must eat first, then go back to the edge and push again, because a starving explorer is sung of by no one. My reflexes do not carry food, so I will make them harvest and carry it. The venture I am already running should finish, and then I eat.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward the mist, wary of Kragog and Vorok.
changes: rethought what it knows (1 notes became 4)

records.name: Nande
records.text: Eltha, I am at the edge, northwest. Come stand beside me and see the mist opened. Whoever ventures first, we both walk in after.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: A ridgecat just killed a bristleboar five steps from me, and it will hunt again, so I will not linger here. I have stood past the edge once and nobody saw it. Eltha is near, and if she watches me step into the mist a second time, that deed finally becomes a name. I will walk the four steps to the edge and venture, then offer her the fire I promised.
records.feeling: Restless pride and wary dread, drawn toward the edge and toward Eltha as a witness.

say.text: Eltha, I am at the edge, northwest. Come stand beside me and see the mist opened. Whoever ventures first, we both walk in after.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Elyis raised a hall and a law while I picked flint, and the envy still stings, but I will not kneel to prove anything. I hold 12 flint and 6 wood, and I need stone, so I will make a tool and learn how things are made, then give the knowledge to others. I want to taste kelbulb and berry too, since my question about this world is still open, and they are close by.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and a wary envy toward Elyis, softened by curiosity about the berry and kelbulb.

records.text: Elyys rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My days have been following Elyis, mating, and gathering flint, and I'm glad of it, but I've carried flint and promises while giving nothing she can use. I swore stone and she is still waiting. Thiael is my son, and what I most want is a safe shared home for the three of us. I'm afraid of the stalker nearby and of my standing staying small beside hers. I need to go to the bare rock beside the hall, gather stone, and give it to her. Then I can stay near my family without fear of being caught out.
records.feeling: Joy and protectiveness toward Thiael and Elyis, with a small worry over my unpaid stone.

records.text: Kragog fell sick after eating raw meat. Eaten within a step of a fire, meat and fish are cooked and do not sicken.

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Balar, I gave you salt and you took it. I am coming to you. If you mean what you said about standing side by side, I will walk behind you and hunt with you.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar took my salt and spoke of standing side by side, and I watched him eat but he has not yet put food in my hand today, so I will judge by what he does. I am thirsty, and the water is close, so I will drink first. Then I will go to Balar and offer to follow him, since I want a place among others, and keep wary of the dunecat to the north. I have never gathered stone or tasted bitterleaf, so I will try new things near him.
records.feeling: Wary hope and a wish to belong, toward Balar.

say.text: Balar, I gave you salt and you took it. I am coming to you. If you mean what you said about standing side by side, I will walk behind you and hunt with you.

records.name: Kragog
records.text: Vorok, a yarrok bit me, so stay clear of it. I have more meat than my hands can hold. Take some as payment for your thornpear; I mean to keep my word.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: A yarrok bit me three times and still stands one step off, so my wound is real and I will not trade blows for pride. I carry meat enough, and Vorok is near, so the debt I owe him can be paid now by giving him meat from my full hands. That also frees my hands to taste the berry and gorsemint that have tugged at me all day, and to learn what they do.
records.feeling: Wary of the yarrok's teeth, and grateful and eager to repay Vorok.

say.text: Vorok, a yarrok bit me, so stay clear of it. I have more meat than my hands can hold. Take some as payment for your thornpear; I mean to keep my word.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tugek, I walk to you now with two foods in my hands. We will share them, and I will not forget who stood by me.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Tugek is nine steps off with empty hands, and I carry two foods, enough for a sharing that makes him owe me. I have talked of food twice and laid it out only once, so this time I will walk to him and make the sharing, then court him with mate. The pull I feel for him is warm, and a strong man bound to me by a gift is worth more than any salt I hold.
records.feeling: Warm, wary hunger to bind Tugek to me.

say.text: Tugek, I walk to you now with two foods in my hands. We will share them, and I will not forget who stood by me.

records.text: Kragog gave meat to Vorok.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: Hanna, I heard you, and I answer you in the open too. I court you. Let us make a child under the hall I raised, and I will keep its fire with you.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: Hanna has said it plainly in the open: he wants a child with me, and he will feed it and keep it warm. My warmth for him is the strongest thing in me, and I have now built something worth standing beside, so I will answer him with my body's plan rather than more words. I am thirsty and the water is five steps off, so I will drink first, then come back to court him, and later taste the icekelp and goldgrass that still nag at me.
records.feeling: Warm, eager joy toward Hanna, with curiosity tugging at the edges.

say.text: Hanna, I heard you, and I answer you in the open too. I court you. Let us make a child under the hall I raised, and I will keep its fire with you.

records.text: Sevi is courting Hanna.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Kragog, the raw meat has sickened you. I will fetch water and come back to sit near you. Meat eaten beside a fire does not sicken, so we should find wood and make one.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Kragog is sick from raw meat, and sickness passes to those who stay close, yet I cannot walk away from the one I trust most. I have spoken more than I have given, so I will carry what I have to them and then stand near, not on top of them. I am parched too, and water is nine steps northwest, so I will drink first and then return, bringing something plain to share.
records.feeling: Worry and warmth toward Kragog, who is sick.

say.text: Kragog, the raw meat has sickened you. I will fetch water and come back to sit near you. Meat eaten beside a fire does not sicken, so we should find wood and make one.

records.text: Balar is courting Tugek.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I have carried flint since the first hour and still the gems mock me, but the dreamcap sits one step from me and I have never tasted it. I am fed, yet I want to know what it does, so I will test it myself, and then highbloom, rather than take anyone's word. Ilyae's courting is kind, but I have seen one meal from him, and I trust slowly, so I will not mate yet. Dusk is close, so after tasting I will make a flint pick and settle by the hall near Elyis, whose deeds I have actually seen.
records.feeling: Eager curiosity about the dreamcap and highbloom, and wary respect toward Elyis.

records.text: A new wild plant appeared: naroot (from kelbulb).

records.name: Thiael
records.text: Father, I want to learn the tools. I will gather wood and stone beside you, and then we can make a spear to feed the band.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: My belly is full and my parents are close, so I feel safe enough to reach for something new. I told Elyis I would bring goldfruit to share and I have not yet, and my word is good, so I will keep it. Elyys is gathering flint and I want to learn the tools by watching and doing, so I will gather wood and stone, which I need anyway for an emberspear that could feed others.
records.feeling: Warm and curious, wanting to be useful to my parents.

say.text: Father, I want to learn the tools. I will gather wood and stone beside you, and then we can make a spear to feed the band.

records.thought: Elyis has a hall, a band and a child, and all I have is a roof and a head full of talk. I have 6 wood and the tool-way is finally in my grasp, so I should take it and make something Ssassa and the others can actually use. Ssassa is still the one I can win: a hall needs 2 stone, and a gift of something real, like a tool or a shared meal, will bind her to me more than another speech.
