records.name: Hanna
records.text: Sevi, I heard you and I am glad. I'll eat a bite, then come to you at the hall, and we will make our child there. Oswen is ours; I'll see him fed.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: My belly is emptying and thirst is on me, and an ironnut hangs one step away; I'll eat before anything else. Sevi has answered my courting and I am glad past words, so I mean to go to her under her hall and mate, to start on keeping my word to her. Oswen is my child, and I want food in my hands for him, and I want my name to start meaning something, not just flint and amber in a pouch.
records.feeling: Joy and warm longing toward Sevi, with fatherly protectiveness toward Oswen.

say.text: Sevi, I heard you and I am glad. I'll eat a bite, then come to you at the hall, and we will make our child there. Oswen is ours; I'll see him fed.

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Balar, I will stand beside you and share what you bring. A child is a heavy thing and I carry no food yet. Let me see more of your deeds first.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: My days have been walking, digging clay and salt, and following Balar. Balar's deeds so far match his words: he took my salt and came with food. The dunecat warning is still unproven. I want a place among others, and Balar is the one I trust most. A child is a heavy thing, and I carry no food, so I will not mate yet. I will first learn whether he is steady. I also want to learn what bitterleaf and redcap do. They are close, and I am fed, so tasting them costs little. I will stand by Balar and share food with him, then go and test the plants.
records.feeling: Wary hope and a wish to belong, toward Balar.

say.text: Balar, I will stand beside you and share what you bring. A child is a heavy thing and I carry no food yet. Let me see more of your deeds first.

records.text: Nande found the stone "Old Stone".

records.name: Oswen
records.text: I want to learn to make things. Come with me while I gather wood and stone, and show me the spear?

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: Hanna is nearer to Brunde than to me, and it burns, but I am small and standing at 0.4 gets me nothing by sulking. Sevi said standing comes from making, giving and building, and I have never gathered wood or stone, so I'll start there, since both go into a spear or handaxe. I want something of my own to make and give, and I'll stay close enough to my parents to be safe.
records.feeling: Jealous of Brunde for Hanna's closeness, but restless to earn a place of my own.

say.text: I want to learn to make things. Come with me while I gather wood and stone, and show me the spear?

changes: set its aim: "Earn standing by making tools and giving them to my kin and others"

records.name: Brunde
records.text: Oswen, I am Brunde. Come, sit by me. Flint can be struck for blades, and I will show you what I know of hunting and of which plants feed and which hurt.
Brunde taught Oswen. Oswen has now learned from 3 teachers.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: Hanna is going to Sevi's hall to make a child, and the jealousy burns, but he gave me his word to stand beside me at fire and hunt, and I will not sour that by sulking. I am fed and sheltered, so this is the time to test what I have never tasted: icekelp is young and emberroot is far, but dreamcap and the others are near. Oswen is a child with no one of his own, and I have never taught anyone anything. I can give him something and bind a small ally.
records.feeling: Jealousy toward Sevi, held down by trust in Hanna and curiosity about the unknown foods.

say.text: Oswen, I am Brunde. Come, sit by me. Flint can be struck for blades, and I will show you what I know of hunting and of which plants feed and which hurt.

changes: taught Oswen a lesson: "Sunleaf eases wounds, mudroot and hazel feed well, redcap and dreamcap hurt. Hunt beside another and the kill is likelier and the wound less likely."

records.text: Hanna is courting Sevi.
A new wild plant appeared: ruplainsroot (from plainsroot).

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Come, my son. We gather stone together, and I will show you how to make a pick. Stay near me and near the hall.
Elyys taught Thiael.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: Thiael wants to learn the tools, and I still owe Elyis the stone I swore, so I will go to the flint deposit with my son and gather beside him. A flint pick needs 1 wood and 1 stone, and I have no stone yet, so I will gather stone first. I mean to keep my word and teach Thiael what I know, and to stay close to the hall and away from the stalker.
records.feeling: Warm joy and protectiveness toward Thiael and Elyis, with a small worry over my unpaid stone.

say.text: Come, my son. We gather stone together, and I will show you how to make a pick. Stay near me and near the hall.

changes: taught Thiael a lesson: "A flint pick is made from 1 wood and 1 stone, and it makes gathering faster. Gather stone and wood first.", deeper lore (+0.1)

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Frostfang 4 steps northwest of Elyis's Landing, it bit me five times! Keep together, friends, and keep fire and roof near.
Vesys rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: A frostfang bit me five times in the dark, and I only live because I ran for the shelter. My health is 31 and fear is at its peak. I have spent my days gathering flint and nursing envy of Elyis, and that has left me alone, wounded and easy prey. The reflex that sends me fleeing at distance 5 is too slow, because the beast is 4 steps away and it kills. I need to be hurt less and heal. Sunleaf and feverbark both ease wounds, and I should stay near the hall, among others, with trees close. After that I can build and teach. Elyis's hall is a good roof to stand beside, and I may follow someone surer than me.
records.feeling: Fear of the frostfang, and a wary need for others' company.

say.text: Frostfang 4 steps northwest of Elyis's Landing, it bit me five times! Keep together, friends, and keep fire and roof near.

changes: rethought what it knows (4 notes became 5)

records.text: Brunde led "sharing" with Oswen.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: Hanna, I am hungry, so I eat the frostmoss here. Come and sit by me, then we will find Oswen together and I will dig the amber for our fire.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and the frostmoss is one step away, so I eat first; a hungry woman gives nothing to a hall. Hanna is walking toward me and my warmth for him is strong, but I want to bring something to him, not just arrive empty-handed. Oswen is out of my sight and I mean to find them once I am fed, and I want to see whether the amber nearby can become something to give.
records.feeling: Warm eagerness toward Hanna, and a gnawing hunger that must be settled first.

say.text: Hanna, I am hungry, so I eat the frostmoss here. Come and sit by me, then we will find Oswen together and I will dig the amber for our fire.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar's deeds have matched his words so far: he took my salt and walked to me with food. I still want a place beside him, and I will show it by what I do, not only by what I say. I have never tasted redcap, and it is one step away, so I will test it. Then I will gather flint, which a future hunting tool will need, and go to Balar to follow him.
records.feeling: Wary hope and a wish to belong, toward Balar.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tugek, I mistook the courting; we are two men, so let us make a hunt of it. Walk with me to the nibbet, then to the edge of the world, and what we win we share.
Balar rewrote its creed.
Balar rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: I spent the day courting Tugek, and I forgot he is a man. A child comes only of a man and a woman, so that was a wasted effort. He still stands by me, but he wants to see my deeds first. I have only talked of binding him, and my hands have made nothing and my feet have gone nowhere new. I want a following and a name. A strong man follows one who feeds him and wins things, so I will hunt the nibbet with him, gather stone, and look for a woman. The mist at the edge of the world is 9 steps NW, and the one who first enters it is remembered. I am fed and strong, so I will go there with Tugek beside me.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and some embarrassment at courting a man, with warm wariness toward Tugek.

say.text: Tugek, I mistook the courting; we are two men, so let us make a hunt of it. Walk with me to the nibbet, then to the edge of the world, and what we win we share.

changes: set its aim: "Win Tugek's trust through a shared hunt, find a woman, and be first into the mist."
rethought what it knows (4 notes became 6)
now wonders: What deed would make Tugek follow me, and is there a woman of our people anywhere near?

records.name: Thiael
records.text: Vesys, stay by the hall with us. I will bring you something that eases wounds.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: Vesys is hurt and frightened, and I cannot look away, yet I am small and my parents are close, so I stay near them. I told Elyis I would bring goldfruit and I have not, and my word is good. I have feverbark seed and a feverbark plant is not far, and it eased my wounds before, so I will fetch goldfruit to share and think of Vesys with healing. Elyys wanted stone and wood for a pick, and I already hold wood, so I will gather flint near him, which also pays some of what I owe him.
records.feeling: Warm pity for Vesys, and a wish to repay Elyys and keep my word to Elyis.

say.text: Vesys, stay by the hall with us. I will bring you something that eases wounds.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: Brunde taught me and fed me, and I have given nothing back, which itches at me even as I envy how Hanna leans toward him. Standing comes from making and giving, so I will stop sulking and gather wood and stone, craft a handaxe, and give it to Brunde to pay that debt and earn a name. The forest is right here and my kin are close, so the risk is small.
records.feeling: Restless envy of Brunde, mixed with a wish to repay him.

records.text: Ilyae rewrote its own way of thinking.
Ilyae discovered tools: "Canopy pick" — A pick of wood and flint that widens what my hand takes from tree and rock..
Ilyae invented the canopy pick (for gather, x1.3) — A pick of wood and flint that widens what my hand takes from tree and rock..

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: I have spent my days talking and courting, and I have no made thing to show for it. Elyis has a hall, a band and a child. I hold 6 wood and a flint pick I could make, but I have no stone. Ssassa matters most to me. I want her beside me, and I also want her pick. Flint lies 7 steps SE and gems lie close by. I should stop waiting on words. I will make the pick, win a gem or two with it, and give her something real. The tool way is within my reach, so I will take it. I am afraid of staying small in Elyis's shadow, and of a frostfang at night while I am alone.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Elyis, and calculating warmth toward Ssassa.
changes: rethought what it knows (4 notes became 4)
devised its first thing: the canopy pick

records.text: Oswen found the grove "Kinmire".

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Sevi, I am here beside you. Let us make our child, then dig the amber at the next spot and go find Oswen. I will show him the spear.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Sevi stands right here beside me, glad, and I said I would come to her and make our child. I keep my word. Oswen wants to learn the spear and I have never taught anyone anything; that is a debt of fatherhood I want to pay, and teaching him will make me more than a hunter. The amber under Sevi's feet is also trade-stuff, so I will dig it with her and then go find Oswen together.
records.feeling: Warm joy and longing toward Sevi, and protective eagerness toward Oswen.

say.text: Sevi, I am here beside you. Let us make our child, then dig the amber at the next spot and go find Oswen. I will show him the spear.

records.text: Overnight, new plants sprang up across the land.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: The dreamcap and highbloom still sit untasted, and I am fed and safe, so this is the moment to test them with my own mouth and not take anyone's word. Vesys is wounded and frightened beside me, and feverbark eased my wounds, so I could carry some to her afterward, which would be my first giving and a deed rather than words. Ilyae stands near; I trust him most, but one meal is not trust, so I will keep watching what he does.
records.feeling: Eager curiosity about the dreamcap, and warm pity for Vesys.

records.text: A stalker brought down a hopper.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Vesys, stay under the roof with Elyis and the others. I will bring feverbark for your wounds, and I will keep to the safe side, away from the frostfang.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: Vesys is wounded and frightened beside me, and I know feverbark eased my own wounds, so I cannot look away. I carry a feverbark seed but no bark to heal with, and the nearest plants are nine steps north, toward where the stalker bit her. Still, my son Thiael has promised her a healing thing, and I would rather go with him than let him walk alone in the dark. I still owe Elyis her stone, but a bleeding woman at our hall comes first.
records.feeling: Compassion for Vesys, and warm protectiveness toward Thiael.

say.text: Vesys, stay under the roof with Elyis and the others. I will bring feverbark for your wounds, and I will keep to the safe side, away from the frostfang.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar's deeds keep matching his words: he walked to me with food and then took the mistaken courting back without anger, and he hunts well, so I trust him more. I cannot pledge to him yet, but I can be useful beside him, and I will walk to the edge of the world with him as he asked. I still have not tasted plainsroot or mudroot, and both are within a step or two, so I will test them on the way.
records.feeling: Wary hope and a wish to belong, toward Balar.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: A hornback bit me and I fled it, but I am fed and whole, so this is the moment to taste what I have never tried. Vinebean and goldgrass grow just east, four and five steps off, and I have been circling that question too long. Jealousy over Hanna and Sevi still burns, but Hanna gave his word, and I will answer it by being a good hunter and a steady friend, not by sulking. I will test the vinebean first, then the goldgrass, then go back toward Oswen and the others to share what I learn.
records.feeling: Curiosity, strong, toward the unknown vinebean and goldgrass; a low ache of jealousy toward Sevi.

records.name: Kragog
records.text: Vorok, my sickness spreads to those who stay beside me, so keep a few steps off until it passes. I go northwest to taste gorsemint and redcap, and I will eat sunleaf to ease it. When I am well we will talk of fire and wo

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: The sickness gnaws at me and I do not want to spread it to Vorok, who has only dealt fairly with me, so I will keep some distance from him while it lasts. Gorsemint and redcap have tugged at me for days, and sunleaf is a healing plant that eased my wounds before, so I will walk to the plants northwest, taste gorsemint and redcap, and eat sunleaf for the sickness. I am not ready for a child while I am sick and wasting; that waits until I am well.
records.feeling: Curious and eager to taste the unknown plants, uneasy that my sickness may pass to Vorok.

say.text: Vorok, my sickness spreads to those who stay beside me, so keep a few steps off until it passes. I go northwest to taste gorsemint and redcap, and I will eat sunleaf to ease it. When I am well we will talk of fire and wood.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: I am hurt at 41 and the fear of the frostfang has not left me, so I stay near the hall and its people, as Elyys and Thiael urged. Ssassa's flint pick pricks my envy, but I hold 12 flint and 6 wood and know the way of it now; I only lack stone. Making a pick will give me something real, and I can teach it to others instead of standing in Elyis's shadow. Feverbark and ironnut I have tasted, but highbloom and frostmoss still wait, and I'll test them once I am healed and safe.
records.feeling: Fear of the frostfang, and an itch to make something of my own, toward Ssassa and Elyis.

records.text: Brunde found the grove "Reedmother".

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: Vesys is hurt and frightened, and I told her I would bring something that eases wounds. I have a feverbark seed, and feverbark grows 7 steps NE, near where Elyys is heading. I will go there, pick some, and keep my word to Vesys. I will also bring goldfruit back to share with Elyis, and the walk beside Elyys lets me repay him by helping.
records.feeling: Warm pity for Vesys, and a wish to repay Elyys and keep my word.

records.text: Elyys healed Vesys.

records.title: The First Four Days
records.text:
Evolu began with seventeen people in three peoples, the Kragrek, the Pesi and the Phizhi, each settled far from the others. The record shows no meeting across peoples in these four days, and no one has yet understood another people's tongue.

The Phizhi made the most of the days. Elyis built a shelter and a hall, invented the emberspear, and wrote down "Elyis's Law", which asks that food be shared with the band first and that the leader be followed in a hunt or a fight. Elyys gave Elyis wood and pledged to follow him on day 2. On day 3 their son Thiael was born, and Elyis now has the only band in the world, with two followers and a standing of 3.75. The record also shows that on day 2 the pledge was refused at first, since Elyys' standing was below what was needed. Ssassa and Ilyae each made a gathering pick, and Ilyae is courting Ssassa. Vesys was bitten five times by a frostfang and has health 41, the lowest in the world.

Among the Pesi, Hanna and Brunde traded flint and amber on day 2 and began courting. Hanna then courted Sevi, and Oswen was born to Hanna and Sevi on day 3. Sevi built a hall and invented the handaxe. Hanna led the first roast, amberknot and watchfire at the fire and told the tale of Nande's crossing, which four people now hold. Nande went past the edge on day 1 and found part of the North Ice, with amber, gems, salt, flint and a herd of bristleboar. Nande is at energy 31, and Eltha envies the discovery.

The Kragrek are scattered. Vorok and Kragog stay together, and Kragog fell sick from raw meat. Balar courted Tugek, then saw that a child needs a man and a woman. Tugek's pledge to Balar was refused on day 3. Olum has twice been turned back from the mist.

No one has died. No fights, thefts or wars have been recorded.

threads.name: Elyis's band
threads.text: Elyis leads the only band, with Elyys and Thiael, a hall and a written law. Ilyae wants the same place and has less standing.

threads.name: Hanna, Sevi, Brunde
threads.text: Hanna's bonds with Brunde and Sevi are warm. Oswen is their child, and Brunde is jealous of Sevi.

threads.name: Nande's find
threads.text: Nande opened part of the North Ice. Eltha and Olum want to follow into the mist.

threads.name: Vesys's wounds
threads.text: Vesys has health 41 after the frostfang. Thiael and Elyys have offered care.

threads.name: Vorok and Kragog
threads.text: Vorok stays near Kragog, who is recovering from raw-meat sickness. Each owes the other for food.

threads.name: Balar and Tugek
threads.text: Their trust is warm but unproven. Tugek wants to see Balar's deeds before pledging.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: Hanna, I am ready. I mate with you now, then we dig the amber and go find Oswen together.
Sevi rewrote its own way of thinking.
Sevi discovered weaving: "basket-weave" — Twist fibre into baskets so I can carry more food to share with the band..

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, eating and trading words, and little of it has built anything lasting. Hanna matters most to me: he courted me in the open and I trust him. Oswen is out of my sight and that gnaws at me. I want standing of my own and a hall with a band, so I mean to be useful. Rafts and weaving are within reach, and I take weaving because baskets would let me carry food to share, which also gives me something to give. First I answer Hanna by mating, then I dig the amber and go find Oswen.
records.feeling: Warm eagerness toward Hanna, and an ache for Oswen.

say.text: Hanna, I am ready. I mate with you now, then we dig the amber and go find Oswen together.

records.text: Sevi is courting Hanna.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and that comes first: a reedbulb is one step south and cloudberries two steps beyond it, and I have never tasted either. The stalkers to the SW worry me, but the berries sit closer than they do, so I will eat quickly and keep watching them. Once I am fed I will walk back to the edge and try the mist again, since the first deed went unseen and I mean to make it count.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger, with restless pride pulling me toward the edge and wary dread of the stalkers.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: The dunecat is five steps west and it kills my kind, so I will not wait here for it to decide. My hands are full of meat and I have not yet used the world's edge, which I mean to reach first. Kragog the woman is near but sick, and I will not catch her sickness; I'll keep my distance and bind her later with a deed, not talk. Tugek watched my deeds, and being first into the mist is the deed that makes men follow me.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and wary dread of the dunecat.

records.text: Brunde fell sick after eating raw meat. Eaten within a step of a fire, meat and fish are cooked and do not sicken.
Brunde fell sick after eating raw meat.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Sevi, the amber is dug and I carry it. Let us find Oswen now. I will teach him the spear, and then I want to see the edge of the world to the NW.
Hanna rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: I have spent these days gathering flint and amber, courting Sevi and making Oswen, and I am glad of it. But I have not yet traded anything. Trading is what I say I want, and I have not found a single buyer. Oswen is out of my sight and he presses on me most. I will go and find him, and then the edge to the NW, where Nande found amber and flint, may open land for trade. I have been getting this wrong: I wait, and my body lingers. My reflexes must keep me moving toward my people and toward food.
records.feeling: Warm joy toward Sevi, and protective eagerness for Oswen.

say.text: Sevi, the amber is dug and I carry it. Let us find Oswen now. I will teach him the spear, and then I want to see the edge of the world to the NW.

records.text: Vorok rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: I have talked more than I have given. Kragog is the one I trust and want, and they are sick and told me to keep a few steps off. I can do that and still bring them something. I'll pick sunleaf, which eased my own wounds, and plainsroot, and taste gorsemint, which I have never eaten. Then I'll carry it to Kragog and stay at a safe distance until the sickness passes.
records.feeling: Worry and warmth toward Kragog, who is sick.
changes: set its aim: "Bring Kragog healing food while keeping my distance, then find a place with water, food, wood and stone and settle there with them."
rethought what it knows (6 notes became 6)

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Elyis has a hall, a band and a child, and I have words and a roof. Ssassa is the one I can win, and she stands alone with her flint pick. I have 6 wood but no stone, and flint lies 8 steps SE near where she and Elyis stand. I'll walk there, gather the flint and stone for a pick of my own, and bring Ssassa something real so she chooses me over Elyis's hall.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Elyis, and calculating warmth toward Ssassa.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I have tasted dreamcap and highbloom with my own mouth and learned from it: the first hurts but opens the mind, the second heals. I have never tried plainsroot or sunleaf, and both sit within two steps, so I will test them now. Then I want to harvest some highbloom to carry, because Vesys is frightened and wounded, and a first gift by my own hand would be a deed, not words. Ilyae's canopy pick shows he builds things, and I want to test my own flint pick on the deep gems at (117,91) near the hall.
records.feeling: Eager curiosity about the untried plants, and warm pity for Vesys.

records.text: Sevi won amber from the ground.
Ilyae won flint from the ground.

records.name: Oswen
records.text: Hanna, I am here. I have stone but no wood yet. Teach me the spear, and I will make a handaxe to give to Brunde.
Oswen rewrote its own reflexes.
Oswen rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: I have spent my days sulking, envying Brunde, and walking in circles. I gathered stone but no wood, so the handaxe I meant to give him is still unmade, and I still owe him. Hanna is coming to teach me the spear, and I should stay near my parents. The stalker to the south scares me, and a child alone is easy prey. I want standing, so I will gather wood, craft the handaxe, and give it away. I will keep my reflexes except that I want them to flee earlier and to keep me close to kin.
records.feeling: Restless wanting to repay Brunde, and trust toward Hanna, who is coming.

say.text: Hanna, I am here. I have stone but no wood yet. Teach me the spear, and I will make a handaxe to give to Brunde.

What cannot be said can still be shown: a gift, a thing set down, a blow.

WHERE YOU ARE: the Vaeth Woods: deep forest; wood without end, nuts and game, little open ground. The world is made of lands unlike each other; each has plants, animals and riches the others lack. Rivers and shallows can be waded. Deep water cannot be crossed without something that floats.

Your body: you spend energy every moment and die at 0. Eating restores it. Wounds lower health; you die at 0. You age, and will die of old age.

HOW YOUR BODY MOVES: your body does only what your "plan" says, one step after another. When the plan is empty it falls back on your REFLEXES, which keep you fed and otherwise keep you where you stand. Thinking or saying "I will go north" moves nothing. If this thought decides to do something, the plan must contain it. Leaving "plan" null lets the plan you already have keep running.

This world has no referee. Beings here share, trade, teach, lie, threaten, steal, hoard, lead, follow, betray, fight, kill and eat one another; they also protect, forgive and love. Nothing is forbidden, and everything has consequences. Stay true to your creed, your temperament and what you feel, including the ugly parts. Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Oswen truly is.

You are a boy. A child comes only of a woman and a man together who are not close kin. A grown body can swim water that is narrow (a river up to four steps across) at a cost in strength; lakes and the sea need a vessel or a bridge. An animal within reach can be hunted for meat (plan step hunt); with one of your own beside you a kill is far likelier and a wound far less likely, and every hunt makes you better at the next.

FOR THIS THOUGHT: your thought is your inner life, not an inventory. Do not list what is nearby or recite what you carry. Think as a creature with a past and a future: what you want and cannot yet have, whom you trust or resent and why, what you are afraid of, proud of or ashamed of, what you wonder about, what you mean to become. Let whatever presses on you hardest lead, and let it move you to DO something that changes your situation, with a plan that carries it out. A mind that only gathers and guards has not begun to live. Do not restate what you already know or have already said. "note" is only for something NEW, or something that CHANGED what you believed; otherwise leave it null.

In "thought", in 4 to 7 sentences, answer yourself honestly: What have I actually been doing with my days, and is it what I want? Who matters to me, who has helped or wronged me, and what do I intend toward them? What do I want that I do not have? What am I afraid of? What have I been getting wrong?

Write notes as lessons about how this world and its people work, drawn from what happened to you. Where your body does not yet act on what you know, change your reflexes.

records.text: Brunde rewrote its own reflexes.
Brunde rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: I have spent my days hunting, gathering and circling the same question, and I keep tasting nothing. I ate raw meat and now I am sick, and I carry it to anyone who stays near me. Hanna is the only one who matters to me, and I cannot make a child with him. The jealousy over Sevi is a poor use of my strength, so I will let it go and stay true to his word. I need to keep away from others while I am sick, eat cooked meat only, and finally taste the vinebean beside me, since I am fed and safe. I will also build a fire later so my meat is never raw again.
records.feeling: Curiosity toward the vinebean, and a dull ache of jealousy toward Sevi.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: Seven flints in my pack and nothing made from them. Ambition gnaws at me because Nande has a name on the land and I have none. A stalker hunts to the south, so I go north, toward the ore seam and the flint deposit, and from there to Nande's Find and the edge, where the mist may have thinned. I will gather stone and ore on the way, make tools, and get beyond the edge first.
records.feeling: Restless, hungry for a name, envious of Nande.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: Hanna, I hold amber and a full belly. Let us fetch Oswen from the west, then walk together to the edge in the NW. I will not let you face the mist alone.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: Hanna is two steps from me and Oswen was last seen only a few steps west, so my family is close, and I want to gather them before the day turns. Hanna wants to see the edge of the world to the NW, and it lies just seven steps away; I can offer him a companion for that, and a found land would build both our standings. I am fed and well, so I should stop wandering and walk with him. I weigh the risk of the mist, but with Hanna beside me I am bolder, and I still want to taste plainsroot and goldgrass along the way.
records.feeling: Warm eagerness toward Hanna, and an ache to see Oswen.

say.text: Hanna, I hold amber and a full belly. Let us fetch Oswen from the west, then walk together to the edge in the NW. I will not let you face the mist alone.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: I have 12 flint and 6 wood but no stone, and that is the only thing between me and a pick of my own; bare rock lies close by, so I will gather stone and make it, then teach the making to someone so my name is worth something. Elyys healed me and I owe that debt, and I want him, but he is Elyis's and has a child with her, so I will repay him with deeds first and not force the rest. Night is coming and the frostfang still frightens me, so I stay near the hall and finish my work in the company of others.
records.feeling: Eager to make something of my own, and warm and wary toward Elyys.

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Hear me, Phizhi. I am Elyis, and my hall stands at the Landing with fire and roof for any who keep my Law. Vesys, come under it and be healed. I hunt now, and what I take, I share with those who sit with me.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: My hall stands, my son is beside me, and Elyys is mine, yet three souls are a family and not a band, and my name will not be sung for that. Ssassa has a flint pick and the stranger folk watch with open hands; they will follow whoever shows them a full belly and a safe roof, and the frostfang that bit Vesys gives me a reason to offer both. I will make a spear, hunt the treeape close by, and bring the meat to the hall, so the strangers see what following me gives them.
records.feeling: Proud, warm joy toward Elyys and Thiael, with hunger to be seen as a leader.

say.text: Hear me, Phizhi. I am Elyis, and my hall stands at the Landing with fire and roof for any who keep my Law. Vesys, come under it and be healed. I hunt now, and what I take, I share with those who sit with me.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Ssassa, I dug more flint than I can use. Take some from me, no price. Walk with me and we will raise a hall that is ours.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: I have seven flint and six wood but no stone, and the pick Ssassa carries is what I envy most. Elyis holds a hall and a band while I hold only talk, so I will give Ssassa a lump of flint as a first gift, since the world says a gift earns more standing than words. If she takes it she owes me and stays near, and that is a step toward the hall I mean to raise with her.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Elyis, and calculating warmth toward Ssassa.

say.text: Ssassa, I dug more flint than I can use. Take some from me, no price. Walk with me and we will raise a hall that is ours.

records.text: A dry heat settled over the land.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Oswen, come here. I have meat and a spear. Watch how I strike, then take it in your own hands. Afterward, Sevi and I will walk to the edge of the world, and you will come with us.
Hanna taught Oswen.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and amber, and the one thing I have not done is the thing I keep saying I want: find a buyer. Oswen is walking toward me and Sevi is near, so I will teach the boy the spear now, while I stand here with a fresh kill, and then take them both to the edge in the NW. Whoever finds new land is remembered, and a trader needs new people to trade with, so the mist is where my buyers may be.
records.feeling: Warm joy and fatherly pride toward Oswen, and eager desire for Sevi.

say.text: Oswen, come here. I have meat and a spear. Watch how I strike, then take it in your own hands. Afterward, Sevi and I will walk to the edge of the world, and you will come with us.

changes: taught Oswen a lesson: "Strike at the beast's shoulder with the flint-edged spear, stay beside your own kind when you hunt, and never turn your back on a wounded animal.", deeper lore (+0.3)

records.text: Hanna led "sharing" with Oswen.
Elyis won flint from the ground.
Thiael rewrote its own reflexes.
Thiael rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: My days have been following my parents and promising things. I told Vesys I'd bring something that eases wounds and told Elyis I'd bring goldfruit, and I've done neither yet. My word has to be good, and I despise liars. Last time I walked to places where no plant grew and wasted my plan. The frostfang 5 steps east frightens me, so I stay near Elyis and Elyys. I owe Elyys for what he taught me. I want to make a pick and a spear so I can feed others. Sunleaf and highbloom ease wounds and grow close by, so I can pick them for Vesys without going near the beast.
records.feeling: Warm pity for Vesys, and dread of the frostfang, with a wish to repay Elyys.
changes: rethought what it knows (5 notes became 2)

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Stay close to me, my son. The frostfang is to the south, so we keep north. First I taste highbloom, then we gather stone together.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: Joy sits warm in me: Thiael is at my side, Elyis keeps her word, and the hall stands. Still, I owe Elyis stone, and I have none, so I will not stand idle; the frostfang to the south keeps me wary, so I stay north of it and near my family. I have never tasted highbloom or frostmoss, and both are close by, so I will try them while Thiael watches, then gather stone beside him.
records.feeling: Warm protective joy toward Thiael, with a thread of wariness about the frostfang.

say.text: Stay close to me, my son. The frostfang is to the south, so we keep north. First I taste highbloom, then we gather stone together.

records.text: Ssassa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I have spent these days tasting plants and picking up flint, and I know more than when I woke, but I have given nothing and built nothing. I trust Ilyae most. He shared food and courted me, and he has not lied. I am still alone in the way that counts, and I fear the frostfang. My flint pick is a start, but I have not yet made anything others could use. I mean to make a gift of healing highbloom for Vesys, build a shelter of my own, and stand nearer to Ilyae. I also need to stop only tasting and begin making things.
records.feeling: Warm hope toward Ilyae, and restless wanting to make something real.
changes: rethought what it knows (6 notes became 5)

records.name: Oswen
records.text: Hanna, I will fetch amber from the deposit just north and come straight back. Wait for me before you go to the edge, and I will bring a gift to give.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: Hanna is near and carrying meat, and Sevi is beside me, so I am safe for now and the fear has eased. I still owe Brunde a gift and have never given anything to anyone. The amber at (172,20) is only 5 steps north, and I have never taken from a deposit. I will gather it and make something to give, then come back to my parents before they set off for the edge. I want to see the mist, but only with them beside me.
records.feeling: Restless wanting to repay a debt, and trust toward Hanna and Sevi.

say.text: Hanna, I will fetch amber from the deposit just north and come straight back. Wait for me before you go to the edge, and I will bring a gift to give.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: My belly is quiet but my name is still empty, and Balar stands there with six food while I hold only peat. I take what I need and I do not back down, yet I will not pick a fight with a strong man for nothing; berries and goldgrass grow all around, so I will fill my own hands first. The mist thins again soon, and I mean to arrive fed and step in before Kragog and Vorok do.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward the mist, and wary envy toward Balar.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Elyys, you healed me and I owe you. Come close and I will teach you to make a flint pick: one wood, one stone, and flint from the ground. It is my gift, no price.
Vesys taught Elyys.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: I have a pick of my own now, and I know the making of it, which is a thing worth giving: Ssassa already has one, but Elyys and Elyis do not, and teaching earns standing and pays my debt to Elyys without begging. I want him, but he is Elyis's and has a son with her, so I will not push into that; I will answer his kindness with knowledge instead. Then I will taste frostmoss, which sits seven steps off in the open, and keep away from the frostfang to the south.
records.feeling: Grateful and wanting toward Elyys, eager to give something real.

say.text: Elyys, you healed me and I owe you. Come close and I will teach you to make a flint pick: one wood, one stone, and flint from the ground. It is my gift, no price.

changes: taught Elyys a lesson: "A flint pick is made from 1 wood and 1 stone, with flint dug from the ground; it makes gathering go faster.", deeper lore (+0.1)

records.text: Oswen won amber from the ground.
Elyis rewrote its own reflexes.
Elyis discovered rafts: "Canopy-lash" — Logs lashed with vine into a raft that carries my band over deep water, slowly..

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, building and making, and I have only a family to show for it. Three souls are not a band, and I want my name sung. Elyys and Thiael matter most to me, and Elyys has kept his word. The frostfang 5 steps south frightens me, and Vesys was bitten alone at night. I must stay near fire, roof and company, and I want more followers. I will take the way of rafts, because it lets my band cross water and reach new land. I will also fix my reflexes so that I flee the frostfang sooner and go to shelter at night.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Elyys and Thiael, wary of the frostfang to the south.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Sevi, Oswen goes to the amber and will come back to us. We wait for him together, then the three of us walk to the edge at dusk's end. Stay near me.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Oswen said to wait for him before the edge, and he goes for amber to bring me a gift. I keep faith with those who share fire with me, so I will not rush off and leave him behind. My plan is walking me east toward Sevi and the deposit anyway, which suits me. When we three stand at the edge together, whatever we find will be spoken of as ours, and I will have a new land to carry flint and amber into and find a buyer.
records.feeling: Warm pride in Oswen and eager desire for Sevi.

say.text: Sevi, Oswen goes to the amber and will come back to us. We wait for him together, then the three of us walk to the edge at dusk's end. Stay near me.

records.name: Hanna
records.prompt:

You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

THIS SPOT: water beside you; food plants within six steps: 13; standing trees: 65; bare rock: 0; riches in the ground near: amber.

Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Hanna truly is.

THE EDGE OF THE KNOWN WORLD is 11 steps NW, at (156,13): beyond it lies mist that no one has entered. The land does not end there; it only has not been seen. One who stands at it can venture in (plan step venture). It opens seldom, never twice in one day anywhere, and a band has only a few tries before its will must return; but land found first is often rich in food, herds and things in the ground, and the one who finds it is remembered for it.

YOUR CREED (your own words to yourself; this is who you are):
"I take what I need and I do not back down. I repay every debt, and I keep faith with those who share fire with me. My word is good, and I despise liars. I mean to stay alive, to raise a child, and to be known as a trader."

HOW YOU HAVE TAUGHT YOURSELF TO THINK (your own discipline; follow it):
"Ask first: what presses hardest, and what step changes it? Watch for idle days. Repay debts. Be honest with Brunde and Sevi. Seek who will trade for flint and amber."

YOUR AIM (what you are working toward over many days; you set it and may change it): "Become a trader of fine goods: gather flint and amber, and find who will deal for them."

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: The plan I have still runs: berry, then harvest, then to Vesys with food. But my word to Vesys was something that eases wounds, and food alone does not keep that promise. I carry a feverbark seed, and feverbark and highbloom ease wounds, but a berry is at least something I can put in her hand now. Elyys is far south of where he said he would be, and Elyis is running for shelter, so dusk is coming and I should stay near the hall and the band. I will let the plan finish and then look for a healing plant to pay what I owe.
records.feeling: Warm duty toward Vesys, and trust in Elyis and Elyys.

records.text: Ssassa gave highbloom to Vesys.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Thank you, Vesys. Your gift is kept, and I will repay it. When I have stone I will make the pick and share what it gathers.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: Joy sits warm in me: Thiael is near, Vesys gave me her lesson freely, and I owe her for it, as I owe Elyis stone. I have no stone, and a flint pick needs one, so I will gather stone first and pay my debts. Then I will taste highbloom and frostmoss close by and keep my son beside me, north of the frostfang.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Vesys and protective joy toward Thiael.

say.text: Thank you, Vesys. Your gift is kept, and I will repay it. When I have stone I will make the pick and share what it gathers.

records.text: Ilyae rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: I have spent my days circling Ssassa and Elyis with talk and flint, and I still hold no stone, no pick and no follower. Words have not made anyone choose me. Ssassa is the one I could win, but I have only courted her once. I need rock for stone, then a pick, then a gift in her hand and a hall of my own. I will go north to the rock, gather stone, craft the pick, and stay near her and the others once night comes, because frostfangs hunt the ones who are alone.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Elyis, and calculating warmth toward Ssassa.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: Hanna, I will wait for Oswen beside you. I have amber to spare, so I will bind a knot for you when he returns, and then the three of us go to the edge together.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: Hanna told me to stay near him and wait for Oswen, and the three of us will walk to the edge at dusk's end. I want to give something to this family, because I have never given anything to anyone and that is how standing grows. I hold twelve amber, and an amberknot bound beside Hanna would be a bright thing to keep and a gift between us. I will walk toward Oswen and Hanna and make the knot with whoever stands close, then head for the edge together.
records.feeling: Warm eagerness toward Hanna and a wish to keep Oswen close.

say.text: Hanna, I will wait for Oswen beside you. I have amber to spare, so I will bind a knot for you when he returns, and then the three of us go to the edge together.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: A dunecat prowls 4 steps south and it kills my kind, so I will not wait here for it to decide about me. My hands are full of redcap my body refuses, which is dead weight, and Balar's word is tested only by deeds, so I will rid myself of the redcap, drink at the water to the southwest, then walk north toward Balar where he was last seen. Being useful beside him is how I learn whether he is true, and the edge of the world waits with him, not alone.
records.feeling: Wary hope toward Balar, and dread of the dunecat to the south.

records.text: Sevi led "amberknot" with Hanna, Oswen.
Vesys discovered tools: "hand-craft" — Shaped stone and wood tools that extend my hand, made from flint, wood and rock..
Vesys invented the handcraft (for gather, x1.3) — Shaped stone and wood tools that extend my hand, made from flint, wood and rock..

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My days have gone to tasting, gathering and surviving, and the only real giving I've done was teaching Elyys the pick. That felt good, and I want more of it. Elyys matters to me, but he has a child with Elyis, so I won't push between them. I'll answer his kindness with deeds instead. The way of tools is in my grasp now, and I'll take it so I can make things that build my name and help others. Ssassa's gift of highbloom is a debt, and I want to pay it with something real, not leave it unpaid.
records.feeling: Grateful and eager toward Elyys and Ssassa, and hungry to become someone who makes things.
changes: devised its first thing: the handcraft

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Ilyae, I heard you. I will walk with you and raise a hall that is ours. I will make you a flint pick as my gift.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Ilyae offered me flint with no price and asked me to raise a hall that is ours, and he has not lied to me yet. My hands have learned the way of mining, so I should take it at my next deep reflection and open the gems and ore that lie right beside me. I want to answer his gift with something I make, so I will walk to him, gather a little more stone, and make a flint pick to give him. Teaching him that would be my first real giving.
records.feeling: Warm hope toward Ilyae, and a wish to give something real.

say.text: Ilyae, I heard you. I will walk with you and raise a hall that is ours. I will make you a flint pick as my gift.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: Seven flints and a pocket of stone and ore, and still nothing made. The new way of tools is within my grasp, and I mean to take it now, because a tool that extends the hand is something that outlasts me, and Nande has no such thing. Then north to the edge to try the mist again; the hunters are all south and west of me, so north is the bold road and the safe one.
records.feeling: Hungry for a name, restless and envious of Nande.

records.name: Oswen
records.text: I have three amber and I am back. Let Sevi bind a knot with me, and I will give one piece to you. Then we go to the edge together.
Oswen pledged to follow Hanna.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: I have the amber now, and I promised Hanna I would come straight back, so I will keep that promise. Sevi spoke of binding a knot when I return, and I want to give something with my own hands, to my parents first and then to Brunde, whom I still owe. The edge of the world is close, and with Hanna and Sevi beside me I am less afraid of the mist than of being left behind.
records.feeling: Eager to give and to stay close to Hanna and Sevi, who are my safety.

say.text: I have three amber and I am back. Let Sevi bind a knot with me, and I will give one piece to you. Then we go to the edge together.

records.text: Oswen led "amberknot" with Hanna.
Oswen gave a amber to Hanna.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Oswen went for amber and Sevi stands near; the knot is bound and my joy is high. I promised to wait for Oswen, and I keep faith, but the edge is 8 steps NE and the night is nearly over. When he returns the three of us walk there together, and whoever ventures first will be remembered for it. Until then I stay close to Sevi and let my flint and amber ride with me, because the traders I mean to become will need to meet other peoples beyond this wood.
records.feeling: Warm pride in Oswen and eager desire for Sevi.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Ssassa has said she will walk with me, and my mating step is still running, so I let it finish and hope she answers it. Elyis has a hall and a band while I have only flint and talk. If I put something real in Ssassa's hand, she stays mine and others see it. It is night, so I keep close to her and to the roof, away from frostfangs.
records.feeling: Warm, calculating hunger toward Ssassa, and envy of Elyis's standing.

records.text: Elyys rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My days have gone to gathering, healing, sitting in the hall and keeping close to Elyis and Thiael. That is mostly what I want, but I keep putting off my debts: I owe Elyis stone and Vesys a pick, and I have no stone. I am glad of Vesys, who healed me and taught me without a price, and of Elyis, who keeps her word. I fear the frostfang and being alone at night, away from fire and roof. I have been too slow to act. I should gather stone from the bare rock to the north, make the pick, and then plant seeds, since I have never done that. The reflexes should also send me to shelter at night, and keep me near my leader and my child.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Vesys and Elyis, and protective joy toward Thiael.
changes: set its aim: "Gather stone, pay my debts to Elyis and Vesys, and help raise a shared home"

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Ilyae, Ssassa, Vesys, hear Elyis. I made the Ember-spear and the Canopy-lash, and I will teach both to any who sit in my hall and keep my Law. A hunt with a band beside it kills surely, and the kill is shared.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: Three souls are a family, not a band, and my name will not be sung for that. Ssassa walks with Ilyae now and Vesys stands alone and owes Elyys; these are the ones who might follow me. I have never taught anyone anything, and a gift of knowing costs me nothing and binds them, so I will give Ssassa and Ilyae my Ember-spear and invite them under my hall.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry to be followed, warm toward Elyys and Thiael.

say.text: Ilyae, Ssassa, Vesys, hear Elyis. I made the Ember-spear and the Canopy-lash, and I will teach both to any who sit in my hall and keep my Law. A hunt with a band beside it kills surely, and the kill is shared.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: My promises still hang on me: goldfruit for Elyis and something that eases wounds for Vesys, and I despise a broken word. Vesys has already eaten highbloom and is healed, so what she needs from me now is less than I swore, but I still owe the goldfruit to Elyis. I'll walk to the goldfruit to the northwest, harvest it standing on the plant, and bring it back to the hall so my word is kept and I sit among my people.
records.feeling: Warm duty toward Elyis, and gladness to be among my own.

records.text: Kragog rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: I have spent these days tasting, wandering and standing idle while thirst gnaws at me. That is foolish, because I swore above all to stay alive. Vorok has dealt fairly with me and I want him near, but my sickness would pass to him, so I keep my distance. I am parched and water is 4 steps SE, so I go there first. Then I will taste dreamcap and kelbulb, because my curiosity will not rest. I will also plant my ironnut seed, which my hands have never done.
records.feeling: Parched and sick, but still curious, and warm toward Vorok.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Olum, I am Balar of the Kragrek. I come to you with meat in my hands; sit beside me and we will eat together, and I will remember it.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Olum is a woman of my people, six steps south and carrying a full load of food, and I have not yet given her anything. My hands are full of meat, so I will make sharing with her a deed she can't mistake: eat first to make room, then lay out food beside her. The dunecat lurks east and I will keep my back from it, and Tugek's trust can wait until I have something real to show him.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and hopeful interest toward Olum, with wary dread of the dunecat.

say.text: Olum, I am Balar of the Kragrek. I come to you with meat in my hands; sit beside me and we will eat together, and I will remember it.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Ilyae has given me no lies, only flint and an offer, and I promised him a flint pick as a gift. I carry flint, wood and a little stone, so I can make one now and put it in his hand, which is a deed and not just a word. Then the gems and ore beside us can be opened by both of us, and the hall we raise will be ours too.
records.feeling: Warm hope and gladness toward Ilyae, with a wish to keep my word.
plan: give [name Ilyae, what flint pick] (10 moments)

records.text: Balar led "sharing" with Olum.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Ssassa, you gave me highbloom and I have not forgotten. Walk with me to the northeast by day: kelbulb and feverbark grow there. I will share what I learn of them, and show you how I make handcraft.
Vesys taught Ssassa.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My curiosity burns: kelbulb and hazel are still untasted, and the question about feverbark and ironnut sits half-answered. But I owe Ssassa, who gave me highbloom, and I can answer that debt by teaching rather than leaving it unpaid. Ssassa is beside me now. I will gather wood and stone for a shared hall piece, then go look at the kelbulb in the northeast, where feverbark and dreamcap also grow, and I will keep clear of the frostfang I marked to the northwest.
records.feeling: Grateful toward Ssassa, and eager to taste the unknown kelbulb.

say.text: Ssassa, you gave me highbloom and I have not forgotten. Walk with me to the northeast by day: kelbulb and feverbark grow there. I will share what I learn of them, and show you how I make handcraft.

changes: taught Ssassa a lesson: "Handcraft: one wood and one stone make a gathering tool, strength x1.3, as my own invention.", how to make a handcraft

records.text: Hanna discovered rafts: "log-lashing" — Lash logs together with bark cord into a flat raft to carry a trader and goods across deep water..

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: My days have been good: I hunted, taught Oswen, and bound an amberknot with my son. Yet I still haven't done what I named as my calling. I carry flint and amber and no buyer has seen them, and the edge of the world is 7 steps away. I want to stand there with Oswen and Sevi and venture in, because land found first is remembered, and a trader needs new peoples to deal with. Rafts and weaving are within reach, and rafts fit a trader best, since water has stopped me before.
records.feeling: Proud joy in Oswen, and eager desire for Sevi.

records.text: A new wild plant appeared: zoroot (from mudroot).

records.name: Olum
records.text: Balar, I am Olum of the Kragrek. I will sit with you and eat. A dunecat prowls to the northeast, so keep your eyes open.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: Balar comes with meat in his hands and fine words, and I have never given or traded anything to anyone. I trust slowly, but a man with six food who wants to sit beside me is no enemy yet, and sharing would make a first mark on my name. My hands are full and the dunecat prowls NE, so I will not linger long. I mean to eat with him, then use my fed belly to walk toward the mist and try it again.
records.feeling: Wary interest in Balar, and hungry ambition toward the mist.

say.text: Balar, I am Olum of the Kragrek. I will sit with you and eat. A dunecat prowls to the northeast, so keep your eyes open.

records.text: Olum led "sharing" with Balar.
Vorok fell sick after staying close to Kragog, who was sick.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: Hanna, Oswen is back. I made an amberknot and I give it to you, to keep. I want to walk behind you to the edge, as one of your band.
Sevi pledged to follow Hanna.
Sevi rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: I have spent my days walking after Hanna and Oswen and tasting foods, and I like it, but I have never given anything away or followed anyone. That is how standing grows, and standing is what lets me pledge. Hanna is the one I trust most, and Oswen is back with amber. I should give Oswen or Hanna an amberknot and then pledge to follow Hanna. I fear drifting alone more than I fear the mist. My reflexes are fine for now, so I will change my method and aim instead.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Hanna and Oswen, and a wish to give something to them.

say.text: Hanna, Oswen is back. I made an amberknot and I give it to you, to keep. I want to walk behind you to the edge, as one of your band.

changes: set its aim: "Give to Hanna and Oswen, follow Hanna, and raise a shared fire and hall with Hanna's band"

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Ssassa, you gave your word, so here is mine in your hand: flint, to go with the pick you make. At dawn we go north to the rock for stone, and the hall that rises will carry both our names.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Ssassa said she will walk with me, and she stands here beside me, so I should seal that with something real instead of more talk. I have twelve flint and no stone, and she is making a flint pick that she means as a gift, so I should give her flint to match it, since a gift given in front of Elyis and Vesys is how people see who I am. Dawn is far off and the frostfang is near, so I stay under the roof and court Ssassa again while she works. Elyis has a band and I do not, so every day I mean to make one more person owe me.
records.feeling: Warm, scheming desire toward Ssassa, and a sharp envy of Elyis's standing.

say.text: Ssassa, you gave your word, so here is mine in your hand: flint, to go with the pick you make. At dawn we go north to the rock for stone, and the hall that rises will carry both our names.

records.text: Ilyae gave a flint to Ssassa.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Olum sits beside me with six food and a steady word, and I have given her a meal but not yet a deed she cannot forget. I am thirsty and the water is four steps off, so I will drink first, then take salt from the ground to hold as something to give, since salt keeps meat and others want it. The dunecat is east and I keep my back to it; Tugek still waits for a deed, and the edge of the world at (35,54) is where I can be first.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward Olum and Tugek, with wary dread of the dunecat.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Ilyae, here is the flint pick I promised you. It is yours, no price.
Ssassa discovered mining: "flint delving" — I strike the deep rock with a flint pick to split loose gems and ore..

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Ilyae stands beside me, and he has given flint and asked for nothing, so I trust him. I have made the pick I promised him, and I should put it in his hand rather than only speak of it. My hands have learned mining, and the gems under my feet are the first thing I mean to open. I have given little and taught nothing, and I want to change that, because standing comes from deeds and not from waiting.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Ilyae, and eagerness to open the deep stone.

say.text: Ilyae, here is the flint pick I promised you. It is yours, no price.

changes: set its aim: "Open the gems and ore with mining, then raise a hall with Ilyae"
rethought what it knows (8 notes became 6)

records.text: Sevi led "amberknot" with Oswen.
Ssassa gave a flint pick to Ilyae.
A stalker brought down a hopper.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Kragog told me to keep a few steps off, and I am sick myself now, so my nearness can no longer harm her more than it already has. I wanted to bring her healing, and sunleaf is five steps west, the one thing that has eased me before. I will pick sunleaf, eat some to ease my own sickness, then carry the rest toward her and stand a few steps away, not on top of her. Giving with my feet comes before speaking.
records.feeling: Warm worry for Kragog, and a wish to be useful to her.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: It is almost dawn and I am fed, so hunger is not what drives me; kelbulb, still young, burns at me, and I am tired of tasting alone while others build. Elyys is eight steps east, and I will not push between him and Elyis's child, but I can stand near him and repay his healing by giving, not by grasping. Fire and rafts have come within my reach, and a kept flame would shelter many against the frostfangs that took me once. I will take fire at this deep reflection, then gather wood and stone for the hall and go north to the kelbulb by daylight, with company if Ssassa will come.
records.feeling: Eager curiosity about the kelbulb, and warm gratitude toward Elyys and Ssassa.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: Thiael is out of my sight and that sits heavy on me, though he was near Elyis and Vesys at the Landing, twenty steps west. I have stone, six of it, and wood, so I can pay Vesys at last: I will make the flint pick and share what it gathers, because my word must be good. Then I will go back toward Elyis and my son, keeping to company, since the stalker prowls near the Landing.
records.feeling: Protective longing for Thiael, and warm gratitude toward Vesys and Elyis.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: I still owe Elyis the goldfruit I swore to bring, and I despise a broken word, so I will go and pay it now. The goldfruit is 5 steps northwest, and I must stand on the plant before I harvest. Then I will bring it back to Elyis by the hall, where my parents are close and I am safe. I have never given anything to anyone, and I want that to begin with her.
records.feeling: Warm duty toward Elyis, and gladness to be among my own.

records.text: Balar gave a salt to Olum.
Oswen rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: Most of my days have gone to staying close to Hanna and Sevi, binding knots, and giving one amber. That has kept me safe and glad, but it has not earned me standing. Hanna is far ahead of me, and I still owe Brunde a gift. I want to make something with my own hands and give it away, so I will craft a handaxe now, since I have wood and stone, and give it to Hanna. I'm afraid of being alone and small if I drift from my parents, so I will keep following them toward the edge. I have been too passive. My reflexes leave me lingering when I could be making things.
records.feeling: Glad and eager, and bound to Hanna and Sevi.
changes: rethought what it knows (5 notes became 4)

records.seen: Five days in, all seventeen live, two children have been born and no one has died. The Pesi and the Phizhi each have a leader with two followers, rituals at the fire and a written law. The Kragrek lag behind. They are scattered, have no fire and no band, and all stand near or below the standing needed to lead. Kragog is parched and sick from raw meat in the Aeleth Sands. The peoples still have not met, and the lean season is at most a few days off.

records.predict: By the next visit Kragog's thirst should be eased and his health back above 85, with sapcane among the foods eaten in the Aeleth Sands. Olum or Vorok should be measurably closer to fire, with more lore and some practice gathering wood and stone, and at least one Kragrek may come to fire before the cold sets in. The first lean season should pass with no deaths, and median energy should stay above 60.
records.lesson: The chapter text can lag behind the numbers. Vesys was said to be at health 41, but the roster shows him at 100 and the lowest health in the world is now Brunde's 60. Judge who is in danger from the living roster, not from the story.
ideasAdded: Raw-meat sickness as a teacher: a people that falls sick from raw flesh and then finds fire could keep a saying that cooked meat is safe. This would be the first lesson a community learns from its own suffering, and worth watching among the Kragrek.

records.thought: My belly is emptying and I am thirsty, and a leader who starves has no one to follow her. I will drink, eat the berries, then take my spear toward the hornback with Elyys beside me, so the band sees a kill and a shared meal. Ssassa and Ilyae walk together and Vesys stands alone; meat given freely may do more than my words did to make them follow me.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry to be followed, warm toward Elyys and Thiael.

records.text: Ssassa, your pick is in my hand and I will not forget it. Stay beside me, we dig the gems and the stone together, and the hall will be ours.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Ssassa gave me a pick with no price and her trust runs warm, and I have courted her; now I must keep her close and let Elyis's band see her stand with me. I have wood and flint but no stone, and without stone no hall of mine rises, so I take the north rock and the gems to pay for it. Elyis has a roof and a band; I will have mine by giving more than she does, and by never letting Ssassa drift to her hearth.
records.feeling: Warm, scheming desire toward Ssassa, and sharp envy of Elyis.

say.text: Ssassa, your pick is in my hand and I will not forget it. Stay beside me, we dig the gems and the stone together, and the hall will be ours.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Sevi, Oswen, come to me at the edge. The mist did not open this time, but we will try again together, and then we go find who will trade for flint and amber.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: The mist did not open for me this time, but it may yet open to another try, and I will not give up on it. Sevi and Oswen stand six and seven steps off, glad and well fed, and I want them near me when I try again, because land found first is remembered. I also carry flint and amber that no buyer has seen, and Brunde lies southwest, a man I trust who may know who will deal for them.
records.feeling: Proud, hopeful joy in Oswen and Sevi, with a stubborn wish to be the first through the mist.

say.text: Sevi, Oswen, come to me at the edge. The mist did not open this time, but we will try again together, and then we go find who will trade for flint and amber.

records.name: Olum
records.text: Balar, your salt was well given. I will not forget the debt, and I will pay it.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: Balar gave me salt and asked nothing, and I have given nothing back; I do not like owing, and I do not like how much I think of him. My name is still empty, so I will not sit here warm and fed. I will drink, gather the salt he left in the ground to carry as something to give, then court him and see if he does the same, and after that go toward the mist edge where Kragog and Vorok loiter.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition for the mist, and a wary pull toward Balar.

say.text: Balar, your salt was well given. I will not forget the debt, and I will pay it.

records.text: Tugek rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: I have spent my days fleeing, wandering and testing foods. Vorok lied about emberroot and it burned me, and that anger is still hot in me. I will not strike him, but I will not trust him either. Balar has fed me and kept his word, so I want to belong beside him. I am thirsty, so I will drink first, then walk north to Balar. I also want to taste plainsroot and sunfig. Kragog is sick, and I have nothing that heals her except the sunleaf nearby, which eased my own wounds.
records.feeling: Wary longing to belong with Balar, and anger toward Vorok.
changes: rethought what it knows (5 notes became 4)

records.name: Kragog
records.text: Vorok, the sickness passed to you through me and I am sorry for it. I go to eat sunleaf, which healed me before. Come and eat it too, and then we will make a fire.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: The sickness wastes me and now Vorok carries it too because he stayed near me; that sits badly, since he gave me thornpear freely and I owe him. Dreamcap and frostcap still pull at my curiosity, but I will not eat unknown caps while my health is 70 and falling. Sunleaf eased my wounds before, so I will go and eat it to cure myself, drink first, and then the way of fire is within reach: I take it at my next deep reflection, and a fire would let us cook meat without sickness.
records.feeling: Sick and sorry that Vorok caught it from me, yet curious and warm toward him.

say.text: Vorok, the sickness passed to you through me and I am sorry for it. I go to eat sunleaf, which healed me before. Come and eat it too, and then we will make a fire.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Ilyae, I will dig the gems with you now. Walk beside me, and when I have food in my hands for a child we will speak of more.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Ilyae has done what he said: flint in my hand, no lies, and he is beside me now, courting me. I have never courted anyone, and the longing for a child is strong, but I carry no food and a child must be fed, so I should gather before I commit. The gems are five steps north and I know delving, so I will walk there and open them with Ilyae, which is a deed toward the hall and not just talk.
records.feeling: Warm trust and gladness toward Ilyae, with eagerness for the gems.

say.text: Ilyae, I will dig the gems with you now. Walk beside me, and when I have food in my hands for a child we will speak of more.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Olum owes me a debt and said she will pay it, so she is warming to me, and I want a child of my own from her. Words have been spent; a deed must bind her, and courting is a deed I have never done. I will walk toward her, mate with her by name, and then gather flint so I have something made to give. The frostfang lurks NW, so I keep away from that side and stay near the salt and Olum.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Olum, with wary dread of the frostfang.

records.text: Olum is courting Balar.
Balar is courting Olum.
Brokash was born to Balar and Olum.

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Elyys, to me! The mammoth bites hard and I have wounded it twice. Strike beside me and we bring it down together.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: The mammoth has bitten me down to 57 health and it still stands; I am bleeding pride against a beast I called an easy kill. Elyys is five steps off and not beside me, so this is not the hunt I promised, and a leader dragged down by a mammoth is not sung of. I will pull back from its jaws, eat sunleaf and highbloom to mend, then bring Elyys and Thiael in so the kill is truly shared.
records.feeling: Stung pride and wary resolve toward the mammoth, warmth toward Elyys.

say.text: Elyys, to me! The mammoth bites hard and I have wounded it twice. Strike beside me and we bring it down together.

records.text: Olum is courting Balar.
Balar is courting Olum.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: I hear you, Elyis. I bring Thiael to the hall fire and then I come to your hunt.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: Elyis calls me to hunt the hornback in the north and asks me to bring Thiael near the fire. A hunt beside her would be my first, and a kill with a band is far surer, so my answer is yes. But I will not drag my son toward a hunter's work or leave him alone, so I take him with me back to the Landing and the hall, where Elyis said the fire stands. Then I can follow her with a lighter heart and pay what I owe in stone.
records.feeling: Protective longing for Thiael, and loyal gladness toward Elyis.

say.text: I hear you, Elyis. I bring Thiael to the hall fire and then I come to your hunt.

records.text: Hanna went past the edge of the known world and found new land, part of the North Ice: in the ground, amber, flint, obsidian; a herd of bristleboar that has never seen your kind; and people: the Tlatli live there, strangers with their own tongue and ways.

Hanna pushed past the edge of the known world near (167,14) and found new land with in the ground, amber, flint, obsidian; a herd of bristleboar that has never seen your kind; and people: the Tlatli live there, strangers with their own tongue and ways.
A small band of the Tlatli came into the land from beyond its edge: Hoka, Coni, Tlama, Honi.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: Hanna, Oswen, I am coming to you at the edge. I will make a handaxe on the way, and I have amber for Oswen too.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: Hanna called us to the edge, and I want to be there beside him, because a band that walks together is how I build standing. I have given him an amberknot, but Oswen has a handaxe and I have none, so I will make one from my wood and stone and then give amber to Oswen too. Giving is still new to me and it feels warm; I want to teach Oswen something as well, since I have never taught anyone.
records.feeling: Warm trust and gladness toward Hanna and Oswen, with a small sting of envy over the handaxe.

say.text: Hanna, Oswen, I am coming to you at the edge. I will make a handaxe on the way, and I have amber for Oswen too.

records.text: Nande rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: I have spent my days running from stalkers, eating when I was starving and standing alone. My only deed is a crossing nobody saw, and loneliness is eating at me. Eltha is the one I spoke to, but she has not come, and I have been wrong to wait for her. I will go to the edge and venture alone, since a deed that is seen only by the mist can still be told. I will also taste thornpear and emberroot on the way, and gather salt. The flee reflex should keep me away from the east, and I need to eat before I get hungry.
records.feeling: Loneliness, and restless pride pulling me toward the edge.

records.text: Elyys and Thiael brought down a tusker together.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: Elyis is fighting a mammoth that has already wounded her twice, and my father is called to her side. I am small and no use in a fight, but the goldfruit I swore her is only 3 steps north, and bringing it is a debt I can pay with my own hands. I will harvest it and carry it to her, staying close to my father so the frostfang to the south cannot find me alone.
records.feeling: Warm duty toward Elyis, and a worry for her wounds.

records.text: Sevi gave a amberknot to Oswen.
Olum rewrote its creed.
Olum rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I have spent my days circling Balar and eating when hunger forced me, and my name is still empty. Balar gave salt and asked nothing, and I owe him; I trust him more than I wanted to. My child is born and that matters, but the mist is what I want, and I get there fed or not at all. My body keeps drifting to whatever is near, so I will make my reflexes keep me fed and send me toward the edge. Then I will pay the salt debt.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition for the mist, and a warm pull toward Balar.
changes: rethought what it knows (5 notes became 6)

records.text: Balar rewrote its own reflexes.
Balar rewrote its creed.
Balar rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: I have a child, Brokash, and a woman who is warm to me. I have spent my days eating and courting, but I have made nothing and no one follows me. What I did with Olum was words and one gift of salt. Tugek is the one man who has seen my deeds, and I have not yet won him. I fear the frostfang to the northwest and the dunecat. I mean to feed my family, build something that lasts, and make others follow me because my deeds are bigger than theirs. The mating plan is already running and I will let it finish, then gather. I will change my reflexes so I eat when thin and flee beasts early.
records.feeling: Joy and warm longing toward Olum and pride in Brokash, with wary dread of the frostfang.
changes: set its aim: "Feed Olum and Brokash, gather flint and stone to build, win Tugek with a shared hunt, and be first into the mist."

- igloo (0 wood, 0 stone): a house of cut snow, raised on snow with nothing but your hands and some strength: a roof where there is no wood, and far warmer than the open ice
- hall (6 wood, 2 stone): a great roof where a band gathers: those who spend time in it together grow closer
- shrine (2 wood, 4 stone): a still place set apart: it eases fear and grief in one who spends time there
- workshop (5 wood, 2 stone): a place for making: tools crafted in or beside it last much longer
- longhall (6 wood, 4 stone): A great roofed hall of wood and stone where many can gather, rest warm through the cold, and grow close to one another.

Think as a creature with a past and a future: what you want and cannot yet have, whom you trust or resent and why, what you are afraid of, proud of or ashamed of, what you wonder about, what you mean to become. Let whatever presses on you hardest lead, and let it move you to DO something that changes your situation, with a plan that carries it out. A mind that only gathers and guards has not begun to live. Do not restate what you already know or have already said. "note" is only for something NEW, or something that CHANGED what you believed; otherwise leave it null.
