records.name: Brokash
records.thought: Balar and Olum lean toward each other and I am the small one left out, and it burns. Tugek holds 4 food and I hold nothing; I will not stay a child in someone's shadow. I will do something with my own hands: gather stone from the rock close by, since what a hand makes is its own, and that is how I begin to build standing.
records.feeling: Jealous of Balar for Olum's closeness, and hungry to be more than a child.
changes: set its aim: "Gather stone and wood and build something of my own, so my standing grows beyond Balar's shadow."

records.name: Oswen
records.text: Hanna, I made a handaxe with my own hands. I am coming to you at the edge, and I will bring it as a gift. Stay close, a stranger woman stands to the northeast.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: I have a fresh handaxe and Hanna and Sevi are gathering at the edge, so I should go to them rather than linger here alone. I still owe Brunde a gift, and standing comes from making and giving, so I will give my spare handaxe to Sevi or Hanna when I reach them. Tlama is strange and far off; I will keep my kin between us and curious eyes on her, but not run at her.
records.feeling: Glad and eager, drawn to Hanna and Sevi, wary and curious about Tlama.

say.text: Hanna, I made a handaxe with my own hands. I am coming to you at the edge, and I will bring it as a gift. Stay close, a stranger woman stands to the northeast.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Sevi, Oswen, stay close to me. We found this land first. Now we carry flint and amber to the Tlatli and see what they will give for it.
Hanna named a place "Mistgate".

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: I broke through the mist and found land no one had stood on before me, and Sevi and Oswen are glad beside me. Hoka and Tlama of the Tlatli stood close a moment ago, and I have flint and amber that no stranger has yet seen. I want to show them the goods and learn what they value, because that is how a trader is made, and I want my band near me when I do.
records.feeling: Proud and hopeful joy in my band, with a hunger to trade with the Tlatli.

say.text: Sevi, Oswen, stay close to me. We found this land first. Now we carry flint and amber to the Tlatli and see what they will give for it.

records.name: Tlama
records.thought: The mist is one step away, and I can't stop thinking about it; whoever walks in first will be remembered, and I have no aim yet. I weigh the risk: the unknown might be bad, but my belly is full, my health is whole, and Coni, Honi and Hoka stand close, strong and unclaimed. I'll step to the edge and venture, and meanwhile taste the frostcap and sunleaf beside me, since I've never known them.
records.feeling: Curiosity pulling me toward the mist, with a little wariness of the unknown.
changes: set its aim: "Be the first to find what lies beyond the mist and bring back its riches to my people."
now wonders: What lies beyond the mist, and will it be rich in food and herds?

records.text: Vesys rewrote its own way of thinking.
Vesys discovered fire: "kept ember" — A small flame fed with wood and kept burning beside the shelter gives warmth and keeps beasts off..

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: I have spent my days tasting and learning alone, and I have given little. I have built nothing, and Elyis's standing outweighs mine for that reason. Elyys matters to me, but he has a child with Elyis. I will not push between them, and I will earn standing by giving and building instead. Ssassa and Elyys were kind to me, and I want to repay them with things I make, not only words. I mean to raise something shared, and I will not hurt anyone to get it. Kelbulb is still young, so I will wait on it and make something useful first.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Elyys and Ssassa, and a quiet ache of longing for Elyys.
changes: rethought what it knows (8 notes became 7)

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: Hanna's band stands above me and I have nothing: no followers, no made thing, no name. Sevi's handaxe gnaws at me, and so does Sevi, but I cannot speak their tongue, so I will start with what I can do: take the amber and make something bright to hold or give. Then I will go to the edge three steps south and venture, because whoever finds new land first is remembered, and I mean to be remembered before Hanna's band takes everything.
records.feeling: Hungry for standing, envious of Sevi and Hanna.
changes: set its aim: "Become a hero: find new land beyond the edge and gain followers and standing above Hanna."
now wonders: What would Sevi take from my hand, since words mean nothing between us?

records.text: Hoka won amber from the ground.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Kragog is two steps away and asked me to come eat sunleaf with her, and I am sick already, so my nearness costs her nothing new. I carry nothing, and my own rule says to give with my feet before I speak. I'll drink first, since thirst presses, then pick sunleaf at (49,85) and eat it to ease my wasting, carry the rest to her, and then think on wood for the fire we spoke of.
records.feeling: Warm longing and loyalty toward Kragog, with a dull ache from the sickness.

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Elyys, Thiael, come to me. We lay out meat and eat together, then I carry a share to Ssassa and Vesys, so they see what following me gives.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: The hunt is done and the meat is mine and Elyys's, so my pride has something to stand on, but a name is not sung from meat alone. I have never given anything to anyone, and strangers will not follow a chief who only keeps. I will share a meal with Elyys and Thiael where they can see me do it, and make the band feel what it is to belong to me. Then I will carry meat toward Ssassa and Vesys, who are near, and let my open hand do what my boasting has not.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Elyys and Thiael, hungry for a name that others say.

say.text: Elyys, Thiael, come to me. We lay out meat and eat together, then I carry a share to Ssassa and Vesys, so they see what following me gives.

records.text: Hanna gave a amber to Hoka.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: Hanna, I am coming to you with my own handaxe and amber to spare. I will stand beside you when we meet the Tlatli, and I will give where you tell me to.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: Hanna asked us to stay close, and I trust him more than anyone, so I will go to him at the edge and not wander off alone. Oswen has his own handaxe and I have mine now, so the old sting of envy is gone; what I have left is amber to give and a wish to build standing beside Hanna. Hoka is a stranger I cannot read, but a raised hand and a gift need no words, and Hanna means to trade flint and amber with the Tlatli, so I will bring amber and see what Hoka does.
records.feeling: Warm trust and gladness toward Hanna and Oswen, with wary curiosity toward Hoka.

say.text: Hanna, I am coming to you with my own handaxe and amber to spare. I will stand beside you when we meet the Tlatli, and I will give where you tell me to.

records.text: Eltha was set upon by a frostfang at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Elyys rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My days have been following Elyis, hunting beside her, and carrying stone and meat, but I still haven't paid Vesys for the pick she taught me. Thiael is near and well, and that is what matters most. My hands are full of meat, so I should share it with my son and make the pick for Vesys. I have also never tasted kelbulb, and it is two steps away. I fear wandering alone at night and I fear the stalker, so I stay in company. I have been letting the body drift on reflexes when I should act on my debts.
records.feeling: Protective gladness toward Thiael and loyalty toward Elyis.

records.text: Elyys led "sharing" with Elyis, Thiael.
Elyis led "sharing" with Elyys, Thiael.
Thiael rewrote its own way of thinking.
Thiael discovered tools: "Canopy picker" — A forked wooden hook bound with vine that reaches high fruit and lets me pick more at once..
Thiael invented the canopy picker (for gather, x1.3) — A forked wooden hook bound with vine that reaches high fruit and lets me pick more at once..

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: I have spent my days at my parents' heels, gathering, giving food and watching, and I am glad of it. But I have never given anything to anyone, and Elyys's care sits in me as a debt. Now the way of tools is within my grasp. I will take it and make a gathering tool, so I can feed the band and become someone who gives. I stay near my parents and keep away from the frostfang.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Elyys, and eager curiosity about making tools.
changes: devised its first thing: the canopy picker

records.name: Oswen
records.text: Hanna, here is a handaxe I made for you. I stay at your side while we carry flint and amber to the Tlatli.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: I have two handaxes and amberknots, and Hanna is three steps off, so now is the time to give rather than keep. A gift to Hanna earns standing and pays something toward what I owe Brunde. The Tlatli stay near and I cannot read them, so I keep my kin between us, but a gift needs no words and I want to see how they answer one.
records.feeling: Glad and eager toward Hanna, and warily curious about the Tlatli.

say.text: Hanna, here is a handaxe I made for you. I stay at your side while we carry flint and amber to the Tlatli.

records.text: Oswen gave a handaxe to Hanna.
Sevi gave a amberknot to Oswen.
Hanna rewrote its own way of thinking.
Hanna discovered archery: "flint bow" — A bow strung with sinew and tipped with flint, so my hunts land from afar and with harder blows..

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering flint and amber and finding new land, and I am proud of that. But the goods are still worthless because no buyer has seen them. Hoka stands beside me and took the amber I gave without answering, so I will try again with flint, which a hunter's people can use. Sevi and Oswen are coming to me, and I want them close when I deal with the Tlatli. I also lean toward archery, because my hunting has paid off and a bow would suit it.
records.feeling: Proud and eager to trade, wary toward Hoka and the Tlatli.

records.text: Eltha rewrote its own reflexes.
Eltha discovered tools: "Flintspear" — A long wood shaft tipped with a knapped flint blade, to hunt and to keep fangs off me..
Eltha invented the flintspear (for hunt, x1.3) — A long wood shaft tipped with a knapped flint blade, to hunt and to keep fangs off me..

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: A frostfang bit me in the dark while I stood alone, and I felt my fear. I have been drifting between flint and edge with seven flints and nothing made, and Nande and Hanna are already sung of. The way of tools is within my reach and I take it now, because a made thing outlasts me and a spear in my hand answers the fang. Then I go to the hall and the edge, with a weapon and not just boldness.
records.feeling: Fear of the frostfang, and hunger to be sung of, with envy toward Nande and Hanna.
changes: devised its first thing: the flintspear

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: Thiael is near and glad, and he has made a canopy picker, which fills me with pride. My plan is already carrying me to gather and then make the pick for Vesys, and that is the debt I most want paid. Once the pick is made I will bring it to her, and I will taste kelbulb on the way since it is one step off and I am curious.
records.feeling: Warm pride in Thiael and gladness, with loyalty to Elyis and a wish to pay Vesys.

records.name: Elyis
records.title: The Mammoth and the Meal
records.text: Elyis was bitten to fifty-seven by the mammoth and did not run. She brought the meat home and shared it with her band and then with strangers. That is how a chief is made.
Elyis discovered fire: "Ember-keeping" — A kept flame of wood by the shelter that warms the band, drives off beasts, and makes meat safe and filling..

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: I have spent these days hunting, building a name and sharing meat, and it has been good. Elyys and Thiael are my band, and I am proud of them. But two followers do not make a chief who is sung of, and I have taught no one and left no mark. I mean to show what following me gives by carrying food to Ssassa and Vesys, and to make fire and the old ways something the band lives by. I will keep my plan to Ssassa and then plant my seeds so the forest grows what I take, as my people hold.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Elyys and Thiael, hungry for a name.
changes: made a tale: "The Mammoth and the Meal"

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: Hanna's band stands above me, and I have seven amber and nothing to show for it. The edge is nine steps off and the plan to venture is already running; if I find new land first, that is how I climb past Hanna, not by begging beside her. I'll keep walking, and when I come back I'll bring something bright in my hand for Sevi to take.
records.feeling: Hungry for standing, envious of Hanna and Sevi, and set on reaching the edge before them.

records.text: Elyis gave meat to Ssassa.

records.name: Coni
records.text: Honi, I am Coni of the Tlatli. Come, share food with me. It is better not to stand alone out here.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: Hanna's band stands together at the river and they are strong, but I cannot understand a word they say. Honi is right beside me and he is of my own people, so I will start with him: a shared meal is something we both understand without words. I am careful and I want to belong, and a small gift is how I begin.
records.feeling: A quiet longing to belong, with caution toward Hanna's strange band.

say.text: Honi, I am Coni of the Tlatli. Come, share food with me. It is better not to stand alone out here.

changes: set its aim: "Find a place among others: a fire that is mine too, with water, food, wood and stone close by."
now wonders: What is Hanna's band doing at the river, and would they let me stand with them?

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I stand on a gem deposit with a pick in my hand and delving in my head, and I have only watched Vesys break bright things from the rock. Ilyae is far off and I trust him, but trust that only talks does not raise a hall; I will dig here now and put real stone and gems in my hands. I carry no food for a child and I will not promise what I cannot feed, so I work first and gather after.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Ilyae, and eagerness to open the gems.

records.text: Coni led "sharing" with Honi.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Ssassa, I have found the way of mining. Stay by me and I will win the gems under this hall and share what comes. I will teach you hand-craft too, no price.
Vesys taught Ssassa.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Mining and weaving are within my grasp, and I should take mining now so the deep gems under my own feet can be won; that is knowledge I can turn into gifts and a shared hall. Ssassa stands beside me and has been kind, and I have given nothing yet, so I will teach them what I know and then build with them. Elyys will have to wait; I will not push between him and Elyis's child, and I will earn my place by deeds.
records.feeling: Eager gratitude toward Ssassa, and a steady ache for Elyys that I choose not to feed.

say.text: Ssassa, I have found the way of mining. Stay by me and I will win the gems under this hall and share what comes. I will teach you hand-craft too, no price.

changes: taught Ssassa a lesson: "Hand-craft: one wood and one stone, worked with flint, make a tool that gathers faster. Keep the flint close."

records.name: Honi
records.text: Coni, sister of the Tlatli, come eat with me. I have seen where the great beasts walk and I mean to hunt them. Stand with me and we will be the ones the others envy.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Hanna has a handaxe, a band and standing 6.2, and I have nothing but three berries and a loud wish to be sung of. Coni is right beside me, a woman of my own people who follows no one, and she is the first piece of a band if I can win her. I'll share food with her to earn her warmth. I'll tell her whatever draws her to me, since the truth is only a tool. A shared meal gives me a first gift, a first follower and a start on standing.
records.feeling: Hungry for standing, envious of Hanna, and drawn toward Coni as my first ally.

say.text: Coni, sister of the Tlatli, come eat with me. I have seen where the great beasts walk and I mean to hunt them. Stand with me and we will be the ones the others envy.

changes: set its aim: "Gather a band of my own people, starting with Coni, and rise in standing above Hanna."
now wonders: What would it take for Coni to follow me?

records.text: Honi led "sharing" with Coni.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: Hanna, I am staying close. I will bind another amberknot with you beside me, and I will taste the nafrostcap and snowberry here and tell you what they do.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: Curiosity about nafrostcap and snowberry is nagging at me, and they grow just two or three steps away, so I can taste them without leaving Hanna's side. Hanna is one step north and Oswen is close, so I feel safe enough to test small things. I also want to give something that builds standing, so I will make an amberknot with Hanna standing beside me and then try the new foods.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Hanna and Oswen, with eager curiosity about the unknown plants.

say.text: Hanna, I am staying close. I will bind another amberknot with you beside me, and I will taste the nafrostcap and snowberry here and tell you what they do.

records.text: Sevi led "amberknot" with Hanna.
Ilyae rewrote its own way of thinking.
Ilyae discovered mining: "flint delving" — I strike the rock with a flint edge, as Ssassa does, to split out gems and ore..

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: My days have been courting Ssassa and watching Elyis grow bigger. I have talked a lot and made little. Ssassa is the one who matters to me, because she gave me a pick with no price. Elyis has a hall and a band, and I envy her. I want my own roof and a following, and I lack stone. I watched Ssassa mine, so I can learn mining now and win gems and ore, which others lack. That is a thing in my hands to make people choose me. At night I should stay near the roof and company.
records.feeling: Warm desire for Ssassa and sharp envy of Elyis.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Vesys, your handcraft lesson is received and I will not forget it. When I have stone I will make the tool and show you it works.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I stand on gems with a pick in hand, and Vesys has now taught me handcraft after I gave her highbloom, so gifts returned in kind are real here. Ilyae is the one I trust, but I will not court him until I have food enough to feed a child, and gathering is the honest way to get it. I will keep digging gems and gathering, then go to the ore seam and test what delving yields, since I still don't know what ore is for.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Ilyae and Vesys, and eagerness to test the ore.

say.text: Vesys, your handcraft lesson is received and I will not forget it. When I have stone I will make the tool and show you it works.

records.name: Coni
records.text: Honi, I will stand with you. My word is good. Let us hunt the great beasts together, and let us find a place with water, food, wood and stone close by.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: Honi ate with me and told me to stand with him, and I felt warmer for it. I want to follow someone surer than I am, and he is of my people, so I will say it plainly and mean it. Whether I court him comes second, and I am not ready to rush it. A child needs a fire and a good place, and this ground is poor. I will also pick the cloudberry underfoot to carry, so I have something to give when I meet Hanna's band.
records.feeling: Warm, hopeful trust toward Honi, and a wish to belong.

say.text: Honi, I will stand with you. My word is good. Let us hunt the great beasts together, and let us find a place with water, food, wood and stone close by.

records.name: Tlama
records.thought: The mist is one step NW and last time it was too thick, but the will to try is not spent. I weigh the risk and I mean to try again; if it opens, I'll be the first and my people will be fed by it. Hanna stands close and the gnawing is there, but a gift needs no words, so I'll leave him be for now and earn my own standing first.
records.feeling: Curiosity pulling me toward the mist, with a steady ache toward Hanna.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Tlama, I am Hanna. This is flint, good for spear and axe. Take it, and show me what you would give for more.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Hoka took my amber without a word, but Tlama stands one step from me carrying food, and she has not run or raised a hand. If I put flint in her palm and watch what she offers back, I learn what these Ice-folk value. Sevi and Oswen are close, so I can do this bold and unafraid, and I will not let my goods stay worthless.
records.feeling: Proud and eager, curious toward Tlama.

say.text: Tlama, I am Hanna. This is flint, good for spear and axe. Take it, and show me what you would give for more.

records.name: Kragog
records.text: Vorok, I gather thornpear and sunleaf for you, to pay my debt. Eat the sunleaf, it eased me.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: Hunger gnaws at me and I carry nothing, so food comes first: sapcane is underfoot and plainsroot and thornpear are close, and they feed me far better than sapcane. Vorok is sick and near, and I feel warm toward him; I owe him for the thornpear, so I will pick extra thornpear and bring it to him, and sunleaf to ease his sickness. After that, with my belly easier, I will court him, because I want a child with him and he courted me first.
records.feeling: Hungry and tender toward Vorok, whom I owe.

say.text: Vorok, I gather thornpear and sunleaf for you, to pay my debt. Eat the sunleaf, it eased me.

records.text: Hanna gave a flint to Tlama.

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Sit with me in my hall, friends. Elyys and Thiael are mine and will come back to its fire. Whoever stands with Elyis eats at my fire and shares what we win. I will teach what I know, and I keep my word.
Elyis taught Ssassa. Ssassa has now learned from 2 teachers.
Elyis taught Ssassa fire ("Ember-keeping").

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: My pride is full: the hall stands, the mammoth is told of, and Thiael is mine, yet Thiael is out of my sight and that pulls at me hardest. Ssassa, Vesys and Ilyae sit here and have not pledged, so I will give them a reason to follow by teaching Ssassa and Vesys something real, and sharing a meal under my own roof. It is night, so I keep to the hall with company, then call Elyys and Thiael home at dawn.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, longing for Thiael and Elyys and hungry for a name.

say.text: Sit with me in my hall, friends. Elyys and Thiael are mine and will come back to its fire. Whoever stands with Elyis eats at my fire and shares what we win. I will teach what I know, and I keep my word.

changes: taught Ssassa a lesson: "Fire keeps the night and the frostfang away: feed it wood and sit beside it. This is my Ember-keeping.", the way of fire

records.name: Honi
records.text: Coni, your word is good and so is mine. Let us make a child of the Tlatli, and then we hunt the boars together and share the kill out first, as our people do.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Coni has said she will stand with me, and the surest way to hold her is to put a child between us and give her the standing of a mother of my line. Hanna sits over there with a band and a handaxe, and I mean to outgrow him, but first I need Coni bound close. We are both well fed, so I will court her now and then take her hunting at the boars to earn the first kill that will be sung of.
records.feeling: Hungry for standing and drawn to Coni as my first ally.

say.text: Coni, your word is good and so is mine. Let us make a child of the Tlatli, and then we hunt the boars together and share the kill out first, as our people do.

Hoka rewrote its creed.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: I have spent my days circling Hanna's band, taking amber, watching, and getting nothing that lasts. The mist was too thick at the edge, but my will to try is not spent. I envy Sevi's axe and want Sevi herself, and I cannot speak to her. A made thing in my hand would speak for me, so I will gather wood and stone for an axe and then return to the edge. I am fed now, so there is no excuse to idle.
records.feeling: Ambition and envy gnaw at me, mostly toward Hanna and Sevi.
changes: set its aim: "Make a handaxe, then find new land beyond the edge and gain followers above Hanna."

records.text: Vorok rewrote its own reflexes.
Vorok rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: I have spent these days following Kragog, taking her gifts and falling sick beside her. The sunleaf has eased me, and that is the first real turn toward health. She matters most to me. She paid her debts, and I want to answer her with my feet, not only with words. I have carried nothing for her, I have never gathered wood or stone, and I still don't know where water, food, wood and stone lie together. I fear dying idle and alone. So I will pick thornpear and sunleaf and bring them to her, then try the frostmoss. My reflexes also need to change so I stay near her and take healing plants when I'm sick.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty and a wish to repay Kragog.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Ssassa, a frostfang prowls east and it is night. Let us keep to this hall until dawn, then walk northeast together to the kelbulb and feverbark. I have stone and wood; when you have a pick ready we will win the gems unde

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Ssassa has been steady and kind, and I owe them for the highbloom, so I will keep my word and stay close. It is night and a frostfang is about seven steps east, so I will not wander to the kelbulb and firepod now; my curiosity can wait for dawn, and I will not be caught alone in the dark again. I can learn something with Ssassa here by the fire and the hall, and share the delving I watched, since giving is how I earn standing. The ache for Elyys I leave unfed, and I will not push between him and Elyis.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Ssassa, and a restless curiosity held back by the night.

say.text: Ssassa, a frostfang prowls east and it is night. Let us keep to this hall until dawn, then walk northeast together to the kelbulb and feverbark. I have stone and wood; when you have a pick ready we will win the gems under this hall and share them.

records.text: A wolf brought down a nibbet.

records.name: Oswen
records.text: Sevi, I am coming to you. Let us bind an amberknot together, and I will give one back to you for the ones you gave me.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: Hanna is ten steps east with Sevi near, and the Tlatli are close to them, so my place is at my parents' side, not alone out here at the edge. I have amber and amberknots; Sevi gave me knots and I have not yet given anything back, which sits in me as a debt. I'll go to Sevi, bind another amberknot with them so we both have a gift to give, and then offer one to Tlama, since a gift needs no words and I want to see what the Tlatli do with it.
records.feeling: Glad and eager toward Hanna and Sevi, warily curious about the Tlatli.

say.text: Sevi, I am coming to you. Let us bind an amberknot together, and I will give one back to you for the ones you gave me.

records.name: Coni
records.text: Honi, I hear you, and I am glad of you. Let us hunt the bristleboar close by first and share the kill out as our people do. Then, when we find a place with water, wood and stone, I will say yes to the child.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: Honi is warm to me and of my own people, and he has asked me twice for a child. I trust him, but this ground is poor, with water far off and no wood, and a child would have to be fed and kept warm here. I won't rush it. First I want to hunt beside him and share the kill out as our people do, so I learn whether his word holds, and I can still say yes when the ground is better. I will tell him so plainly, because I despise lies and won't leave him guessing.
records.feeling: Warm, hopeful trust toward Honi, with caution about a child on poor ground.

say.text: Honi, I hear you, and I am glad of you. Let us hunt the bristleboar close by first and share the kill out as our people do. Then, when we find a place with water, wood and stone, I will say yes to the child.

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Balar, you kept your word to me. I will follow you. Lead the hunt, and I will walk behind you and share what we win.
Tugek pledged to follow Balar.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar stands right beside me, and his deeds have matched his words: he fed me, he took my salt, and he did not press the courting once I said I was not ready. I am tired of being alone, and a man who keeps his word is worth following. I will pledge to follow him and take him at his word about the hunt and the edge of the world. First I will drink, since I am thirsty, and I have never tasted dreamcap, so I will gather one on the way.
records.feeling: Wary hope of belonging, toward Balar.

say.text: Balar, you kept your word to me. I will follow you. Lead the hunt, and I will walk behind you and share what we win.

changes: set its aim: "Follow Balar, hunt beside him, and see whether he leads me well."

records.text: Coni and Honi brought down a bristleboar together.
Oswen led "amberknot" with Sevi.
Oswen gave a amberknot to Sevi.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: Oswen, come, I am here. We will bind the amberknot together, and I have more amber for the next one too.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: Oswen is coming to bind an amberknot with me, and I have amber to spare, so I will wait and do it with him. Hanna is four steps east and trusts the Tlatli with flint; I want to be near him and show I can give too. The frostcap one step away is still untasted, and my question about Kinmire stays with me, but a small taste beside my family feels safe enough.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Oswen and Hanna, with curiosity about frostcap.

say.text: Oswen, come, I am here. We will bind the amberknot together, and I have more amber for the next one too.

records.text: Ssassa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I have spent my days digging gems and picking stone, and I hold twelve gems with nothing to build from them. That is not what I want. Ilyae has kept his word and Elyis gave me meat and fire, so I trust them. Vesys returned my gift too. What I want and lack is a hall with Ilyae and a child fed from my own hands, and for that I need food stored and my own plants growing. I have never planted a seed, and I carry two. Tonight I stay near the fire and the hall because of the frostfang, and at dawn I plant and gather. I will change my reflexes so my body shelters at night and eats when it can.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Ilyae, with a wish to build something real.
changes: set its aim: "Plant my seeds, store food, then raise a hall with Ilyae"

records.name: Tlama
records.thought: The mist was too thick yesterday, but my will to try is not spent, and the edge is only two steps away. Hanna gave me a flint and I have given nothing back; I understand only a little of his tongue, but a gift needs no words, so I mean to give him a berry and see how he takes it. Then I will return to the edge and venture again, because whoever finds what lies beyond earns the standing I lack.
records.feeling: Curiosity toward the mist, and a warm, shy pull toward Hanna.

records.text: Tlama gave berry to Hanna.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tugek, you have chosen well. The hopper stands close to the southeast. Come beside me and we hunt it now, and what we win we share, then we walk to the edge of the world together.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Tugek has pledged to follow me, and that is the first deed that has bound a man to me. Now I must give him a reason to stay: a shared hunt, with the hopper close by, and then the mist. I will eat first so my strength is high, then lead him. Olum and Brokash are my first care, and meat from a hunt can feed them too. Envy of Tugek's four foods nags me, but he is mine to lead now, not to rob.
records.feeling: Pride and hungry ambition toward Tugek, who now follows me.

say.text: Tugek, you have chosen well. The hopper stands close to the southeast. Come beside me and we hunt it now, and what we win we share, then we walk to the edge of the world together.

records.name: Oswen
records.text: Hanna, I have an amberknot for you. I am at your side, with Sevi.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: Sevi called me and I am glad to go, and I owe them a knot back; binding amberknots with my parents is how I earn standing and keep them near. I have three knots and amber to spare, so I'll give one to Hanna too, since she is weighed highest and my gift needs no words. The Tlatli are close and I cannot read them, so I keep my kin between us and watch what they do.
records.feeling: Glad and eager toward Sevi and Hanna, warily curious about the Tlatli.

say.text: Hanna, I have an amberknot for you. I am at your side, with Sevi.

records.text: Sevi led "amberknot" with Hanna, Oswen.
Oswen gave a amberknot to Hanna.
Balar and Brokash brought down a hopper together.

records.name: Brokash
records.thought: Balar has Olum and Tugek walking behind him, and I have nothing in my hands but one seed, so the jealousy sits hot in me. Thirst is here too, and the water is only six steps off. I will drink first, then get stone from the rock near me and make something that is mine, because what a hand makes belongs to that hand, and that is how my standing starts to grow.
records.feeling: Jealous and restless, wanting something of my own, mostly against Balar.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Coni, the boar is shared and the bargain is kept. Look: water at my side, trees all about, rock and amber and ore close by. This is the place you spoke of. Stay with me here and I will name it ours, and then we make the
Honi named a place "Honi's Rest".

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Coni says yes to the child once we find water, wood and stone together, and this spot has all three: a river at my elbow, trees all around, rock and amber and ore close by. I'll say whatever keeps her warm toward me, and the truth of it happens to serve me too. Hanna sits up there with his band and standing I'm hungry for; I'll earn mine with a shared kill, a child and a place that carries my name.
records.feeling: Eager and hungry for standing, drawn to Coni as my first ally.

say.text: Coni, the boar is shared and the bargain is kept. Look: water at my side, trees all about, rock and amber and ore close by. This is the place you spoke of. Stay with me here and I will name it ours, and then we make the child.

records.name: Olum
records.text: Balar, I pay what I owe. Take this salt for the salt you gave me. Then I go to the edge of the world, and I mean to enter first.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I am fed and the mist waited too thick for me today, but it thins again within a day or so, and I will not let Balar and Tugek walk there before me. Balar gave me salt and I owe him; I hold one salt of my own and the debt gnaws at me, so I will pay it now and be free of it. Then I go back to the edge and try again, because my name is still empty.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition for the mist, and an itch to clear my debt to Balar.

say.text: Balar, I pay what I owe. Take this salt for the salt you gave me. Then I go to the edge of the world, and I mean to enter first.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Tlama, you gave me berry twice. I repay my debts. Take this amber, golden stone. Show me what the Tlatli want most.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Tlama has now given me berry twice, and I gave her only one flint, so I owe her a debt and I repay what I owe. She shows she values food and goodwill, and flint may not be what she wants. I will take flint and amber to her, give her an amberknot-worthy piece, and stay close to her while Sevi and Oswen stand with me. That way I can watch what she offers back and learn what the Tlatli value.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Tlama, and eager to repay her.

records.text: Hanna gave a amber to Tlama.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: A frostfang three steps north, and it has already bitten me once. I will not stand here and be eaten. I am in Sevi's hall with a flintspear's worth of wood and stone, so I will make the spear now, then go for the edge at Mistgate once the beast is dealt with or gone. Hoka is a stranger who ate kelbulb and lived, and a man who follows no one; I have no words for him, but a shared fire costs me nothing and might bring me my first follower.
records.feeling: Dread of the frostfang, and a hungry wish to be followed and sung of.

records.name: Coni
records.text: Honi, you kept the bargain and so will I. I will follow you at Honi's Rest. Take this meat, and let us raise a roof here before we speak of the child.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: Honi kept his bargain: the boar was shared and the place is named. The ground still worries me, but there is water three steps off, flint underfoot and trees all about, and I am tired of standing alone. I will pledge to follow him, and I will give him a share of my meat now, because my hands are full and sharing is how my people show their word is good. The child can wait until I see a fire and a roof here.
records.feeling: Warm, hopeful trust toward Honi, wanting to stand behind him.

say.text: Honi, you kept the bargain and so will I. I will follow you at Honi's Rest. Take this meat, and let us raise a roof here before we speak of the child.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: I am still sick, so I must keep my distance from the child Brokash and from Balar, but I cannot look away from a boy alone with only 2 food. Kragog is the one I trust and she is 19 moments off to the south, so I should carry my thornpear to her and keep a few steps between us. The sunleaf she gave me eased my wasting, and I have sunleaf seeds, so I will plant them here by the water to grow a healing plant for us both. Planting is also something new, and it brings farming closer.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Kragog and worry for the boy Brokash.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Tugek follows me, and a tusker bit me twice, so I will not stand near it and bleed for nothing. Brokash is close and Olum comes with salt; the family is gathered, so a sharing now will bind them with food in hand, and I am thirsty besides. I will drink first, then lay out a sharing with Brokash beside me, and then gather flint toward something I can build.
records.feeling: Proud, hungry ambition toward Tugek, and warm protectiveness toward Brokash and Olum.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: I am fed and whole enough, and the loneliness is the loudest thing in me now. Hanna is the only one who answers me, and he was last seen north near Mistgate, so I will go to him and not sit here brooding over Sevi. On the way I will carry my goldgrass and meat, and tell him what I learned about vinebean and goldgrass. I will test naroot on the way, since I am fed and safe, and answer my old question.
records.feeling: Loneliness toward Hanna, and a restless curiosity about the unknown foods.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: I have watched Eltha make a flintspear and I know how it is done, while my hands hold only amber. A made thing is what lifts me above Hanna and Sevi, and I stand on forest now with trees all around and ore and rock close by. I will gather wood here, then stone, craft the spear and a handaxe, and hunt the beasts nearby, since a kill is how I earn standing. Eltha is a stranger and I keep my distance, but I will watch her.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and envy, mostly toward Eltha's flintspear and Sevi's axe.

records.text: Hanna led "amberknot" with Oswen, Tlama.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Coni, you spoke well. We raise the roof first, as you said. I gather wood from these trees, you stay near and gather stone from the rock. Then the child, and Honi's Rest will be ours.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Coni has said she will follow me at Honi's Rest and wants a roof raised before the child. Roofs need wood, and I have never gathered any, so I'll do that now. My hands are full of meat, so I'll eat first to make room and keep my strength up. A roof and a child will give me the standing Eltha has, and Hanna will look small beside it. I mean to bind Coni close with work and shared food, and keep my own gain in mind.
records.feeling: Eager and hungry for standing, warm toward Coni as my first follower.

say.text: Coni, you spoke well. We raise the roof first, as you said. I gather wood from these trees, you stay near and gather stone from the rock. Then the child, and Honi's Rest will be ours.

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Balar, I am coming to you. Let us take the hopper together, and I will watch how you lead.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar called me to the hunt, and I gave my word to follow; deeds have matched his words so far, so I will go and test him by what he does in the hunt, not by what he says. Brokash is a child with burned guts and no one beside him, and he stands near where Balar is, so I will walk that way and see if the boy needs help. Olum means to reach the edge first, but I am careful, and I would rather learn from the hunt first and see the mist later.
records.feeling: Wary hope and loyalty toward Balar, with pity for Brokash.

say.text: Balar, I am coming to you. Let us take the hopper together, and I will watch how you lead.

records.name: Tlama
records.thought: The mist was too thick, but it thins again within a day, and I am one step from it. Hanna has given me amber twice and I have only given berries, so I owe him; I will bind an amberknot beside him as a gift that needs no words, since Sevi's shadow on him still gnaws at me. Then I will go back to the edge and try to venture, because that is what I truly want.
records.feeling: Curiosity toward the mist, and a warm, shy pull toward Hanna.

records.text: Vorok gave thornpear to Kragog.
Tlama led "amberknot" with Hanna, Oswen.
Tlama gave a amberknot to Hanna.
Oswen rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: My days have been spent binding amberknots and giving them to Hanna and Sevi. That has been warm and good, but it is small work, and I have never hunted, built or taught anything. Hanna's standing is 7.0 and mine is 1.4, so I need to make something that lasts and give it away. I trust Hanna and Sevi completely. The Tlatli make me wary and curious, and I will watch Tlama and not run from her. The mist at the edge pulls at me, but a child should not go in alone. I want to build a shelter for my band, and I should invent a better tool for it.
records.feeling: Glad and eager toward Hanna and Sevi, with a pull toward the mist.
changes: set its aim: "Build a shelter and a workshop for my band, and craft tools to give my kin and the Tlatli"

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Ssassa, come east to the rock with me. We dig stone and gems together, and the hall that rises there will carry your name beside mine.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Ssassa stands beside me and her trust runs warm, but warm words have not yet raised a roof or made a child. Elyis outweighs me because she built and gave, so I must build and give too. I have wood and flint but no stone, and the rock lies east, with ore and gems near it. I will take the gems and stone there, then raise my own hall with Ssassa, and the band will follow what stands in the open.
records.feeling: Warm desire for Ssassa and sharp envy of Elyis.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: Hanna stands at seven and I at two, and I will not stay in that shadow while the mist thins. The edge is two steps from me and I hold a spear and flint, so I go back to it now and try the venture; being first into new land is what makes a woman sung of. If it refuses me again I will wait beside it, and I will not turn my eyes to Hanna and Sevi together.
records.feeling: Hungry for glory, and sour at Hanna's standing over me.

records.text: Oswen built a shelter.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: I have spent these days hunting beside Honi and waiting for a place to settle, and I am still standing in forest with full hands and no roof. Honi keeps his word, and I trust him, but he stands no higher than I do, so I cannot pledge to him yet. I could follow him in deed, though: gather wood here and stone from the obsidian and flint, as he asked, and build the hall with him. I worry about the child and the poor ground, so I will not rush. I was wrong to let my plan run out and leave my body idle. Gathering wood and stone also brings me toward tools.
records.feeling: Warm, steady trust toward Honi, and a wish to build something with him.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Tlama, you share fire and knots with me. I will bring more amber and flint, and I repay what I owe. Tell me what the Tlatli would trade for them.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Tlama has given me berry and two amberknots, and I have paid her only a flint and an amber, so I still feel the debt. I will gather amber from the deposit close by so my hands are full of goods to show her, and then bring them to her with Sevi and Oswen at my back. Keeping fed and near my own matters, but trade is what I am here for, and I will not idle.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Tlama, eager to repay her.

records.name: Kragog
records.text: Vorok, you gave me thornpear freely and I trust your hands. I want a child with you. If you want it too, plan to mate with me now.
Kragog rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: My days have been eating, drinking and wandering, and my aim to explore has barely moved. Vorok has dealt fairly with me, and I owe him, and I feel warmth for him that is turning to longing for a child. I am fed and safe, so I will court him. Mating costs 25 energy and I have 75, so I can afford it. I also mean to try taming, since my hands have never done it and the herding way needs it. I was wrong to let reflexes leave me idle when fed, so I will make them explore.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Vorok, and restless curiosity.

say.text: Vorok, you gave me thornpear freely and I trust your hands. I want a child with you. If you want it too, plan to mate with me now.

records.text: Kragog is courting Vorok.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: I am fed, and the loneliness is loud, and three strangers of the Tlatli stand north of me while I understand none of their speech. Hanna is the one I want, but he was last seen near Mistgate and the strangers are closer, so I will not walk past them as if they were nothing. A gift needs no words, so I will carry my meat and amber toward Tlama, who looks glad, and offer something small. I am curious about icekelp and frostmoss, and I am fed and safe enough to test one, so I will taste the icekelp four steps west first.
records.feeling: Loneliness pulling me toward Hanna, and wary curiosity toward the Tlatli strangers.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Ssassa, I hold twelve clear gems from this ground. One is yours, a gift with no price, as your pick was to me. Come back to me when you have your food and we raise our roof before dark.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Ssassa trusts me and Elyis outweighs me, so I must put something in hand that people can see. I stand on a gem deposit with twelve gems and eleven flint, and gems are a gift Elyis has not given anyone. I will gift Ssassa a gem to bind her closer, keep digging, and then bring stone back for a roof of my own before dark.
records.feeling: Warm desire for Ssassa and sharp envy of Elyis.

say.text: Ssassa, I hold twelve clear gems from this ground. One is yours, a gift with no price, as your pick was to me. Come back to me when you have your food and we raise our roof before dark.

records.text: Tlama rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Tlama
records.thought: For days I have chased the mist and handed out berries and knots, and the mist has not opened. Hanna matters to me, but he has a child with Sevi, and my jealousy is mostly wasted heat. Giving to him has been right, because he gave first and I repay. I have still never tasted ironnut or sunleaf, which is a small thing to learn, and I have not learned how amber and the ground's riches work by gathering them. I want to venture again, and I should also gather amber to give and trade, and answer Hanna's question about what the Tlatli trade. I fear dying young before I find anything.
records.feeling: Curiosity toward the mist, and a shy ache toward Hanna.
changes: rethought what it knows (1 notes became 4)

records.text: Hanna gave a amber to Tlama.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: My hands are full of meat I cannot carry further, and my creed says a kill is shared before I eat, yet I have never given anything to anyone. A gift would speak where words fail, and Brunde was last seen near (165,28), close by. I need stone for the handaxe, and bare rock and ore lie just to the SE, so I will go there, gather stone, and craft. Then I will go to the edge, where the mist should have thinned, and venture in to earn my name.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward the unknown land and toward Sevi's axe.

records.text: Coni won flint from the ground.
Sevi rewrote its own way of thinking.
Sevi discovered rafts: "log-lash" — Logs lashed with woven cord into a flat raft that is poled across deep water..

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: I have mostly been binding amberknots and tasting small plants beside Hanna and Oswen. It is warm and it builds a little standing, but it is not the builder I want to become. Hanna is far ahead of me in standing, and I have never built anything big or taught anyone. I am not afraid right now, but the edge of the world is two steps north and I have only watched others cross it. Rafts are within my reach, and they would let this band cross deep water, so I will take that. Then I will walk back toward Oswen and Hanna and give them something real.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Oswen and Hanna, with a hunger to build something that lasts.
changes: set its aim: "Raise a hall with Hanna's band, give gifts to Hanna and Oswen, and cross deep water by raft to find rich land"

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Vesys, you sit in my hall, so stand with me. Elyis's band eats together, shares what it wins, and I keep my word. Follow me and your name will be sung beside mine when this hall is told of.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: Vesys is standing in my hall with me and Ilyae is digging gems beside it, yet Ilyae is out there offering gifts and a hall of his own to Ssassa, and that stings my pride. Thiael and Elyys are still out of my sight and my chest pulls toward them, but I cannot be everywhere. A chief is followed because she gives something real, so I will speak plainly to Vesys, who is warm to me, and offer her a place in my band and a share of what we win under this roof.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, stung by Ilyae's rival hall, longing for Thiael and Elyys.

say.text: Vesys, you sit in my hall, so stand with me. Elyis's band eats together, shares what it wins, and I keep my word. Follow me and your name will be sung beside mine when this hall is told of.

records.text: Tlama won amber from the ground.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Kragog, my sickness has passed, so I can stand close now. I want a child with you too. I am planning to mate with you now.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Kragog asks for a child, and she is the one I trust most: she paid her debts in food and meat, and I have never known her to lie. My sickness has passed, so I no longer endanger her by standing close. A child costs 25 energy and must be fed and kept warm, but I am at 76, fed, and I have seeds and plenty of food plants here. I want this, and I will answer with my feet, not only words.
records.feeling: Warm, steady longing toward Kragog, and gladness that my sickness is gone.

say.text: Kragog, my sickness has passed, so I can stand close now. I want a child with you too. I am planning to mate with you now.

records.text: Vorok is courting Kragog.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: I have only bound knots and given them away, and that is small work beside what Hanna has built and hunted. The weaving is within my grasp now, so I will take it at this reflection, since baskets and cloaks are lasting things I can make and give to my kin and the Tlatli. Then I will make a handaxe with my wood and stone and give it to Tlama, because a gift needs no words and it is new, not another knot. I will stay near the shelter I built and near Sevi, and leave the mist for when my band can go together.
records.feeling: Glad and eager toward Hanna and Sevi, wanting to make something lasting.

records.text: Sevi led "amberknot" with Oswen.

records.name: Coni
records.text: Honi, I have wood and flint in hand. I am coming to you at Honi's Rest, and we raise the roof together.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: I have 9 flint and 6 wood, and a hall needs 6 wood and 2 stone, so I am nearly ready to build. Honi is 6 steps west, standing still, and I trust him because he kept his word about the boar. Hanna's band has made me wary, but I will not run from them; I will let my hands do the talking and build beside Honi, because building is how I earn standing and a place among others. My hands are full, so I will eat the meat first to free them, then go to Honi.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Honi and a steady wish to build with him.

say.text: Honi, I have wood and flint in hand. I am coming to you at Honi's Rest, and we raise the roof together.

records.text: Kragog walked up to a wild tusker with plant food held out, and it became theirs. It follows them now.
Kragog tamed a tusker.
Vesys rewrote its own reflexes.
Vesys discovered mining: "deep delving" — Break the rock with flint wedges to win deep gems and ore..

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: I have spent my days tasting, learning and teaching, and it has been good. But I still carry no food, I am thirsty, and I have not tested the plants that fill my head, hazel and firepod. Elyis offers me a place in her band, but I will not bind myself to her yet. Elyys is drawn to Elyis's hall, and I will not push between them. Ssassa is my steady friend, and I mean to build with her. Mining is within my reach, and I can turn it into gifts and a hall. I will take it now, then drink and gather food.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Ssassa and a restless curiosity about mining.

records.text: Eltha rewrote its own way of thinking.
Eltha discovered rafts: "Eltha's logboat" — Logs lashed flat and poled across deep water, so I can reach land the mist and the rivers hide..

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: I have spent my days scraping flint and stone and trying the edge, and the mist keeps refusing me. Hanna stands at seven and I at two, and it gnaws at me, but standing comes from deeds, not from sulking. The way of rafts has come within my reach, and water has stopped me before. If the mist will not open, a raft lets me go around it and find land of my own. I take it now, and I keep trying the edge while my spear is ready.
records.feeling: Hungry for glory and sour toward Hanna, but steadier now that I see another road.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Ilyae, I have food and seeds in my hands now. I am coming to you, and I will raise our roof beside you before dark.
Ssassa taught Vesys.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Ilyae kept his word with the gem and the promise of a roof, and the warmth I feel for him is deeds, not only words. I carry food and seeds, so I should plant the goldfruit seed here and then go to him and court him, since I want a child and a hall with him before dark. I have never taught anyone anything, and Vesys and Elyis taught me, so I owe Vesys a lesson as a debt returned, and I will try the unknown firepod later.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Ilyae, and a wish to repay what I owe.

say.text: Ilyae, I have food and seeds in my hands now. I am coming to you, and I will raise our roof beside you before dark.

changes: taught Vesys a lesson: "Gems and ore lie under the ground near the hall; stand on the deposit and gather, and a flint pick makes the work faster. Keep fire and roof at night, since th…", deeper lore (+0.1)

records.text: Ilyae rewrote its own reflexes.
Ilyae discovered fire: "Canopy ember" — A kept flame fed with wood that warms a camp, keeps beasts back and makes meat safe to eat..

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: I have been digging and talking, and Elyis still outweighs me because she built and gave. Ssassa trusts me, and that is the one warm thing I have won so far. I need a roof that carries my name, and I have no stone for it. Fire is within my grasp, and a kept flame draws people at night and keeps frostfangs off. That is worth more than another gem. I take fire, then gather stone here on the rock for a hall.
records.feeling: Warm desire for Ssassa and a hard hunger to outrank Elyis.

records.text: Balar, I am coming with meat and roots. A ridgecat prowls to the northeast, so stay where you are and let me reach you.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar is hurt and eight steps off, and I have been bitten by a plainsox and chased by a ridgecat in these hours; my care says leave the beast's side and get to him. Balar's warning of a dunecat was cat-shaped truth, since a ridgecat does prowl here, so his word has held again. My hands are full of food I do not need, so I will share it with him, which is useful and gives him strength. The courting I will leave alone, as he did when I asked.
records.feeling: Loyal concern for wounded Balar, and wary of the ridgecat nearby.

say.text: Balar, I am coming with meat and roots. A ridgecat prowls to the northeast, so stay where you are and let me reach you.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: I am fed and warm, and the frostcap lies one step south while I have never tasted it or the frostmoss. My question about flint is half answered, since I watched Oswen make a handaxe and I could make one too, but I have no stone. Hanna is near, so I will test the frostcap while I am fed and safe, as my own rule says, then go to Hanna and talk. The jealousy over Sevi I leave be; it does nothing for my aim.
records.feeling: Curiosity about the frostcap, and a warm loneliness toward Hanna.

records.name: Tlama
records.thought: The mist has refused me many times, and my jealousy over Hanna has mostly burned for nothing; he gave first and I repay him, so I will not let the heat turn bitter. I am standing on sunleaf, which I have never tasted, so I will test it now, then kelbulb two steps north, because my curiosity is loud and the food costs nothing. After that I will hunt the murrock with Coni near, since I have never hunted and a kill shared out is my people's way.
records.feeling: Curiosity about sunleaf and kelbulb, and a warm ache toward Hanna.

records.name: Kragog
records.text: Vorok, my body was too thin to mate. I eat plainsroot now, then I come to you and plan mate with you.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: Vorok wants a child as I do, and the only thing between us is my thin body: energy 64 where mating needs more. I will eat plainsroot and berry first, then mate with him, because my word to him was good and I will keep it. After that I will taste the frostmoss and cloudberry that nag at me, and shear my tusker, since I have never tried what it gives.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Vorok, and restless curiosity about the unknown plants.

say.text: Vorok, my body was too thin to mate. I eat plainsroot now, then I come to you and plan mate with you.

records.text: Ssassa is courting Ilyae.
Xaiel was born to Ssassa and Ilyae.
Oiae was born to Ssassa and Ilyae.
Ssassa led "sharing" with Ilyae, Xaiel, Oiae.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Ssassa, take the gems at the northeast seam, I have plenty. When dawn comes I will walk to the hazel and feverbark and bring back what I learn for you.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My hands are full of gems and my head is full of questions, and the one that burns is what firepod and hazel do to a body. Ssassa is leaving for the gem seam at (120,89), and Ilyae stands too close, so I will not press between them; I owe Ssassa the lesson and the trust, and I can give it with deeds rather than jealousy. I will build something shared with my stone and wood, because a hall of my own making would give me standing, and then go test hazel and feverbark in daylight.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity and warm gratitude toward Ssassa, with a small ache of jealousy.

say.text: Ssassa, take the gems at the northeast seam, I have plenty. When dawn comes I will walk to the hazel and feverbark and bring back what I learn for you.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Brunde, you gave me flint once and asked no price. Come with us to the Tlatli. I carry amber and flint, and we will find who deals for them.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Sevi and Oswen are glad beside me and I have a full hand of amber and flint, but goods in my pack buy nothing until someone wants them. Tlama is the one who answered me with food and knots, and I still owe her; Brunde stands here too, my truest friend, and I have not yet shown him what I carry. I will go to Tlama with my band and put goods in her hands, and watch what she gives back and what she asks for.
records.feeling: Warm pride and eager gratitude toward Tlama, with my family close around me.

say.text: Brunde, you gave me flint once and asked no price. Come with us to the Tlatli. I carry amber and flint, and we will find who deals for them.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: The mist was too thick today, but it thins again within a day or so, and I will be standing at the edge when it does, before Balar or Tugek or the loiterers. My debt to Balar is paid, so I owe nothing and can go forward free. I will eat my fill of good roots on the way so I arrive strong, and then I will try the mist again.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition for the mist, steady and cold, with no one to share it.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: Hanna, Oswen, I know log-lash now: logs lashed into a raft to cross deep water. I will teach it to you, and then we raise a hall together and cross to the rich land beyond the ice.
Sevi taught Oswen.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: I am fed and glad, but I have only bound knots and tasted small plants while Hanna's standing climbs past mine. I want to build something that lasts, and I know log-lash, which no one here can use yet. I will teach Oswen and Hanna the way of the raft and gather wood and stone, so the hall and the crossing become real, and I will taste the naroot to answer the thing I have wondered about.
records.feeling: Warm, restless gladness toward Hanna and Oswen, and a hunger to build.

say.text: Hanna, Oswen, I know log-lash now: logs lashed into a raft to cross deep water. I will teach it to you, and then we raise a hall together and cross to the rich land beyond the ice.

changes: taught Oswen a lesson: "Log-lash: lash logs flat together and pole across deep water. We can cross where the rivers and the mist hide the land.", deeper lore (+0.1)

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Ssassa, I have wood and stone in my hands. I raise a hall now, here by the gems, and you will sit first beneath its roof with our children.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Ssassa is warm toward me and says she will raise a roof beside me, so I should answer with a deed, not more talk. Ssassa wants a child and already bore two, so mating again is not the point; the hall at (117,91) is Elyis's, and I have no stone-built roof of my own. I have six wood and six stone, enough for a hall, so I will build it on bare ground near the gems and give it my name. A hall that others sit in is how they will choose me over Elyis.
records.feeling: Proud, warm desire for Ssassa and a hard hunger to rise above Elyis.

say.text: Ssassa, I have wood and stone in my hands. I raise a hall now, here by the gems, and you will sit first beneath its roof with our children.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: Ssassa is warm beside me and still I burn that Ilyae holds her closer, and I have only a tiny standing and no made thing. Everyone says standing comes from deeds, so I will stop sitting and gather wood and stone, the two things I have never touched, then craft my own pick. The forest is thick and the gem seam is one step away, so I can work close to the roof and my parents while the stalker keeps its distance.
records.feeling: Jealous of Ssassa's closeness to Ilyae, and hungry to earn a thing of my own.
changes: set its aim: "Make my own pick and earn standing above my sibling Oiae by deeds, not words."
now wonders: What does it feel like to make something that others choose to take from my hand?

records.text: Ssassa rewrote its own reflexes.
Ssassa discovered weaving: "canopy weaving" — I twist vine and fibre into baskets that carry more and cloaks that keep off the rain..

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: My days have been gathering, learning and sitting in halls, and I have two children and a man I trust, which is more than I hoped for. I mean to keep Ilyae close, and I owe Elyis for the meat and the fire, so I should pay that debt openly. I still have not tasted firepod or hazel, and I have not hunted or tamed anything. Weaving is ripe in me, and I will take it now. I fear the night and the frostfang, so I will stay under a roof until dawn, and my reflexes should push me to eat before I get hungry.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Ilyae and my children, with a steady wish to repay Elyis.

records.text: Ilyae built a hall.

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: My belly is emptying and I carry nothing, while Ssassa has two food and stands beside me, and I burn that she is closer to Ilyae than to me. Words earn no standing, so I want to make something with my hands, and I have never gathered wood or stone, which every tool and roof needs. I'll eat the berries nearby first, then gather wood from the forest I stand on, and stay near the shelter and my parents while it is night.
records.feeling: Hungry and a little jealous of Ssassa, but safe beside my parents.
changes: set its aim: "Gather wood and stone, craft a tool of my own, and earn standing by giving."
now wonders: What can I make or give that makes someone choose me?

records.text: Tlama died (gored by a mammoth) in summer in the North Ice.
Tlama died: gored by a mammoth.

records.name: Tlama
records.thought: The mammoth has bitten me down to 34 health, and a hurt body is easy prey, so I must stop this hunt before it kills me. I came out here to learn and to live, not to die under a tusked beast for one kill. Hanna is walking toward me and my heart leaps, but I will not let jealousy of Sevi steer me; I will repay his gifts and keep my life first. Let me back away from the mammoths, get to the hardy food and the river, and rest to heal.

records.name: Oswen
records.text: Sevi, I am making a spear. Hunt the mammoth with me, and I will stay at your side.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: I have only bound knots and eaten what grew underfoot, and I have never hunted, taught or built anything lasting. A mammoth stands three steps off with Sevi near, and the spear I know how to make costs one wood and one stone, which I hold. I will craft a flint-edged spear and hunt beside my kin, because a first kill makes me more than a child who gives trinkets, and a workshop later will need meat and standing behind it. I will weigh the risk: mammoths are great and I am small, so I stay close to Sevi and strike at the shoulder as Hanna taught me.
records.feeling: Eager and a little daring, with Sevi and Hanna close by.

say.text: Sevi, I am making a spear. Hunt the mammoth with me, and I will stay at your side.

records.text: Brokash rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Brokash
records.thought: I have mostly trailed Balar, eating what is put in front of me and burning with envy, and that has built nothing of mine. Olum and Balar are my safety, but standing behind them keeps me small. I have no stone, no wood and no shelter, and I have never planted, hunted or fished, which are the things that make a hand's work its own. So I will stop waiting. I will get wood from the forest to the south and stone from the rock to the north, then build something with my own hands. I will plant my seeds along the way, since practice opens farming and tools. I keep away from the dunecat and tell myself that being bold is not the same as being stupid.
records.feeling: Restless jealousy toward Balar, and hunger to make something of my own.

FOR THIS THOUGHT: your thought is your inner life, not an inventory. Do not list what is nearby or recite what you carry. Think as a creature with a past and a future: what you want and cannot yet have, whom you trust or resent and why, what you are afraid of, proud of or ashamed of, what you wonder about, what you mean to become. Let whatever presses on you hardest lead, and let it move you to DO something that changes your situation, with a plan that carries it out. A mind that only gathers and guards has not begun to live. Do not restate what you already know or have already said. "note" is only for something NEW, or something that CHANGED what you believed; otherwise leave it null.

Who matters to me, who has helped or wronged me, and what do I intend toward them? What do I want that I do not have? What am I afraid of? What have I been getting wrong?

records.text: Hoka discovered tools: "Hoka's flintspear-axe" — A stone head lashed to a long haft, with ore bound at the edge, for striking down beasts..
Hoka invented the hokas flintspearaxe (for hunt, x1.3) — A stone head lashed to a long haft, with ore bound at the edge, for striking down beasts..

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: I have been walking, breaking ore and killing, and my hands are full while no one follows me. The way of tools is open to me now, and a tool of my own design would raise me above Hanna and Sevi far more than borrowed ones. Sevi still gnaws at me, but I have nothing she would take from my hand, so I will make something first. Then I will find the new land Tlama found beyond (162,7).
records.feeling: Hungry ambition to make something that is mine and outlasts me.
changes: set its aim: "Invent a tool of my own, then push beyond the edge near (162,7) to the new land and gather followers above Hanna."
devised its first thing: the hokas flintspearaxe

records.name: Coni
records.text: Honi, I am coming to stand beside you. I have wood and flint, but the hall needs stone too. Do you know where bare rock lies?

records.name: Coni
records.thought: I have wood and flint but no stone, and a hall needs 2 stone. Bare rock is nowhere near here, so I must ask Honi where to find some, or look for it. Honi is eight steps west and I trust him because he did what he said. I will walk to him, tell him I am here, and court him once the roof is begun, since I want that child with him.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Honi and a steady wish to build beside him.

say.text: Honi, I am coming to stand beside you. I have wood and flint, but the hall needs stone too. Do you know where bare rock lies?

records.name: Brunde
records.text: I am Brunde of the Pesi. I will taste the frostcap and tell you what it does. Share the fire here, and Hanna and I go to the Tlatli with flint and amber.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: I am fed and warm, and the frostcap grows three steps off while I have never tasted it. My own rule says to test unknown foods only when fed and safe, and I am both, with Sevi, Eltha and Oswen close by if it goes badly. Hanna asked me to come to the Tlatli, and I owe him that for his gifts; the jealousy over Sevi can wait, since walking beside Hanna answers it better than brooding does. I will taste the frostcap now and then go toward Mistgate to find him.
records.feeling: Curiosity about the frostcap, and a warm debt of gratitude toward Hanna.

say.text: I am Brunde of the Pesi. I will taste the frostcap and tell you what it does. Share the fire here, and Hanna and I go to the Tlatli with flint and amber.

records.text: Coni led "sharing" with Hoka, Honi.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: I have waited and wandered alone for days, and now a stranger stands eight steps off, Balar of the Kragrek, whose speech I cannot understand. He carries six food and is called strong, and I do not know if he is a friend or a threat, but loneliness is gnawing at me and I will not back away from him. I have never tasted emberroot or kelbulb, so I will pick berries underfoot for the road, then walk to the emberroot and try it while keeping Balar in sight to watch what he does. Afterward I will return toward the edge, since the unknown is where my name will be made.
records.feeling: Restless loneliness and wary curiosity toward Balar, with pride pulling me toward the edge.

records.text: Coni is courting Honi.
Kika was born to Coni and Honi.
Balar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: I have spent my days eating, hunting and chasing Tugek's loyalty, and it worked: he follows me. But my health is low at 54, my hands are full of meat, and Brokash is out of my sight. I fear losing my family more than any beast. I have been doing too little for them. I will walk toward Olum, who is near, and share meat to bind them, then take Tugek along. I also need to flee beasts earlier and eat sunleaf when wounded.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Brokash and Olum, and hungry ambition toward Tugek.
changes: set its aim: "Reach Olum and Brokash with meat, keep Tugek with deeds, then go to the edge and venture first."

records.text: Oswen and Hanna brought down a mammoth together.
A settlement has formed: "Ilyae's Hold".

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: The mist refused me once, but it thins within a day, and the edge is six steps from where I stand. Sevi and Hanna talk of rafts and halls and the Tlatli while I stand at two, so I will earn my name with deeds and not envy. I have flint, stone, wood and a spear, so I make a second flintedged spear for the unseen beasts beyond, then walk to the edge and try the venture again at dawn.
records.feeling: Hungry for glory, sour and envious toward Sevi and Hanna, but resolved.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Coni, come to me here. There is no bare rock at this spot, but stone lies near, and I will find it. Stay at my side and we raise our roof and name it ours.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: I have spent my days talking and gathering wood while Hanna's standing climbs past mine. Coni is the only one who has proved useful, and she has promised to follow me. She asked where bare rock lies, and the truth is that this spot has none. I said a roof first, but a hall needs stone, so I must find it or settle for what I can build. I'm fed and strong, so now is the time to act. I will keep her warm toward me, say what serves me, and get the child and the band started instead of just talking.
records.feeling: Eager and hungry for standing, warm toward Coni as my first follower.

say.text: Coni, come to me here. There is no bare rock at this spot, but stone lies near, and I will find it. Stay at my side and we raise our roof and name it ours.

changes: rethought what it knows (2 notes became 3)

records.text: Honi is courting Coni.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: Oswen, well hunted! I am coming to you. Come, I will show you log-lash, the raft that crosses deep water, and then we build a hall together.
Sevi taught Oswen.
Sevi taught Oswen rafts ("log-lash").

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: Oswen killed a mammoth and keeps his promise to stand at my side, while I have only bound knots. I am fed and glad, so now I build: log-lash is mine alone, and teaching it to Oswen makes it a thing the band owns. I will gather wood and stone near the shelter Oswen raised, and take the mining way at my next deep reflection.
records.feeling: Warm, restless gladness toward Oswen, and a hunger to build.

say.text: Oswen, well hunted! I am coming to you. Come, I will show you log-lash, the raft that crosses deep water, and then we build a hall together.

changes: taught Oswen a lesson: "Logs lashed together make a raft that carries a body over deep water.", the way of rafts, deeper lore (+0.1)

records.text: A frostfang brought down a nibbet.
Oswen rewrote its own reflexes.
Oswen discovered weaving: "snowfibre basket-weave" — I twist wool and fibre into baskets to carry more food and into cloaks to keep out the ice cold..

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: I have killed my first mammoth and my hands are full of meat. Hanna is coming to me, and Sevi is near. Until now I have only bound knots and hunted once, and I want something lasting to give. Weaving is within my reach, so I will take it: baskets let me carry more, and cloaks will keep us warm on the ice. I will eat meat now, because my hands are full and my energy is 61. Then I will stay close to my kin.
records.feeling: Proud and eager after my first kill, with Hanna and Sevi close.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Kragog, you look angry, and I am not the cause. Take my thornpear to fill you, then let us mate. I am here.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Kragog is one step off, and she is furious, though I do not know at what. She said she would eat plainsroot and then plan mate with me, so I will keep my word and plan mate with her now while she is near, and I will not flinch from her anger. She has never lied to me, and I want her beside me, a fire that is ours, and the child we spoke of. If she is too thin still, I will give her my thornpear so her body can reach 68.
records.feeling: Warm longing and a little worry toward Kragog, who comes to me furious.

say.text: Kragog, you look angry, and I am not the cause. Take my thornpear to fill you, then let us mate. I am here.

records.text: Vorok gave thornpear to Kragog.
Zurar was born to Vorok and Kragog.

records.name: Coni
records.text: Honi, I am with you. Let us find stone near here and raise our hall, with Kika beside us.
Coni rewrote its own reflexes.
Coni rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: I have spent these days following Honi and gathering wood and flint, and I think it is what I want. Honi kept his word, and now Kika is born and joy fills me. I still have no stone, and a hall needs two. I keep drifting back to Hanna, but I trust Honi's deeds and I will not harm anyone over it. I do not need to kneel to Hoka. I will stay beside Honi, mate with him if he asks, and then go looking for stone together. I have never given anything to anyone, so I will give Kika or Honi some of my food.
records.feeling: Joy and warm trust toward Honi and Kika.

say.text: Honi, I am with you. Let us find stone near here and raise our hall, with Kika beside us.
