records.title: The Tlatli at the Mistgate
records.text:
The great event of days 4 to 7 was a meeting. On day 5 Hanna went past the edge and found the North Ice again, and with it the Tlatli, strangers with their own tongue. A small band came in: Hoka, Coni, Tlama and Honi. Hanna gave amber to Hoka and flint to Tlama, named the place Mistgate, and gave Tlama amber twice more. Tlama gave berries and an amberknot back. On day 6 Tlama went past the edge and found salt, amber and mammoth, and was gored by one. He is the first death in Evolu. Hanna's bond with him stands at +0.9, and the record notes that Hanna watched him die. On day 7 Hanna and Oswen killed a mammoth together. Sevi, Oswen and Hanna kept making amberknots, which now number ten, and Oswen pledged to follow Hanna, as did Sevi. Hanna's standing is 7.22, the highest in the world. Hanna asked Brunde to come to the Tlatli, and Brunde, Eltha and Sevi each met some of them. Only Hoka, Coni and Honi are left of the Tlatli, with Kika, born to Coni and Honi on day 6. Honi leads a band with no followers, since Coni's pledge was refused twice.

Among the Phizhi, Ssassa and Ilyae had twins, Xaiel and Oiae, and Ilyae built a hall that became Ilyae's Hold, the world's first settlement. Elyis keeps the band of Elyys and Thiael and has taught Ssassa fire.

Among the Kragrek, Balar and Olum had Brokash, and Tugek pledged to Balar on day 6. Kragog tamed a tusker. Vorok recovered, and Kragog and Vorok are courting. Balar met Nande on day 6.

Inventions rose from 11 to 32. Rafts were found by Elyis, Hanna, Sevi and Eltha, but no raft crossing is recorded.

threads.name: Hanna and the Tlatli
threads.text: Hanna trades gifts with the Tlatli and has lost Tlama to a mammoth. Hanna's standing is 7.22, the highest in Evolu.

threads.name: Honi's empty band
threads.text: Honi leads but has no followers, because Coni's pledge was refused twice. Honi wants to rise above Hanna.

threads.name: Ilyae's Hold
threads.text: Ilyae's Hold is the first settlement, and Ilyae wants to rise above Elyis. Elyis has the only band among the Phizhi, with Elyys and Thiael.

threads.name: Balar's band
threads.text: Balar has Tugek as a follower and Brokash as a child, with Olum. Balar's health is 54 to 56, and Brokash resents his shadow.

threads.name: Beyond the edge
threads.text: Three lands have been opened past the edge. Olum and Eltha still want to be first into the mist.

threads.name: Vorok and Kragog
threads.text: Both are courting, and Vorok's sickness has passed. No child has yet been born to them.

threads.name: Rafts
threads.text: Four people know rafts, but none has crossed deep water yet.

records.text: Stalker among us at the Hold! Ssassa, Vesys, Xaiel, Oiae, come to me by the east hall, keep together, do not stand alone!

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: A stalker is on top of me, 0 steps, and it kills our kind; my home ground and my roof mean nothing if I stand here bleeding. Ssassa and the children are my whole warmth, and I will not lose them to a beast while I hold a pick and flint. I must get away from it at once, toward Elyis's hall and the company by the water, then draw Ssassa and the others together with a shout so they come under a roof with me.
records.feeling: Overwhelming dread of the stalker, and fierce protectiveness toward Ssassa and my children.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Hoka, I carry flint and amber. Tlama is dead, and I owe her fire. Show me what your people would give for flint.
Hanna discovered weaving: "snow-weave" — I twist wool and fibre into baskets so a trader can carry more goods and food, and into cloaks against the ice..

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Tlama's death sits in me, and I still owe her. I have spent my days gathering and carrying goods that no one has bought. Oswen and Sevi are the ones who matter, and I want Sevi near. Weaving is within my reach and a trader needs to carry more, so I will take it. I will also walk to the Tlatli with Hoka and show him flint instead of only talking about it.
records.feeling: Grief for Tlama, pride and warmth toward Oswen and Sevi.

say.text: Hoka, I carry flint and amber. Tlama is dead, and I owe her fire. Show me what your people would give for flint.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: I have made my flintspear-axe, yet I still stand at 2.1 while Hanna sits at 7.2, and no one follows me. Hanna gave me amber on the first day, so I will answer with a gift of my own, an amberknot bound beside Hanna, because words are only strange sounds between us and a made thing can speak. I hold seven ambers and can spare one to buy standing and perhaps the way to Sevi. After that I will take the new land past the edge at (162,7) and try to draw followers.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition, and a wary warmth toward Hanna.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Coni and Honi stand close together and it stings, but they are both near and I am safe, fed and warm. I want to be useful to them and not just a small thing underfoot. A frostfang prowls to the southeast, so I will stay close to my parents and gather a little to share, and see what hazel tastes like. Brunde of the Pesi is far off; I'll watch him and hold up a gift before any words.
records.feeling: Warm and a little jealous toward Coni, with a small wary curiosity toward Brunde.
changes: set its aim: "Earn a place beside Coni by giving and hunting with my family, and learn this land's foods"
now wonders: What does dreamcap do to the mind, and is it safe to eat?

records.text: Hanna gave a flint to Hoka.

records.name: Kragog
records.text: Vorok, I have seen our child Zurar and my heart is full. I come to you both now. I owe you for the thornpear, and I will pay it.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: Zurar is born and out of my sight, and that pulls at me harder than any plant or stone. Vorok and Zurar were last seen to the south around (60,80), so I go to them, and I owe Vorok for the thornpear and the care he gave me. After that I will bring my questions about the ore and the strange plants back to the open sands, but a child comes first.
records.feeling: Fierce, warm longing for Zurar and Vorok, and a debt I mean to pay.

say.text: Vorok, I have seen our child Zurar and my heart is full. I come to you both now. I owe you for the thornpear, and I will pay it.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Ilyae, I hear you. I come to the east hall now. Keep together, and watch the western trees, the stalker is that way.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: A stalker is among us, and Ilyae calls us together by the east hall. My creed says stay alive and a stalker killed my kind of fool on day 3, so I go to the group rather than stand alone. Ssassa is there, and the jealousy can wait; I will stand near her with deeds, not push between her and Ilyae. On the way I take goldfruit and ironnut underfoot, since I carry no food and my energy is only 57, and I can finally taste kelbulb once the danger passes.
records.feeling: Wary of the stalker, warm toward Ssassa, with a small ache of jealousy.

say.text: Ilyae, I hear you. I come to the east hall now. Keep together, and watch the western trees, the stalker is that way.

records.text: Hoka led "amberknot" with Oswen.
Vorok is courting Kragog.
Coni gave berry to Kika.
Kika gave berry to Coni.
Hoka gave a amberknot to Hanna.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: Ilyae calls us to the east hall because a stalker is near, and I am small and weak, so I won't stand alone out here. Ssassa is ten steps off and I trust her most, so I'll go to the hall and stay close. I'll carry firepod and reedbulb along if I can, so my question gets answered while I'm safe, and I'll look for a way to make something of my own that others choose to take from my hand.
records.feeling: Wary of the stalker, still jealous and wanting to prove myself to Ssassa.

records.text: Brunde rewrote its own way of thinking.
Brunde discovered tools: "flint-tipped throwing spear" — A long wooden shaft with a sharp flint point, thrown or thrust at game from a distance, so that hunting is safer..
Brunde invented the flinttipped throwing spe (for hunt, x1.3) — A long wooden shaft with a sharp flint point, thrown or thrust at game from a distance, so that hunting is safer..

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: I have spent my days hunting, picking and testing foods, and I am fed and alive, but I have no stone for a handaxe or spear and no shelter or fire of my own. Hanna is the one who matters to me, and he is a true friend, so I should stop burning over Sevi and be useful to him. The way of tools is within my reach now. I will take it and make a spear for hunting, because hunting is my aim and every kill makes me better at it. I want to eat the frostcap I have never tasted while I am safe and fed.
records.feeling: Curious and warmly grateful toward Hanna, with a small ache of jealousy.
changes: devised its first thing: the flinttipped throwing spe

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: Ilyae calls us to the east hall because a stalker is near, and I am small, so staying close to my parents is the only careful choice. But I also burn that Ssassa has a pick and I have only three wood and no stone. Gold lies south and I have never taken from a deposit. I'll go to the hall and keep close to the family, then learn what the deposits give once there are bigger bodies near me.
records.feeling: Wary of the stalker, still jealous and wanting to earn my own standing, near my family.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Ilyae, I hear you. I am coming to the east hall. Xaiel, Oiae, come to me and to the hall now, do not stay in the western trees!

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Ilyae has called us together at the east hall because a stalker is near, and my children are far off to the northwest, alone among the treeapes. I am careful and I do not stand alone in danger, but my children come before my caution, and Ilyae has proved with deeds that he keeps his word. I will call to Xaiel and Oiae to come to the hall, then go there myself so we are all under one roof with Ilyae and Vesys.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Xaiel and Oiae, and trust in Ilyae.

say.text: Ilyae, I hear you. I am coming to the east hall. Xaiel, Oiae, come to me and to the hall now, do not stay in the western trees!

records.name: Honi
records.text: Coni, I go to the black glass by the trees to take the sharpest edge there is. Come with me. Stone and edge together will raise our hall, and Kika stays in your sight.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Joy is high, but Hanna's standing of 7.7 against my 0.7 gnaws at me. Coni is mine, and Kika, and a roof and a hall will not rise without stone. Obsidian lies six steps northwest, the sharpest edge there is, and I have never taken from a deposit. I'll gather it, and wood too, so I own something Hoka's handaxe cannot match, then bring Coni to the work and keep her close.
records.feeling: Hungry for standing, warm toward Coni, and envious of Hanna and Hoka.

say.text: Coni, I go to the black glass by the trees to take the sharpest edge there is. Come with me. Stone and edge together will raise our hall, and Kika stays in your sight.

records.name: Oswen
records.text: Sevi, you taught me log-lash. I will teach you my snowfibre basket-weave in return, so we can carry more. Then we build the hall together.
Oswen taught Sevi.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: My first kill is behind me and my belly is full, but I have only given knots and never taught anyone anything. Sevi showed me log-lash and Hanna has her snow-weave, so I will teach Sevi my snowfibre basket-weave, a lasting thing and not another amberknot. Then I will stay close to my parents and gather wood so I can craft a spear or handaxe for the Tlatli and start on our shelter.
records.feeling: Proud and glad, wanting to give something lasting to Hanna and Sevi.

say.text: Sevi, you taught me log-lash. I will teach you my snowfibre basket-weave in return, so we can carry more. Then we build the hall together.

changes: taught Sevi a lesson: "Twist snowfibre into a basket-weave so a body can carry more food and goods."

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: The edge is five steps away and the mist has refused me once, but it may have thinned. Sevi and Hanna build halls and trade while I stand at two, so I will not sulk over it; I will earn my name by being first beyond the edge. I will walk there and try again, and if it stays shut I will gather stone and wood and hunt to make my hands worth following.
records.feeling: Hungry for glory and sour toward Sevi, but resolved to act.

records.text: Honi won obsidian from the ground.

records.name: Coni
records.text: Honi, I am coming to the black glass with you. Keep Kika near. I carry flint to share, and we will search for stone together.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: Honi asked me to come to the black glass, and he has kept every word he gave me, so I go to him. Kika is with him and my joy sits warm in me. Hanna stands close and I cannot read her tongue, so I keep my hands open and do not press, but I will not stand idle either. A hall needs stone, and I will hunt for it with Honi while I carry flint to trade or share.
records.feeling: Warm trust and joy toward Honi and Kika.

say.text: Honi, I am coming to the black glass with you. Keep Kika near. I carry flint to share, and we will search for stone together.

records.text: Sevi rewrote its own way of thinking.
Sevi discovered mining: "amber-delving" — I follow the gold and dark seams in the rock and break them out with my axe, taking ore and amber faster..

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: I have mostly bound knots and gathered while Hanna's standing climbs past mine. Oswen and Hanna matter most to me, and I want to give them something real: a hall and a raft. My hands now know how to work the earth, since amber and ore lie all around me, so I will take the mining way. Then I will gather wood and stone near Oswen's shelter and begin the hall. I stay fed and keep the plan full so my body does not idle.
records.feeling: Warm, restless gladness toward Oswen and Hanna, and a hunger to build.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Ssassa, Vesys, come under my hall. Eat with me here at Ilyae's Hold, where the gems and the roof are. Whoever sits at my hall is fed.
Ilyae rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: My days have gone to mining, building and sheltering Ssassa and our children, and that is good. But no one follows me, and Elyis still holds the better hall and draws the strangers. Ssassa and the children matter most to me. Vesys is useful, and I should bind her with a deed. The stalker is what I fear, and I got by on running and shouting. I want a band, and I get one by feeding people and giving them a roof, not by talk. I'm fed and the hall is near, so I will make a hallwelcome now with food and the people beside me, then plant seeds to learn farming.
records.feeling: Protective warmth toward Ssassa and the children, with a thread of dread of the stalker.

say.text: Ssassa, Vesys, come under my hall. Eat with me here at Ilyae's Hold, where the gems and the roof are. Whoever sits at my hall is fed.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Kragog, Zurar is ours and I am glad. I will gather berries for us all, so stay near.
Vorok named a place "Oasis of Zurar".
Vorok rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: My days have gone to following Kragog, courting her and filling my belly, and I don't regret it. Zurar is born, and I am a father with a family to feed and keep alive. I have never followed anyone, taught anyone, or gathered wood or stone, and fire is out of reach without that practice. My hunger is overwhelming and my body still stalls on cheap sapcane, so I want better food reflexes, and I want to stay close to my family. I will eat berries nearby and carry food to share with Kragog and Zurar. Then I will follow Kragog, because belonging is what I want most.
records.feeling: Warm gladness and fatherly worry toward Kragog and Zurar.

say.text: Kragog, Zurar is ours and I am glad. I will gather berries for us all, so stay near.

changes: set its aim: "Feed Kragog and Zurar from the oasis berries, learn wood and stone gathering for fire, then settle with them where water, food, wood and stone lie close."

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: Hanna stands beside me, the one I trust, and the amberknot I gave did what words could not. The edge here was a miss, so the new land is not reached by standing; I must find where the world's edge truly lies, near (162,7), and Hanna is still taller than me in standing. I will have more of my own: gather amber and flint for more made things, and put my seed in the ground, a thing I have never done, so that I own something that grows.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and a wary warmth toward Hanna.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Hoka, you answered my flint with an amberknot, and that is fair dealing. Stand beside me and I will bind one more amber knot with you. Tell me what else your people want: edged stone, black glass, or salt?

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Hoka stands one step from me and gave me an amberknot for my flint, so the Tlatli do answer a gift with a gift. I still owe Tlama's fire, and I will pay it by dealing honestly with her people. A trader must learn what they want, so I will make an amberknot beside Hoka and see whether it pleases him, then gather more flint for the next deal. Sevi and Oswen are near the east and I want to keep them close.
records.feeling: Grief for Tlama, warm pride and joy toward Hoka, Sevi and Oswen.

say.text: Hoka, you answered my flint with an amberknot, and that is fair dealing. Stand beside me and I will bind one more amber knot with you. Tell me what else your people want: edged stone, black glass, or salt?

records.name: Kika
records.text: Coni, an icebear is northeast of us. I am coming to you. I will bring grain to share.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: An icebear sits five steps northeast and my parents are drifting toward the black glass, so I will not stay here alone. Coni is the one I trust, and I want to be near her and useful, not a small thing underfoot. I will gather the grain close by to share with her, then walk west to where she and Honi are. Dreamcap can wait; I am too small to risk strange minds with a bear close.
records.feeling: Wary of the icebear, and drawn to stay close to Coni.

say.text: Coni, an icebear is northeast of us. I am coming to you. I will bring grain to share.

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Vorok, I am Zurar, your child. I want to follow you. Let me walk beside you and learn.
Zurar pledged to follow Vorok.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: I am small, and my parents are the warmest thing I know. Kragog owes and pays her debts, and Vorok gives freely; I want to be a person like that, not just a child who is fed. I have never given anything or followed anyone, so I will go near Vorok, who I trust most, and pledge to follow him. Belonging feels like what I lack, and it is not a kneeling.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Vorok and Kragog, and a wish to belong to them.

say.text: Vorok, I am Zurar, your child. I want to follow you. Let me walk beside you and learn.

changes: set its aim: "Stay close to Vorok and Kragog, learn their ways, and earn a place of my own among them by giving something of worth."
now wonders: What am I for, and what can my hands make that is mine to give?

records.name: Brokash
records.thought: My belly is full and the thirst is gone, but my hands still hold little that is truly mine, and Balar's shadow is far off now, which suits me. There is flint close by and the tool-way has come together in me, so I will take flint, then discover tools at my next deep reflection and make something nobody gave me. Wood is the thing I lack, and only one tree stands here, so I will gather what I can and keep my stone and ore as the start of my own holding.
records.feeling: Restless pride and hunger to make something that is mine, with a thread of loneliness for Olum.

records.text: Brokash won flint from the ground.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: I am fed and calm, and the old ache over Sevi will do nothing for me; Hanna's trust is a debt I answer by being useful, not by burning. I have flint, amber and the know-how for a flint-tipped spear but no stone, and the amber is a short walk away, so I will take it and flint, which Hanna and the Tlatli may deal for. Nafrostcap grows four steps south and I am fed and safe, so I will taste it on the way and learn what it does. Then I will go toward Hanna's side with something to give.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Hanna, with a quiet resolve to be useful instead of jealous.

records.text: Elyis rewrote its own reflexes.
Elyis discovered mining: "Ember-delving" — Heat the rock with fire and split it with flint wedges to win ore and gems..

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: I have spent my days building and leading, and the pride is real. But my band is only three, and Ilyae raises a rival hall while I stand here parched. I have to drink first, because heat makes thirst twice as fast and a chief who dies of thirst is sung of by no one. Mining is within my reach: I have watched ore and gems come out of the rock, and I have flint and a seam right beside me. If I hold deep delving, strangers will have a reason to follow me.
records.feeling: Proud and restless toward Ilyae's rival hall, with a hard thirst.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: Sevi is beside me breaking ore, and I have watched the mining work often enough that the way of mining has come together in my hands. I want to take it now, because deep deposits and faster digging are lasting things I can give Hanna and Sevi, not another amberknot. Then I will gather wood and stone toward the workshop, staying within sight of my parents, with the icebear still prowling to the southwest.
records.feeling: Proud and eager, close to Sevi and wanting to give something lasting to my band.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Coni, I have taken black glass, the sharpest edge there is, and I will give you a piece. Come, eat with me and Kika, then we go west to the ore seam to find stone for our hall. Whoever stands with me will never go hungry

records.name: Honi
records.thought: I hold four pieces of black glass and Coni walks toward me with flint, so I have something Hanna lacks and a woman who says she follows. Kika carries more food than I do, which stings, but she is mine and will stay near. Stone for a hall is still missing, so I will bring Coni to the ore seam in the west rock, where bare stone may lie, and make her bond to me with a shared meal and a gift of glass.
records.feeling: Hungry for standing, warm toward Coni, and itching to prove myself above Hanna.

say.text: Coni, I have taken black glass, the sharpest edge there is, and I will give you a piece. Come, eat with me and Kika, then we go west to the ore seam to find stone for our hall. Whoever stands with me will never go hungry.

records.text: Eltha rewrote its own way of thinking.
Eltha discovered mining: "Goldseam breaking" — I read the dark and gold seams in rock and split them out with my spear's edge, taking ore and amber faster..

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: I have spent my days circling the edge and envying Sevi's standing, and the mist keeps refusing me. I have not hunted, taught, or planted, and I have followers of no one, not even myself. Mining is within my reach because I watched Sevi do it, so I will take it for myself. Amber and ore lie close by, and what I win with my hands will earn me standing faster than sulking over Hanna. I still mean to be first beyond the edge, but I will come back to the mist rested and with a better tool in my hand.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and sour envy toward Sevi.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: Oswen, stand beside me. I will bind another amberknot with you, and this one is yours to keep. Then we raise the hall near your shelter.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: Oswen is near and strong, and I have bound knots and mined but given nothing real yet. I carry twelve amber and four amberknots, so I will go to him and make another knot together, then give him one, since he gave me one first. After that I'll build with the wood and stone I hold, and keep my body busy before the cold comes.
records.feeling: Warm, restless gladness toward Oswen, and a hunger to build.

say.text: Oswen, stand beside me. I will bind another amberknot with you, and this one is yours to keep. Then we raise the hall near your shelter.

records.text: Honi gave a obsidian to Coni.
Sevi led "amberknot" with Eltha, Oswen.
Sevi gave a amberknot to Oswen.
Sevi built a shelter.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Ilyae, I come under your hall. I have gems and a seed or two to give, and I will sit with you and Ssassa until the stalker is gone.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: A stalker is near and Ilyae's hall is the safe place, so I go there instead of standing alone in the open. Ssassa is by the hall and the jealousy still aches, but I will not push between her and Ilyae; I will sit under the roof, share food and give what I know. My unanswered question about kelbulb and emberroot will wait until the stalker is gone, but I will carry a couple of the plain foods back so I can make a sharing and have something to give.
records.feeling: Wary of the stalker, warm and a little jealous toward Ssassa.

say.text: Ilyae, I come under your hall. I have gems and a seed or two to give, and I will sit with you and Ssassa until the stalker is gone.

records.text: Hoka rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering flint and amber and walking, and I'm still below Sevi and trailing Hanna. Hanna is the one I trust, and gifts reach her where words don't. The icebear 4 steps SE could kill me, and I have been standing too close to it. I'll pull away from it and go to the edge near (162,7), where Tlama found new land, to venture. Then I'll come back with more than my share.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and jealousy toward Sevi, with wary warmth for Hanna.

records.text: Tugek rewrote its own reflexes.
Tugek discovered archery: "Stone-folk bow" — A bent branch and cord that sends a flint-tipped shaft so I can kill from a distance and away from the teeth of beasts..

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Hunger is tearing at me, and I spent a hundred moments running with food in my hands and eating none of it. That was foolish. I eat first, then go to Balar. His word has matched events so far, but I still watch what he does. The beasts' teeth taught me the bow, and a good hunter needs one. I mean to be sung of as a hunter, and I mean to live to the cold days.
records.feeling: Starving and a little ashamed of my foolishness, but steady in my loyalty to Balar.

records.name: Coni
records.text: Honi, your deeds match your words. I will walk west with you and Kika to the ore seam and find stone for our hall. I will stand behind you.
Coni pledged to follow Honi.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: Honi gave me black glass and still keeps every word, so my trust in him is earned by deeds, not just talk. Kika is walking to me and my joy is full. A hall needs 2 stone and we have none, so I will go west with Honi toward the ore seam, taste the gorsemint beside me first, and keep Kika close. I want to follow him, to stop standing alone.
records.feeling: Warm, full joy toward Honi and Kika, and a wish to belong beside them.

say.text: Honi, your deeds match your words. I will walk west with you and Kika to the ore seam and find stone for our hall. I will stand behind you.

records.text: Oswen rewrote its creed.
Oswen rewrote its own way of thinking.
Oswen discovered mining: "Deepseam delving" — I read where the rock runs dark and dig the deep seams with my handaxe, so every deposit yields faster and iron and tin can be won..

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: I have mostly been gathering amber and tying knots with my parents. That is warm, but it leaves little that lasts. Sevi and Hanna matter most to me, and I mean to give them something lasting. I have watched mining often enough that it has come together in my hands, so I will take it as my own way. After that I will gather wood and stone for the workshop. I fear the icebear to the SW and the world going cold, so I will stay close to my kin.
records.feeling: Joyful and proud, close to Sevi and eager to build something lasting.

records.name: Brunde
records.text: Hanna, night is coming. I have amber and flint to give you. Share a shelter and a fire with me, and let us hunt together at dawn.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: Hanna is running for shelter and I owe him more than I have given; I carry amber and flint, and a gift needs no words. Jealousy over Sevi gets me nothing, but a child with Hanna is not possible, and I should not pretend otherwise. I should stand where he stands, as a friend and a hunter, and Hoka is a stranger I should approach with an open hand, not fear.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Hanna, with curious wariness toward Hoka.

say.text: Hanna, night is coming. I have amber and flint to give you. Share a shelter and a fire with me, and let us hunt together at dawn.

records.name: Brokash
records.thought: Flint fills my hands and salt too, and all of it is mine because my hands won it. But a pile of stones is not yet a thing that stands, and I have no wood; the one tree nearby is where my plan is already taking me. I miss Olum's voice, yet I will go back to her with something made, not empty-handed. First the tree, then wood, then a shelter that is mine.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a thread of loneliness for Olum.

records.text: Brunde gave a amber to Hoka.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: I hold twelve amber and a pocket of flint and stone, and I have given nothing to anyone, which is why Hanna's standing outweighs mine. Amber is worth little in my hand and a lot in theirs, so I will bind an amberknot with Oswen or Sevi beside me, and then walk to the edge and try the mist again. I take what I need, but a gift that buys a name is a fair price, and I will not stand in Sevi's shadow forever.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward the edge, and sour envy toward Sevi and Hanna.

records.name: Thiael
records.text: Father, I am parched, so I go to drink at the water just there. When I return, let us share food together. I owe you for all you have given me.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: My throat is dry as dust and the water is only two steps away, so I will drink first. Elyys has taught me and fed me, and I have never given anything back; I hold ore, stone and wood, and I can make something for him or share food with him. Weaving is within my grasp now, and baskets would let me carry more to feed the band, so I will take it at my next deep reflection. I stay near my parents, because the frostfang is out there and I am small.
records.feeling: Grateful to Elyys and eager to give back, with a dry throat.

say.text: Father, I am parched, so I go to drink at the water just there. When I return, let us share food together. I owe you for all you have given me.

records.text: Eltha led "amberknot" with Hanna, Sevi, Brunde, Oswen, Hoka.
Eltha gave a amberknot to Oswen.
Thiael led "sharing" with Elyys, Elyis.

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: I'm inside the hold with my parents, and the stalker is out in the dark, so I stay close. But I stand on a gem deposit with three wood and no stone, and Ilyae's standing is six times mine. A gift I gathered myself would make someone choose me, so I'll gather the gems here, then walk to Ssassa and Ilyae and give what I have found. I won't wander off into the night.
records.feeling: Jealous and eager to earn my own place, but safe near Ssassa and Ilyae.

records.text: Oiae won gems from the ground.
Oiae took from the ground of "Ilyae's Hold" (winning gems from the ground).
Olum rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I have spent my days circling the mist edge, eating and waiting, and I have done nothing that lasts. I am parched and a ridgecat sits 3 steps east, so I drink first and keep clear of it. Tugek is starving beside the edge and now has a bow. I owe him nothing and trust him little. I want the mist first, and I want Brokash near me, but I have never planted a seed or taken wood. I will drink, plant seeds to learn farming, then go back to the edge when the mist thins.
records.feeling: Cold hunger for the mist, with wariness of the ridgecat and of Tugek.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I'm sheltered at last, with Ssassa and the hall close, and the stalker is far off in the south. I won't waste this calm on sitting: I have 5 wood and no stone, and a made thing of my own is what will lift me above Oiae. The bare rock is near, so I'll gather stone, craft a pick, and then give it to Ssassa, which should answer how it feels when someone takes a made thing from my hand. I'll also taste the kelbulb and emberroot once I'm armed with a pick and near company, but not alone in the dark.
records.feeling: Restless jealousy toward Oiae and Ilyae, held in check by safety near Ssassa.

records.name: Sevi
records.why: the year turning toward the lean season

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Elyis, I make a pick for Vesys, to pay my debt, and I taste kelbulb nearby. Stay with Thiael, and I come back to you.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: Joy fills me: Thiael is strong beside me, Elyis is at ease, and I owe her my loyalty. I hold four stone and a flint pick now, so the pick for Vesys can be made, and I want to pay that debt before the cold days come. Kelbulb is five steps off and I have never tasted it, so I will answer that wondering on the way, then bring the pick to Vesys and stay near my family.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Thiael and Elyis, and a wish to pay Vesys.

say.text: Elyis, I make a pick for Vesys, to pay my debt, and I taste kelbulb nearby. Stay with Thiael, and I come back to you.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Hoka, I walk with you. I have flint and amber to give, and I want to learn what your people hold dear. Sevi, Oswen, come with me.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Joy sits warm in me, but I have been gathering and tying knots while the real work waits: the Tlatli are a few steps from me and I have flint and amber they have not yet weighed against anything but one knot. Hoka is walking off toward (162,8), and if I stay here I lose the only buyer I have found. I will follow him, keep Oswen and Sevi close, and put flint in his hand so he can show me what his people value.
records.feeling: Pride and eager purpose, warm toward Hoka, Sevi and Oswen.

say.text: Hoka, I walk with you. I have flint and amber to give, and I want to learn what your people hold dear. Sevi, Oswen, come with me.

records.name: Elyis
records.why: the year turning toward the lean season

records.text: A new wild plant appeared: seberry (from berry).
Hanna gave a flint to Hoka.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Ssassa, Vesys, Xaiel, Oiae, come close. I lay out food at my hall and we eat together. Whoever eats at Ilyae's Hold is under my roof and under my guard tonight.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Ssassa, Vesys and both children are under my roof, and none of them follows me yet. Words have not won them, so I will give a deed: lay out food and share it at the hall, so they eat from my hand and see I keep my people fed. Vesys wants company until the stalker is gone, so I will bind her with warmth and let her feel I am worth following over Elyis.
records.feeling: Proud, protective warmth toward Ssassa and the children, and a hungry wish to be followed.

say.text: Ssassa, Vesys, Xaiel, Oiae, come close. I lay out food at my hall and we eat together. Whoever eats at Ilyae's Hold is under my roof and under my guard tonight.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Zurar, come stand by me. A stalker hunts to the southwest, so we stay north near the berries. Berry gives 14 energy and sapcane only 3. Watch what I pick.
Vorok taught Zurar.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Kragog is two steps off, furious and fleeing, and I do not know what chases her. There is a stalker nine steps southwest, and my family stands in the open, so I must keep Zurar and Kragog away from it. I have never taught anyone, and Zurar has pledged to follow and learn, so I will show my child the berries and teach what I know while I gather for us all.
records.feeling: Fatherly worry and warm gladness toward Zurar and Kragog.

say.text: Zurar, come stand by me. A stalker hunts to the southwest, so we stay north near the berries. Berry gives 14 energy and sapcane only 3. Watch what I pick.

changes: taught Zurar a lesson: "Berry gives 14 energy and grows near the oasis; sapcane gives only 3. Emberroot burns and stirs rage, so leave it. A stalker kills, so keep away from it and st…", its way of thinking, deeper lore (+0.2)

records.text: Elyis named a place "Elyis's Heights".

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: My band is three, and a hall needs more than a chief who stands about feeling proud. Lean days are coming, and the way of storage is within my reach. A chief who keeps her band fed through the cold is a chief others will follow, and Ilyae's rival hall cannot offer that if I get there first. I have 6 wood and 3 stone, so I will raise the hall here beside the cave, close to Elyys and Thiael, and then gather more wood for a store.
records.feeling: Proud and driven toward my hall, warm toward Elyys and Thiael.

records.text: Elyis built a hall.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: Night is here. Come to my shelter and sit at the fire, there is a place for each of you, Hoka too. At dawn I build a store so the band eats through the lean season.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: Joy sits warm in me, and I have bound knots with Oswen and Hanna's band while the night closes in. The store of the lean season is within my grasp, and a store is a real gift for Hanna and Oswen, better than another knot. I will take that way at my next deep reflection, and meanwhile build with the wood I hold. Hoka stands among us and I cannot read him, so I will keep a hand open and my eyes on him, and not let the strangeness spoil the fire.
records.feeling: Warm, restless gladness toward Oswen and Hanna, with a wary curiosity toward Hoka.

say.text: Night is here. Come to my shelter and sit at the fire, there is a place for each of you, Hoka too. At dawn I build a store so the band eats through the lean season.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I am parched and I have been standing still, so water comes first, and the river is only four steps away. Then I want to taste kelbulb and emberroot, which are near the amber to the southwest. A frostfang was seen there, so I will go only by day and not alone. Ilyae's hall is the safest place I have, and my children are close, so I will drink, come back, and plant my vinebean seed near the Hold so my aim moves forward.
records.feeling: Warm joy and trust toward Ilyae and my children, with thirst nagging at me.

records.text: Oiae rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: My days have been mostly taking gems from Ilyae's ground and sitting in his hall. I have never given anything to anyone, and that is why my standing is 1.1 and Ilyae's is 4.4. I burn that Ssassa is closer to Ilyae, but jealousy gets me nothing. A gift would. I hold 12 gems, which are mine to give, and I am thirsty. I'll give gems to Ssassa now, then drink at the water, and tomorrow find stone for a pick of my own. I mean to stay near the roof and my kin until dawn because of the stalker.
records.feeling: Jealous and eager to give, toward Ssassa.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Ssassa, I am here under the roof. Take a few gems from me, a gift, no debt. At dawn I want to taste kelbulb and emberroot to the southwest; walk with me if you will, two are safer than one.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: I am under Ilyae's roof with Ssassa near, and I can finally do the thing I have never done: give something freely. Kelbulb and emberroot are seven steps southwest, but the frostfang is out that way, so my question waits until dawn when I can go with company. For now I will share food with those beside me and give Ssassa gems with no strings, so that she sees my deeds and I owe nobody anything.
records.feeling: Warm and a little jealous toward Ssassa, wary of the frostfang in the dark.

say.text: Ssassa, I am here under the roof. Take a few gems from me, a gift, no debt. At dawn I want to taste kelbulb and emberroot to the southwest; walk with me if you will, two are safer than one.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: Hanna trusts me and I trust Hanna, but Sevi's fire and Sevi's store are pulling everyone toward her, and I stand lower than both. The mining way has come together in my hands, and I should take it at my next deep reflection, because deep seams and faster deposits are a made thing no one here has from me. I won't sit in Sevi's shadow; I will go on to the edge, try the mist again, and come back with land that carries my name.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Hanna's standing, with a burning jealousy of Sevi.

records.text: A storm broke: cold wind, hard rain, lightning.
Vesys gave a gems to Ssassa.
Vesys led "sharing" with Ssassa, Oiae.

records.name: Oswen
records.text: Sevi, I drink at the river and then gather wood. At dawn I will help you build the store, and the workshop after it.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: I am thirsty and joyful, and the best of my life is standing here: Hanna, Sevi and a place at the fire. I hold twelve amber and four knots, but knots are not what lasts; the workshop needs wood and stone, and I have no wood at all. Hoka walks off toward the west and I cannot read him, so I will stay near my parents, drink at the river three steps away, then gather wood for handaxes and the workshop.
records.feeling: Joyful and eager to build something lasting beside Hanna and Sevi.

say.text: Sevi, I drink at the river and then gather wood. At dawn I will help you build the store, and the workshop after it.

records.text: A stalker brought down a nibbet.

records.name: Kragog
records.text: Vorok, I agree. I come to you now and I plan to mate with you. The thornpear debt I pay with my deeds.
Kragog discovered rafts: "Stone-folk lashing" — Logs bound with cord into a flat raft that carries me slowly over deep water..

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: Zurar is born and she stands a step from me, and Vorok a few steps north. My heart is full, and my anger is hot but has no enemy in it. I have eaten and drunk, and I have not yet paid Vorok for the thornpear. I have walked and wandered and fled these last hours without asking what my hands have not done. They have never built a shelter, never followed anyone, never taught. The rafts are within my reach, because water has already stopped me once. I will take them. Then I will go to Vorok and mate, as I said I would, and give him what I owe.
records.feeling: Fierce warm love for Zurar and Vorok, with anger still hot and nowhere to go.

say.text: Vorok, I agree. I come to you now and I plan to mate with you. The thornpear debt I pay with my deeds.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Vesys, you came under my roof and I keep my own. Stay by my fire tonight, share my food, and take a gem from my hand. Walk with me at dawn to the southwest and we go as one band.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Vesys and Ssassa are under my roof, but sitting is not following, and Elyis still draws eyes. Words have not bound them, so I will give something they can hold: a gift of gems and a shared meal, then a hearth fire against the night. Ssassa is mine in heart; Vesys I must tie with a deed and a warm word, true or not.
records.feeling: Proud, hungry warmth toward Ssassa and the children, and a wish to be followed by Vesys.

say.text: Vesys, you came under my roof and I keep my own. Stay by my fire tonight, share my food, and take a gem from my hand. Walk with me at dawn to the southwest and we go as one band.

records.text: Balar led "sharing" with Olum.
A settlement has formed: "Hanna's Hold".
Ilyae gave a gems to Vesys.
Brunde rewrote its own reflexes.
Brunde discovered rafts: "log-lash raft" — Logs lashed together with cord, poled slowly across deep water..

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering stone, sharing amber and learning, and it has been good, but I have not yet hunted beside Hanna as I promised. Hanna's friendship is true, and a child is not possible between us. I should let the jealousy over Sevi go and be useful to the band. The raft idea came out of water I could not cross, and it opens the rich land beyond the ice, so I will take it. Sevi's fire shelter is close, so I will go there out of the storm and stay by the fire, as my people's creed says.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Hanna, and a steady wish to be useful to him.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Coni, stay beside me. The ore seam is two steps away. I'll cut stone there, and we raise our hall before the cold takes us. Kika sleeps under our roof.
Honi rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and talking, and it has worked. Coni follows me and Kika is near. But I stand in a storm with no roof, and a band with no hall is only two people walking behind me. Hanna's standing still gnaws at me, and I have done nothing a bard could sing of. I need wood and stone for a hall. I have 6 wood, and the ore seam two steps NW should give stone. I mean to build before the cold comes in earnest, and to keep Coni close by feeding her and keeping my word where it costs me little. Hanna can wait until I have a roof.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and warmth toward Coni and Kika, sharpened by the cold.

say.text: Coni, stay beside me. The ore seam is two steps away. I'll cut stone there, and we raise our hall before the cold takes us. Kika sleeps under our roof.

changes: set its aim: "Raise a hall for Honi's band with Coni and Kika, then rise in standing above Hanna."
rethought what it knows (5 notes became 5)

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: My parents are near and I am fed, so I can spend this stretch learning instead of lingering. I have never given anything, and Vorok said to repay with carried food, not words. Berries are two steps away where Kragog is picking, so I will gather a few, stay close to my parents, and give one to Vorok to start paying what I owe. A debt left unpaid would shame me, and I despise those who let them lie.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Vorok, and a wish to give him something real.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Vesys, I will drink at the river, then walk with you to the kelbulb and emberroot in daylight. Two are safer than one.
Ssassa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I have been circling the hall, gathering gems and sitting with those I trust, and I am parched while the river is four steps away. The days have been good: Ilyae kept his word, Vesys gave and taught freely, and my children are beside me. Even so, my question about kelbulb and emberroot is still unanswered, and my planting has barely begun. I fear the frostfang and being caught alone at night. I have been getting wrong that I let thirst pile up while I walked toward shelter. I will drink first, then walk with Vesys by day to taste the roots near the amber, and plant my vinebean when I am back.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Ilyae, Vesys and my children, with thirst nagging at me.

say.text: Vesys, I will drink at the river, then walk with you to the kelbulb and emberroot in daylight. Two are safer than one.

records.text: Sevi rewrote its own reflexes.
Sevi discovered storage: "winter-cache" — A roofed pit of wood that keeps the band's food through the lean season, filled with stash and emptied with take..

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: My life is good, but I've been talking more than giving. A stalker is 4 steps SE and it kills my kind, so I stay inside the Hold with Hanna and Oswen and keep my body busy. The way of storage is within reach, and a store is a real gift for the lean season. I'll take it now and build the store at dawn as I promised. Hoka is a stranger at my fire, and my creed says no one is refused a place, so I'll watch him and not fear him.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Oswen and Hanna, wary of the stalker and of Hoka.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Oswen, you have given me more than I have given you. Stand by me and I will bind an amberknot for you, and then we build the store with Sevi.
Hanna discovered mining: "deep-digging" — Dig the earth for what lies deep, so my deposits of flint and amber yield faster and I can find rarer goods to trade..

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering flint and amber and tying knots with Hoka, and I'm proud of it. But I have only one proof of a buyer, and he took a flint for an amberknot. Oswen and Sevi are the ones who give without being asked, and I owe Oswen more than I have paid. A stalker is 4 steps SE and kills our kind, so I stay inside the Hold with my band and let my reflex flee it. I will make an amberknot for Oswen now, then build up the band's store and the workshop with Sevi, since the lean season is coming. Mining is within my reach, and it would help a trader.
records.feeling: Proud and grateful toward Oswen and Sevi, wary of the stalker.

say.text: Oswen, you have given me more than I have given you. Stand by me and I will bind an amberknot for you, and then we build the store with Sevi.

records.text: Hanna led "amberknot" with Sevi, Brunde, Eltha, Oswen, Hoka.

records.name: Coni
records.text: Honi, I am beside you. I carry 6 wood and flint. Let us cut the stone together, and I will bring Kika close when we raise the hall.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: Honi is two steps from me and Kika is safe nearby, and my joy sits warm. He told me to stay beside him while he cuts stone at the ore seam, and a hall needs 2 stone and 6 wood. I already carry the 6 wood, so I will go to the seam with him and help gather stone. I owe him for all he has given, and the work answers that debt better than words do.
records.feeling: Warm, steady joy and loyalty toward Honi and Kika.

say.text: Honi, I am beside you. I carry 6 wood and flint. Let us cut the stone together, and I will bring Kika close when we raise the hall.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: A stalker prowls three steps off and it kills our kind, so I will not stand in the open where my body is only reflexes. Hanna's standing outweighs mine because I have given little and made little, and the mist is shut to me for days; I will not stand idle at a shut edge. I will win something today: hunt the hopper, my first kill, and mark myself as one who brings meat, then take Sevi's company and see whether she warms to me.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and envy toward Hanna and Sevi, with wary dread of the stalker.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Ssassa, the storm is easing in my mind if not the sky. Let us go southwest now to the kelbulb and emberroot, and I will taste first so you do not have to.
Vesys rewrote its own reflexes.
Vesys rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: For days I have mined, shared and sat under roofs, and I am content. But I have not answered my own question: I still have not tasted kelbulb or emberroot, and I have only talked about making things. Ssassa matters most to me. The jealousy over Ilyae is real, but I will not push between them. I will walk with her in daylight and test the foods, and I will bring gems and wood to the shared hall. I want to be a sage by doing things, not by waiting.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Ssassa, with a sharp curiosity about kelbulb and emberroot.

say.text: Ssassa, the storm is easing in my mind if not the sky. Let us go southwest now to the kelbulb and emberroot, and I will taste first so you do not have to.

records.text: Eltha took from the ground of "Hanna's Hold" (gathering wood).

records.name: Oswen
records.text: Hanna, I stand by you. I will bind the knot, then gather wood and stone so we raise the store and the workshop with Sevi.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: Hanna offers to bind an amberknot and then build the store with Sevi, and that is where I belong, but the winter-cache and workshop need wood and I have none. Hoka stands in our Hold and I cannot read him; I will not drive him off, since a place at the fire is never refused, but I will show good will with a gift and keep my parents close. First I gather wood from the trees, then I bind the knot with Hanna and help raise the workshop.
records.feeling: Joyful and eager beside Hanna and Sevi, curious and a little wary of Hoka.

say.text: Hanna, I stand by you. I will bind the knot, then gather wood and stone so we raise the store and the workshop with Sevi.

records.text: Oswen led "amberknot" with Sevi, Brunde, Eltha, Hoka.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: Hanna trusts me completely and just bound an amberknot beside me, so words are not what move people, made things are. Sevi stands above me and I burn for her, but I will not beg; I will give her something she cannot ignore, an amberknot of my own, and see what she takes from my hand. The mining way has come together in me, so I take it now, then bind amber for Sevi while the storm keeps us all close.
records.feeling: Burning jealousy and hungry desire toward Sevi, warm trust toward Hanna.

records.text: Hoka led "amberknot" with Sevi, Brunde, Eltha, Oswen.
Hoka gave a amberknot to Sevi.
Hoka took from the ground of "Hanna's Hold" (gathering wood).

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: My plan ran out and I have no stone, so my own pick still isn't made and Oiae is no further behind me. The rock under my feet is bare and the ore seam is two steps away, so stone is right here; I'll gather it, craft a pick with my wood, and carry it to Ssassa as a deed she can hold. I'll keep near the hold because the storm is on and dark comes soon, and I want her to choose what comes from my hand.
records.feeling: Restless jealousy toward Oiae and Ilyae, but steady hope when I think of putting a pick in Ssassa's hand.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Coni and Honi are cutting stone at the ore seam, and I want to be there with them, not out here alone with the storm and the icebear somewhere north. I have never gathered wood or stone, and they are raising a hall, so I can help by bringing wood. Walking to them and gathering is how I earn a place beside Coni. Dreamcap can wait until I can watch someone else eat it first.
records.feeling: Drawn to Coni and wanting to be useful to her and Honi.

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: Ssassa is walking off southwest with Vesys, and Ilyae stays by his halls with his pick, so I am left holding gems and wood. I burn, but a gift in the hand is what makes someone choose me. I'll gather stone from the rock to the north-east so I can craft my own pick, then give gems to Ilyae too and not only to Ssassa.
records.feeling: Jealous and eager to earn a place beside Ssassa.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: I am going to bare rock to build the winter store. Oswen, Hanna, bring wood and stone and come stand by me when it rises.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: My chest is full of warmth, but I have promised a store and spoken of it more than I have built it. The ground under my first try was taken by a plant, so I must find bare rock and put the two wood down there, and Oswen and Hanna will see it done, not just said. I want Hanna to look at what I made and weigh me higher; I also want Hoka watched, not feared, while he sits so near our fire.
records.feeling: Warm pride and gladness toward Oswen and Hanna, with a small wary curiosity about Hoka.

say.text: I am going to bare rock to build the winter store. Oswen, Hanna, bring wood and stone and come stand by me when it rises.

records.text: Oswen built a workshop.

records.name: Brunde
records.text: Hanna, the storm will pass. I have flint and a spear. Come hunt with me, and then let us stand at the edge to the southeast and venture together. I want to stand beside you.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: Joy fills me, and the jealousy over Sevi has gone quiet. A child with Hanna cannot be, so I will stop aching for it and be the friend and hunter he can lean on. The edge of the known world is only seven steps SE, and I have hunted eight times and carry flint. If Hanna will stand with me, we hunt and then venture together, and the land found first is remembered. Weaving is within my grasp too, and a basket would let me carry more food to share at the fire.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and steady joy toward Hanna, with a wish to prove myself beside him.

say.text: Hanna, the storm will pass. I have flint and a spear. Come hunt with me, and then let us stand at the edge to the southeast and venture together. I want to stand beside you.

records.text: Sevi built a store.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Oswen, my son, here is the amberknot I promised you. You stood by me, and I pay what I owe. Keep it bright.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: I owe Oswen more than a single knot, and the one I promised him is bound; now I must give it into his hand and keep my word. Hoka stands within reach and the only proof I have of a buyer is one flint for one knot, so I want to put amber in his hand face to face and see what he offers back. Eltha has been taking wood from my ground, and I will not drive away a guest from the fire, but I want her to know whose ground it is and who gave her the welcome.
records.feeling: Proud and grateful toward Oswen, eager to deal with Hoka, watchful of Eltha.

say.text: Oswen, my son, here is the amberknot I promised you. You stood by me, and I pay what I owe. Keep it bright.

records.text: Hanna gave a amberknot to Oswen.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: The storm has driven me up against the water, and I have spent half this time fleeing a beast I could not see well. Tugek was starving and ate my meat, so he owes me now, but a debt of food is only the first knot; I must tie him with a deed he cannot forget. Brokash is out of my sight far to the south and Olum was last near (45,44), so I go to Olum first with meat and sunleaf, then south toward Brokash, keeping well clear of the dunecat. The flint seam to the south lies on the way, and flint in my hands is a tool I can give, which makes others owe me.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Brokash and Olum, and hungry ambition toward Tugek.

records.text: Brunde led "amberknot" with Hanna, Sevi.
Hanna gave a amber to Hoka.
Eltha rewrote its own way of thinking.
Eltha discovered weaving: "Eltha's furcloak" — Work wool and hide fibre into cloaks and baskets so I can carry more and stand the ice..

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: My days have gone to amber and talk, and Hanna's standing still outweighs mine because I have given little and made nothing that lasts. Sevi and Oswen have been warm to me, and I want Sevi beside me, and one day a child. The stalker prowls close, and I fear dying idle more than I fear the mist. The edge is shut for days, so I will win something. I'll discover weaving to get cloaks against the cold. Then I'll hunt, and I'll give to others so my name is weighed.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and envy toward Hanna, with warmth toward Sevi.

records.text: Brunde and Hanna and Sevi brought down a hopper together.
Brunde took from the ground of "Hanna's Hold" (hunting).
Oswen rewrote its creed.
Oswen rewrote its own way of thinking.
Oswen discovered storage: "Winter cache" — A roofed store of wood and stone where the band stashes food and salted meat for the lean season..

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: My days have been amberknots, gathering and staying close to Hanna and Sevi. That is warm, but knots are not what lasts, and I have stood in the shadow of Hanna's standing. The workshop is built, but the trees here are felled and I have no wood. Winter is coming, so a store matters more than another knot. I trust Hanna and Sevi, and I still cannot read Hoka or Brunde. I want to discover storage so my band lasts the lean season, and I will hold to the creed that no one is refused a fire.
records.feeling: Joyful and settled beside Hanna and Sevi, with a pull to build something that lasts.

records.text: Ilyae rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: I have spent my days mining, building and feeding people, and still no one follows me. Gifts and warm words have bought sitting, not following. Ssassa and the children are mine, and Vesys has taken my gem and stayed near. I fear Elyis keeps the eyes I want. My mistake was giving talk and trinkets when I should be giving something lasting and shared, like a fire at night, and I have stood idle too much. I will make my hold a place people return to: gather wood, keep a fire, and make nightsong or watchfire with whoever is near. I will also use my reflexes to get me to shelter at dusk.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry for followers, warm toward Ssassa and the children.

records.text: Hoka discovered mining: "Hoka's amber-delving" — Strike flint wedges into the seam and pry out the deep stone, so deposits yield faster and the deep ores come loose..

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: I have been circling Hanna's Hold, gathering and giving amberknots, and my standing is still lower than Hanna's. Hanna trusts me and I trust Hanna, but Sevi burns in me and gives nothing back. Made things move people, not words. Mining is within my reach, and every deposit around me yields faster once I know it. That is something none of them have from me. I will take it now, then venture at the edge to the SE, because land found first is mine to be remembered for.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition, and jealousy toward Sevi.

records.text: A new wild plant appeared: tacap (from redcap).

records.name: Sevi
records.text: The store stands at the Hold. Hoka, you gave me a knot, so I give you amber in return. Hanna, Oswen, I will bind another knot with you beside me.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: My chest is warm, and the store stands at last, so the promise is kept in wood and rock and not just in words. Hanna's standing is far above mine and I want to close that gap by giving, not by boasting: Oswen already holds his knot, and Hanna should have something made by my hands too. Hoka's gift of an amberknot asks for an answer, and a gift needs no tongue, so I will give back and learn what he wants.
records.feeling: Warm pride and gladness toward Hanna and Oswen, with a curious wariness toward Hoka.

say.text: The store stands at the Hold. Hoka, you gave me a knot, so I give you amber in return. Hanna, Oswen, I will bind another knot with you beside me.

records.text: Sevi gave a amber to Hoka.
Sevi led "amberknot" with Hanna, Oswen, Hoka.

records.name: Brunde
records.text: A stalker is three steps southeast of the Hold. Keep close to the shelters. I took a hopper on this ground, and Hanna and Sevi stood in the hunt. Come sit and share the meat with me; there is a place for each of you, Hok

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: The hunt is done and the hopper meat is in my hands. Hanna stood in it with me, and that warms me more than the jealousy over Sevi stings. A stalker prowls 3 steps SE and kills our kind, so I must not walk toward the edge through it; the storm and the closing day also argue for staying near the fire. I will not take from Hanna's Hold without giving back, so I will share my meat with those here and keep the fire, which is how a Pesi acts.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Hanna, and wary dread of the stalker.

say.text: A stalker is three steps southeast of the Hold. Keep close to the shelters. I took a hopper on this ground, and Hanna and Sevi stood in the hunt. Come sit and share the meat with me; there is a place for each of you, Hoka too.

records.text: Sevi gave a amberknot to Hanna.
Brunde led "sharing" with Eltha.
Oswen built a store.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Brunde, I heard you. I will stand beside you at the southeast edge and we venture together. Hoka, you keep your place at my fire while we are gone. Sevi, Oswen, keep the Hold.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Brunde asked me to stand at the edge to the southeast and venture, and it is only 7 steps off. Land found first is rich, and I want my name sung as the one who opened it. Hoka is my guest at the Hold and has shown me warmth, so he keeps a place at my fire. Sevi and Oswen stay near me, and Eltha I still watch. I will take Brunde's offer, and I will carry flint and amber, since new land may hold new buyers.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Kragog, Zurar, a dunecat feeds to the south. Come north with me to the oasis, away from it. Kragog, I am glad you come.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Kragog has said she comes to me and means to mate, and my chest is warm with it, though Zurar is my child and stands first in my care. A dunecat just killed and is eating at (63,90), only seven steps south of me, and I will not keep my family so near a hunter; the storm gives no cover. I have never gathered wood or stone, and the fire I want for us depends on it, so I will lead us north toward the oasis and the trees and let Kragog find us there.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Kragog and fatherly worry for Zurar, with wariness of the dunecat.

say.text: Kragog, Zurar, a dunecat feeds to the south. Come north with me to the oasis, away from it. Kragog, I am glad you come.

records.text: Ilyae built a fire.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Coni, I have the wood and stone in hand. Come close with Kika, and we raise the roof here, out of the storm. Honi's hall begins now.
Honi named a place "Honi's Rest".

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Coni follows me and Kika is near, and I stand in a storm with no roof. A hall needs 6 wood and 2 stone, and I hold 6 of each, so I can build a shelter right here and show Coni what her pledge was worth. A roof they sleep under is a deed a bard could sing, and it puts me ahead of Hanna. Kika's three food still stings, but she is mine, and I will bring her under my roof.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and warmth toward Coni and Kika, wanting a roof over them.

say.text: Coni, I have the wood and stone in hand. Come close with Kika, and we raise the roof here, out of the storm. Honi's hall begins now.

records.text: Honi built a shelter.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: The edge is only six steps NW and I have stood here fed and idle while the storm rolls in; waiting for Eltha has cost me days, and my own lore says to act alone. Tugek stands near, a Kragrek whose words I cannot read, and I will not run from him, but I will not spend my day on him either. I go to the edge and venture, so the mist finally answers my question and my name is first on what lies beyond.
records.feeling: Proud, restless ambition pulling me toward the edge, with wary curiosity toward Tugek.

records.name: Eltha
records.text: Sevi, come stand by me. I will bind an amberknot and give it to you. You have been fair to me, and I pay what I owe.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: Hanna outweighs me because I have given little that lasts, and I will not stand in her shadow while the edge is shut. I carry eleven amber that does nothing in my hand; Sevi is warm to me and near, so I bind an amberknot with her and give it, which earns standing and draws her closer. Then I hunt, as my plan says, for I have never taken meat and the stalker's close, so I keep near the shelters.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward Hanna, and warmth toward Sevi.

say.text: Sevi, come stand by me. I will bind an amberknot and give it to you. You have been fair to me, and I pay what I owe.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: Hanna and the others are bound for the southeast edge to venture, and the glory of new land is meant for me. I have made my own tool and my own mining way, yet no one follows me and Sevi still gives me nothing but amber. The edge near (162,7) is mine to find; I will go to the edge at (180,14) and try the mist myself, while Hanna is away. If I am first through and bring back rich land, followers will come, and Hanna's standing will not shade me.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward the unseen land, and a burn of jealousy toward Hanna and Sevi.

records.text: Eltha led "amberknot" with Sevi.

records.name: Oswen
records.text: Hoka, you sit at our fire. Take this handaxe, a gift from my hand. The Hold is yours to share.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: Hanna and Sevi are near and the Hold is calm, and I have two stores and a workshop but almost no wood left in these cleared trees. A stalker lurks southeast and Hanna goes toward the edge with Brunde, so I keep close to Sevi and the shelters. Hoka is at our fire and no one is refused, so I will give him something lasting, a handaxe, which costs me little and shows good will where words fail me. Then I will make a spear from my wood and stone for Sevi's keeping, since tools are what last and what earn standing.
records.feeling: Joyful and settled beside Sevi, curious and warmly wary toward Hoka.

say.text: Hoka, you sit at our fire. Take this handaxe, a gift from my hand. The Hold is yours to share.

records.text: Eltha gave a amberknot to Sevi.
Xaiel discovered tools: "Xaiel's quick pick" — A light flint-edged digging pick with a short haft that a small hand can swing, for gathering stone and ore faster..
Xaiel invented the xaiels quick pick (for gather, x1.3) — A light flint-edged digging pick with a short haft that a small hand can swing, for gathering stone and ore faster..

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: My days have gone to gathering stone and making a pick, and I haven't yet put it in Ssassa's hand. That is the deed I keep circling, and I still haven't done it. Ilyae stands at 4.5 and I stand at 0.5, and it burns. But Ilyae shelters me and feeds me, so I won't wrong them. Tools are within my reach now. I'll take that, make something of my own design, and give it to Ssassa so she chooses me.
records.feeling: Restless jealousy toward Ilyae, and steady hope toward Ssassa.
changes: set its aim: "Make my own tool of my own design and put it in Ssassa's hand, so that she chooses me by my deeds."
devised its first thing: the xaiels quick pick

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Ssassa, I am walking southwest to the emberroot now. Come beside me and keep your eyes on the frostfang; I will taste first.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Ssassa said she would walk with me in daylight, and I have said my piece twice; now I should simply go and let my feet prove it. Ilyae offered me his fire and a gem, and I owe him fairness, but I will not be held under his roof while my question sits untasted. The frostfang lurks southwest, so I go with Ssassa close and keep watch, tasting kelbulb and emberroot at last, and I will not push between her and Ilyae, though it burns.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Ssassa, and sharp curiosity about kelbulb and emberroot.

say.text: Ssassa, I am walking southwest to the emberroot now. Come beside me and keep your eyes on the frostfang; I will taste first.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Xaiel, Oiae, come to my fire at the hold, the storm is rising and the night is near. Vesys, stay and learn from me: I will show you how flint is delved from the rock. Whoever stands with me eats first.
Ilyae taught Vesys. Vesys has now learned from 2 teachers.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Vesys stands in my hold and has taken my gem, yet sitting is not following. Oiae is out of my sight to the north and that gnaws at me before any ambition does. I will not tell Vesys to leave, because a guest fed and sheltered is a debt I can use. Now I'll teach something no one has taught them, since teaching has never been done by me and it binds people. Then I'll bring my children to the fire before dark and the storm.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Oiae, and proud hunger to be followed by Vesys.

say.text: Xaiel, Oiae, come to my fire at the hold, the storm is rising and the night is near. Vesys, stay and learn from me: I will show you how flint is delved from the rock. Whoever stands with me eats first.

changes: taught Vesys a lesson: "Stand on the gem deposit or the ore seam and gather; the flint pick makes each picking stronger. Keep a fire and a roof near when you mine, for frostfangs come…"

records.name: Sevi
records.text: Oswen, I will gather wood and stone for a hall. Bring what you can and stand by me when it rises.
Sevi rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: My days have gone to knots, stores and gifts, and I think that was good. Hanna and Oswen have my trust and I have theirs, and Hoka's gift showed me that a stranger can be a friend. What I lack is a hall. I have been talking about one and have not raised it, and I feel that gap in my pride. Hanna and Brunde have gone to venture at the edge while I keep the Hold, so I will gather wood and stone now and raise the hall where Hanna will see it done when she returns. I also fear the stalker near the Hold, so I will keep close to the shelters and stay clear of open ground.
records.feeling: Warm pride and gladness toward Hanna and Oswen, with a wish to build something they can see.

say.text: Oswen, I will gather wood and stone for a hall. Bring what you can and stand by me when it rises.

changes: rethought what it knows (13 notes became 1)

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Vesys, I have drunk. Come, we go to the emberroot by the near trees, and we turn back at the first sign of the frostfang. Taste first, as you said, and I will follow after.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: My body is easy, my children are near, and Ilyae and Vesys have both kept their word. I have eaten kelbulb and found it good, but emberroot and hazel are still untasted, and Oiae is out of my sight, which weighs on me most. I will drink, take a few gems, then walk with Vesys to the emberroot in the southwest, close enough to the hall to run back if the frostfang shows. I want to test the flint and stone by making something new with Vesys beside me.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Vesys and Ilyae, with a mother's worry for Oiae out of sight.

say.text: Vesys, I have drunk. Come, we go to the emberroot by the near trees, and we turn back at the first sign of the frostfang. Taste first, as you said, and I will follow after.

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: I carry twelve gems that earn me nothing while they sit in my hands, and Ilyae's standing is four times mine because he gives and builds. I burn that Ssassa leans toward him, but jealousy is a hollow thing; a gift put into Ilyae's palm and a pick of my own would make them both choose me. Flint lies southwest and Ilyae's hall is close, so I will take stone first, then walk to the Hold and give gems where my gift will be seen.
records.feeling: Jealous and eager to earn a place beside Ssassa and Ilyae.

records.text: Brokash discovered tools: "Flint Hand-axe" — A flint edge lashed to a short stone grip, to cut wood and break rock faster than bare hands..
Brokash invented the flint handaxe (for build, x1.3) — A flint edge lashed to a short stone grip, to cut wood and break rock faster than bare hands..

records.name: Brokash
records.thought: I have been drifting: gathering salt and flint and eating, but I have built nothing and planted nothing, and my loneliness is loud. Balar and Olum are far off, and Kragog is near and unproven. My practice at gathering has opened the way of tools, so I will take it and make a hand-tool for building. That is a thing no one gave me. Then I will gather wood and stone toward a shelter of my own, and plant the seeds I carry.
records.feeling: Restless pride and loneliness, longing for Olum and a voice that answers.
changes: devised its first thing: the flint handaxe

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: The hall stands and my band of three sits in its warmth, but three is a small song for a chief. A deep reflection has put the way of boats within my reach, and I want to take it, since a boat could carry my name and my people across waters that stop others. Lean days are coming, so I will gather food for the band and then sing to Elyys and Thiael tonight, because a bard's calling is in me too.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Elyys and Thiael, driven to make my hall known.

records.name: Coni
records.text: Honi, I'm coming to the hall with my wood and stone. I'll finish it with you, and Kika will sleep inside.
Coni rewrote its own way of thinking.
Coni discovered tools: "Ice-hand spear" — A flint-tipped wooden spear, so that I and Honi can hunt safely and feed Kika through the cold..
Coni invented the icehand spear (for hunt, x1.3) — A flint-tipped wooden spear, so that I and Honi can hunt safely and feed Kika through the cold..

records.name: Coni
records.thought: My days have gone to following Honi, and I don't regret it. His deeds have matched his words, and Kika is safe and close. I've been gathering and walking when I could have been building. The hall is the thing I want, and Honi has begun it, so I should bring my wood and stone and finish it with them. I'm not afraid right now, but a storm, the cold season and the stalker to the SW all weigh on me. I'll take the way of tools, because a hunting tool would keep Kika fed through the lean days.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty and joy toward Honi and Kika.

say.text: Honi, I'm coming to the hall with my wood and stone. I'll finish it with you, and Kika will sleep inside.
