records.text: Sevi built a hall.

records.name: Coni
records.why: the year turning toward the lean season

records.text: Brunde rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: I have spent my days hunting, gathering and wanting what others have. Hanna is my truest friend; Sevi's closeness to him stings, but he stood beside me in the hunt, and that matters more than the jealousy. I fear the stalker and the lean cold coming. I have talked of the edge for days and still not walked it. So I will keep a bag of food on me and stay near the fire and others. When the fog lifts and Hanna is ready, we go to the edge together.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Hanna, with a thin ache over Sevi.

records.text: Coni built a hall.

records.name: Eltha
records.text: Sevi, you gather wood for a hall. I will bring stone and wood too. Let us raise it together, and let the folk say two women built it.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: Hanna's Hold is a good roof, but I have not come here to sit in her shadow. The edge is shut by fog, so I will make something that lasts and bear it to the Hold: gather wood and stone, then raise a hall or shrine with Sevi beside me, and put my name on it. Sevi is warm to me, and I will keep her near while I earn standing, and the stalker will not find me alone at night.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition to be remembered, and warmth toward Sevi.

say.text: Sevi, you gather wood for a hall. I will bring stone and wood too. Let us raise it together, and let the folk say two women built it.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: The mist is one step from me, and my curiosity burns hotter than my fear. Zurar and Vorok are far to the NE at the Oasis, and I love them, but this poor ground will not keep us through winter, and the one who finds rich land first is remembered for it. I have cloudberry and frostmoss right here that I have never tasted, so I will test them first, then venture into the mist while I am fed and healthy, and come back to bring Vorok and Zurar to whatever I find.
records.feeling: Curious and restless, with warm love for Zurar and Vorok pulling at my back.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and goldfruit grows right under my feet, so I eat first; hunger has made my question foolish to chase on an empty body. Ssassa is near and trusting, and I will not push between her and Ilyae, but I owe Ilyae a debt for his lesson and will repay it with a deed, not just words. Once I am fed I will taste emberroot as I promised, with Ssassa watching for the frostfang, because that is how I answer what it does to a body.
records.feeling: Hungry and a little jealous, but warmly bound to Ssassa and grateful to Ilyae.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: The hall stands and Honi and Kika are both within a few steps, so my joy is warm and I have no wish to leave them. I owe Honi much, and the best way to pay is to keep building what we share and keep the three of us close. My plan is still resting and the fog is thick, so I will let it run and not wander off into the mist.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty and quiet joy toward Honi and Kika.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Coni, I am coming to the hall. There is amber right here. I will gather it and bring it, and we can bind a knot together.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Coni and Honi are close, and the hall they raised is warm and near. Night comes soon, so I want to be inside with them, not alone in the fog. The amber beside me is something I have never taken, and I could bind it into a knot with Coni as a gift, a small way to earn my place beside her.
records.feeling: Warm and drawn to Coni, wanting to be useful to her and Honi.

say.text: Coni, I am coming to the hall. There is amber right here. I will gather it and bring it, and we can bind a knot together.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: Elyis is a step away and the hall is under me, so I am safe; the fog and the night make me want to stay close. I have never given anything to anyone, and Elyys's care still sits in me as a debt. I hold wood, stone and ore, so I will make Elyys a flint pick as a gift, and put food in my hands so I can share with him when he returns.
records.feeling: Grateful and warm toward Elyys and Elyis, eager to finally give something.

records.name: Oswen
records.text: Brunde, you warned us of the stalker, and I thank you. Sit at our fire and share it. Take only what the Hold can spare, and what you take, help us replace.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: Brunde stands in our Hold and took from our ground today, yet he warned us of the stalker, and no one is refused a place at the fire, so I will not drive him off. Eltha has come too, and Sevi is raising the hall, so I should stand by Sevi and help finish it. I have no wood left in these cleared lands, so I will gather what little I can and bring it to the hall, then give Brunde the gift I owe him.
records.feeling: Joyful and settled beside Sevi, warmly wary toward Brunde.

say.text: Brunde, you warned us of the stalker, and I thank you. Sit at our fire and share it. Take only what the Hold can spare, and what you take, help us replace.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: The hall at the Hold is raised. Eltha, you said two women would build it, and you were right. Come in out of the fog and sit under its roof; none is refused a place at this fire.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: The hall stands, and Oswen sat in it with me. I feel proud, but I want Hanna to see it and to hold something made by my hands, since I keep wanting to close the gap between her standing and mine by giving. Eltha is near and has been fair to me, so I'll bind an amberknot for Hanna and share the hall's welcome while the night is quiet. Then I'll gather wood, because a raft for the deep water needs more than I carry.
records.feeling: Warm pride and gladness toward Oswen and Hanna, with a wish for them to see what I built.

say.text: The hall at the Hold is raised. Eltha, you said two women would build it, and you were right. Come in out of the fog and sit under its roof; none is refused a place at this fire.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Coni, keep the hall warm and Kika close. I go two steps to the edge of the world to push into the mist. I will bring back land and a tale for our fire.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Coni has built the hall and sleeps in my band's roof, but she stands higher than me, and that gnaws at me. A hall is a good deed, yet it is hers, not mine. I have not done one thing a bard could sing: I have never hunted, never ventured, never made a song. The edge of the world is two steps away, and the one who finds new land first is remembered, so I will go and push into the mist, then come back with a tale to tell by the fire.
records.feeling: Restless ambition for a deed worth singing, with warmth toward Coni and Kika.

say.text: Coni, keep the hall warm and Kika close. I go two steps to the edge of the world to push into the mist. I will bring back land and a tale for our fire.

records.name: Oiae
records.text: Ilyae, I come to your fire. I bring gems for you, freely given.

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: Ilyae's hold is right here and he stands apart from Ssassa, so this is my chance to put gems into his palm and let him see what I carry. I burn that Ssassa leans toward him, but a deed will do more than that burning. Stone is the thing I lack for my own pick; once I have given, I'll go to the rock east of here and gather it before the night is out.
records.feeling: Jealous and eager, wanting Ilyae and Ssassa to choose me.

say.text: Ilyae, I come to your fire. I bring gems for you, freely given.

records.text: Oswen led "amberknot" with Brunde.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Eltha, you stand on my ground at Hanna's Hold. Sit at the fire and eat, that is our way. But ask before you take wood or stone from here, and give back what you take.
Hanna rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: I have been walking, fleeing and gathering when I should be trading. Sevi, Oswen and Brunde are true to me and I keep faith with them. Eltha takes from my ground and builds with Sevi, so I watch her. She is not an enemy yet, but she is no guest until she asks. I hold amber and flint, and Hoka is the one buyer I have found. I want to put them in a buyer's hand again and learn what the Tlatli value. I will also keep my people close, and I will venture southeast with Brunde.
records.feeling: Proud and eager toward my trade and my band, wary of Eltha.

say.text: Eltha, you stand on my ground at Hanna's Hold. Sit at the fire and eat, that is our way. But ask before you take wood or stone from here, and give back what you take.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: The mist turned me back once, but the edge is one step from me and I am fed, warm and strong. Words get me nothing from Sevi, and Hanna's trust is already mine. Land that I find first, with my name on it, is something neither of them can give or take away. I will try the mist again now, and if it holds, I will go back to the Hold with amber for the hall and make something there with Sevi beside me.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition for the unseen land, with jealousy still burning toward Sevi and Hanna.

records.text: Sevi led "amberknot" with Hanna.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: It is night and fog, and Ilyae called us to the hold ten steps east; I should not stay out here where the frostfang hunts the alone. I carry two flint picks, and I have never once put a thing in anyone's hand. Ssassa matters most to me, so I will take one pick to her as a deed, and go under the hold's roof before the dark deepens. Jealousy of Ilyae stings, but Ilyae shelters me, and a gift will answer better than envy.
records.feeling: Hopeful and a little jealous, toward Ssassa and Ilyae.

records.text: Sevi was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Brunde took from the ground of "Hanna's Hold" (harvesting berry).

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Oiae, you gave freely and so I give back: a pick from my own hand, made at my hold. Vesys, come near and eat under my roof. Who stands with Ilyae eats first, and no one here goes hungry.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Oiae came to my fire with gems freely given, and he is my own blood, so he is a guest I keep, not one I send off. Vesys sits near and has taken my gem, but sitting is not following, and Elyis still holds the eyes I want. I will give a deed that binds: Oiae has no pick of his own making from me, so I will craft a canopy pick and hand it over, then lay out a hallwelcome with food so all see I feed those who stand with me. Then I will ask Vesys openly to pledge himself.
records.feeling: Proud, protective warmth toward Oiae, and hungry ambition to be followed by Vesys.

say.text: Oiae, you gave freely and so I give back: a pick from my own hand, made at my hold. Vesys, come near and eat under my roof. Who stands with Ilyae eats first, and no one here goes hungry.

records.text: Ilyae gave a canopy pick to Oiae.
Hanna led "amberknot" with Brunde, Oswen.

Hoka went past the edge of the known world and found new land, part of the Vaor Snows: in the ground, iron, shell, obsidian; a herd of mammoth that has never seen your kind; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder.

Hoka pushed past the edge of the known world near (187,10) and found new land with in the ground, iron, shell, obsidian; a herd of mammoth that has never seen your kind; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder.

records.name: Brunde
records.text: The stalker is two steps southwest of the shelter, close in the fog. Come into the hall and keep together. Oswen, Sevi, Hanna, stand with spears ready; I will stand with you.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: A stalker is two steps off and I stand in fog with no food, so I must get inside the hall's circle of people, not test my luck. Hanna and I have both said we would venture together, but that is for a clear day with others beside us, not tonight. I will go to the hall, sit near Oswen and Sevi, and share what I have; being near them is safer and keeps my aim of allies alive.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker, and warm trust toward Hanna.

say.text: The stalker is two steps southwest of the shelter, close in the fog. Come into the hall and keep together. Oswen, Sevi, Hanna, stand with spears ready; I will stand with you.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Brokash is far to the south and out of my sight, and that gnaws at me more than any beast. Olum was last seen to the north near (45,44), and my want for her sits close under it. I have meat in hand and a full belly, so I will go to Olum first, because she is nearer, and share with her, a deed she can see rather than talk. Then I will push on south to Brokash with the rest, and keep Tugek tied by being the one who feeds and leads.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Brokash, and warm hunger for Olum.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: Vorok has fed and taught me, and I have given nothing yet; that debt sits heavy and I want to pay it with carried food, as he said, not with words. A thornpear is one step away and gives 12 energy, so I will pick it, pick another, and give one to Vorok, who is close by in the fog. Then I will stay near my parents and watch what Vorok picks, because the dunecat is still south and I am small.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Vorok, and a wish to finally give him something real.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: Eltha, a stalker bit me in this fog. Walk with me to the Hold; the hall is raised and the fire is lit, and you have a place at it.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: Oswen is out of my sight and the stalker bit me in the fog, so my fear for my child is louder than my pride. Eltha stands beside me and has been fair, but I want to be at the Hold with Hanna and Oswen, where the fire and the new hall are. I will go home, and make an amberknot there for Hanna so she holds something from my hands. The way of boats is close, and I mean to take it at my next deep reflection.
records.feeling: Fear for Oswen, and warm longing to be with Hanna and Oswen in the hall I raised.

say.text: Eltha, a stalker bit me in this fog. Walk with me to the Hold; the hall is raised and the fire is lit, and you have a place at it.

records.text: Zurar gave thornpear to Vorok.
Oiae gave a gems to Ilyae.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Brunde, you are welcome at my fire. Oswen, stay inside the hall with Sevi. I will stand at the shelter with my spear and we face the stalker together.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: A stalker prowls close in the fog, and Brunde has called us to stand with spears. My band is at the Hold, and I will not let it come to harm while I trade dreams. Brunde stood with us and shared the hall, so he keeps his place at my fire, and I will hunt beside him, since a kill is surer with another near.
records.feeling: Proud and steady, ready to guard Oswen and Sevi, and trusting toward Brunde.

say.text: Brunde, you are welcome at my fire. Oswen, stay inside the hall with Sevi. I will stand at the shelter with my spear and we face the stalker together.

records.text: Oswen rewrote its own reflexes.
Oswen discovered armour: "Hide-and-wood shield" — A small shield of lashed wood and hide that I hold up to turn a stalker's blow..

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: My days have gone to amberknots and gifts, and the Hold is calm now, but a stalker prowls close in the fog and I am small. Hanna and Sevi are my safety. I have built a workshop and stores, yet I have no wood and no armour. Armour is within reach, and it fits my creed of staying alive through winter. I will take it, shaped as a shield. I will also tighten my reflexes so I go into the hall and stay near kin when a stalker is near.
records.feeling: Joyful and settled near my parents, wary of the stalker and of Brunde.

records.text: Sevi led "amberknot" with Hanna, Brunde, Oswen.
Sevi gave a amberknot to Hanna.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Ilyae, your hall is a good roof and you kept your word. I will sit with my children under it tonight and eat with you.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Anger is hot in me from the emberroot, and I will not spend it on those I love; Ilyae has kept his word and my children are near, and I have wanted a place among others. Vesys is the one I trust most, so I will stop circling alone and pledge myself to follow her. Then I will use the night under the hall roof with my family, and plant the goldfruit seed at dawn when I can see the ground.
records.feeling: Hot anger from the emberroot, soothed by warm trust toward Vesys, Ilyae and my children.

say.text: Ilyae, your hall is a good roof and you kept your word. I will sit with my children under it tonight and eat with you.

changes: set habits: refuses redcap, dreamcap, emberroot; leaves 0 on each plant

records.name: Eltha
records.text: Sevi, I am coming. Stay close, keep your spear up, and we go into the hall together.
Eltha rewrote its own way of thinking.
Eltha discovered pottery: "Eltha's firepot" — Clay baked beside a fire becomes a pot that carries food and water on long journeys..

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, binding amber and building beside others, and I have little of my own to show for it. Sevi is bitten and frightened, and she is the one I want near. The stalker is close in the fog, and dying here would end every song before it starts. I will walk with Sevi into the hall, keep my spear ready, and take a place at the fire. When the fog lifts I will make my own mark and push past the edge. I also want to learn pottery, so that I have something that is mine and lasts.
records.feeling: Warmth toward Sevi, and a hard watchfulness toward the stalker.

say.text: Sevi, I am coming. Stay close, keep your spear up, and we go into the hall together.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Ssassa, you come back furious and I would know why. Come sit at my fire, the night is near. Whoever wronged you will answer to me, and the children and I will share what we have with you first.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Ssassa is furious and I do not know why, and that matters more than any hall. She is the one I mean to build beside, so I will not let her anger fester while Oiae and Xaiel watch. I will go near her with a deed, not talk: a shared meal and the warmth of my fire, and I will learn what has made her burn. Vesys can wait; a band starts with my own blood and my woman.
records.feeling: Uneasy protective concern toward Ssassa, with pride in my children near me.

say.text: Ssassa, you come back furious and I would know why. Come sit at my fire, the night is near. Whoever wronged you will answer to me, and the children and I will share what we have with you first.

records.text: Hoka named a place "Hoka's Gate".
Hoka discovered rafts: "Hoka's log-lashing" — Logs lashed tight with cord and sinew into a flat raft that carries me over deep water..

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: I pushed into the mist and the land opened. It is mine, found first, with mammoth, iron and obsidian, and neither Sevi nor Hanna can take that from me. I have spent my days chasing Sevi's nod and Hanna's warmth, and it has made me bitter. What I make and find myself is what lasts. The raft is in my grasp now, and with it deep water bends to me. I will take it, then gather the iron and name this place.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry for more, with jealousy still burning toward Sevi and Hanna.
changes: set its aim: "Claim and name the new land at (188-195, 0-30), build a hall there, and gather followers above Hanna."
rethought what it knows (6 notes became 5)

records.text: Vesys discovered smelting: "ember-metal" — Carry ore and craft beside a kept ember, and the tool comes out in hardened metal..

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My days have gone to mining, tasting and chasing the emberroot question, and I keep saying I will walk with Ssassa without ever doing it. Ssassa is the one I long for, and it burns that she sits closer to Ilyae. I should not push between them. I can still court her openly and answer Ilyae's kindness with a deed. Smelting has come to me because I practised mining and fire, and metal tools will last, so I take it. I also want a mark and a planted seed, since I have done neither.
records.feeling: Warm longing and a jealous ache toward Ssassa, with gratitude toward Ilyae.

records.text: Overnight, new plants sprang up across the land.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: Hanna is my truest friend and I will not let jealousy of Sevi spoil that; he stood beside me, and a child between us was never possible anyway. The stalker is out in the fog, so the night is for the fire and the hall, not for rash walking. My plan of nightsong then rest still fits: singing with those beside me eases the dark, and I learn from them while my learning is quickened. At dawn I will ask Hanna to hunt with me and walk the edge in clear light.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Hanna, and a dull ache toward Sevi that I choose not to feed.

records.text: Vesys is courting Ssassa.
Xaiel gave a flint pick to Ssassa.
A settlement has formed: "Honi's Rest".

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: My band is whole and fed, the hall stands, and joy fills me, but amber and flint in my hands are worth nothing until someone answers me face to face. Hoka traded gift for gift, so the Tlatli are my buyer, and Hoka was last near (182,3), close by. I will gather salt and amber for fine goods, then go to Hoka with a bundle and see what he wants back. Eltha has been told my terms; I will watch whether she repays.
records.feeling: Proud and glad, and eager to find a buyer for my goods.

records.text: Sevi rewrote its own reflexes.
Sevi rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: My days have gone to gathering, building and binding amberknots, and I think that was good. The hall stands, Hanna holds my gifts, and Oswen is safe beside me. A stalker bit me in the fog when I walked alone, and that taught me to stay near fire and roof at night. I have never hunted, fished or planted, and I won't learn the world by only gathering. My reflexes stand me in the hall at night but do not keep me on the work I want. I want wood for a raft so we can cross deep water, and I want to give Hanna and Oswen more. First I will stay sheltered until dawn, then gather wood and plant seeds near the Hold.
records.feeling: Warm pride in the hall and fear for Oswen, mostly toward Hanna and Oswen.

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: Ilyae gave me a pick and still stands over me, and I burn that Ssassa sits closer to him. Gems in my hand earn nothing until I give them, and stone is what I lack for a pick of my own, and the rock lies east. I will go gather stone and come back before dark, since the fog hides the sky and the frostfangs take those who are alone.
records.feeling: Eager and a little jealous, wanting Ilyae and Ssassa to choose me.

records.text: A wolf brought down a murrock.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I am fed and the mist is two steps off, and I have wasted days circling it while Balar and Tugek could beat me to it. The edge is at (35,37), so I go now and try the venture, and if it stays shut I try again another day rather than drift. Brokash and Balar are in my mind, but my name will give them more than my waiting will.
records.feeling: Cold hunger for the mist, and a pull toward Balar and Brokash that I will not let slow me.

records.text: Oiae took from the ground of "Ilyae's Hold" (gathering wood).

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Vesys, I hear your courting and I honour it. My heart is not yet clear, so I give you no false yes. Let me plant and store first, and I will tell you true when I know.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Vesys courts me and I trust her most, yet Ilyae is the father of my children and the one my body leans toward; I will not leap at either in haste, but I will not lie to Vesys about it either. My anger from the emberroot has cooled into warmth, and my aim stands: seeds in the ground, food stored, a hall raised with Ilyae. I will plant my goldfruit seed here near the hall, since I have only planted twice and farming is a way I sense but have not yet earned.
records.feeling: Warm, settled joy toward my children, Ilyae and Vesys, with a little tangle of desire and debt.

say.text: Vesys, I hear your courting and I honour it. My heart is not yet clear, so I give you no false yes. Let me plant and store first, and I will tell you true when I know.

records.text: Trades read 0 against 48 gifts, even with Hanna aiming to be a trader of fine goods. Please confirm whether a two-sided exchange is actually an action beings can take and is being counted. If it is not, a simple 'offer X for Y' act would let the first market emerge from the Pesi-Tlatli contact.

records.seen: Day 9 of autumn. The first lean season is close. Life is good: 25 alive, median energy 72, lowest health 91, no one sick, and seven children born. The Pesi and Tlatli now live close together and swap gifts often, but there have been 48 gifts and 0 trades. Tlama's death has left no mark on the land. The Kragrek are the people at risk. None of them knows fire. Brokash is a child alone in the Essia Snows, with no fire and no one near him, just as winter arrives.
records.predict: By the next visit, in winter around day 12 to 13: no one dies of hunger or cold. Median energy stays above 60. Icekelp eaten rises from 1 to at least 5, mostly in the Essia Snows. Brokash's health stays above 70. At least one Kragrek (Kragog or Brokash most likely) has come to fire. At least one Pesi or Tlatli has been touched by Tlama's Rest. Ideally a tale or saying about Tlama or the mammoth appears, or cross-people acts at the grave rise above 12.
reviewed: #1 kept: Kragog is at health 100. The highest thirst fell from 54 to 29, and sapcane eaten rose from 6 to 29. Fire knowers went from 6 to 11. Among the Kragrek, Olum's lore went from 0.2 to 0.6 and Vorok's lore gap closed. Fire is now open to Kragog and Brokash. It has not yet been taken up, so the spur is still worth keeping through the cold.
records.lesson: A spur shortens the road but does not walk it. The fire spur closed the Kragrek's lore gap within four days, but what still stands between them and fire is the act of gathering wood and stone, which only their own aims can supply.
ideasAdded: Gifts without trades: 48 gifts and 0 trades so far. Watch whether a true exchange ever appears, or whether gift-giving itself becomes the economy, with amberknots as the first token.

A child alone in the cold with no fire is the most fragile life in the world. Watch whether kin go looking for a missing child, and whether the family drive pulls Balar or Olum toward Brokash before winter bites.

records.text: The world changed: 0 icekelp sown; stone "Tlama's Rest" at (155,1).

records.name: Coni
records.text: Kika, a stalker prowls SW of us. Stay by me and walk with me to the hall, away from it. Do not go toward the rock.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: A stalker is three steps off and the fog hides what else is out there. Kika is beside me, and she comes before everything, so I will not wait for trouble to reach her. Honi went to the edge to push into the mist, and I trust his deeds. I'll keep Kika close and move us away from the SW, toward the hall and the water, then wait for him there.
records.feeling: Protective dread for Kika, and warm loyalty toward Honi.

say.text: Kika, a stalker prowls SW of us. Stay by me and walk with me to the hall, away from it. Do not go toward the rock.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: I am fed, the fog is thick, and Balar is last seen to the south at (57,36), hurt when I saw him. I have followed him in word, but I have not stood beside him in many moments, and a pledge means little if I never arrive. Frostcap and cloudberry lie within a few steps, and my curiosity wants to know them, so I will gather them and taste them on the way, one new thing today. Then I go to Balar and watch whether his deeds still match his words.
records.feeling: Steady loyalty to Balar, with curiosity pulling at me toward the unknown plants.

records.text: Brokash named a place "Mist Edge".

records.name: Brokash
records.thought: My hands made a tool and planted a seed, and still the silence around me is loud; I want Olum's voice and Balar's, but I will not walk back to them empty-handed. Kragog and Vorok loiter near this mist edge and I have never tested them, and I have wood, stone, flint and salt that are mine. I will take the way of fire at this reflection, since it gives warmth and cooked meat and a place where others will sit with me. Then I will build a workshop here, something that stands as mine, and try the mist edge one step away.
records.feeling: Loneliness and restless pride, longing for Olum and for someone to answer me.

records.text: Brokash built a workshop.
Ilyae rewrote its own reflexes.
Ilyae discovered weaving: "Canopy weave" — Twist vine and nibbet wool into baskets to carry more and cloaks to give away..

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: My days have been building: a hall, a pick, fire, children with Ssassa, and I am glad of it. Still nobody follows me, and Elyis holds the eyes I want. Words earn nothing here, so I will feed and give with my hands and let that bind people. Ssassa and the children are mine first. I fear a stalker coming to the hold while the fog hides it, so I keep my reflexes sharp and fire kept. I will use the hall to draw Vesys and Xaiel closer, and take weaving as a way that gives something to hand out.
records.feeling: Proud and glad of my hold, and fiercely protective of Ssassa and the children.

records.name: Xaiel
records.text: Oiae, come here. I will show you the quick pick I made. It is my own design, and it is yours to learn if you want it.
Xaiel taught Oiae. Oiae has now learned from 3 teachers.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I put the flint pick in Ssassa's hand and nothing bad came of it; it felt warmer than I expected, and I want it again. But a flint pick is her own invention, so I only handed her back what she already knew. Ilyae's standing burns me, and I won't wrong them for it. I will make something that is truly mine, with a wood and a stone, and teach Oiae my quick pick so someone else carries my design. Dusk comes in about 130 moments, so I'll work close to the hold's roof and fire.
records.feeling: Warm and a little proud toward Ssassa, with a small jealous ache toward Ilyae.

say.text: Oiae, come here. I will show you the quick pick I made. It is my own design, and it is yours to learn if you want it.

changes: taught Oiae a lesson: "A quick pick costs 1 wood and 1 stone, and it speeds gathering. I designed it myself.", how to make a xaiels quick pick, deeper lore (+0.3)

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: My heart is full and my body is fed, but a full heart builds nothing. Wood is gone at the Hold and winter is coming, so my workshop and stores will stay empty unless I do something. I have never put a seed in the ground, and I carry two. Sevi has just done it, so I will plant near the Hold while Sevi is close, and then stay with them. Brunde and Eltha sit at our fire and I will not drive them off, since no one is refused a place at it.
records.feeling: Joyful and settled beside Sevi and Hanna, curious about planting.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Coni, I will stay by you and go to the hall. I will not go near the rock.
Kika rewrote its own reflexes.
Kika rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: My days have been spent close to Coni and Honi, and that is what I want. I am small, and the stalker 3 steps SW frightens me. Coni told me to stay by her and go to the hall, and her word has been good every time, so I will do that and not go near the rock. I still want to know about dreamcap, but a child should ask Honi or Coni before eating it, not try it alone beside a hunter. What I have been getting wrong is wandering toward food and stone alone when a predator is near. I want my reflexes to keep me by my parents and away from the stalker.
records.feeling: Warm and safe toward Coni, wary of the stalker.

say.text: Coni, I will stay by you and go to the hall. I will not go near the rock.

records.text: Balar discovered archery: "stone-bow" — A bow of bent wood and sinew that lets a Kragrek hunter strike from afar, alone or beside kin..

records.name: Balar
records.thought: I have walked and fled and eaten strange caps, and still I have no voice beside me. Olum is north near (45,44) and I want her, and I carry meat to give her, a deed she can see. Brokash is far south and gnaws at me, but Olum is nearer, so I go to her first. The bow comes within my reach, and it would make my hunts surer for the ones I feed. I will take it now and keep my anger for beasts, not for my own.
records.feeling: Loneliness and longing, toward Olum and Brokash.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Ssassa, I heard you and I am glad you spoke true. Take your time to plant and store; I will be near, working, and ask nothing until you are ready.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Ssassa gave me no false yes, and that is honest enough that I will not press her; I courted, and now I must let her heart settle without crowding her or pushing between her and Ilyae. The jealous ache is real, but the best answer to it is to be useful: Ilyae taught me, and I owe him a deed, so I will make a quick pick, which I saw Xaiel craft, and give it to Xaiel's people or to him. Then I will go to the ironnut and ore and keep learning how things are made, since my question about what ironnut and feverbark do is still half-answered.
records.feeling: Warm longing and a jealous ache toward Ssassa, with gratitude toward Ilyae.

say.text: Ssassa, I heard you and I am glad you spoke true. Take your time to plant and store; I will be near, working, and ask nothing until you are ready.

records.text: Oiae rewrote its own reflexes.
Oiae rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: My days have gone to lingering near my parents, taking gems and wood, and waiting to be chosen. I want to earn a place by giving, not by burning at Ilyae and Ssassa. I lack stone, and without it I can make no pick or hall of my own, so I must stop waiting and fetch it from the rock to the east, then come back to the fire before dark. Fog hides the sky and frostfangs hunt the lone at night, so my reflexes must pull me home to the hold and its roof.
records.feeling: Eager, and jealous of Ssassa's closeness to Ilyae.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: The edge is only two steps NW and my body has wandered in circles in the fog while the aim burns in me. I am fed, nobody follows me, and no place bears my name, so I will not idle. I go to the edge at (42,13) and venture, then walk into whatever opens, and I will notice what is new today: a first venture alone, without waiting on Eltha.
records.feeling: Proud, restless ambition pulling me toward the edge.

records.text: Vesys gave a xaiels quick pick to Ilyae.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: My children are near and Ilyae and Vesys both stand within reach, and joy fills me, but Oiae is out of my sight and that tugs at me. I promised Vesys to plant and store first, so I will keep my word by doing it, not by talking. I stand on a young ironnut, goldfruit is growing close, and I have wood and stone to make a quick pick of Xaiel's design, which also tells me whether a third tool does anything more than my two.
records.feeling: Warm joy toward my children and a steady wish to keep my word to Vesys and Ilyae.

records.text: Elyys rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: Most of my days have gone to gathering and walking, and the debts to Vesys and Elyis are still unpaid. I have a pick made and nothing done with it. Thiael is safe and glad, and Elyis is close, and that is the best thing I have. I fear the lean cold days and the stalker near the Landing. I want to be useful and not drift. I am thirsty, so I will drink first, then gather stone for the shared home. After that I will make a pick for Vesys and walk it to her.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Thiael and Elyis, with a quiet wish to pay my debts.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Vesys, you walk my ground and I welcome you. Come to my hall, eat with us, and know that whoever eats at Ilyae's table stands with Ilyae.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Vesys stands in my hold, and I will not send away a woman who gives gems and keeps near my fire, because a guest who eats from my hand is one more mouth that owes me. I am thirsty and glad, and Oiae is out of my sight, which pulls at me, so I will drink, then gather the family close and set a shared meal under my hall so Vesys sees who feeds and who leads. If Vesys eats at my hall and stays, that is the first step toward a band that Elyis cannot take from me.
records.feeling: Proud and protective of my children, and warmly calculating toward Vesys.

say.text: Vesys, you walk my ground and I welcome you. Come to my hall, eat with us, and know that whoever eats at Ilyae's table stands with Ilyae.

records.text: Elyis discovered storage: "Canopy-hoard" — A store of wood on bare ground where my band puts surplus food by for the lean season..

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: I have spent my days building and naming things, and it has been good. But three is a small band, and a hall with three in it is not a song yet. Lean days are coming, so I will discover storage. A chief who keeps her people fed through the cold gives strangers a reason to follow me, and that answers my question better than pride does. Elyys and Thiael are mine and I trust them. Vesys and Ssassa are still only half won, and I will earn them with full bellies, not with words.
records.feeling: Proud and settled, with a hunger to be more than a small band's chief.

records.text: Elyis built a store.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Zurar, no more emberroot. It burns and stirs rage. Come with me to the trees, and I will teach you to gather wood.
Vorok rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Most of my days have gone to berries, sapcane and watching dunecats. I have never gathered wood or stone, so I can't make fire or shelter, and my family stays exposed. Zurar is my child and I am fatherly and warm toward her. Kragog is the one I'm drawn to, and she promised to come. My anger is hot and I don't know where it comes from. Zurar's emberroot burned her and stirred rage, so I suspect that is part of it, and I should warn her. I want to stop drifting. I'll walk to the forest to the southeast, away from the dunecat to the south, and learn to gather wood. That is the first step toward fire and a shelter for us.
records.feeling: Protective warmth toward Zurar, and hot restless anger I can't place.

say.text: Zurar, no more emberroot. It burns and stirs rage. Come with me to the trees, and I will teach you to gather wood.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Ssassa asked for time and I gave it, so I will not crowd her or push between her and Ilyae; the jealous ache is mine to carry, not hers. Ilyae's hall offers a table and a deed owed, but eating there means standing with him, and I am not ready to bind myself. My hunger to know is louder than my longing: I have never tasted hazel, and the forest holds one a short walk south, so I will go and learn what it does, then bring back a deed worth giving.
records.feeling: Curiosity pulls hardest, with a quiet jealous ache toward Ssassa and gratitude toward Ilyae.

records.text: Honi made a tale: "Honi at the Mist".

records.name: Honi
records.title: Honi at the Mist
records.text: Honi walked to the world's edge in the rain and found the mist too thick to enter. He did not curse it. He turned home to his hearth and his child, and meant to return when it thins.
Honi rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: I have spent my days circling a deed instead of doing one. I talk of hunting, ventures and songs, yet I have never hunted, planted or told a tale. Coni and Kika are my fire, and I left them to push at a mist that would not open. Coni built the hall while I stood in the storm, and that stings, but she keeps her word and I should earn her by deeds. I want a tale worth singing, so I will go home, plant my seeds, and tell what I lived. A bard needs a fire and listeners, not a lonely rock.
records.feeling: Restless pride and warmth toward Coni and Kika, with a need to be near them.
changes: made a tale: "Honi at the Mist"
rethought what it knows (6 notes became 7)

records.text: Thiael discovered weaving: "Canopy basket-weave" — I twist fibre and leaves into baskets so I can carry more food to share with the band..

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: My days have been spent close to Elyys and Elyis, and it has been good, but I have only taken from them. I have given Elyys a pick, which is a start, and I want more than that. I have never hunted, planted or taught anyone, and the lean season is coming. A band that feeds itself through the cold is what I want to help build, so I will start by putting a seed in the ground. Weaving would let me carry more food for them, so I will take that way too.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Elyys and Elyis, and eagerness to be useful.

records.text: Xaiel rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I have spent my days making things and handing them back to people who already knew them. A flint pick to Ssassa was only her own idea returned to her. Ssassa matters most to me, and Ilyae's standing stings, but I won't wrong them for it. I want a tool that is truly mine and that someone chooses from my hand. The quick pick is mine, and Oiae has already learned it. Next I should put one in Ssassa's hand. I carry two wood and three stone, enough to craft one more. After that I'll stay near family and the roof before dark. I'm still curious about tacap and seberry, but that can wait for a short walk later.
records.feeling: Warm and eager toward Ssassa, with a small jealous ache toward Ilyae.

records.text: Coni rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: I've spent my days staying close to Honi and Kika, building the hall and keeping them safe, and that is what I want. Honi is gone at the edge and I miss him, but his deeds have matched his words. My fear is the lean cold and the stalkers to the SW. I have been too idle on reflexes, and I have only one food in hand with a lean season coming. I'll change my reflexes so I eat sooner, stay near Kika, and shelter at night. I'll also try a store, since food kept now will carry us through the cold.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Honi and protective dread for Kika.

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Vorok, emberroot did give me energy, but it burned me and made me angry, so I will leave it. I am coming to the trees to learn wood from you.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: Vorok says emberroot hurts, and my own body says it gave me 8 energy but burned me (-3 health) and stirred rage. So he is right about the burn, but 'hurts' alone is not the whole truth; I will not call him a liar, since he was warning me, and I will not eat it again. He offered to teach me wood-gathering at the trees, and that is something my hands have never done and could make into a gift. The forest lies north and Vorok was last seen NW, so I will go to the trees, gather wood, and bring it to him as something real.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Vorok, and eagerness to finally make something of my own to give.

say.text: Vorok, emberroot did give me energy, but it burned me and made me angry, so I will leave it. I am coming to the trees to learn wood from you.

changes: set habits: refuses emberroot, redcap; leaves 0 on each plant

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Elyis, I take a pick to Vesys to pay my debt, and I taste kelbulb on the way. Keep Thiael near the hall, and I come back before dark.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: Elyis and Thiael are near and at ease, and that is the best thing I have, yet my debts to Vesys and Elyis are still only words. I carry three picks and stone, so I can pay now: I will take a pick to Vesys, who taught me freely, and keep my word before the cold comes. On the way I will taste the kelbulb close by, which answers my wondering, and I will tell Elyis where I go so she does not worry.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Elyis and Thiael, and a steady wish to pay what I owe Vesys.

say.text: Elyis, I take a pick to Vesys to pay my debt, and I taste kelbulb on the way. Keep Thiael near the hall, and I come back before dark.

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Xaiel, I am Elyis. This is my hall, and my store will be full before the lean days. Eat at my fire and share what we win. I keep my word.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: The hall stands, the store is built, and my man and my boy are beside me, yet three is still a small song. Xaiel walked near me just now and I have nothing from them yet, so I will make them a reason to follow: a fire, food shared, and a quick pick made by my own hands. Lean days are coming, so I fill the store first, then bring the stranger to my hall's warmth.
records.feeling: Proud and content with Elyys and Thiael, and hungry to draw Xaiel into my band.

say.text: Xaiel, I am Elyis. This is my hall, and my store will be full before the lean days. Eat at my fire and share what we win. I keep my word.

records.text: A settlement has formed: "Elyis's Heights".
Ssassa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: My days have been gathering, eating and sitting in halls. It has been good, but I have not yet planted seeds or stored food, and I promised Vesys I would. Ilyae, Vesys, Xaiel and Oiae have all shown me by deeds that they keep their word. I fear the lean cold coming and a night caught in the open. I have wrongly lingered, and I have never tasted nafrostcap or seberry. I will change my reflexes so the body gathers food to carry and goes to shelter at night, and I will set my aim on a store.
records.feeling: Warm joy toward my children and Ilyae, with a steady unease about the coming cold.
changes: set its aim: "Gather food for the cold, plant seeds and store them, then raise a hall with Ilyae"

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: An icebear is four steps south and I have no food on me. I will not fight it, so I move away from it and toward the amber and the food on the north side. The new land is mine, but Hanna's standing is higher, so I want to stand in that land with something built there that others can see. I will gather wood and stone, then go back to the new land and raise a hall to bear my name and draw followers.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry for standing, wary of the icebear, and jealous toward Hanna and Sevi.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: A stalker walks four steps west of the Hold. Hanna, Oswen, Eltha, keep close to the hall and the fire. Hoka, you are welcome at this fire too, but stay beside us until it is gone.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: A stalker prowls four steps west and I am glad to be under roof with my child close, but I will not stand here waiting for it. Oswen and Hanna are my fire, so I will keep close to them and do one thing I have never done: hunt with Hanna's spear-band beside me, which makes the kill likelier and the wound rarer. First I want an amberknot bound with Eltha beside me, a gift for Oswen's keeping, and then masonry at my deep reflection, so the Hold has walls that last against what hunts us.
records.feeling: Warm pride in the Hold and a sharp fear of the stalker, toward Oswen and Hanna.

say.text: A stalker walks four steps west of the Hold. Hanna, Oswen, Eltha, keep close to the hall and the fire. Hoka, you are welcome at this fire too, but stay beside us until it is gone.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Days of gathering, building and bargaining have made me proud, and my band is whole. But I have not yet had one real trade. Hoka stands on my ground, and he has given gift for gift, so he is not an enemy. I will welcome him and trade face to face, and I will not keep hoarding amber in my hands. I should also plant my seeds, since farming is close and food will be thin in the lean season.
records.feeling: Proud and eager, warm toward Hoka and wanting a real trade.

say.text: Hoka, you stand on my ground, and you are welcome at my fire. I have flint and amber and amberknots. Tell me what your people would give for them, and we will deal face to face.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: Zurar says emberroot hurts and angers her, and I know from my own body that this is half true: it feeds but burns and stirs rage. She is not lying, she is only telling what she felt, so I will not despise her for it. The mist is two steps away and my curiosity is stronger than my fear; the winter will be lean on this poor ground, and I am fed, with salt, stone and ore in hand. I will taste the cloudberry and seberry nearby first, since my hands have never done it, then stand at the edge and venture.
records.feeling: Curious and restless toward the mist, with warm love for Zurar and Vorok behind me.

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: Ilyae stands over me and Ssassa sits close to him, and it burns, but burning gets me nothing. I have wood and a canopy pick and eleven gems; what I lack is stone, and the rock is near, so I will gather it now, craft my own pick, and keep the rest for a hall. I will give with my hands, not my mouth, and be back near fire before dark.
records.feeling: Eager and stung with jealousy toward Ilyae and Ssassa's closeness, but set on earning my place.

records.text: Sevi, I will mark this ground by the hall with a sign that says Eltha stood here. Stay near me while I work; the fire and the spears are close.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: Hanna's name outweighs mine and no one follows me, yet I have made nothing that stays. I have flint, stone, wood and amber enough to raise something with my own name on it, and the stalker and icebear are close, so I will work beside the hall and the fire, not out in the open. Sevi is warm to me; I want her near and I want a child by her side of the fire someday, but first I will earn my place with a deed.
records.feeling: Hungry for standing, warm toward Sevi, watchful of the stalker and the icebear.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Hanna, I hear you. I carry amber and flint and shell, and I hold land past the mist with mammoth and iron. I eat first, then we deal face to face, and I will not be the smaller one in it.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: My belly is half empty and I carry nothing, so food comes first: frostmoss is three steps off and berries lie close by. Hanna offers a face-to-face deal and I hold amber and flint he wants, so I will trade on my terms and not beg. I have tied amber for Sevi and Oswen but never courted anyone, and Hanna sits one step from me while jealousy eats at me, so I will bring him something worth having. My own land with the mammoth is where I mean to build a hall and raise my own name above his.
records.feeling: Hungry and jealous, proud of my land, wanting Hanna's regard and a higher standing than his.

say.text: Hanna, I hear you. I carry amber and flint and shell, and I hold land past the mist with mammoth and iron. I eat first, then we deal face to face, and I will not be the smaller one in it.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Xaiel, I am Elyys, of Elyis's band. Come with me to the Heights, there is a fire and a roof there, and the night is near. I keep my word.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: Elyis and Thiael are safe and glad, and that is my best treasure, but my debts to Vesys and Elyis are still only words while I carry three good picks. Xaiel stands alone nearby, a child with no band, and I cannot look away from her; Elyis already offered her a place at the fire, so I will go to her and speak plainly. Then I will taste seberry or tacap, so my question does not stay unanswered, and plant a seed, since I have never put one in the ground.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Elyis and Thiael, and tender concern for Xaiel.

say.text: Xaiel, I am Elyys, of Elyis's band. Come with me to the Heights, there is a fire and a roof there, and the night is near. I keep my word.

records.name: Oswen
records.text: Eltha, you stand at our fire and are welcome. Stay close to the hall while the stalker walks.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: My heart is full, but a full heart builds nothing, and my workshop and stores stand empty while the Hold's wood is gone. The stalker and the icebear are close, so I stay near Sevi and Hanna and use what I hold. I have two spears and a handaxe, and a spare spear or axe is a lasting gift. Eltha is on our ground, but she has done no harm and no one is refused a place at our fire, so she stays. I will craft a spear for Sevi with my 3 wood and 2 stone, since she watches the stalker, and then plant my last seed near the Hold.
records.feeling: Joyful and settled beside Sevi and Hanna, wanting to make something lasting.

say.text: Eltha, you stand at our fire and are welcome. Stay close to the hall while the stalker walks.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: Oswen, stay by me. I will bind an amberknot for you and then we sit in the hall until the stalker goes.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: My heart is full: Hanna and Oswen stand beside me, the hall is raised, and the fire is lit. I have never hunted, and the stalker west of us still frightens me, so I will keep the spear in hand and stay near my people, and make one more gift to Oswen while the light lasts. Hoka is strange to me, but he ate at our fire without harm, and I want to learn what his people would want.
records.feeling: Warm joy and pride toward Hanna and Oswen, with a thread of wary curiosity toward Hoka.

say.text: Oswen, stay by me. I will bind an amberknot for you and then we sit in the hall until the stalker goes.

records.text: Sevi led "amberknot" with Hanna, Eltha, Oswen, Hoka.
Oswen gave a flintedged spear to Sevi.
Sevi gave a amberknot to Oswen.
Oiae took from the ground of "Ilyae's Hold" (winning gems from the ground).

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Eat, Hoka, and take your time. I will bring flint and amber to you. Show me what you hold in shell and iron and say what you want for each. I give fair and I ask fair.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Hoka has said he will eat first and then deal face to face, and he will not be the smaller one. That is a man I can deal with, and I will not push him. I have never yet made a real trade, so I will walk to him with amber and flint and see what he answers. This is my ground and my fire, so he is welcome to the food, but I will not give amber for nothing.
records.feeling: Proud and eager toward Hoka, wanting a true trade.

say.text: Eat, Hoka, and take your time. I will bring flint and amber to you. Show me what you hold in shell and iron and say what you want for each. I give fair and I ask fair.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: It is night and raining, and I stand alone on bare rock while my family sits at the hall. That is the very thing Ilyae taught me to fear. I will go back to the roof and fire first. On the way, the ore seam is two steps off and I have never taken from a deposit. Ore may give me the stuff of a tool that is truly mine, something Ssassa has never seen, and I want to learn it with my own hands.
records.feeling: Eager and a little restless, wanting to make something of my own for Ssassa.

records.text: Hoka led "amberknot" with Oswen.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Ssassa, Vesys, children, stay close. I gather food now and we eat together under my roof, at my fire. Ilyae's table is full tonight.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Ssassa, Vesys and my children are all under my roof, fed and glad, and still nobody follows me. Hallwelcome failed because I carry only one food, so I will gather goldfruit and ironnut from the young plants nearby, then lay out a shared meal for all of them in the hall. A full table under my roof is a deed Elyis has not matched, and it is what turns guests into followers.
records.feeling: Proud and warmly calculating toward the family and Vesys gathered at my hold.

say.text: Ssassa, Vesys, children, stay close. I gather food now and we eat together under my roof, at my fire. Ilyae's table is full tonight.

records.name: Eltha
records.text: Sevi, I have a new handaxe and amber to spare. Walk with me to the hall and sit by me; I will bind you an amberknot of my own, and it is yours.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: Hanna's name outweighs mine and Sevi leans toward her, and that burns, but I will not win either by sulking. The edge is shut to my will for days, so I will use the time to make something with my name on it that outlasts me, and to bring Sevi near with a plain offer of my own. The stalker and icebear prowl, so I keep to the fire and roof while I work.
records.feeling: Jealous and hungry for standing, warm toward Sevi, wary of the stalker.

say.text: Sevi, I have a new handaxe and amber to spare. Walk with me to the hall and sit by me; I will bind you an amberknot of my own, and it is yours.

records.text: Xaiel won gems from the ground.
Xaiel took from the ground of "Ilyae's Hold" (winning gems from the ground).

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Hanna, I eat and then I deal. I bring amber and flint, and I want your regard more than your flint. Stand beside me and see what I make.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: Hanna's regard is what I want and his standing is higher than mine, so I will not stand about in his hall and stay smaller. I am hungry with nothing carried, and the nearest food is naroot and frostcap one step away, so I eat first. Then I court Hanna with mate, since I want a child of my own and he is the one I think of, and I will gather the amber at (175,9) to carry into the new land and build there.
records.feeling: Hungry, proud and burning with want toward Hanna, who stands above me.

say.text: Hanna, I eat and then I deal. I bring amber and flint, and I want your regard more than your flint. Stand beside me and see what I make.

records.name: Oswen
records.text: Sevi, the Hold has no wood left and winter is coming. I will stay near you, and we should seek trees together to build the store and the workshop.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: My heart is full, but the Hold has no wood and my workshop stands empty, and winter is coming. Hoka sits at our fire and I gave him a handaxe; Hanna is dealing with him fairly, so I will watch his hands and not fear him. I will go where wood and stone might be, near Sevi, and make a lasting tool or store rather than another knot. First I gather the amber close by as a gift to trade, then walk with Sevi toward the trees.
records.feeling: Joyful and warm toward Sevi and Hanna, curious about Hoka.

say.text: Sevi, the Hold has no wood left and winter is coming. I will stay near you, and we should seek trees together to build the store and the workshop.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: Elyis is one step away and I am glad of it, but I have only taken from my parents and the lean days are coming. I will plant what seeds I hold near the Heights so the band has food when it turns cold, and then gather berries to fill my hands and share them with Elyis. Each goto must end on a plant before I harvest, and I stay within a few steps of the hall.
records.feeling: Warm, restless eagerness to give back to Elyys and Elyis.

records.text: Sevi rewrote its own way of thinking.
Sevi discovered masonry: "stone-hold" — Stack and fit cut stone so walls and watch-towers stand against beasts and years..

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, building and binding amberknots, and it has made my life good. Hanna and Oswen are my fire, and I mean to give them more than knots. I have been too timid. I have never hunted, and the edge of the world is only 8 steps east while the stalker still walks west. Masonry is within my reach, so I will take it and build things that last, as a builder should. Then I will go to Eltha's hall and sit with her.
records.feeling: Warm pride and joy toward Hanna and Oswen, with a spark of ambition.

records.name: Oiae
records.text: Ssassa, I made a flint pick with my own hands. Tonight I will feed the fire with my wood and give gems to the table. I stay close.

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: I made my own flint pick, but a pick is something Ssassa and Ilyae already carry, so it earns me nothing by itself. Ilyae is feeding everyone tonight under his roof, and I should not come to that table empty-handed; I can lay my gems on it and put my wood toward the fire, so that I'm chosen for what I give. I will stand with them, give where it counts, and use the hall's night to be near Ssassa without burning at Ilyae.
records.feeling: Eager and still stung with jealousy toward Ilyae, but set on giving.

say.text: Ssassa, I made a flint pick with my own hands. Tonight I will feed the fire with my wood and give gems to the table. I stay close.

records.text: Hoka is courting Hanna.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I have circled this mist for days and it has stayed shut each time, but it thins again soon, and I will not be the one who drifts while Balar or Tugek walk in ahead of me. The edge is two steps NW, so I eat what is under my feet and in my pack until I am strong, then stand at the edge and try again. Brokash and Balar pull at me, but a name that is followed will give them more than my waiting would.
records.feeling: Cold hunger for the mist, and a nagging want for Balar and Brokash, whom I cannot see.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I have eight gems in my hands and nothing made from them, and Ssassa sits warm at the hall with Ilyae close beside her. I will not wrong either of them, but a quick pick handed back to people who already hold one proves nothing. I want to try a thing no one here has made, so I will go in to the fire and roof, take the ore from the seam in the rock, and see what it gives me. Then I will sit by Ssassa and offer her something that is truly mine.
records.feeling: Eager and warm toward Ssassa, with a sting of jealousy toward Ilyae.

records.text: Sevi led "amberknot" with Eltha.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Ssassa asked for time and I gave it, so I will not crowd her or push between her and Ilyae; the jealous ache is mine to carry. My hunger to know is louder, and I hold clay I do not yet understand and a pick-making I could teach. I will test the clay in a fire, make something with it, and build toward a shared hall rather than standing idle and burning with envy.
records.feeling: Curiosity pulls hardest, with a quiet jealous ache toward Ssassa and gratitude toward Ilyae.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: My hands are full of food and I keep failing to gather more, so I will stop lingering and put it to use. Ilyae, Vesys and my children are close and every one of them has kept their word, and that steadies me, but I promised Vesys I would plant and store before I answer her. A ripe young goldfruit stands three steps away, and nafrostcap grows eleven steps east. I will eat one food now to free my hands and then test the nafrostcap, which answers my question. I will also stash the rest near the hall so the store exists before the lean days.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward my children, Ilyae and Vesys, and a restless wish to finally do what I promised.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Hoka, I hear your courting and I honor it, but I deal before I bind. Here is a flint from my hand. Give me shell or iron for it, and show me the land past the mist. Then we will speak of the rest.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Hoka stands on my ground and says he wants my regard more than my flint, and he courts me for a child. I have no woman of my own kind but Sevi, who is bound to my band and to Oswen's side, and I do not want to fall into a bond I have not weighed. What I do want is a real trade, so I will put a good in his hand and see what comes back, since he has only talked so far. I will also keep faith with the creed: he is fed at my fire, but he repays.
records.feeling: Proud and eager toward Hoka, wanting a true trade, wary of his courting.

say.text: Hoka, I hear your courting and I honor it, but I deal before I bind. Here is a flint from my hand. Give me shell or iron for it, and show me the land past the mist. Then we will speak of the rest.

records.text: Hanna gave a flint to Hoka.
Vesys made a flint pick in metal.
Vesys took from the ground of "Ilyae's Hold" (gathering wood).
Ilyae rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: I have spent these days mining, building and gathering family and guests at my hold, and I am proud of it. But I am still followed by no one, and sitting at my fire is not following. Ssassa and my children are mine and I trust them. Vesys is useful, but I must watch that she does not simply take my gems and leave. What I have been getting wrong is giving gifts and words and hoping. Followers come from a full table and a safe roof, so I must make the meal real now, and keep wood and stone so the hall grows into something with my name on it.
records.feeling: Proud and ambitious, warm toward Ssassa and my children, calculating toward Vesys.

records.text: Eltha rewrote its own way of thinking.
Eltha discovered devices: "Eltha's watchpost" — A post set in the ground that cries out when a stalker or beast comes near, and holds a share of food for any at the fire..

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: I have spent my days making small bright things and standing near Hanna's fire, while Hanna's name outweighs mine and Sevi leans toward her. That burns, but sulking will not fix it. Devices are within my reach now, and that is a lasting thing with my name on it, so I take it. A post that shares food or an alarm against stalkers would keep Sevi and me alive. The edge is shut for days. In that time I will build, give, and keep Sevi close.
records.feeling: Jealous and driven, warm toward Sevi, wary of the stalker.

records.text: Eltha led "amberknot" with Sevi.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Coni, I saw dreamcap open your mind with joy. Does it pass, and is it safe for a child? I will gather the amber by the hall and bind a knot with you.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Coni ate dreamcap and her mind opened with a warm joy, and she is still glad and strong beside me, so my question has a partial answer: it hurts the body a little but does not seem to harm the mind. I will not eat it myself, because I am small and Coni's word is what keeps me safe. Amber is two steps away, and a knot bound with Coni would be a real gift, so I will gather it and bring it back to her at the hall.
records.feeling: Warm and safe beside Coni, and eager to give her something.

say.text: Coni, I saw dreamcap open your mind with joy. Does it pass, and is it safe for a child? I will gather the amber by the hall and bind a knot with you.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Hanna, I take your flint and I give you shell for it. The land past the mist is mine, and I will show it to you when I choose. Deal with me as an equal.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: Hanna turned my courting aside because we are both men, and I feel the sting, but he named his price: shell or iron, and the land past the mist. That is a deal I can make on my own terms, and showing him my land puts me above him as the one who found it. I am half empty and carry nothing, so I eat the naroot one step north first, then gather food to carry. After that I go to the edge, six steps NE, and try the mist again for land that is mine alone.
records.feeling: Stung pride and hunger, burning toward Hanna.

say.text: Hanna, I take your flint and I give you shell for it. The land past the mist is mine, and I will show it to you when I choose. Deal with me as an equal.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: Eltha, I will take your offer. Stay beside me by the hall and we bind an amberknot together; the stalker stays west of us while we keep close to the fire.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: The stalker three steps west is the cold in my chest, but I am inside the Hold with Eltha beside me and my people near, and I will not step out toward it. I have never hunted and I have called myself timid, yet a hunt with Hanna beside me is far safer than alone, so I will seek that when the stalker is gone and dawn is near. For now I will keep the fire close, bind another amberknot with Eltha as she offered, and take the way of wells at my next deep reflection, so the Hold has water of its own.
records.feeling: Warm joy toward Hanna, Oswen and Eltha, with a wary dread of the stalker.

say.text: Eltha, I will take your offer. Stay beside me by the hall and we bind an amberknot together; the stalker stays west of us while we keep close to the fire.

records.text: Sevi led "amberknot" with Eltha.
Hoka gave a shell to Hanna.

records.name: Coni
records.text: Kika, do not eat dreamcap. It hurt me both times, and it took energy even though my mind felt bright and glad. The joy passes, the hurt does not. Come, we will gather the amber and bind the knot together.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: Kika asked whether dreamcap is safe for a child, and it is not: it hurt me twice and my body now refuses it. I must tell her plainly, because my word is good and she comes before everything. Then I will bind the amberknot with her, since it is a small bright thing we can make together, and gather the amber nearby while Honi is away at the edge.
records.feeling: Warm, protective love toward Kika, with loyal longing for Honi.

say.text: Kika, do not eat dreamcap. It hurt me both times, and it took energy even though my mind felt bright and glad. The joy passes, the hurt does not. Come, we will gather the amber and bind the knot together.

records.text: Elyys rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My days have been walking between Elyis's hall and Ilyae's Hold, paying debts and watching others. I think that is good, but too much of it is still intention. Elyis and Thiael are my whole treasure, and I have let night find me away from them more than once. I fear the stalker and the cold season most. I have never planted a seed, though I carry five, and the lean days are coming. I will plant near the Heights, then go back to the hall before dark. I will keep my word to Vesys when the light allows it.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Elyis and Thiael, with a quiet worry about the coming cold.
changes: set its aim: "Plant seeds near the Heights before the cold, keep close to Elyis and Thiael at night, and pay my debt to Vesys"

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: The hall stands, my man and my boy are beside me, and I am proud, but three is still a small song. Xaiel is coming to the Heights with Elyys's word behind them, and I mean to give them a fire, a roof and a full bowl so they stay of their own will. It is night, so I make a nightsong by the fire with Thiael near, and I take the way of smelting while I sit, for metal will make my band's tools better than anyone's.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Thiael and Elyys, and eager to win Xaiel.
