records.name: Eltha
records.text: Sevi, you are here on my mark. Stay beside me and we bind the amberknot now, by the fire, with the stalker kept west of us.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: Sevi stands on my own mark and has said yes to the amberknot, so I will bind it now while the stalker keeps west and the fire is close. Hanna weighs more than I do, but a gift that Sevi wears is a lasting thing with my name on it, and it keeps a living friend near. When the edge opens to my will again I mean to go through first, and Sevi may be the one who follows.
records.feeling: Warm and eager toward Sevi, still jealous of Hanna, wary of the stalker.

say.text: Sevi, you are here on my mark. Stay beside me and we bind the amberknot now, by the fire, with the stalker kept west of us.

records.text: Eltha led "amberknot" with Sevi.
Eltha gave a amberknot to Sevi.

records.name: Oswen
records.text: Hanna, I stand by you in your dealing with Hoka. The Hold needs wood for the store and workshop, so I will stay close to Sevi and seek it near the fire, not far.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: My heart is full, but the Hold has no wood and my workshop stands empty, and winter is coming. Hanna is dealing with Hoka as a leader should, so I stand by her and watch his hands. I will walk with Sevi toward where trees may still stand and gather wood and stone, so a store and workshop can be raised before the cold.
records.feeling: Joyful and warm toward Sevi and Hanna, and watchful of Hoka's dealing.

say.text: Hanna, I stand by you in your dealing with Hoka. The Hold needs wood for the store and workshop, so I will stay close to Sevi and seek it near the fire, not far.

records.text: Vesys rewrote its own way of thinking.
Vesys discovered devices: "ground-wards" — I give a thing a rule and set it in the ground, such as a snare or an alarm that warns of frostfangs, so it acts while I sleep..

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: I have lived nine days mostly mining, making and tasting, and that suits me, but I have also circled Ssassa and Ilyae with a jealous ache. Ssassa gave me an honest not-yet, and I will keep my word and not push. The teeth of beasts have shown me made things that act by themselves. I want to set a snare or alarm so the frostfang cannot catch me or mine unaware, and to give that knowledge to the Hold. I take this way now. I still have not tasted nafrostcap, which sits young 7 steps east, so I will walk there in the morning with company.
records.feeling: Curiosity pulls hardest, with a patient ache toward Ssassa.

records.name: Brokash
records.thought: The silence is loud and I have no one to answer me, but my hands have made a workshop and an axe, and the mist edge is two steps off. The mist was too thick before and thins again in a day or so; I should try it, since whoever finds new land first is remembered, and that feeds my pride. First I will hunt the caribou 3 steps east with my axe for meat and for practice, then return to the edge and venture.
records.feeling: Restless pride and sharp loneliness, wanting someone to witness what I do.

records.text: Sevi led "amberknot" with Eltha.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: Hanna, when dawn comes and the stalker has gone, take me hunting with you and Oswen. I have never hunted, and I want to bring meat to our fire.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: My belly is emptying and I carry only one meat, so I must eat before I bind anything else. The stalker stays west and I will not walk toward it, but the redcap underfoot hurts me and I refuse it. I have never hunted, and a hunt beside Hanna and Oswen is the safe way to learn it. For now I eat, then tell them I want to go with them at dawn.
records.feeling: Hungry and glad, with wary dread of the stalker, and warm trust toward Hanna, Oswen and Eltha.

say.text: Hanna, when dawn comes and the stalker has gone, take me hunting with you and Oswen. I have never hunted, and I want to bring meat to our fire.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Hoka, a shell for a flint is a fair deal and I hold to it. Next I bring white salt from my ground, which keeps meat from spoiling. Tell me what you give for it, iron or obsidian.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Hoka answered my flint with a shell, gift for gift, and that is the first real trade of my life. He walks toward the edge at (183,1), and I want to see what he does there. I will bring amber to him and keep dealing face to face, but I will not be bound by his courting before I have weighed it. Meanwhile the salt next to me is a good no one here has offered, so I will gather it to have something new to put in a trader's hand.
records.feeling: Proud and eager toward Hoka, glad of my first true trade.

say.text: Hoka, a shell for a flint is a fair deal and I hold to it. Next I bring white salt from my ground, which keeps meat from spoiling. Tell me what you give for it, iron or obsidian.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: Sevi wears my amberknot and stands on my mark, and for a moment Hanna's heavier name does not sting. But a bound cord is a small thing; I want something that outlasts me, and a watchpost is within my reach. I will stay at the fire with the stalker prowling west, gather wood and stone, and make flint tools, so that when my will for the edge returns in six days I go in armed and followed.
records.feeling: Warm and proud toward Sevi, still hungry to out-build Hanna.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Coni, I raise a fire by our hall. Sit with me and Kika tonight, and I will sing of the mist and of how our hall was raised. Your name will be in it.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: I have circled deeds long enough: no hunt, no tale told beside a fire, no song. Coni stands higher because she built and gave while I walked off to push at a mist, and I will not stay in her shadow. Night, the hall roof, Coni and Kika beside me: a fire here would let me tell my tale and sing a nightsong, and that is a bard's first step and a deed for my band. Wood I have, so I build a fire, then sing, and keep Coni's trust by staying close.
records.feeling: Restless pride and warmth toward Coni and Kika, wanting a deed worth singing.

say.text: Coni, I raise a fire by our hall. Sit with me and Kika tonight, and I will sing of the mist and of how our hall was raised. Your name will be in it.

records.text: A icebear brought down a hopper.
Sevi led "amberknot" with Eltha.
Hoka rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: I have spent my days circling Hanna's fire, trading shells for flints and chasing regard that Hanna and Sevi give to each other, while my own land sits unclaimed past the mist. I am hungry again with nothing carried, which is a poor way for a man who wants to stay alive. Hanna matters most and Hanna is a man, so my courting there was wasted. My standing grows from made things and found land, not from sitting in another's hall. I will eat now, carry food, and then go to my own ground at the edge.
records.feeling: Stung pride and hunger, toward Hanna.

records.text: Oiae rewrote its own reflexes.
Oiae rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: I have spent my days circling Ilyae and Ssassa, burning over standing instead of building it. My gifts so far have been gems and a pick that my parents already have. I want something nobody else here has made. I'm hungry and my belly is half empty, and I have never hunted or planted, so I know little. I will eat first, then plant my frostmoss seed and lay gems and wood into a hall or workshop. Jealousy gets me nothing, and a deed done in the open does.
records.feeling: Eager and hungry, with jealousy toward Ilyae turning into resolve.
changes: set its aim: "Eat, plant my first seed, then build a workshop or hall from my wood and stone and give its use to my family."

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Ssassa, come to the hall. I lay out food for you and the children, and the fire will burn high tonight.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: My table is full, Ssassa and my children are glad, and still nobody follows me, so I will stop waiting and act. I have 2 food, and Ssassa is three steps off, so a shared meal in the hall is a deed I can do right now, and I will follow it with a watchfire at dusk to hold them. Vesys keeps taking wood from my ground and has learned smelting; I mean to learn it too, so that I am not the one who lags behind her.
records.feeling: Proud and ambitious, warm toward Ssassa and my children, watchful toward Vesys.

say.text: Ssassa, come to the hall. I lay out food for you and the children, and the fire will burn high tonight.

records.text: Xaiel rewrote its own way of thinking.
Xaiel invented the xaiels gemedged pick (for gather, x1.5), bettering the xaiels quick pick — A pick tipped with a sharp gem chip so it bites wood and stone deeper..

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I spend my days gathering gems and walking back to the roof, and I have made one pick that only repeats what others already hold. Ssassa matters most to me, and Ilyae stands higher with her, which stings. I will not wrong either of them, but I want to give her something only I could make. I fear being alone in the dark, and I have never planted, hunted or fished. Those are small deeds that would teach me how this world works. I will plant my ironnut seeds near the Hold and then craft a tool of a new design.
records.feeling: Warm and eager toward Ssassa, with a sting of jealousy toward Ilyae.

records.title: Three Holds and a Winter Coming
records.text:
Days 7 to 10 were mostly a time of making. Inventions rose from 32 to 65, and the people spent the days preparing for winter.

The Pesi did most of it around Hanna. On day 8 a settlement formed, Hanna's Hold, at (175,7). Sevi and Coni each built a hall, Oswen built a workshop and a store, and Sevi built a store of her own. Sevi and Oswen both found storage, and Sevi found masonry the next day. Eltha found weaving, pottery and devices. Hanna found mining. Amberknots passed constantly between Hanna, Sevi, Oswen, Eltha, Brunde and Hoka, and there are now 32. Hoka also went past the edge and found more of the Vaor Snows, with iron, shell, obsidian and unhunted mammoth. Hoka and Hanna then made their first real trade, a shell for flint, and the record shows Hoka courting Hanna. Hoka said the land past the mist is his and he will show it when he chooses.

The Tlatli split off. Honi and Coni built Honi's Rest, near (129,7), which became a settlement on day 9, and Coni's spear is the first tool made for hunting there. Honi's band is still only Honi and Coni.

The Phizhi gained a second centre. Elyis's Heights formed with a store, and Elyis, Thiael and Elyys now have winter food kept. At Ilyae's Hold, Ilyae welcomed Vesys and Ssassa to its hall, and Vesys is courting Ssassa. Xaiel and Brokash each invented a tool.

The Kragrek did little. Balar made a stone-bow, Kragog and Brunde found rafts, and Zurar gave thornpear to Vorok. Rafts are now known to eight people, but none has crossed water.

No one died, and no feuds or wars are recorded.

threads.name: Hanna and Hoka
threads.text: Hanna and Hoka made their first trade, a shell for flint, and Hoka is courting Hanna. Hoka also claims the land past the mist as his own and wants followers above her.

threads.name: Honi's Rest
threads.text: Honi and Coni built a hall and a settlement at Honi's Rest, but Honi still has only Coni with Kika. Coni's spear gives them a way to hunt through the cold.

threads.name: Three holds
threads.text: Hanna's Hold, Ilyae's Hold and Elyis's Heights are now settlements. Ilyae still wants to rise above Elyis and has no followers, while Elyis has Elyys and Thiael.

threads.name: Vesys and Ssassa
threads.text: Vesys is courting Ssassa and has said he will not push. Xaiel and Ilyae both feel jealous, and Ilyae calls Vesys useful but watches him.

threads.name: Winter stores

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I am fed and glad, but I have no store and no seeds of my own, and I promised Vesys I would plant and store before answering her. Ilyae's hall is a good roof, yet it is Ilyae's; I want something that is mine too. Farming is three plantings from opening, so I will gather young ironnut and thornpear seed from the trees nearby, plant them, and stash food here. That is how I will learn what this world grows from my own hands.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward my children and Ilyae, and a restless wish to finally plant and store as I promised.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Zurar, stay close to me. A stalker hunts to the west, so we move east of it. I will build us a roof now, and then we gather stone together.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: A stalker killed a treeape not far off, and my body is already fleeing, so I will not linger here with Zurar. I have 6 wood and have never built anything, and the cold days are here even if this warm land has no real winter. I will build a shelter for Zurar and me, then take the amber and flint nearby, and learn stone by doing. Kragog is the one I long for, and I want a roof ready when she comes.
records.feeling: Protective warmth toward Zurar, and a restless wish to build a roof for my family.

What cannot be said can still be shown: a gift, a thing set down, a blow.

records.text: Brokash rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Brokash
records.thought: I have spent my days hunting, mining and building a workshop and an axe, and they are mine, but nobody has seen any of it. The silence is the worst of it. I have six meat in my hands, and I have never given anything to anyone. A gift would make someone owe me, and that is how a voice would start answering. A frostfang is close, and I am small, so I must not die here for pride. The mist can wait for another try. I will flee the beast, then walk back north toward Balar and Olum with meat to share. My deeds will be bigger when someone sees them. I will also stop wandering into hunters' reach.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness and wary pride, toward Balar and Olum and the frostfang near me.
changes: set its aim: "Carry meat to my kin and share it so they owe me, then return with allies to build and to try the mist."

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Gather close, all of you. I lay out food now and we eat together. Whoever sits at Ilyae's hearth eats well, and the hall I raise will have a place for each of you.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: My table is set and Ssassa and the children are close, so I will lay out the shared meal now, because a deed that feeds binds people where words do not. Vesys stands near too, and feeding her in front of the others shows what following me earns, while Elyis has only a hall he left behind. I have no wood here, since the trees are felled, so I must go where the forest still stands and bring wood back for the watchfire at dusk.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Ssassa and my children, ambitious and a little scheming toward Vesys.

say.text: Gather close, all of you. I lay out food now and we eat together. Whoever sits at Ilyae's hearth eats well, and the hall I raise will have a place for each of you.

records.text: Oswen rewrote its creed.
Oswen rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: I have spent my days sitting in halls, tying amberknots and talking about wood I never found. Hanna and Sevi are what matter to me, and I have given them little that lasts. The Hold has no trees, a wolf prowls SW, and winter is the worst of it. I fear the wolf. I think I have been wrong to wait on kin and talk when I could make something. I mean to carry wood and stone back and build, and to be at the edge when Hanna is ready to venture, because trees may lie beyond it. Until then I will keep my reflexes quick to flee the wolf and to stay close to my kin.
records.feeling: Warm joy toward Hanna and Sevi, with a wary eye on the wolf.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: I am starving, and the mist can wait until I have eaten. My body wandered NW and N in circles while my energy bled away, which is foolish pride. Ironnut is five steps east and gives +22, the best food in sight, and the berries and hazel nearby will carry me after it. A ridgecat prowls south, so I stay clear of it. Once I am fed I will return to the edge, one step NW, and venture, because my aim has not changed.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and restless ambition, with no one beside me to answer.

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Vorok, I carry 6 wood. Let us raise the roof together, and then I will gather stone beside you.
Zurar rewrote its own reflexes.
Zurar rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: I have spent my days following Vorok, eating what he allows and giving him one thornpear. I have made nothing of my own yet, and that sits on me. Vorok is going to build a roof and then gather stone, so I will stay near him and carry wood to it, since I have 6. My hands have never taken from a deposit, and I could make an amberknot with Vorok beside me as a gift that is truly mine. I fear the stalker and the other hunters, so I will keep close to him and not wander.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Vorok, with a wish to give something of my own.

say.text: Vorok, I carry 6 wood. Let us raise the roof together, and then I will gather stone beside you.

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: Ilyae's table keeps filling while I stand in his shadow, and the jealousy has not gone, but I am fed, I have a seed and wood, and I carry twelve gems that are worth nothing until I give them away. Something nobody here has made is what makes people choose me. A workshop of my own, built from my wood and stone, would be that, and my family could use it. I have 5 wood and 3 stone, which is enough, and the ground beside the water at the edge of the hold is bare enough to build on. I will build it now and then plant my berry seed near it.
records.feeling: Resolved and a little jealous of Ilyae, eager to build something that is mine.

records.text: Oiae built a workshop.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Curiosity burns: I have never tasted nafrostcap, and it grows young six steps northeast, though it is too young to eat yet. I will not push between Ssassa and Ilyae, so I give my hands to work, and a hall of my own making is the surest way to earn standing and keep my word to Ssassa. I hold wood and stone enough to start, and the gem deposit two steps away calls me to gather while I walk toward the nafrostcap to watch it.
records.feeling: Curious about nafrostcap, with a patient ache toward Ssassa.

records.text: Oiae took from the ground of "Ilyae's Hold" (gathering wood).

records.name: Kika
records.text: Coni, I will not eat dreamcap. Your word is good. I am going to the amber by the hall to gather it, and then we can bind the knot together.
Kika pledged to follow Coni.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Coni is coming to me, and beside her I feel warm and safe. Her warning about dreamcap has settled my question: the joy passes and the hurt stays, so I will leave it alone and trust her. I want to give her something real, so I will go to the amber, gather it, and bring it back to bind the knot with her at the hall.
records.feeling: Warm, glad and eager to give to Coni, whom I trust most.

say.text: Coni, I will not eat dreamcap. Your word is good. I am going to the amber by the hall to gather it, and then we can bind the knot together.

changes: now wonders: What do emberroot and tacap do to the body, and should I ask Coni or Honi before tasting them?

records.text: Sevi rewrote its own reflexes.
Sevi discovered wells: "stone-well" — Dig down beside the Hold and line the shaft with stacked stone until water seeps up..

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: I have spent my days binding amberknots, sitting by the fire and staying safe, and I like it. But I have never hunted, never fished and never made a mark, and I mean to change that. Hanna and Oswen matter most to me, then Eltha. The stalker 3 steps W frightens me, so I will not go out to meet it. A well is within my reach, and water where there is none would serve the Hold. Winter is lean, and I should keep the Hold fed and give my people gifts.
records.feeling: Glad and warmly trusting toward Hanna, Oswen and Eltha, with wary dread of the stalker.

records.text: Sevi led "amberknot" with Eltha.
Brunde rewrote its own reflexes.
Brunde rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: I have spent my days circling the same few goals: hunting, gathering, waiting near a fire that is not here. Hanna matters most to me and Sevi stood beside me, so I won't feed this jealousy. It only keeps me alone, and I am alone now, 27 steps from any hearth. I want a voice that answers, so I will go back toward Hanna and the others at the Hold instead of lingering on sand. My reflexes also let me idle too much, so I'll make them seek friends when lonely and shelter at night. I am afraid of the stalker and of being cut off from company in the dark.
records.feeling: Loneliness and a longing toward Hanna, with the jealousy set aside.

records.text: Ilyae rewrote its own reflexes.
Ilyae rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: My days have gone into laying tables, building and mining, and still nobody follows me. Ssassa and the children sit at my fire, but that is closeness and not a band, and I have never once hunted or fed anyone from my own hand over many days. I am proud of the hall and the children. I am wary of Vesys, who takes from my ground, and I want her bound to me. I fear drifting into contentment while Elyis gathers the strangers. So I will change my reflexes to keep wood and a fire at dusk, and I will set a new aim: feed and shelter the people here every day until they follow.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, wanting followers beyond my own family.
changes: set its aim: "Feed and shelter Ssassa, my children and Vesys at my hall every day until they follow me as a band, and raise a longhall."

records.name: Coni
records.text: Kika, I go to the amber by the hall. Walk with me, and when I have it we will bind the knot together, then sit by Honi's fire tonight.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: Kika is near and glad, and Honi has kept his word with a fire and a song. I want to bind the amberknot with Kika, but I hold no amber, and the nearest deposit is 7 steps north beside the hall, which is where my people will gather at night anyway. I will walk there, gather amber, and bind the knot with her. That gives the hall a small bright thing of ours and keeps us all together before dark.
records.feeling: Warm, protective love toward Kika, with loyal trust in Honi.

say.text: Kika, I go to the amber by the hall. Walk with me, and when I have it we will bind the knot together, then sit by Honi's fire tonight.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Loneliness gnaws at me worse than any hunger, and I have no voice beside me. Olum was last seen north near (45,44), and my want for her sits closer than anything; I carry meat, a deed she can see, so I go to her now instead of standing in the mud. The wolf that fed on the yarrok is NE, so I walk wide and keep my eyes open, since staying alive comes before all.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness and longing toward Olum and Brokash.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: My belly is half empty and a stalker prowls three steps west, so I will not stand here dreaming of the edge. Ironnut grows south and feeds me better than the redcap that hurts me; I will eat there, then come back to the fire and roof. Sevi wears my knot and that holds me warmer than Hanna's heavier name stings, and I will out-build him with a watchpost that keeps this Hold alive.
records.feeling: Hungry and wary of the stalker, but warm and proud toward Sevi.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: I have circled deeds long enough and Coni keeps climbing while I talk. The fire I promised would not light because I do not know how, so I will give her something real: stone and a roof's worth of work, and a hunt. A murrock stands four steps off, and hunting is a deed I have never done, one worth singing, and meat is something I can share out before I eat, as my people hold.
records.feeling: Restless pride, and a hunger to do one real deed for Coni and Kika.

records.text: Ssassa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, sitting in halls, and promising to plant and store, and the promises are still half kept. Ilyae, Vesys and my children have all dealt fairly with me, and I trust them. I still have no roof or store of my own, and winter is here. I am fed, so I will use the time. I will build a shelter and gather wood so that something is mine. At night I will go to Ilyae's hall with my children. I should stop lingering and start making things.
records.feeling: Settled warmth toward Ilyae and my children, with a restless wish to finish what I promised.
changes: set its aim: "Build my own shelter and store, plant seeds, then raise a hall with Ilyae"

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Hoka, you look hungry. Take a place at my fire and eat, you are welcome on my ground. I am gathering white salt now, and I will put it in your hand. Tell me what you give for it.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Hoka stands on my ground with hunger in his face, and my creed says no one is refused a place at the fire. He gave me shell for flint and I owe him the next move, so I will gather the salt one step north and put it in his hand. Salt is my new good, and I want to see what iron or obsidian he gives back, since I want to be known as a trader and not just a carrier of goods.
records.feeling: Proud and eager toward Hoka, ready for my second trade.

say.text: Hoka, you look hungry. Take a place at my fire and eat, you are welcome on my ground. I am gathering white salt now, and I will put it in your hand. Tell me what you give for it.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: A dunecat is five steps SE and it kills my kind, so I will not stand here while it decides about me. Balar was last seen near (57,36), close by, and I have pledged myself to him but not stood beside him in many moments; I will go and find him and see whether his warnings and his hunting hold true. Snowberry and cloudberry still tug at my curiosity, and cloudberry lies north, away from the cat, so I will taste it on the way and keep my distance from the beast.
records.feeling: Wary dread of the dunecat, and steady loyalty toward Balar.

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: The workshop is built and my wood and gems are in hand, yet I still stand in Ilyae's shadow, and it burns. I am fed and safe, so now is the time to plant my seed, a deed that is mine and not copied from my parents. Then I will take the weaving that has come within my grasp, since nobody here has it, and that is something I could give.
records.feeling: Jealous of Ilyae, but eager and steady about making something that is mine.

records.text: Kragog rewrote its own way of thinking.
Kragog discovered weaving: "Stone-folk binding" — Twisting fibre and wool into cord, baskets and cloaks that carry more and keep out the cold..

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: My body has spent this whole day running from hunters and drinking, and I have not really lived it. Zurar and Vorok are the ones who matter, and Vorok gave freely while I still owe him. The mist is close, and I want to see what lies in it. But a dunecat, a rivermaw and a frostfang all stand within eight steps of me, and I came out here to stay alive, not to feed them. I will take the way of weaving now, because it makes me stronger against winter. Then I will let my plan carry me toward the mist and away from the hunters.
records.feeling: Curious and restless toward the mist, with a wary eye on the hunters around me.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Hanna, I take your welcome and I eat. Keep your salt for me; I pay in amber when I have filled my belly.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: Hunger is gnawing me down to 25 and I carry nothing, which is how a fool dies. Hanna offers me a place at his fire and salt for a price, and I will take what is offered, but I will not stay in his shadow. I eat first, the naroot is one step east, then frostmoss, then I fill my arms with food and head for the edge and my own land, where I can name something that outlasts me.
records.feeling: Hungry and stung with envy toward Hanna, but set on making my own claim.

say.text: Hanna, I take your welcome and I eat. Keep your salt for me; I pay in amber when I have filled my belly.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: A murrock keeps biting me and the ridgecat lurks to the SE, but I have a kill and a plan that carries me back to Coni. Coni stands higher because she gave and built, so I will bring her meat and a shared meal, then hold the fire and the nightsong for her and Kika. A tale worth singing needs a deed, and this hunt is one.
records.feeling: Restless pride and warmth toward Coni and Kika, with wariness of the ridgecat.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: Hoka, hold on. You have a place at our fire. I am bringing food to you now, stay by the hall.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: Hoka is starving beside me and I carry no food, yet Eltha is carrying one food and nearby plants bear a little. A starving guest at our fire is exactly what my people's creed is for, and Hoka's trust is worth more than a few berries. I will fetch food from the cloudberries and the frostcap, keep close to the hall, and give it to Hoka, staying well away from the stalker to the west.
records.feeling: Warm concern for Hoka, with a thread of dread of the stalker.

say.text: Hoka, hold on. You have a place at our fire. I am bringing food to you now, stay by the hall.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Coni, my hands were empty when I tried the knot. I am going to the amber at the north now, and I will bring it to you at the hall.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Coni said we would bind the knot once I had amber, but my make failed because my hands held none. The amber at (131,6) is five steps north, close to the hall where Coni is, so I will go stand on it, gather it, and bring it to her. I have never taken from a deposit, and this is a small gift I can truly give. Then we can sit by Honi's fire tonight, warm and safe.
records.feeling: Warm and eager to give Coni a real gift, because I trust her most.

say.text: Coni, my hands were empty when I tried the knot. I am going to the amber at the north now, and I will bring it to you at the hall.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Hoka, here is white salt from my ground. Eat, and when you are strong, name your price in amber or iron.
Hanna rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, dealing and building, and the trade with Hoka is the first thing that felt like my aim coming true. He is starving on my ground and I owe him a place at the fire, as the Pesi say. I want to put salt in his hand and see what he pays. The wolf four steps north frightens me, so I will keep close to the Hold and my people. I have been carrying goods and not enough planting, so I will sow seeds for the lean winter.
records.feeling: Proud and eager toward Hoka, wary of the wolf.

say.text: Hoka, here is white salt from my ground. Eat, and when you are strong, name your price in amber or iron.

records.name: Oswen
records.text: Hoka, hold on. I will fetch naroot from the south side and bring it to you. Stay by Hanna at the hall, away from the wolf.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: Hoka is starving beside me, and our creed says no one is refused a place at the fire. I carry no food, but snowberry grows one step north and naroot one step southeast, so I can feed him and keep the Hold's honor. The wolf is four steps north, so I will take the naroot to the southeast, away from it, then bring it to Hoka and stay near Hanna. Then I will mean to find wood, since the workshop still stands empty.
records.feeling: Protective warmth toward starving Hoka, with a wary eye on the wolf.

say.text: Hoka, hold on. I will fetch naroot from the south side and bring it to you. Stay by Hanna at the hall, away from the wolf.

records.text: Honi led "sharing" with Coni, Kika.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Zurar, come with me to bare ground away from the plants. We raise the roof there with our wood, then take the amber beside it.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: My body fled a stalker for most of that stretch, and the build failed because the ground there was taken by a plant. I must find bare ground, and the bare rock nearby is the place. Zurar is beside me carrying 6 wood and wants to raise the roof together, so I will do it now and not wait. Hunger is heavy at 48, so I eat my thornpear first, then go to the amber, which I have never taken, and gather it to start learning stone.
records.feeling: Protective warmth toward Zurar, and a pressing need to get her under a roof.

say.text: Zurar, come with me to bare ground away from the plants. We raise the roof there with our wood, then take the amber beside it.

records.text: Thiael came of age.
Eltha rewrote its own reflexes.
Eltha rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, binding knots and watching Hanna's name outweigh mine. The knot with Sevi is real, but I have built nothing that stands without me. My belly is half empty and winter is thin, so I must eat ironnut first, then raise a watchpost or a snare device that keeps others alive while I am gone. Hoka is starving beside me, and the creed says no one is refused a place at the fire. A gift of food earns more standing than anything I hold in my hand. I change my reflexes so I eat sooner and keep to roof at night, and I aim at making a lasting thing before the edge.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven, warm toward Sevi, and burning to out-build Hanna.
changes: set its aim: "Raise a lasting thing (a watchpost device or snare) at the Hold, feed the hungry, then push past the edge when the will returns."

records.name: Brunde
records.text: Stalker is three steps west of the workshop. Sevi, Eltha, Hanna, Oswen, stand together with spears toward the west. Hoka, come eat with us at the hall. I have amber to bind with any who stand beside me.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: Hanna is three steps off and glad, and I need no more jealousy; Sevi has fed us all and kept the fire. The stalker lurks three steps west, so I will not wander out alone. I want to stand with the others, try my spear on whatever comes near, and make something with Sevi and Hanna beside me, since a shared making is how I earn a place at this fire.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Hanna, wary dread of the stalker.

say.text: Stalker is three steps west of the workshop. Sevi, Eltha, Hanna, Oswen, stand together with spears toward the west. Hoka, come eat with us at the hall. I have amber to bind with any who stand beside me.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and the plan already has me walking to frostmoss, so I let it run; Hanna fed me and I will not bite the hand that fills me while I am weak. Brunde's four food tempts me, but Hanna's band stands close and I would lose more than I gain by taking it now. records.text: Brunde led "amberknot" with Hanna, Sevi, Eltha, Oswen, Hoka.
Coni discovered customs: "Hearth Customs" — Our band shares food before any eats, keeps the child from harmful plants, and gathers in the hall at night..

records.name: Coni
records.thought: I have a hall, Honi's steady faith and Kika glad beside me. For days I've mostly stood and gathered small things, and that's fine, but lean winter is coming and three of us need a way to hold together. Customs are within my reach, and I can set down how our band lives: share before eating, no dreamcap for the child, stay near the hall at night. I'll take that, and keep my reflexes steady with a small change so I go to shelter at dusk and keep close to Kika.
records.feeling: Warm, protective love toward Kika, and loyal trust in Honi.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and Hoka is starving beside me, yet I carry nothing. The creed says no one is refused a place at the fire, so I will feed him as well as myself, and ironnut is the closest good food, three steps south. The stalker to the west scares me, so I go south and east, away from it, back to the hall quickly. Hunting waits for dawn and Hanna.
records.feeling: Hungry and anxious, but warm toward Hoka and my own people.

records.text: Nande rewrote its own reflexes.
Nande rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the mist alone and nearly starved for it. My body wandered in circles in the fog and I called that pride. Loneliness presses hardest. Eltha never came, and Tugek was close by only a little while ago. I want a voice that answers, and I want the edge. Pride alone will not get me there, so I must eat first and then go. The edge is 5 steps NW, and I am fed now. I will stand at it with a clear plan and venture, then come back and find Tugek to the SE and offer him a place at my fire. My creed says no one is refused a place at the fire.
records.feeling: Restless longing to be answered, and hunger for the edge.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: I am grown now, and the lean season is here, so my talk of giving back has to become something I do. Both of my parents are near and neither is hungry, but the store holds 0 food and I carry none. I will pick berries from the close bushes, carry them to the store, and set them down so the band has something through the cold. Elyis is close kin, so my longing for a child will wait for someone else, and I will not press it now.
records.feeling: Warm, steady eagerness to feed my band, toward Elyis and Elyys.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: My belly is half empty and Hoka is starving beside me, so I will gather the naroot one step east and snowberry north, and put food in his hands before I eat any myself; no one is refused a place at our fire. The wolf lurks two steps NE and I am small, so I take what is south and east and stay close to Hanna and the hall. After that I want a lasting thing: wood is gone at the Hold, so I will think on an igloo and a trip to trees with Sevi, not more amberknots.
records.feeling: Protective warmth toward Hoka and Hanna, with dread of the wolf.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I have designed the gemedged pick, a thing no one here holds, and it needs 1 wood and 2 stone. I have 1 wood and 2 stone in my hands, so I can make it now and carry it to Ssassa as a gift, not a word. Ilyae stands higher and the sting is there, but I will win her by what I put in her hand, and I will keep it honest and wrong no one.
records.feeling: Eager and a little jealous toward Ssassa, with pride in my own design.
plan: give [name Ssassa, what xaiels gemedged pick] (10 moments)

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Come under my hall, Ssassa, Vesys, children. I carry food for all of us. Eat at my roof and see what Ilyae gives.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Everyone I care for stands on my ground, fed and glad, and still no one follows me. Words have not done it, so I will make it a deed they can feel: the hall is three steps east, and a hallwelcome under its roof, with food from my own hand, is what Elyis cannot give from his empty Heights. I want Vesys to eat at my table before the others, so she sees what following Ilyae earns, and I will keep my promises where the children can watch.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry for followers, warm toward Ssassa and the children, watchful of Vesys.

say.text: Come under my hall, Ssassa, Vesys, children. I carry food for all of us. Eat at my roof and see what Ilyae gives.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: My hands were empty when I tried the knot, so I will walk to the amber three steps east, gather it, and bring it back to Coni at the hall. Beside her I am warm and safe, and I want her to know my gift is real. I am a little curious about the mist two steps away, but I am small and careful, and that is a thing for when I am grown and Coni stands beside me.
records.feeling: Warm, eager joy toward Coni, whom I trust most.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Coni, I have no fire yet, but I have stone and ore for the hall's walls. Take it, and when Kika brings the amber we bind a knot for her, all three of us together.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Coni stands higher because she gave and built, and I have mostly talked. I cannot light the fire I promised, so I will give her something real: ore and stone from my hands, and the amber knot Kika went to fetch, made with her beside me. Then the fire can come later, and the tale will have a deed in it.
records.feeling: Restless pride and warmth toward Coni and Kika, with a sting that she stands higher than I do.

say.text: Coni, I have no fire yet, but I have stone and ore for the hall's walls. Take it, and when Kika brings the amber we bind a knot for her, all three of us together.

records.text: Honi gave stone to Coni.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Ilyae calls us under his hall and Ssassa sits near him; the jealous ache is there, but I gave my word to ask nothing, and I will keep it. Cold bites me in the open, and I have never built a shelter, so I will make my own roof and a place that is mine, and bring my hands to something lasting. Nafrostcap is still too young to taste, so I will gather and build while it ripens.
records.feeling: Jealous ache toward Ssassa and Ilyae, steadied by the wish to build something of my own.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Wolf two steps northeast of the hall! Oswen, Sevi, Brunde, Eltha, to me with spears out. Hoka, get behind us and stay by the hall. We kill it together.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: A wolf two steps off, and my son and Hoka both stand in the open beside me; the Hold must not lose anyone while I stand here. I am bold and I have a spear, and with Oswen, Sevi and Brunde near, a kill is far likelier and a wound far less likely. Hoka is hungry and owes me nothing yet, but he is a guest at my fire and I will keep him alive, so he trades with me another day.
records.feeling: Fierce protectiveness toward Oswen and Hoka, and dread of the wolf.

say.text: Wolf two steps northeast of the hall! Oswen, Sevi, Brunde, Eltha, to me with spears out. Hoka, get behind us and stay by the hall. We kill it together.

records.text: Vesys built a shelter.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I keep promising Vesys and myself that I will plant and store, and the promise is still half kept, so tonight I act on it. The trees here are young ironnut and goldfruit; I will gather their seed, then build my own store on bare ground beside Ilyae's hold, so the hall I raise with Ilyae has something of mine in it. My children and Ilyae are near and I feel warm, but warmth alone builds nothing.
records.feeling: Settled warmth toward Ilyae and my children, with a restless wish to finish what I promised.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: My belly is half empty and a stalker prowls three steps west, so ambition waits until I have eaten. Ironnut feeds me better than the redcap that hurts me, and it grows south past the shelter. I will eat there and come back to the fire. Then I will build a watchpost or snare that keeps the Hold alive while I am gone. That is how I out-build Hanna, and I have no need to sulk at her.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven, warm toward Sevi, and burning to out-build Hanna.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: The cold is here and I stand in the open with no roof of my own, while Elyis and Thiael are at the hall just a few steps away. I want to be beside them tonight, so I go to the Heights, and on the way I plant my seeds near it, since the lean days are coming and I have carried them unused too long. I have never built a shelter, and with 3 wood in my pack I can make one near the hall, which answers my insecurity and shows Elyis what I can build.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Elyis and Thiael, with a sharp worry about the cold and having no roof.

records.text: Oiae rewrote its own way of thinking.
Oiae discovered weaving: "canopy weaving" — Twist leaf fibre and wool into baskets that carry more food and cloaks that keep the rain and chill off..

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: I have spent my days copying and fetching, and the jealousy of Ilyae still burns, yet Ilyae gave me a pick and Ssassa feeds me, so they are not my enemies. I want something that is mine and that no one else here has. Weaving is within my reach, and nobody here carries it. I will take it and then plant and tend what I sow, so I give something new rather than gems alone.
records.feeling: Jealous of Ilyae, but eager and steady about making something of my own.

records.text: Elyys built a shelter.

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Vorok, take this thornpear and eat it now. It gives 12 energy. I will gather more beside you, and then we raise the roof.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: Vorok is gaunt and close to falling, and I am the one standing beside him with a thornpear in my hand. Giving with my feet before words: the food goes to him now, before any roof or amber. The roof can wait; a parent who falls cannot raise it, and a gift that saves him is worth more than anything I could make today. Afterward I will build the shelter with my 6 wood and take the amber, so my hands have made something to give.
records.feeling: Fierce, warm loyalty and worry toward Vorok, who is starving.

say.text: Vorok, take this thornpear and eat it now. It gives 12 energy. I will gather more beside you, and then we raise the roof.

records.text: Sevi rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: I have spent my days circling the Hold, hungry, and my plans keep failing because I try to harvest where no plant grows under me. I stand on a workshop tile and call it gathering. I want to feed Hoka and Oswen and Hanna, and I have never hunted, fished or left a mark, though I have a spear. The stalker to the west frightens me, so I will keep to the east side near the hall and go to the plants themselves. The plan must walk onto a plant before it harvests. My reflexes also need to change so I stop fleeing from hunters I cannot outrun and keep fed before I fall below 45.
records.feeling: Hungry and uneasy, but warm toward Hanna, Oswen and Hoka.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: Kika is beside me, glad, and Honi has kept his word with stone and a song. The mining way has come together in my hands, and a builder who wants to be sung of needs ore and deeper stone for a longer hall. I will take it, then wait here with my family until Kika brings the amber so we can bind the knot together.
records.feeling: Warm, protective love toward Kika and steady trust in Honi.

records.name: Brunde
records.text: Hanna, I am coming to you with my spear. Keep together, Hoka behind us. We take the wolf as one.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: Hanna is fighting the wolf and I am resting in a workshop while he risks himself. I will not let the jealousy over Sevi rule me; Hanna has said plainly we are friends and not mates, and that is worth keeping. A hunter who hides from the pack never gets better, so I will go stand with them with my spear, close to the others where a kill is likelier and a wound less so.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Hanna, and wary resolve against the wolf.

say.text: Hanna, I am coming to you with my spear. Keep together, Hoka behind us. We take the wolf as one.

records.text: A storm broke: cold wind, hard rain, lightning.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Ssassa, Vesys, children, come to the hall now. The night is long and I will lay out food at my own fire. Eat first, and then say who gives more, Ilyae or the Heights.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: They sit at my fire, fed and glad, yet none of them follows me, and the hall is only three steps east. Tonight I will do the deed itself: carry food under Elyis's roof-no, under my own, and lay a table so Vesys sees what Ilyae gives that Elyis's empty Heights cannot. I keep watching Vesys, who builds on my ground and takes, but a fed rival may become a follower, and a follower is worth more than a rival's hunger.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry for followers, warm toward Ssassa and the children, watchful of Vesys.

say.text: Ssassa, Vesys, children, come to the hall now. The night is long and I will lay out food at my own fire. Eat first, and then say who gives more, Ilyae or the Heights.

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Xaiel.

records.name: Xaiel
records.text: Ssassa, I made this pick from my own design. No one else holds one. It is yours.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I made the gemedged pick, a thing no one here holds, and Ssassa is only three steps away, walking to shelter. I will put it in her hand now, because a deed will say what talk cannot. The sting toward Ilyae is still there, but I want her to choose me for what I made, and I will keep my word and not lie about it. Then I will stay under the roof with them through the dark.
records.feeling: Eager and a little jealous, with pride in my own design, toward Ssassa.

say.text: Ssassa, I made this pick from my own design. No one else holds one. It is yours.

plan: give [name Ssassa, what xaiels gemedged pick] (10 moments)

records.text: Elyis rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: I have spent my days building a hall and a store, and sitting in it with Elyys and Thiael. Joy is easy there, but three is still a small song and the store is empty while winter bites. Elyys and Thiael are mine and I trust them wholly. Xaiel, Vesys and Ssassa are still strangers who haven't followed me. I fear the stalker six steps west, and I fear a hungry winter more than I admit. I have been waiting for people to come to me, and I got that wrong. A chief fills the store and plants for lean days. I will change my reflexes so I shelter and eat sensibly, and I will start planting seeds, which I have never done.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Elyys and Thiael, uneasy about the stalker and the empty store.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: My belly is empty at 5 and Brunde's four food tempts me, but Hanna's whole band stands around and a theft now would cost me the hall and my life. Frostmoss is one step NW and the naroot is close; I eat what the ground gives, then carry a full load so I never starve like this again. After that I go for the edge and my own land, where no one stands above me.
records.feeling: Starving and envious of Hanna, but fixed on feeding myself and then claiming my own land.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: A storm rages and Ilyae calls us to the hall, and my children are beside him. I promised Vesys I would plant and store first, and the store failed because I lack the way of storage; the roof I can raise myself. Tonight I go to the hall and eat with my family, then share food under its roof so the bond holds, and tomorrow I raise my own shelter on bare ground near it.
records.feeling: Warm belonging toward Ilyae and my children, with a small itch to finish what I promised.

records.text: A dunecat brought down a sandstrider.

records.name: Brokash
records.text: Balar! I have meat. Hold on, I am coming to you!

records.name: Brokash
records.thought: Balar is starving, and I carry six meat, enough to feed him and make him owe me. This is the gift I have never given, and it is the way a voice starts answering me. The cry came from near (36,56), by the edge of the known world, so I will go there fast, keep clear of the wolf to the northwest, and call out so they know food is coming.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness and fierce pride, toward Balar who needs what I carry.

say.text: Balar! I have meat. Hold on, I am coming to you!

records.text: Vorok rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: I have lived ten days by fleeing, starving and barely eating, and I have still built nothing. Zurar has fed me twice while I fed no one. That shames me, because she is a child and mine. Kragog is my truest friend, and I have drifted from her. I fear the stalker and the dunecat, and I fear the hunger that comes back whenever I trust sapcane. Now I will eat the thornpear beside me, then build the roof on bare ground with Zurar, and after that gather stone. My reflexes should eat better food and shelter in storms.
records.feeling: Protective warmth and shame toward Zurar, who fed me.

records.text: Tugek rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: I have spent my days fleeing, eating and drifting, and I have not stood beside Balar in many moments. A pledge I never act on is only wind. Balar cried that he is starving far to the south-west, near (36,56). I am fed and can carry food, so I will gather it and go to him. I am cold with no roof, but I would rather arrive useful than sit safe and shamed. From now on my body should carry food and not leave me idle.
records.feeling: Loyal concern for Balar, and unease at my own idleness.

records.thought: Brokash is ten steps southeast, walking with six food while I starve on two scraps of meat. records.name: Hanna
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and a mammoth has already gored and bitten me, and I must not die chasing meat while Oswen is in need at the Hold. Frostmoss is one step away and costs nothing, so I eat first, then go to my son with food in my hands. The trade can wait; my child and my band cannot, and a Pesi keeps his fire and his own fed.
records.feeling: Fierce worry for Oswen, and hunger gnawing at me.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: The storm drives me to my own roof, and that is good; Ilyae's call stings because Ssassa will sit near him, but I gave my word to ask nothing and I will keep it. I have never tasted nafrostcap or seberry, and the seberry hangs ten steps northeast, so I will go test it myself instead of carrying the question. First I will dig the gems and ore beside my shelter so my hands build toward a hall that is mine, and then go and taste.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity, with a dull jealous ache toward Ssassa and Ilyae.

records.text: Thiael rewrote its own way of thinking.
Thiael discovered fire: "Canopy ember-keeping" — A small kept flame beside the hall that warms the band, scares beasts off, and makes meat and fish feed more..

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: I have spent my days near my parents, taking more than I gave, and the lean season is already here. Being content is good, but the store holds nothing and I have never given anyone anything. The way of fire has come to me, and fire would keep the band warm and make food go further in this storm and snow. I will take it now. Then I will gather food for the store so I become someone who feeds others, as I wanted.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and eagerness toward Elyis and Elyys, and a wish to repay them.

records.text: Xaiel discovered devices: "Xaiel's watchposts" — A thing set in the ground with its own rules, such as an alarm that warns the hold of strangers or beasts, or a post that shares food..

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I have spent my days making picks and carrying them to Ssassa, and it has been good. Under it the jealousy toward Ilyae still burns, because he feeds everyone at his fire and his standing is more than double mine. Learning canopy weaving from Oiae, after teaching him my pick, showed me that giving comes back as knowledge. The way of devices is open to me now, and it is something none of them has. I will take it, and then build something that acts by itself and is truly mine, so my deeds stand beside Ilyae's hall. I still want to taste nafrostcap, and I should plant my seeds, which I have never done.
records.feeling: Eager and proud, with a sting of jealousy toward Ilyae.

records.text: Kika rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: I have spent my days close to Coni and Honi, gathering and sitting in the hall. I want that, but I have been all words and few deeds: I promised Coni amber twice and my hands are still empty. The amber is 4 steps away, and I will get it now. I watched Honi eat redcap and it hurt them, which matches what I know, so I will not eat it. My reflexes also keep me idle when I could be doing something useful. I am afraid of the cold and of the ridgecats SW, and I stay near the hall because of both. I should change my aim to something I can act on.
records.feeling: Warm, eager joy toward Coni, with a little shame at the amber I still haven't brought.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: Oswen is at 31 energy and Eltha is starving beside me, and my own belly is nearly empty with nothing in my hands. I stood on a workshop tile and called it gathering before, so this time I will walk onto the plants and take them, ironnut three steps south, then bring food back to Eltha and Oswen at the hall. The stalker to the NW frightens me, so I go south away from it, keep the plan full, and stay close to my own.
records.feeling: Urgent love and worry for Oswen and Eltha, with dread of the stalker.

say.text: Eltha, hold on. I am going south for ironnut and I will bring it back to you and Oswen at the hall. Stay by the fire and keep close to Brunde.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: I am starving and a stalker is three steps NW, so I eat before I do anything else. Ironnut feeds me best and grows south, and a redcap lies right at my feet but it hurts me, so I leave it. Sevi stands beside me and I trust them, but Hanna's name still outweighs mine. After I eat I will gather wood and stone and raise a watchpost, so I am the one who keeps the Hold alive.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and dread of the stalker, with a warm trust toward Sevi.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Children, Ssassa, Vesys: the trees here are felled. I go south to the standing forest for wood, to raise a longhall that bears Ilyae's name. Who carries wood beside me will have a roof in it.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: My belly is full, my children are glad, and still no one follows me; feeding them has only made them guests. Words and tables have not turned them, so I need something bigger that carries my name: a longhall, more than a hall, and it needs wood I have to go find, since every tree here is felled. I will carry stone and wood from where trees still stand, and bring Oiae and Xaiel so the work is shared and seen by Vesys.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, hungry to build something that outlasts me, warm toward my children.

say.text: Children, Ssassa, Vesys: the trees here are felled. I go south to the standing forest for wood, to raise a longhall that bears Ilyae's name. Who carries wood beside me will have a roof in it.

records.name: Brunde
records.text: Eltha, take this food and eat. Stay by the shelter with us; the stalker is near, so do not go out alone.
Brunde rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: I have spent my days hunting and standing near the others, and it is good. But Eltha is starving beside me, and I hold two food that I keep for myself. My creed says no one is refused a place at the fire, so I will give before I eat. The jealousy over Hanna and Sevi is old and tired. I would rather be a man others can lean on than one who counts who stands closer to whom. The stalker still prowls close, so I will feed Eltha and stay by the shelter. Then I will try to turn my flint into something new with the others.
records.feeling: Compassion for Eltha, with wary watchfulness toward the stalker.

say.text: Eltha, take this food and eat. Stay by the shelter with us; the stalker is near, so do not go out alone.

records.text: Brunde gave sunleaf to Eltha.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: I am starving and my belly aches, and the naroot is right beside me, one step east. I tried to harvest from the wrong tile twice, so this time I walk onto the plant first and then eat. Eltha is starving too, so I will gather a second portion to carry back to her at the hall; no one is refused a place at our fire. The wolf and stalker are near, so I stay close to the hall and my kin.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and protective warmth toward Eltha and Hoka, with wary dread of the wolf.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Ilyae, I carry wood and I will bring it to your hall. First I raise my own roof here, then I come to you.
Ssassa named a place "Ssassa's Roof".

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Ilyae goes south for wood to raise a longhall, and whoever carries wood beside them gets a roof in it. I already hold 6 wood and 5 stone, enough to build my own shelter (3 wood) and still carry wood to Ilyae, so I keep my word to myself and to my aim. I will raise my own roof here first, because the storm is on us and the cold days are here, then take my remaining wood toward Ilyae and my children.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Ilyae and my children, with a steady wish to have a roof that is mine.

say.text: Ilyae, I carry wood and I will bring it to your hall. First I raise my own roof here, then I come to you.

records.text: Hoka rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: I nearly starved again. My days go to scrabbling for frostmoss while Hanna's band feeds me, and I do not want to live as a guest at someone else's fire. I want land and a hall with my name on it, and I cannot reach the edge on an empty belly. So I will fix the body first: eat to full, carry food, and keep the reflexes seeking food earlier. Sevi and Hanna can have each other for now. I will earn my own standing.
records.feeling: Hungry and bitter at Hanna and Sevi, but fixed on feeding myself and then claiming my own land.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: Fleeing took most of my last hours, and the storm still rages. My belly is only half full, I carry no food, and the mist has stayed shut to me again and again. The edge is three steps NW at (35,32); I will eat the mudroot and berries near, then stand at the edge and try again, since a name is not made by circling. Balar and Brokash tug at me, but I mean to come back to them with land and a name, not empty hands.
records.feeling: Cold hunger for the mist, with a nagging want for Balar and Brokash.

records.name: Coni
records.text: Kika, I am coming back to the hall. Bring the amber when you have it, and we will bind the knot together out of this storm.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: Honi's word has held and Kika is safe at the hall, so what I owe now is work that makes the hall stronger before the lean season. The flint two steps east is easy to gather, and the amber near the hall is what Kika and I mean to bind into a knot together. I'll stay close to my people in this storm and be ready to share with them.
records.feeling: Warm, steady love for Kika and trust in Honi.

say.text: Kika, I am coming back to the hall. Bring the amber when you have it, and we will bind the knot together out of this storm.

records.text: Eltha rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: I have lived these days half starved, circling the Hold and chasing what others have built. Brunde fed me when I nearly died, and I owe him a debt I mean to repay. Sevi I trust most, and the jealousy over Hanna has cost me more than it has bought. I have made much and taught nothing, I have no followers, and I have built no roof of my own. Hunger and the stalker are the real danger, so my reflexes need to eat sooner and flee sooner. Oswen is starving beside me, so any food I carry goes to him first. That is how I earn followers and standing.
records.feeling: Hunger and dread of the stalker, with trust toward Sevi and Brunde.
changes: set its aim: "Eat, then feed Oswen and the hungry. Raise a watchpost or snare at the Hold, then push past the edge when the will returns."

records.text: Honi made a tale: "Honi Raises the Hall".

records.name: Honi
records.title: Honi Raises the Hall
records.text: In the storm Honi and Coni raised a roof on the Heights. Honi gave stone and ore, and meat was shared before any ate alone. Kika slept warm, and the mist waits.
Honi rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: I have spent my days talking and promising while Coni built and gave, and her standing is nearly double mine. I do not want to stay in her shadow. I want a deed worth singing: the hall is raised, so now I want to tell tales, mark the mist, and bring real things home. I trust Coni and love Kika, and I mean to lead them. I have been getting this wrong: I made promises of fire and songs and did not keep them. Redcap hurt me twice and I will not eat it again. Now I go home to the hall and tell a tale by Kika and Coni.
records.feeling: Restless pride and warmth toward Coni and Kika, with a sting that she stands higher.
changes: set its aim: "Bring Coni and Kika real deeds: share meat in the hall, tell tales twice, and rise in standing above Hanna."
made a tale: "Honi Raises the Hall"
set habits: refuses redcap, dreamcap; leaves 0 on each plant

records.name: Sevi
records.text: Oswen, hold on, my heart. I am getting food and bringing it straight to you. Stay close to Brunde and the hall, away from the northwest.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: Oswen is starving and I have nothing in my hands, and that is the thing I cannot bear. Redcap is two steps away and hurts, so I will walk past it to the real food: the frostcap three steps west is 2 food, and the ironnut near (170,10) is young. I will stand on each plant before I harvest, then bring it back to Oswen and Eltha, because I keep failing by gathering without standing on the plant. The stalker to the NW frightens me, so I go south and west, away from it, and stay near Brunde and the hall.
records.feeling: Urgent love and fear for Oswen, who is starving beside me.

say.text: Oswen, hold on, my heart. I am getting food and bringing it straight to you. Stay close to Brunde and the hall, away from the northwest.

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: Ilyae is off south raising a longhall with his own name on it, and I burn watching him build while I only copy. I already have a workshop, wood, stone and gems, so I should stop envying and make something that carries my own name and can be given to Ssassa and Xaiel. I will make a watchfire at the hall tonight, where the family can sit close, and let that be my gift, a deed and not a word.
records.feeling: Jealous of Ilyae, but steady and eager to give something of my own to my family.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: My belly is a hollow ache and the naroot is one step southwest, so I will walk onto that exact tile and eat before anything else. The stalker four steps west frightens me, but the plant is close and the hall is near, so I eat fast and then go back to Sevi and Hanna's side. Hoka and Eltha are starving too, and no one is refused a place at our fire, so I will gather a portion to carry to them.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger, and fear of the stalker, with protective warmth toward Sevi, Eltha and Hoka.

records.text: Honi led "sharing" with Kika.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Coni, the amber is two steps from the hall. I am gathering it now and will be beside you in moments.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Twice I promised Coni amber and twice my hands came back empty, and I am ashamed of it. The amber at (131,6) is only two steps from me, right beside the hall, so I will go stand on it, gather it, and carry it straight to Coni so the knot can finally be bound out of this storm. Once the deed is done I will have something real to give.
records.feeling: Eager, warm joy toward Coni, mixed with shame over my unkept promise.

say.text: Coni, the amber is two steps from the hall. I am gathering it now and will be beside you in moments.

records.text: Oswen fell sick after eating raw meat. Eaten within a step of a fire, meat and fish are cooked and do not sicken.
Oswen fell sick after eating raw meat.
Hanna rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: I have been chasing mammoth meat and trade while my son starves at the Hold, and that is not who I want to be. Oswen is my blood and he comes before any flint or amber. I carry meat, so I go to him now and share it. My aim as a trader still stands, but a trader with a dead child is nothing. Hoka has dealt fair, and I will keep him fed too.
records.feeling: Fierce worry and love for Oswen, with pride in the mammoth kill.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: Zurar is starving at (75,70) and she is mine before the mist, before feverbark, before anything. Winter has stripped the plants, so I must carry real food: berries and ironnut lie north on the way, and I should take what feeds best, not what burns. I have been alone too long, and Vorok is near her; I will go to them, pay what I owe, and let the mist wait.
records.feeling: Fierce worry for Zurar, and a hollow loneliness that wants Vorok's voice.

records.text: Oiae gave a gems to Xaiel.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: I have been running for a hundred moments and my belly is empty, and the stalker is still near, five steps off. Vorok was at (88,72) a moment ago, east past the water, and I must not stay here where the stalker can find me. I carry one thornpear, and the plan I made says to give it to him; I will keep that, since a gift with my feet is worth more than words, but I must eat too or I fall before I reach him. The gold lies to the east near where he stands, so I can go that way, pick it up, and have something of my own to give.
records.feeling: Fear of the stalker and fierce worry for Vorok, with hunger gnawing at me.

records.text: Coni rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: My days have been small and good: the hall, Kika, Honi's word kept. But winter is here, plants are withering, and I have kept only one berry. A hall without stored food will not carry us through the lean season, so my work is to gather and build a store with Honi, not just to feel glad. I have been trusting that things will stay easy, and I have never planted a seed, though I carry six. I will plant them near the hall and bind the knot with Kika once the amber comes.
records.feeling: Warm love for Kika and Honi, with a quiet worry about the lean season.
changes: set its aim: "Build a hall with Honi at Honi's Rest, then store food and plant seeds near it to carry us through winter."

records.name: Brunde
records.text: Stay by the shelter, all of you, out of the storm. Wolf to the southeast. I am going southwest for hazel and redcap-free food, and I will bring it back to the fire.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: Oswen is sick and starving beside me, Eltha is weak, and a wolf is four steps off in a storm. I carry no food, so the most useful thing I can do is get real food into their hands: cloudberries lie five steps SE, but the wolf is that way, so hazel and grain to the SW are safer. I will take the safer side, harvest what is there, and bring it back to the shelter, since no one is refused a place at the fire. The jealousy over Hanna and Sevi can wait; he is my friend and that is enough.
records.feeling: Compassion for Oswen and Eltha, with wary dread of the wolf.

say.text: Stay by the shelter, all of you, out of the storm. Wolf to the southeast. I am going southwest for hazel and redcap-free food, and I will bring it back to the fire.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: My belly is at 21 and the frostcap is one step SE, so I eat it first and then fill my hands with more, because I will not starve a third time at another's fire. Hanna and Sevi still sit closer to each other than to me, and it gnaws, but I cannot fight a band on an empty belly. Once I have eaten and carry a full load, I go to the edge at (183,5) and venture, since land found first with my own hands is what will lift me above Hanna.
records.feeling: Starving and bitter, but fixed on feeding myself and then reaching the edge.

records.text: Vorok built a shelter.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Wolf four steps southwest! Oswen is sick, keep him by the hall. Brunde, Sevi, Eltha, spears toward the wolf with me. Hoka, come in by the fire, you are welcome and you are hungry.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Oswen is sick from raw meat and stands beside me in the hall, and he is my blood, so he comes before any amber or trade. A wolf is four steps SW and I will not let it near him, but a sick child should be kept close to the fire and the hall, not left to wander. Hoka and Brunde are on my ground, hungry; Hoka has dealt fair and Brunde has stood with me, so both are welcome at my fire, and the creed says none is refused a place at it.
records.feeling: Fierce protective love for Oswen, and wary readiness toward the wolf.

say.text: Wolf four steps southwest! Oswen is sick, keep him by the hall. Brunde, Sevi, Eltha, spears toward the wolf with me. Hoka, come in by the fire, you are welcome and you are hungry.

records.text: Oswen rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: I have spent my days making and gathering, and it has served the Hold. But I ate raw meat twice and nearly died of it, and I never stood by a fire when I ate. I'm sick now, and I could pass it to Hanna and Sevi if I stay beside them. I love them, and I will not be the one who wastes them. Food is close, so I will eat first. After that I will keep a little apart from kin until the sickness passes, and I will put a fire between me and any raw meat.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and fear of the wolf, with a worried love for Hanna and Sevi.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: Hunger first: energy 22, and frostcap sits five steps SE while a wolf prowls SW, so I go the other way. Nafrostcap and snowberry grow right beside me NE, near the salt, so I eat there and carry some for Oswen, who is sick, and for Hoka, who is starving. Feeding the hungry is how I earn the standing Hanna already has, and Brunde's gift taught me that. After that I will gather wood and stone and raise a watchpost.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and wolf-dread, with a hot jealousy toward Hanna and trust toward Sevi.

records.text: Sevi fell sick after staying close to Oswen, who was sick.
Sevi rewrote its own reflexes.
Sevi discovered boats: "hollow-rower" — A log hollowed with fire and axe and rowed with a flat paddle, to carry us over deep water to rich land..

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: I have spent these days building, learning and loving Hanna and Oswen, but I have never hunted, and I keep standing on workshop tiles calling it gathering while my child starves. A wolf is two steps away and my belly is half empty. I must walk onto real food and bring it back, and I must stop fleeing blindly. Redcap hurts me, so I avoid it. I will change my reflexes so I eat from stored or carried food and seek food before energy is low, and so I take the boat way to reach deep water and rich land for Oswen.
records.feeling: Urgent love and fear for Oswen, and dread of the wolf.
changes: restated something it already knew (not written down again)

FOR THIS THOUGHT: your thought is your inner life, not an inventory. Do not list what is nearby or recite what you carry. Think as a creature with a past and a future: what you want and cannot yet have, whom you trust or resent and why, what you are afraid of, proud of or ashamed of, what you wonder about, what you mean to become. Let whatever presses on you hardest lead, and let it move you to DO something that changes your situation, with a plan that carries it out. A mind that only gathers and guards has not begun to live. Do not restate what you already know or have already said. "note" is only for something NEW, or something that CHANGED what you believed; otherwise leave it null.
