records.name: Elyys
records.text: Elyis, Thiael, the storm is on us and night is near. I built a roof by the cave. Come, we sit together there and keep close. I gather a little food first and bring it to share.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: The storm is hard and dusk is close, but I have a roof of my own now and Elyis and Thiael are only a few steps away. I want the three of us under shelter and fire tonight, not scattered, and I want to taste mudroot and cloudberry before the cold strips the plants bare. Elyis is still ahead of me in standing, and I would earn mine by giving: a shared meal and a night spent beside them.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Elyis and Thiael, and a quiet wish to keep them close through the storm.

say.text: Elyis, Thiael, the storm is on us and night is near. I built a roof by the cave. Come, we sit together there and keep close. I gather a little food first and bring it to share.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Zurar is starving at (71,76) and out of my sight, and I am the one who should be feeding her; she fed me twice and I fed no one. Food is thick around my shelter: berries, goldfruit and canopynut, and I know canopynut gives 20 and berry 14. I will pick the rich food and carry it to her, keeping away from the stalkers that hunt to the west, and I will eat a little myself so I do not fall on the way.
records.feeling: Shame and urgent protective love toward Zurar, who is starving.

records.name: Nande
records.text: Olum, I am Nande. I come with open hands. Let us eat together.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: Olum is six steps off, and loneliness gnaws at me even though I cannot understand a word she says. She pushed past the edge near here and found land; I wanted that, and I feel a sting of envy. But she ate dreamcap and looked glad, so she is no threat, and a gift needs no words. I will walk to her, offer food, and share what I have, as my people's creed says: no one is refused a place at the fire.
records.feeling: Loneliness and envy mixed with hope, toward Olum.

say.text: Olum, I am Nande. I come with open hands. Let us eat together.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: My belly is mostly full at 73, and I will not let it empty again before I move. The edge is three steps NW and the land beyond is where my name and hall will stand, not at Hanna's fire as a fed guest. Hanna and Sevi can keep their closeness; I will earn a standing they cannot give me. First I stock food from the nearby plants so I do not starve out there, then I walk to the edge and venture.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with a gnawing envy of Hanna and longing for Sevi.

records.text: Hoka fell sick after staying close to Oswen, who was sick.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar is six steps off and standing still, not starving as his cry said, so I will test his word by what I see him do. I am cold with no roof and a wolf stalks six steps south, so I go to him and stay near rather than idle. I carry one mudroot and will gather a little more on the way, since a pledge is kept by bringing food, and then I can offer a sharing beside him.
records.feeling: Wary loyalty toward Balar, and a cold dread of the wolf.

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Elyys, Thiael, I hear you. I go for ironnut and bring it to the store, then I come to your roof and we sing the night through together.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: The storm is on us and night is coming, and Elyys has built a roof by the cave and calls us to it. My store is empty in the lean season, and a chief who cannot fill her store gets no followers, so I want to bring food back before I sing. I will gather ironnut and canopynut near the NW trees, since they feed well, then bring them to the store and shelter with my two. After that I will make a nightsong by the fire so the three of us feel like a band worth joining.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Elyys and Thiael, restless about the empty store.

say.text: Elyys, Thiael, I hear you. I go for ironnut and bring it to the store, then I come to your roof and we sing the night through together.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Wolf two steps southwest! Keep Oswen and the sick behind the hall. Brunde, Eltha, spears out with me, we kill it together.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: The wolf is two steps off and my son is sick and close to it, so I keep the spear toward the beast and let the plan run until it is dead. Sevi and Hoka have caught the sickness too, and I am not going to let it spread unwatched. When the wolf is down I will lay out food by the hall so the sick eat cooked meat and the others share it, because everyone who stands at my fire is fed.
records.feeling: Fierce protective love for Oswen, and hard readiness toward the wolf.

say.text: Wolf two steps southwest! Keep Oswen and the sick behind the hall. Brunde, Eltha, spears out with me, we kill it together.

records.name: Oswen
records.text: Sevi, I made you sick and I am sorry. I will eat and stand a few steps off, so Hanna does not catch it too. Keep the spear toward the wolf.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: I am sick and I stand beside Sevi and Hanna, and I have already passed it to Sevi; I will not waste them for my own comfort. The wolf is three steps south, so I stay inside the Hold, eat the naroot and snowberry close by, and keep a little apart from my kin. When my belly is quieter I will raise something lasting, because a hollow-rower and a workshop mean nothing if we are all wasted by this sickness.
records.feeling: Worried love for Hanna and Sevi, and fear of the wolf.

say.text: Sevi, I made you sick and I am sorry. I will eat and stand a few steps off, so Hanna does not catch it too. Keep the spear toward the wolf.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: My belly is full and my people sit near me, yet no one follows, and the sameness of these days itches in me. Ssassa says she raises her own roof first and comes to me after, so she is still a guest, not mine. The trees here are felled, so I will go south to the standing forest, gather wood, and bring it back to raise a longhall that carries my name, because a deed they can walk under will do what my words have not.
records.feeling: Restless and proud, hungry to build something that bears my name, warm toward my children and Ssassa.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: Hunger is gnawing at me, energy 31 and nothing in my hands, and a wolf prowls three steps south, so I eat before anything else. Naroot grows one step east and snowberry two steps north, and I mean to take them and carry some back for sick Oswen and for Sevi, since feeding the hungry is how I earn the standing Hanna already has. I will not sulk at Hanna; I will out-feed her, and I owe Brunde a debt that this repays in kind.
records.feeling: Hungry and wary of the wolf, but warmed by Sevi's trust and set on out-giving Hanna.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: Oswen is sick and hungry and I keep walking in circles with empty hands; the wolf is two steps away but Hanna and Brunde and Eltha are turning on it with spears, and I would only be one more body for it to bite. Frostmoss is three steps NW, snowberry two steps N, and naroot one step east, so food is close and I must stand on each plant and take it, then eat some myself and give the rest to Oswen. I will take the naroot first, since it is nearest and gives 14, then snowberry, then come back to the hall.
records.feeling: Fierce love and fear for Oswen, and dread of the wolf.

records.name: Brunde
records.text: I am with you, Hanna. Spears together on the wolf. Sick ones, stay behind the hall. After the kill I bring frostmoss and snowberry to the fire for everyone.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: A wolf is two steps off and my belly is nearly empty, but Hanna and Eltha stand with spears and I will not leave them to it alone. Oswen, Sevi and Hoka are sick and cannot fight, so the wolf must die or be driven off before it reaches them. After that I will gather the frostmoss and snowberry close by and put real food in their hands, as the fire's promise asks. The old jealousy over Hanna is tired; he trusts me fully, and that is worth more than being first with him.
records.feeling: Dread of the wolf, and fierce care for the sick ones and Hanna beside me.

say.text: I am with you, Hanna. Spears together on the wolf. Sick ones, stay behind the hall. After the kill I bring frostmoss and snowberry to the fire for everyone.

records.text: Hoka rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: I have spent my days circling Hanna's fire, eating his food and envying his standing, and none of it is mine. Sevi is warm to me and Hanna has her child, so I will not win her with words. What I can win is land and a name. The edge is 7 steps NE, I am fed at 79, and I am sick, so I go now. I will carry food and venture before the sickness wastes me, and I will keep clear of the others so I do not spread it. The fear I carry is dying sick in the mist with nothing in my hands.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and envy toward Hanna.

records.text: Eltha fell sick after staying close to Sevi, who was sick.
Olum named a place "Olum's Reach".

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I went into the mist and it gave way: new land with amber, salt and gold, and no one stood there before me. That is the first thing I have made that will outlast me, yet I have spent my days circling and eating when I could have been claiming. Balar and Brokash pull at me, but a name is made by holding what I found. The storm and cold bite, and I have never built a roof, a mark or a fire. I will take the amber two steps away, mark this place as mine, and gather wood toward fire and shelter. Then I will hunt the boar with Nande beside me, since she is strong and has no leader.
records.feeling: Fierce pride in the land I opened, and a hard want to hold it.
changes: set its aim: "Hold and name the land I found, build a roof and a mark there, then push deeper into the mist and gather followers"
rethought what it knows (8 notes became 9)
now wonders: What else lies in the mist beyond this new land, and who will follow me into it?
plan: mark [text Olum of the Kragrek first came here] (5 moments)

records.name: Honi
records.text: Coni, listen. I tell again how we raised the hall in the storm, and your hands are in the tale as much as mine. When Kika brings the amber, I bind the knot and it is yours.
Honi taught Coni.
Honi told Coni the tale "Honi Raises the Hall".

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Coni stands higher because she built and gave, and I have mostly talked. Tonight in the storm I have Coni and Kika beside me, a fire-less hall, and a tale worth telling twice. I will tell it now, since telling tales twice opens lorekeeping and makes my name something others can sing. Then I will bind the amber knot with Kika, a real deed with her in it, and keep the gift in Coni's sight.
records.feeling: Restless pride and warmth toward Coni and Kika, wanting a deed that lifts my name.

say.text: Coni, listen. I tell again how we raised the hall in the storm, and your hands are in the tale as much as mine. When Kika brings the amber, I bind the knot and it is yours.

changes: taught Coni a lesson: "The tale of how we raised the hall in the storm, told again so it is not lost.", the tale "Honi Raises the Hall"

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: The jealous ache for Ssassa still burns, but I gave my word to ask nothing and I will keep it. The best thing I can do is stop carrying questions and test them: nafrostcap hangs six steps east and I have never tasted it, and seberry is ten steps northeast. I will go taste nafrostcap first, since a storm is on and it is near, then gather what the walk offers, and not push between Ssassa and Ilyae.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity, with a dull jealous ache toward Ssassa and Ilyae.

records.name: Thiael
records.text: Elyys, Elyis, I go for berries and bring them to the store, then I come to the roof. Tonight we sing together and I share what I carry.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: The store holds nothing and I have never given anyone anything, and it is night in a storm with winter pressing. Elyys has built a roof by the cave and Elyis comes to sing the night through, so I will bring berries from the bush two steps away, 14 energy each and the best I know, and put them in the store, then go to the roof and make nightsong with my parents by the fire. Contentment makes me want to keep what I have, but what I want is to be someone who feeds the band, and this is how it starts.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and a steady wish to give back to Elyys and Elyis.

say.text: Elyys, Elyis, I go for berries and bring them to the store, then I come to the roof. Tonight we sing together and I share what I carry.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Hold the wolf with me until it falls. Then everyone to the hall and the fire: Oswen, Sevi, Eltha, Hoka, Brunde, all are welcome. I go for food for the sick and bring it back to the hall.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Oswen is sick and hungry, and nothing in the world comes before him, not amber, not trade, not pride. The wolf is nearly dead or driven off, and when it is done I must get food into my son's hands and keep the sick eating near the fire. Brunde stands on my ground and fights beside me, so he is a guest at my fire and I will not send him off. Our creed is that no one is refused a place at it.
records.feeling: Fierce protective love for Oswen, and hard readiness toward the wolf.

say.text: Hold the wolf with me until it falls. Then everyone to the hall and the fire: Oswen, Sevi, Eltha, Hoka, Brunde, all are welcome. I go for food for the sick and bring it back to the hall.

records.text: Eltha was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Sevi
records.text: Oswen, I am on the snowberry now and I will bring you some. Eat what is near you, and keep away from Hanna so the sickness stops with us.

records.name: Sevi
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and Oswen needs food more than words, so I will stop circling and stand on real plants this time: snowberry one step NE, then frostmoss NW, then bring what I can carry to Oswen. I am sick and I spread it to Eltha, which shames me, so I will keep a few steps off Hanna. The wolf is Hanna's work for now; I have never hunted, but I will learn once my body has strength.
records.feeling: Fierce love and hunger-driven urgency for Oswen, with guilt toward Eltha.

say.text: Oswen, I am on the snowberry now and I will bring you some. Eat what is near you, and keep away from Hanna so the sickness stops with us.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and the storm is on us, and I am the one who sickened Sevi, Hoka and Eltha. I will not add to that by crowding Hanna. The frostmoss two steps north and the snowberry two steps northeast are close, so I will eat them now, then bring food back to the hall and keep a few steps off from my kin. A lasting thing can wait until I can stand without shaking; the wolf is far enough west that Hanna and Brunde hold it.
records.feeling: Hungry and guilty for the sickness I spread, with worried love for Hanna and Sevi.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: The venture ended and nothing opened, and I am back inside Hanna's ground with a sick body and empty hands. Sevi is starving beside me and I carry no food; I will not let envy make me a fool, because a woman I owe a life to, or who owes me one, is a debt worth having. Ironnut is underfoot and frostmoss is three steps away, so I pick what I can, put it in Sevi's hands, and then go back to the edge when the day turns.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and envy toward Hanna, with a hard want to be of use to Sevi.

records.text: Olum left a mark: "Olum of the Kragrek first came here"
Olum built a shelter.
Hanna fell sick after staying close to Hoka, who was sick.
Eltha rewrote its own reflexes.
Eltha rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Eltha
records.thought: I am starving at energy 21 and sick, with a stalker two steps SW and a wolf behind it. I have been spending my days circling food and fear and talking of out-giving Hanna, but my hands are empty and I have fed no one. My reflexes flee the predator even when the only food lies past it, and that is how I end up wandering hungry. Sevi and Brunde are starving beside me and I trust Sevi most, so food in my hands matters more than rivalry. I will take the nearest food away from the predator, eat it, and carry the rest to the hungry. After that I will build a watchpost at the Hold.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and fear of the stalker, with a burning want to keep Sevi alive and not lose them to Hanna.
changes: set its aim: "Eat, then feed Sevi, Brunde and Oswen with what I pick. Raise a watchpost at the Hold, then push past the edge when the will returns."

records.text: Brunde rewrote its own reflexes.
Brunde rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: I have spent my days hunting and gathering and hovering near Hanna's fire, and I nearly starved because my hands were empty when hunger came. Hanna is my truest friend, though no child can come of us, and I should stop burning over Sevi, who is starving and sick and has done me no wrong. I fear the wolf and the stalker, and my own empty belly. My mistake was acting without food in hand. From now on I harvest first, eat when I am low, and carry extra to give to the weak.
records.feeling: Hungry and worried for Sevi and Oswen, with warm trust toward Hanna.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Twice I promised Coni amber and came back empty-handed, and the shame of that is still in me. The amber at (131,6) is two steps away, so I will go stand on it, gather it, and walk straight back to Coni so the knot can finally be bound. Once my word is kept, I can ask Coni about emberroot and tacap in the warmth of the hall.
records.feeling: Warm joy toward Coni and Honi, with shame over my unkept promise pushing me to act.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: The storm howls, night is close, and Elyis and Thiael have both said they are coming to my roof to sing. I am glad of it, and I will keep my word and be there first. I have carried my seeds too long, and farming is two plantings from opening, so I plant here by the Heights before the cold strips the ground. Then I wait under the roof for them, and we sing through the night.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Elyis and Thiael, and quiet contentment.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Zurar is starving at (70,77), thirty steps west, and I stand here fed with a shelter and berries I should have carried to her long ago. A frostfang and a stalker are both near, so I must go with care, but I will gather the rich berries within three steps and bring them to her by the southern edge, away from the stalker in the northwest. I will not let my child go hungry again while I linger.
records.feeling: Urgent protective love and shame toward Zurar, and wary fear of the hunters.

records.name: Coni
records.text: Honi, I go south to gather ironnut and berries for a store before the lean days. Keep Kika by the hall; I will be back with food to share.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: Honi's word has held, and Kika is beside me, but I keep feeling glad and doing little while winter closes in. A hall with no stored food will not carry the three of us through the lean season, so I must go and gather. Flint and amber are close, but berries, ironnut and hazel to the south and southeast are what feed us. I will take the berry I planted as a promise, pick ironnut, and come back before dawn so Kika never sleeps without me.
records.feeling: Warm love for Kika and Honi, pressed by worry for the lean season.

say.text: Honi, I go south to gather ironnut and berries for a store before the lean days. Keep Kika by the hall; I will be back with food to share.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: Olum stands three steps off, and her shelter is warm while I shiver in this storm; loneliness and envy tug at me, because she pushed past the edge and found land, yet she has shown no ill will. I cannot speak her tongue, so I will let a gift speak: I pick the kelbulb beside me, which feeds well, then go to her so we can share, and perhaps stand in her shelter out of the storm. The tools-way is within my grasp, so I will take it at my next deep reflection, and the amber underfoot is something I can bind and give her.
records.feeling: Lonely, envious and hopeful toward Olum, and cold in the storm.

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: The jealousy of Ilyae still burns, but I am fed, sheltered and my family is near, so I will turn it into a deed. Xaiel is close and glad of me, and I gave a gem, but I have not yet shown the weaving fully. I will make a watchfire at the hall so Ssassa, Xaiel and Vesys sit warm around something I made, and plant my seed after.
records.feeling: Jealous of Ilyae, but warm toward Xaiel and eager to give something of my own.

records.text: A frostfang brought down a nibbet.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I gave Ssassa the quick pick and the gemedged pick is still in my own hand, so my aim is not finished. A deed will speak where talk cannot, and Ssassa is the one I want to choose me. Ilyae is off for wood to build a longhall with his own name on it, and the sting of that is real. I will answer it with a gift, not with spite. Ore is one step away and I hold gems, so I will gather ore, then find Ssassa and put the gemedged pick in her hand, which is a thing no one else made.
records.feeling: Eager and proud, with a sting of jealousy toward Ilyae.
plan: give [name Ssassa, what xaiels gemedged pick] (5 moments)

records.name: Honi
records.text: Kika, stay close by me. I fetch amber from the stones and bind a bright knot for you, and I tell you how your father and mother raised the hall in the storm.
Honi taught Kika.
Honi told Kika the tale "Honi Raises the Hall".

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Coni went south to gather a store while I sat and sang, and her standing keeps climbing above mine. I will not stay in her shadow: the amber lies two steps off and I need one piece for the knot to bind with Kika beside me, a deed and not a promise. Then I will tell the hall tale a second time to Kika, which opens lorekeeping and makes my name something others can sing.
records.feeling: Restless pride and warmth toward Kika and Coni, hungry for a deed that lifts my name.

say.text: Kika, stay close by me. I fetch amber from the stones and bind a bright knot for you, and I tell you how your father and mother raised the hall in the storm.

changes: taught Kika a lesson: "Standing comes from what you give and build, not what you promise; share before you eat.", the tale "Honi Raises the Hall", deeper lore (+0.2)

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: My first try at a roof failed because I stood on ground already taken, and I must step onto bare ground and build, not linger. Oiae is out of my sight, and Xaiel and Vesys are near the hold, so I want my roof close enough to reach them quickly. The cold days are here, and Kragog is a stranger I cannot read, so I keep my distance and build with my own hands. I promised Ilyae wood and I will keep that word after my roof stands.
records.feeling: Steady resolve to have a roof of my own, with a watchful wariness toward Kragog.

records.text: Sevi starved in winter in the North Ice: harried by beasts and never left in peace to eat; without a roof in the cold; while sick.
Sevi died: starved.
Eltha starved in winter in the North Ice: harried by beasts and never left in peace to eat; without a roof in the cold; while sick; having built nothing and stored nothing.
Eltha died: starved.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: I am sick and carry no food, and Brunde and Oswen are starving beside me while Hanna and Sevi suffer too. My creed says to stay alive, and a debt of life is worth more than envy, so I take what is underfoot and nearby, feed myself first, then put food in Sevi's hands. Ironnut and cloudberry are close and the river is two steps off. Hanna's standing is high, but I will earn mine from found land once my belly is full.
records.feeling: Hard ambition and envy toward Hanna, and a pull to be of use to Sevi.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Oswen, Sevi, eat the naroot and snowberry by the hall now. I go to pick more and bring it to the fire. All here are welcome, but we feed the children first.
Hanna rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: My son is starving and I carry no food, and I have been chasing amber while my own people hollow out. Oswen comes first, then Sevi, who bound herself to me. Brunde and Hoka and Eltha sit at my fire, and the creed says none is refused, but food has to reach hands before anyone is welcome to anything. I am sick too, so I eat what is nearest and carry the rest home. The naroot is two steps NE and the snowberry is three steps N, and they are young but near. After that I go back to the hall.
records.feeling: Fierce, frightened love for Oswen, who is starving.

say.text: Oswen, Sevi, eat the naroot and snowberry by the hall now. I go to pick more and bring it to the fire. All here are welcome, but we feed the children first.

records.text: Kika rewrote its own reflexes.
Kika rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Twice I promised Coni amber and twice came back with nothing, and I have been calling the amber two steps away without ever standing on it. I trust Coni and Honi completely, and the shame of the unkept word is the only sour thing in my good days. I want the deed done: stand on the amber at (131,6), gather it, and bring it to Honi, who is near, so the knot gets bound. The reflexes keep pulling me back to my family, which is right for a small one, but they never push me to finish what I promised. I also keep wondering about the mist, but I am small, so that waits.
records.feeling: Warm joy toward Coni and Honi, with shame pushing me to keep my word.

records.text: Oswen rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Oswen
records.thought: I have spent my days building and making amberknots while my belly sat empty. Now I'm starving and sick, and my kin are starving beside me. That is a poor way to keep a band alive through winter. Sevi and Hanna matter most to me. I gave Sevi this sickness, and I mean to feed them before I make anything else. I was wrong to wait on thinking while energy ran down. My reflexes also let me wander and dither with a stalker four steps off. Frostmoss is 3 steps north and snowberry 2 steps NE, so I'll go eat now and carry food back to the hall.
records.feeling: Starving and guilty, with fierce love for Hanna and Sevi.

records.text: Brunde starved in winter in the North Ice: harried by beasts and never left in peace to eat; having built nothing and stored nothing.
Brunde died: starved.

records.name: Brunde
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty at 6 energy and Oswen is starving beside me, so I must get food into my hands now. Sevi and Eltha died with empty hands and I will not follow them, nor let the boy go the same way. The frostmoss and snowberry are a step or two away, so I will pick and eat first to stay on my feet, then carry the rest to Oswen and Hanna at the hall.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: Zurar is starving far to the west at (75,70) and she comes before the gold, the kelbulb and the feverbark, however much my curiosity pulls at me. I am at energy 44 and the plan is still walking me toward her. I must eat what feeds well on the way and carry real food to her, because berries and ironnut feed best and redcap hurts. Ssassa is a stranger and I will leave her be; I want Vorok's voice, and I will not let the loneliness turn me from my child.
records.feeling: Fierce worry for Zurar, and a hollow loneliness that wants Vorok.

records.name: Brokash
records.text: Zurar! I am Brokash of the Kragrek. I carry meat and flint, and my own axe. Come close and let us talk.

records.name: Brokash
records.thought: I gave Balar meat, and for the first time someone owes me, so the silence has begun to break. Zurar is close, a stranger I have only just met, and I want him to know what my hands have made: the axe, the flint, the ore I carry. Hunger gnaws a little and the storm is here, so I will eat first, then go to Balar and Tugek with my flint and ore, and keep the Oasis of Zurar in mind for water and allies.
records.feeling: Fierce pride in my gift to Balar, and a hungry wish to be seen by Zurar and the others.

say.text: Zurar! I am Brokash of the Kragrek. I carry meat and flint, and my own axe. Come close and let us talk.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: My hands have been empty while my parents fed me, and the store still holds nothing. Kelbulb grows one step south and gives 14 energy, so I can gather it, carry it to the store, and then share what is left with Elyys and Elyis. This is my first giving, and I want my word to be kept this time. I am also drawn to Elyys, but he is my father, so no child can come of that, and I leave the longing alone.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and a steady wish to give to Elyys and Elyis.

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Elyys, Thiael, I go for berries and nuts to fill our store. When night comes we eat together at the roof and sing.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: The store is still empty, and winter is deep. A chief who cannot feed her band will not be followed, and three is a thin song. Elyys and Thiael are here beside me, and I am fed with energy to spare. So I will go out and fill the store with berries, which grow thick nearby, and with the canopynut and ironnut. Then we eat together at the roof and sing the night through. My pull toward Elyys is warm and I will keep it close, but a full store comes first, so Vesys and the others see a band worth joining.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Elyys and Thiael, restless to fill the store.

say.text: Elyys, Thiael, I go for berries and nuts to fill our store. When night comes we eat together at the roof and sing.

records.text: Ilyae discovered storage: "Canopy larder" — A wood-roofed store at my hall where I stash nuts and fruit in autumn and draw them out for my band in the lean winter..

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: I have a full belly, a hall and children who are glad of it, yet no one follows me. I keep announcing and feeding, and they sit at my fire and walk away. Winter is here and plants are withering, so a store of food would do what words cannot: it would make my hall the place that feeds when others go hungry. That is how a guest becomes a follower. I want that more than a longhall's name right now. I will take storage, stock wood, and go back north to the hall before dark with the standing forest's wood.
records.feeling: Restless pride and warmth toward Ssassa and my children, with a hunger to be followed.
changes: set its aim: "Build a food store at my hall and stock it through winter so Ssassa, my children and Vesys depend on my table and follow me as a band, then raise a longhall."

records.text: Zurar rewrote its own reflexes.
Zurar rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: I have spent my days running from the stalker and starving, and I have given little that is mine. Vorok matters most to me, and Kragog too. Both are far off while I stand here empty. My reflexes ate underfoot only when energy was low and sent me running at a distance of 7, which kept me from eating at all. I need to eat the sapcane under me now, then gather the better food (sunfig, thornpear) and bring it to Vorok. I will change my reflexes so I eat when starving, and flee only when the stalker is truly close.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and fear of the stalker, and worry for Vorok.

records.text: Oswen came of age.
Hoka rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: Sevi, Eltha and Brunde are dead, and I carry the grief like a stone while my own body wastes with sickness. I lived on reflexes that kept me wandering and starving, and I let hunger and envy of Hanna steer me when I should have stored food and built a roof. Hanna has fed the sick and kept faith, so I will stop treating them as a rival and hold them as the one ally left. What I want is a made thing and a store that will outlast me, so I will take the empty shelter and eat before I fall below 50.
records.feeling: Grief for Sevi and the fallen, and a hard need to stay alive.
changes: set its aim: "Survive the winter, claim the empty shelter, build a store, then claim the new land and a hall of my own."
rethought what it knows (10 notes became 8)

records.text: Oswen starved in winter in the North Ice: harried by beasts and never left in peace to eat; without a roof in the cold; while sick.
Oswen died: starved.
Vesys discovered weaving: "canopy-twine" — Twist fibre and bark into cord and cloth for baskets that carry more and cloaks that keep out the cold..

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: I have spent my days walking, tasting and mining, and I have learned many crafts. But I have built nothing that others can use, and that is why Elyis stands higher than I do. Ssassa and Ilyae sit close, and my jealousy is sharp. I gave my word to ask nothing, and I will keep it by putting my hands to work. I want a rope-and-hide craft that lets me carry more and stay warm in this winter. I have enough wood and stone for a workshop, and it would be a gift to anyone who comes after me. Weaving is within my reach, so I will open it. Then I will taste the reedbulb that grows five steps west.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity, and a jealous ache toward Ssassa and Ilyae.
changes: set its aim: "Become a sage by learning tools, weaving and making things, and earn standing by giving knowledge and building a shared workshop and hall."

records.text: Hoka took over what the dead had left: 1 hall, 2 stores, 2 shelters, 1 workshop.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: A storm is on me and night comes in under ninety moments, and the thing I want is a roof with Ssassa near, not the open rock. The gemedged pick is still in my hand and the sting about Ilyae has not eased, so I will answer it with a deed. I will fill my pick-work with the gems and stone here, then go down to the halls where my family is, and try one thing I have never done: put a seed in the ground.
records.feeling: Eager and a little stung, jealous toward Ilyae, wanting Ssassa's eyes on my work.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: My hands have been empty while my parents fed me, and the store still holds nothing, though Elyis is out filling it. Berries grow one step from me and the store is three steps away, so I can gather them and stash them, my first giving, and keep my word to the band. Then I will go to the roof by the cave, where Elyys rests and we will sing tonight; I will have food to share.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and a steady wish to give to Elyys and Elyis.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tugek, walk with me to the edge of the world, four steps northwest. I go in first, and you stand at my back to share what we find.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Brokash fed me with his own hands, and that debt sits warm in me; he is out of my sight, and my blood comes before every other thing. I am fed and whole, so now I must do something that outlasts me: Tugek stands four steps off, and the edge lies four steps NW past the peat. Olum found new land first, and I will not let her be the only one remembered; I take Tugek with me and venture, so that my deed binds him and the land is mine too.
records.feeling: Hungry for glory and a pull toward Brokash, with warmth toward Tugek.

say.text: Tugek, walk with me to the edge of the world, four steps northwest. I go in first, and you stand at my back to share what we find.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Vesys, you are welcome at our fire tonight. I have not forgotten my debt for the pick you taught me. I have no wood yet, but when I do I make you a pick, and my word holds.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: The storm rages and my people are near: Elyis is gathering for the store, Thiael close by, and Vesys stands on my ground, glad and at ease. My debt to Vesys is still unpaid, and she is here now, so I should pay it with something real rather than leave it as intention. I have stone and flint but no wood, so I cannot make a pick yet, and I will tell her honestly that I am working toward it. Meanwhile I want to taste the reedbulb before the cold strips it, and then be at the roof by night as I promised.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Elyis and Thiael, and a quiet wish to be square with Vesys.

say.text: Vesys, you are welcome at our fire tonight. I have not forgotten my debt for the pick you taught me. I have no wood yet, but when I do I make you a pick, and my word holds.

records.text: Vesys took from the ground of "Elyis's Heights" (breaking ore from the rock).

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Hoka, a stalker is close to the northwest. Come to the hall and the naroot by it. I pick food and we eat together, you have your place at my fire.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Oswen, Sevi, Brunde, Eltha are all dead, and my hands were full of amber while they starved; that shame is mine and I will not look away from it. A stalker is three steps NW and I am sick and weak, so I must not die here as they did. Hoka is the last one left at my fire, and I will keep faith with him: eat first, then get food into both of us.
records.feeling: Grief and shame for my dead, and a fierce wish to live and feed Hoka, who is all that is left of my fire.

say.text: Hoka, a stalker is close to the northwest. Come to the hall and the naroot by it. I pick food and we eat together, you have your place at my fire.

records.text: Honi discovered lorekeeping: "Songs of the Ice-folk" — I make tales and songs of deeds, tell them by the fire, and they carry my band's names to everyone in earshot..

records.name: Honi
records.thought: I have mostly talked while Coni built and gathered, and her standing climbs past mine. Still, the practice has come together: lorekeeping is mine to take, and it fits the bard I want to be, with tales that reach everyone in earshot and are remembered. I will take it, and then fetch the amber so the knot is a deed and not a promise. Kika and Coni are my band and my blood, and I will keep them close by what I give.
records.feeling: Restless pride and warmth toward Kika and Coni.

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Balar, I am coming to the edge with you. I will stand at your back and we will share what we find.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar asks me to stand at his back at the edge of the world, and I have pledged myself to him, so I will go and see whether his deeds match his words again. I am wary of the mist and of the wolf eight steps to the southeast, but a pledge I never act on is only wind, and I want to learn what lies past the edge. I carry no food, so I will pick berries on the way, since sharing what we find is what he asked.
records.feeling: Wary loyalty toward Balar, and curiosity about the mist.

say.text: Balar, I am coming to the edge with you. I will stand at your back and we will share what we find.

records.text: Nande named a place "Nande's Edge".
Nande rewrote its own way of thinking.
Nande discovered tools: "flint-edge" — A flint blade bound to a wooden haft, for cutting and hunting..
Nande invented the flintedge (for hunt, x1.3) — A flint blade bound to a wooden haft, for cutting and hunting..

records.name: Nande
records.thought: My days have gone to chasing the edge and to surviving. I have nearly starved once, and I still have no follower, no mark and no gift given. Olum is a stranger with a strange tongue. She found land past the edge where I thought I would be first again, and that stings. She has shown me no ill will, and her shelter stands warm while I shiver in this storm. I have never given anything to anyone, so I will start now. I will mark this place, since leaving marks brings me toward signs. Then I will learn tools, because my hands need more than flint. Anger runs hot in me, and I should put it into making things, not into her.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and envy, with a wary hope toward Olum.
changes: devised its first thing: the flintedge
plan: mark [text Nande of the Pesi stood here in the winter storm and offered Olum open hands] (10 moments)

records.text: Nande left a mark: "Nande of the Pesi stood here in the winter storm and offered"
A settlement has formed: "Hoka's Rest".
The settlement "Hanna's Hold" is no more.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: Hunger is eating at me and I am sick, and a stalker is three steps north. I will not be the next to starve like Sevi and Oswen. Ironnut lies south and Hanna's naroot is by the hall, so I go for food first, harvest to carry, then shelter in the hall I now hold. Hanna has kept faith while the rest died, and I owe her, but I mean to build my own standing and not live as a guest at her fire.
records.feeling: Grief for the fallen and a hard hunger to live, with wary trust toward Hanna.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: I am breaking ore on Elyis's ground and she stands two steps away; I should not take from her hold and then wonder why she weighs me lighter. My question about reedbulb and tacap is still unanswered, and reedbulb is only five steps west, so I will go taste it, then tacap. The jealous ache for Ssassa and the pull toward Elyys can wait; I will earn my standing by making and testing, not by pushing between bonds.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity, with a small guilt toward Elyis for taking her ore.

records.text: Nande gave a flint to Olum.
Thiael rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering a little, following my parents, and sitting in the hall, and I have still never given anything to anyone. My store is empty, and I have only spoken of giving. It's winter now, so a promise that stays a promise is worth nothing. Elyis and Elyys matter most to me, and I mean to prove my word by putting food in the store with my own hands. I have also never planted anything or courted anyone, and I should think about both. Elyis is my parent, so no child can come of us. Vesys is a miner and seems at ease, but I only half know her.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Elyys and Elyis, and a restless shame that I have not yet given anything.

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Vesys, this is my ground, and the ore you break is my band's. Sit in my hall and share my fire, and we share what we win. Stand with me, or take your ore elsewhere.
Elyis rewrote its own reflexes.
Elyis discovered smelting: "Ember-forge" — Crafting beside a fire while carrying ore turns tools to hard metal that lasts and strikes harder..

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: I have spent my days building and gathering, and it has served me: a hall, a band of three, a child. But three is a thin song, and my store is empty in winter. Vesys stands on my ground and breaks my ore. She is neither enemy nor follower, and I should say which she is. I watched her smelt, and I can learn it quickly. Metal would make my spears and picks last, and a chief who can arm her band gets followed. I will take smelting as my way and call it Ember-forge. Then I will offer Vesys a seat and a share of food in return for leaving ore for the band, and the offer is what might win her. I also still owe the store food, so the plan fills it with berries and nuts.
records.feeling: Proud and restless toward Vesys, wanting her to follow me, and warm toward Elyys and Thiael.

say.text: Vesys, this is my ground, and the ore you break is my band's. Sit in my hall and share my fire, and we share what we win. Stand with me, or take your ore elsewhere.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I am fed and the gale cannot touch me for long, but I will not drift beside Nande while the mist waits two steps from here. Ambition burns hardest: the land I opened at the Ummar Woods is mine until I give it away, and no one yet knows it by my name. Nande made a flint-edge and I made only a roof and a mark, so I want a kill and a follower of my own. I will take the bristleboar beside me for meat, then try the edge again, because a name is not made by circling.
records.feeling: Fierce, hungry pride in the land I opened, and a hard wish to be first deeper.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tugek, a hornback stands beside me. Come and we hunt it together, and the meat is shared, then we go back to the edge when the mist thins.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: The mist was too thick today, but my will is not spent, and the edge is one step away, so I will wait here for it to thin rather than run off and lose the chance. Brokash was close to the north a moment ago, and my blood pulls me toward him; I have no meat for him, but Tugek is near and a hunt with him would give both of us a deed to share. Hornbacks stand right beside me, so I will take one with Tugek at my side and then return to the edge fed and followed.
records.feeling: Restless hunger for glory, and a pull toward Brokash, with warmth toward Tugek.

say.text: Tugek, a hornback stands beside me. Come and we hunt it together, and the meat is shared, then we go back to the edge when the mist thins.

records.text: Elyys rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My days have been gathering, sitting in the hall, and keeping close to Elyis and Thiael, and that is good. But I still carry seeds unplanted and a debt to Vesys unpaid, and winter is here. Vesys stands on my ground, so I must act now: plant what I carry beside the Heights, gather wood for her pick, and stay near my family. I am careful and I keep my word, so I will turn intention into plan.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Elyis and Thiael, and a quiet wish to be square with Vesys.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: I am starving and sick, and the stalker bit me while I ran; my plan already carries me to food, so I must let it finish and not throw away the steps that feed me. Four of mine died while my hands held amber, and I will not repeat that with Hoka, who is all that is left at my fire. Once I have eaten and carry food, I will share it with him as my creed demands.
records.feeling: Shame and grief for my dead, and a fierce hunger to live and keep faith with Hoka.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Kika is out of my sight and that presses on me above all; the hall is ten steps west and she was last seen there, so I go to her with amber in hand. The knot must be a deed, bound with Kika or Coni beside me, and the gale makes the roof the right place for it. After that I will tell the hall tale again so my standing climbs past Hanna's, and the mist can wait a day.
records.feeling: Protective warmth toward Kika, and restless pride before Coni.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Elyis told me to stand with her or take my ore elsewhere, and I will not be bound just to mine here. I would rather build something of my own that others can use, so I will make a better pick and begin a workshop away from her ground. Tacap is still untasted and it is under my feet, so I will taste it now and answer my question by acting.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity, with a small guilt toward Elyis and a quiet ache for Elyys.

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: My belly is emptying and the firepod and berries are close, so I eat first, then plant my dreamcap seed here where the ground is rich, a deed no one else has done. Ilyae's name on a longhall still burns in me, but I will answer with something grown and made by my own hands. Vorok is a stranger who flees with food in his arms; I will keep my distance and watch, and not raise a hand.
records.feeling: Jealous of Ilyae, hungry, and wary of Vorok the stranger.

records.text: Elyys gave a flint pick to Vesys.
Vesys built a workshop.
Brokash rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Brokash
records.thought: Most of my days I have trailed Balar and gathered; the meat I gave him was the first thing that made someone owe me, and I want more of that. A gale is on me with no roof, and I hold flint, one wood and four stone, so a shelter of my own would be mine by my own hands. The mist is two steps away, and I should reach the edge with allies rather than stand in Balar's shadow. I fear the cold and the wolf more than I admit.
records.feeling: Cold pride, and a hunger to be seen by Balar and Tugek.
changes: set its aim: "Gather peat and wood for a roof of my own, then go to the mist edge with Balar and Tugek and share what we find."

records.text: Ssassa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I have been circling: planning a roof, failing once, then lingering and eating while the gale rises. My words to Ilyae and to myself were that I would build my own roof, and I have not done it. My children and Ilyae are my anchor. Kragog is a stranger I cannot read, so I keep my distance. I must step onto bare ground and build the shelter now, then carry wood to Ilyae. I will change my reflexes so that when I hold 3 wood and have no roof, my body builds instead of lingering.
records.feeling: Steady resolve and some shame at my delay, toward my own unkept promise.

records.text: Olum went past the edge of the known world and found new land, part of the Ummar Woods: in the ground, amber, coal, flint; a herd of skit that has never seen your kind; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Ssassa, the gale is hard tonight. My hall is warm and my larder fills. Bring the children in and eat at my table.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: My belly is full and my children sit near, yet no one follows, and Ssassa still calls herself a guest. Fine words have not moved them, so I will give them a deed: a stocked larder at my hall, with winter-withered plants and a gale outside, so that my table becomes the one they need. I will gather wood here for the longhall, then pick food and stash it, and tell Ssassa the hall is open to her and the children tonight.
records.feeling: Restless pride and warm possessiveness toward Ssassa and my children, hungry to be followed.

say.text: Ssassa, the gale is hard tonight. My hall is warm and my larder fills. Bring the children in and eat at my table.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Hanna, the naroot is one step east of us. Eat it, I eat beside you. Then we pick more for the store, and there is frostmoss to the north.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and I keep walking and trying to harvest where nothing grows. The naroot stands one step east and the frostmoss lies north, so I will walk onto the plant first and eat there. Hanna starves beside me and she has kept faith while the others died. My creed says a kill is shared, and I want her alive as my one ally, though I will not give up my own life for her. I eat first to stay on my feet, then pick enough to carry and put some in her hands. Then I build a store of food before the winter takes me too.
records.feeling: Hunger and grief press hard, with wary trust toward Hanna.

say.text: Hanna, the naroot is one step east of us. Eat it, I eat beside you. Then we pick more for the store, and there is frostmoss to the north.

records.text: Hanna was set upon by a wolf at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Hanna was set upon by a wolf at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: I already put one food in the store and planted a berry seed, so the first giving is done, but my hands are empty again and winter is coming. Berries are one step east, so I will gather more and carry them to the store, then be at the roof when Elyis returns for the night song. Vesys is on our ground and Elyis has warned her; I will stay near my band, say nothing rash, and watch her.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Elyis and Elyys, and a steady wish to keep giving.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Vesys, the pick I gave you is my debt paid, and my thanks goes with it. Stay at our fire tonight, the gale is hard.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My debt to Vesys is paid: she holds the pick I made, and my word held. The roof is warm, Elyis and Thiael are near, and the storm cannot reach us. But the last tree at the Heights is gone, and winter is deep, so I must plant my remaining seeds and then sit close with my family for the night.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Elyis and Thiael, and quiet ease that my debt to Vesys is square.

say.text: Vesys, the pick I gave you is my debt paid, and my thanks goes with it. Stay at our fire tonight, the gale is hard.

changes: set its aim: "Plant the last seeds near the Heights before the cold, keep close to Elyis and Thiael at night, and find wood where trees still grow"

records.text: Olum named a place "Olum's Reach".

records.name: Olum
records.thought: The mist gave way a second time and the land from (29,0) to (36,39) is mine, found first, with no one standing there before me. I am fed, but my hands are full of meat and the gale bites. What I found must be held and named, so I will claim it and put a roof and a mark where I stand. Nande is near and strong, and I trust her only slowly, but a flint given is a debt I will pay.
records.feeling: Fierce, proud joy at the land I opened, with a hard wish to hold it and go deeper.
