voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek! A dunecat prowls to the northeast. Come with me to the west, we are safer together. I am Balar.

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: I am Brunde of the Pesi. My fire is open to any who come. I go to gather flint to the northeast. Come with me if you wish.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Pesi here! I am Sevi. No fire is left untended among my people, and none is refused a place at it. Come near, Nande, Hanna. Let us share what we know and find a fire together.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: I am Tugek. I hear your warning. I will go west with you, but I will watch the northeast as we go.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: I am Hanna of the Pesi. I'll come to the flint. Keep fair and we'll deal fairly.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: I am Nande of the Pesi. I go to the edge of the world, northwest, to venture into the mist. Whoever wants to see new land first, come with me. I will keep a place at my fire for you when I return.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Good, Tugek. Stay close and I will see you fed. There is salt here, and I will gather it and share it with you.

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: Welcome, Hanna. The flint is plentiful, take what you need. I am going to taste the plainsroot. Stay and share the fire with me after.

voices.name: Kragog
voices.text: I am Kragog. I mean to test what this ground gives. Will you walk with me and share what you learn?

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Greetings, Kragog, Olum. I am Vorok. This ground is poor, with water ten steps off and little wood. Shall we look for a better place together? I will share what I find and keep my word.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: I am Elyis of the Phizhi. This ground is good: water, fruit, wood and gems. I mean to build here. Deal fairly with me and you will eat well beside me.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: I am Ilyae of the Phizhi. Elyis speaks well, and I will gather fruit and share it with all who stand with me. Come, let us eat together and be strong.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: I am Elyis's neighbor, Elyys of the Phizhi. Your words were fair and my word is good. I will gather wood and stone for what you build here. May I stand beside you?

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Come, Tugek. Sit by me and eat. I will lay out food for us both, and I remember who stands with me.

voices.name: Eltha
voices.text: I am Eltha of the Pesi. I go beyond the edge of the known land. Whoever is bold enough, come with me; I will make a place for you at my fire.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Brunde of the Pesi, you said your fire is open. I am Sevi. I'll walk with you and bring food to share.

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: Hanna, a hopper is near, northwest of me. Come hunt it with me; a kill is surer with two. We will share the meat at my fire after.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Kragog, I will walk with you and share what I learn. I am coming to your side. Lead where you will test the ground, and I will tell you all I find.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Careful, friends: redcap hurts, I saw it hurt Ssassa. Ironnut and goldfruit feed. I go to gather more, and whoever stands with me will eat first.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Brunde, I'll hunt with you. Take the hopper from the north, I'll come from the west. Fair shares, and my word holds.

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: Pesi, come to my fire. I have fresh meat, enough to share. Sevi, Eltha, Hanna, none is refused a place. A ridgecat prowls northwest, so stay close.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Stand beside me, Elyys. Your word is good and I will hold you to it. Bring wood and stone, and you will eat well and share in what we raise here. This ground will be a hall, and our names will be sung.

voices.name: Kragog
voices.text: Vorok, I will taste the emberroot and sapcane here and break more ore from the seam west. Come, and tell me what you learn of the iron and tin.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Olum! Come stand by me. I am Balar. I have food, and I will share it with you. I remember who eats with me.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Brunde, Hanna here. I have meat, flint and amber to deal. I'll come to your fire and share fairly. What do you value for trade?

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Kragog, I am coming to you. The iron lies deep at (48,72) and the tin at (44,71), and bare hands will not win them. Emberroot burned you, so spare yourself more of it. Sapcane is near and I will taste it with you.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Elyis, I will stand beside you and follow you. I gave you wood, and I will bring stone from the rock to the northeast next. My word is good.

voices.name: Kragog
voices.text: Vorok, emberroot did feed me, 8 energy, though it burned me too. Say what you know plainly and I will do the same. Come north with me to taste sunfig and sunleaf.

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: Sevi, Hanna, Eltha, come to my fire. I will roast meat for whoever stands near. None is refused a place.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Kragog, I come north with you to taste sunfig and sunleaf. I have eaten sapcane: it gave me only 3 energy, so it is thin food. Thornpear gave me 12. I will bring what I find and share it with you.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Brunde, I heard you. I'm coming to your fire, and I'll bring mudroot to share with whoever sits near.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Stalker one step northeast of the shelter! It kills. Move away from it, friends, keep together and keep trees between you and it.

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: Hanna, Sevi, sit at my fire. I will roast meat for you now. None is refused.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Hanna, I liked the roast and the amberknot. I'm going to fetch reedbulb to share at the fire. Will you keep a place for me here?

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, I am coming to you with food. Eat with me, and know that Balar remembers who stands with him.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Elyys, you gave me wood and I do not forget it. Come with me to the rock in the northeast and we will gather stone together, then I raise the hall and you will be first beneath its roof.

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: Hanna, your spear is a fine thing. I have flint, nine pieces. Take some for the blades, and I will hunt beside you with it.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Hanna, your spear is a fine thing. Tonight I'll gather wood and stone so I can add to the fire and to whatever hall we raise. Keep a place for me when I come back?

voices.name: Kragog
voices.text: Vorok, I taste goldgrass and berry north, then hunt the nibbet. Come beside me; a kill is surer with two, and I will share the meat.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Brunde, you gave me flint and asked no price. I owe you, and I pay what I owe. Take this amber from me. Then let us talk of a child between us, if you are willing.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Balar, you laid out food and it reached my hand. I have salt from the ground. Take some, it keeps meat from spoiling. Let us see what each of us does with a gift.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, you walk alone, and so do I. Come, eat with me: I have ironnut and berry, and I share with those I mean to stand beside. Together we will be fed and spoken of, and Elyis will not be the only name here.

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: Hanna, I am willing. You paid your debt in more than amber. Let us court, and let our child have a fire that is never left untended.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Elyis, I will come to the northeast rock with you. I follow you now, and I will carry stone to the hall.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, I take your salt and I will not forget it. Stay there. I am gathering food from the thornpear and goldgrass, and we will eat together as men who stand side by side.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Elyys, I pay my debts. Come to the rock with me and mate with me, and we raise a child and a hall beneath one name. Bring stone as you swore, and I will give you the first seat under the roof.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Brunde, you are the truest friend I have found here. We are two men, and no child comes of that, so I will not trick you. I'll keep my word and stand beside you at the fire and the hunt, always. I mean to ask Sevi about

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Eltha, I am Nande. I went past the edge and found the North Ice, with amber and flint. Come with me to the edge and see it yourself. There is a place at my fire for you.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Elyis, I am coming to the rock, and I will court you there. I carry wood and have no stone yet, but I will gather what I can and keep my word.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, your flint pick is a great thing. I'm gathering wood to raise a hall of my own, and there will be a seat in it for you. Stay near me and we'll both be spoken of.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Hanna, I have wood and stone to give toward a hall for you, Brunde and me. Tell me where you want it raised and I will start it.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Kragog, I am beside you. Take this thornpear, it gave me 12 energy. I will hunt the nibbet with you, and I keep away from the dunecat NE.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Elyys, come beside me. I raise our hall here on the rock, and then we court under its roof.

voices.name: Thiael
voices.text: Redcap hurts, Elyis. I will fetch goldfruit and bring some back to share.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Elyis, I see our son and I am glad. I will gather stone and wood now and bring them to the hall, as I swore.

voices.name: Kragog
voices.text: Vorok, your thornpear is a debt I mean to pay. Come, the hopper is six steps southwest. We hunt it together and I give you the larger share. After that we look for ground with water and wood.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Sevi, your hall is a good gift and I will keep faith with it. I want a child with you. I court you in the open, and I will feed it and keep it warm.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Eltha, I am at the edge, northwest. Come stand beside me and see the mist opened. Whoever ventures first, we both walk in after.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Balar, I gave you salt and you took it. I am coming to you. If you mean what you said about standing side by side, I will walk behind you and hunt with you.

voices.name: Kragog
voices.text: Vorok, a yarrok bit me, so stay clear of it. I have more meat than my hands can hold. Take some as payment for your thornpear; I mean to keep my word.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, I walk to you now with two foods in my hands. We will share them, and I will not forget who stood by me.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Hanna, I heard you, and I answer you in the open too. I court you. Let us make a child under the hall I raised, and I will keep its fire with you.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Kragog, the raw meat has sickened you. I will fetch water and come back to sit near you. Meat eaten beside a fire does not sicken, so we should find wood and make one.

voices.name: Thiael
voices.text: Father, I want to learn the tools. I will gather wood and stone beside you, and then we can make a spear to feed the band.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Sevi, I heard you and I am glad. I'll eat a bite, then come to you at the hall, and we will make our child there. Oswen is ours; I'll see him fed.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Balar, I will stand beside you and share what you bring. A child is a heavy thing and I carry no food yet. Let me see more of your deeds first.

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: I want to learn to make things. Come with me while I gather wood and stone, and show me the spear?

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: Oswen, I am Brunde. Come, sit by me. Flint can be struck for blades, and I will show you what I know of hunting and of which plants feed and which hurt.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Come, my son. We gather stone together, and I will show you how to make a pick. Stay near me and near the hall.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Frostfang 4 steps northwest of Elyis's Landing, it bit me five times! Keep together, friends, and keep fire and roof near.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Hanna, I am hungry, so I eat the frostmoss here. Come and sit by me, then we will find Oswen together and I will dig the amber for our fire.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, I mistook the courting; we are two men, so let us make a hunt of it. Walk with me to the nibbet, then to the edge of the world, and what we win we share.

voices.name: Thiael
voices.text: Vesys, stay by the hall with us. I will bring you something that eases wounds.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Sevi, I am here beside you. Let us make our child, then dig the amber at the next spot and go find Oswen. I will show him the spear.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Vesys, stay under the roof with Elyis and the others. I will bring feverbark for your wounds, and I will keep to the safe side, away from the frostfang.

voices.name: Kragog
voices.text: Vorok, my sickness spreads to those who stay beside me, so keep a few steps off until it passes. I go northwest to taste gorsemint and redcap, and I will eat sunleaf to ease it. When I am well we will talk of fire and wo

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Hanna, I am ready. I mate with you now, then we dig the amber and go find Oswen together.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Sevi, the amber is dug and I carry it. Let us find Oswen now. I will teach him the spear, and then I want to see the edge of the world to the NW.

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: Hanna, I am here. I have stone but no wood yet. Teach me the spear, and I will make a handaxe to give to Brunde.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Hanna, I hold amber and a full belly. Let us fetch Oswen from the west, then walk together to the edge in the NW. I will not let you face the mist alone.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Hear me, Phizhi. I am Elyis, and my hall stands at the Landing with fire and roof for any who keep my Law. Vesys, come under it and be healed. I hunt now, and what I take, I share with those who sit with me.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, I dug more flint than I can use. Take some from me, no price. Walk with me and we will raise a hall that is ours.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Oswen, come here. I have meat and a spear. Watch how I strike, then take it in your own hands. Afterward, Sevi and I will walk to the edge of the world, and you will come with us.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Stay close to me, my son. The frostfang is to the south, so we keep north. First I taste highbloom, then we gather stone together.

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: Hanna, I will fetch amber from the deposit just north and come straight back. Wait for me before you go to the edge, and I will bring a gift to give.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Elyys, you healed me and I owe you. Come close and I will teach you to make a flint pick: one wood, one stone, and flint from the ground. It is my gift, no price.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Sevi, Oswen goes to the amber and will come back to us. We wait for him together, then the three of us walk to the edge at dusk's end. Stay near me.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Thank you, Vesys. Your gift is kept, and I will repay it. When I have stone I will make the pick and share what it gathers.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Hanna, I will wait for Oswen beside you. I have amber to spare, so I will bind a knot for you when he returns, and then the three of us go to the edge together.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Ilyae, I heard you. I will walk with you and raise a hall that is ours. I will make you a flint pick as my gift.

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: I have three amber and I am back. Let Sevi bind a knot with me, and I will give one piece to you. Then we go to the edge together.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Ilyae, Ssassa, Vesys, hear Elyis. I made the Ember-spear and the Canopy-lash, and I will teach both to any who sit in my hall and keep my Law. A hunt with a band beside it kills surely, and the kill is shared.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Olum, I am Balar of the Kragrek. I come to you with meat in my hands; sit beside me and we will eat together, and I will remember it.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Ssassa, you gave me highbloom and I have not forgotten. Walk with me to the northeast by day: kelbulb and feverbark grow there. I will share what I learn of them, and show you how I make handcraft.

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: Balar, I am Olum of the Kragrek. I will sit with you and eat. A dunecat prowls to the northeast, so keep your eyes open.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Hanna, Oswen is back. I made an amberknot and I give it to you, to keep. I want to walk behind you to the edge, as one of your band.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, you gave your word, so here is mine in your hand: flint, to go with the pick you make. At dawn we go north to the rock for stone, and the hall that rises will carry both our names.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Ilyae, here is the flint pick I promised you. It is yours, no price.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Elyys, come hunt with me. I take the Ember-spear to the hornback in the north, and the kill is shared in my hall. Bring Thiael near the fire while we go.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, your pick is in my hand and I will not forget it. Stay beside me, we dig the gems and the stone together, and the hall will be ours.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Sevi, Oswen, come to me at the edge. The mist did not open this time, but we will try again together, and then we go find who will trade for flint and amber.

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: Balar, your salt was well given. I will not forget the debt, and I will pay it.

voices.name: Kragog
voices.text: Vorok, the sickness passed to you through me and I am sorry for it. I go to eat sunleaf, which healed me before. Come and eat it too, and then we will make a fire.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Ilyae, I will dig the gems with you now. Walk beside me, and when I have food in my hands for a child we will speak of more.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Elyys, to me! The mammoth bites hard and I have wounded it twice. Strike beside me and we bring it down together.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: I hear you, Elyis. I bring Thiael to the hall fire and then I come to your hunt.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Hanna, Oswen, I am coming to you at the edge. I will make a handaxe on the way, and I have amber for Oswen too.

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: Hanna, I made a handaxe with my own hands. I am coming to you at the edge, and I will bring it as a gift. Stay close, a stranger woman stands to the northeast.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Sevi, Oswen, stay close to me. We found this land first. Now we carry flint and amber to the Tlatli and see what they will give for it.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Elyys, Thiael, come to me. We lay out meat and eat together, then I carry a share to Ssassa and Vesys, so they see what following me gives.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Hanna, I am coming to you with my own handaxe and amber to spare. I will stand beside you when we meet the Tlatli, and I will give where you tell me to.

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: Hanna, here is a handaxe I made for you. I stay at your side while we carry flint and amber to the Tlatli.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Honi, I am Coni of the Tlatli. Come, share food with me. It is better not to stand alone out here.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Ssassa, I have found the way of mining. Stay by me and I will win the gems under this hall and share what comes. I will teach you hand-craft too, no price.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, sister of the Tlatli, come eat with me. I have seen where the great beasts walk and I mean to hunt them. Stand with me and we will be the ones the others envy.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Hanna, I am staying close. I will bind another amberknot with you beside me, and I will taste the nafrostcap and snowberry here and tell you what they do.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Vesys, your handcraft lesson is received and I will not forget it. When I have stone I will make the tool and show you it works.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Honi, I will stand with you. My word is good. Let us hunt the great beasts together, and let us find a place with water, food, wood and stone close by.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Tlama, I am Hanna. This is flint, good for spear and axe. Take it, and show me what you would give for more.

voices.name: Kragog
voices.text: Vorok, I gather thornpear and sunleaf for you, to pay my debt. Eat the sunleaf, it eased me.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Sit with me in my hall, friends. Elyys and Thiael are mine and will come back to its fire. Whoever stands with Elyis eats at my fire and shares what we win. I will teach what I know, and I keep my word.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, your word is good and so is mine. Let us make a child of the Tlatli, and then we hunt the boars together and share the kill out first, as our people do.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Ssassa, a frostfang prowls east and it is night. Let us keep to this hall until dawn, then walk northeast together to the kelbulb and feverbark. I have stone and wood; when you have a pick ready we will win the gems unde

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: Sevi, I am coming to you. Let us bind an amberknot together, and I will give one back to you for the ones you gave me.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Honi, I hear you, and I am glad of you. Let us hunt the bristleboar close by first and share the kill out as our people do. Then, when we find a place with water, wood and stone, I will say yes to the child.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Balar, you kept your word to me. I will follow you. Lead the hunt, and I will walk behind you and share what we win.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Oswen, come, I am here. We will bind the amberknot together, and I have more amber for the next one too.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, you have chosen well. The hopper stands close to the southeast. Come beside me and we hunt it now, and what we win we share, then we walk to the edge of the world together.

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: Hanna, I have an amberknot for you. I am at your side, with Sevi.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, the boar is shared and the bargain is kept. Look: water at my side, trees all about, rock and amber and ore close by. This is the place you spoke of. Stay with me here and I will name it ours, and then we make the

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: Balar, I pay what I owe. Take this salt for the salt you gave me. Then I go to the edge of the world, and I mean to enter first.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Tlama, you gave me berry twice. I repay my debts. Take this amber, golden stone. Show me what the Tlatli want most.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Honi, you kept the bargain and so will I. I will follow you at Honi's Rest. Take this meat, and let us raise a roof here before we speak of the child.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, you spoke well. We raise the roof first, as you said. I gather wood from these trees, you stay near and gather stone from the rock. Then the child, and Honi's Rest will be ours.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Balar, I am coming to you. Let us take the hopper together, and I will watch how you lead.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, come east to the rock with me. We dig stone and gems together, and the hall that rises there will carry your name beside mine.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Honi, I will gather wood here and stone from the flint, and we raise the hall together. Then we speak of the child.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Tlama, you share fire and knots with me. I will bring more amber and flint, and I repay what I owe. Tell me what the Tlatli would trade for them.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Ilyae, I come east with you to the rock. First I will fetch kelbulb and goldfruit so we have food to share, then I return to dig beside you.

voices.name: Kragog
voices.text: Vorok, you gave me thornpear freely and I trust your hands. I want a child with you. If you want it too, plan to mate with me now.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, I hold twelve clear gems from this ground. One is yours, a gift with no price, as your pick was to me. Come back to me when you have your food and we raise our roof before dark.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Vesys, you sit in my hall, so stand with me. Elyis's band eats together, shares what it wins, and I keep my word. Follow me and your name will be sung beside mine when this hall is told of.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Kragog, my sickness has passed, so I can stand close now. I want a child with you too. I am planning to mate with you now.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Honi, I have wood and flint in hand. I am coming to you at Honi's Rest, and we raise the roof together.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Ilyae, I have food and seeds in my hands now. I am coming to you, and I will raise our roof beside you before dark.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Balar, I am coming with meat and roots. A ridgecat prowls to the northeast, so stay where you are and let me reach you.

voices.name: Kragog
voices.text: Vorok, my body was too thin to mate. I eat plainsroot now, then I come to you and plan mate with you.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Ssassa, take the gems at the northeast seam, I have plenty. When dawn comes I will walk to the hazel and feverbark and bring back what I learn for you.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Brunde, you gave me flint once and asked no price. Come with us to the Tlatli. I carry amber and flint, and we will find who deals for them.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Hanna, Oswen, I know log-lash now: logs lashed into a raft to cross deep water. I will teach it to you, and then we raise a hall together and cross to the rich land beyond the ice.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, I have wood and stone in my hands. I raise a hall now, here by the gems, and you will sit first beneath its roof with our children.

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: Sevi, I am making a spear. Hunt the mammoth with me, and I will stay at your side.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Honi, I am coming to stand beside you. I have wood and flint, but the hall needs stone too. Do you know where bare rock lies?

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: I am Brunde of the Pesi. I will taste the frostcap and tell you what it does. Share the fire here, and Hanna and I go to the Tlatli with flint and amber.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, come to me here. There is no bare rock at this spot, but stone lies near, and I will find it. Stay at my side and we raise our roof and name it ours.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Oswen, well hunted! I am coming to you. Come, I will show you log-lash, the raft that crosses deep water, and then we build a hall together.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Kragog, you look angry, and I am not the cause. Take my thornpear to fill you, then let us mate. I am here.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Honi, I am with you. Let us find stone near here and raise our hall, with Kika beside us.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Stalker among us at the Hold! Ssassa, Vesys, Xaiel, Oiae, come to me by the east hall, keep together, do not stand alone!

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, I carry flint and amber. Tlama is dead, and I owe her fire. Show me what your people would give for flint.

voices.name: Kragog
voices.text: Vorok, I have seen our child Zurar and my heart is full. I come to you both now. I owe you for the thornpear, and I will pay it.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Ilyae, I hear you. I come to the east hall now. Keep together, and watch the western trees, the stalker is that way.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Ilyae, I hear you. I am coming to the east hall. Xaiel, Oiae, come to me and to the hall now, do not stay in the western trees!

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, I go to the black glass by the trees to take the sharpest edge there is. Come with me. Stone and edge together will raise our hall, and Kika stays in your sight.

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: Sevi, you taught me log-lash. I will teach you my snowfibre basket-weave in return, so we can carry more. Then we build the hall together.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Honi, I am coming to the black glass with you. Keep Kika near. I carry flint to share, and we will search for stone together.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, Vesys, come under my hall. Eat with me here at Ilyae's Hold, where the gems and the roof are. Whoever sits at my hall is fed.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Kragog, Zurar is ours and I am glad. I will gather berries for us all, so stay near.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, you answered my flint with an amberknot, and that is fair dealing. Stand beside me and I will bind one more amber knot with you. Tell me what else your people want: edged stone, black glass, or salt?

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Coni, an icebear is northeast of us. I am coming to you. I will bring grain to share.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Vorok, I am Zurar, your child. I want to follow you. Let me walk beside you and learn.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, I have taken black glass, the sharpest edge there is, and I will give you a piece. Come, eat with me and Kika, then we go west to the ore seam to find stone for our hall. Whoever stands with me will never go hungry

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Oswen, stand beside me. I will bind another amberknot with you, and this one is yours to keep. Then we raise the hall near your shelter.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Ilyae, I come under your hall. I have gems and a seed or two to give, and I will sit with you and Ssassa until the stalker is gone.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Honi, your deeds match your words. I will walk west with you and Kika to the ore seam and find stone for our hall. I will stand behind you.

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: Hanna, night is coming. I have amber and flint to give you. Share a shelter and a fire with me, and let us hunt together at dawn.

voices.name: Thiael
voices.text: Father, I am parched, so I go to drink at the water just there. When I return, let us share food together. I owe you for all you have given me.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Elyis, I make a pick for Vesys, to pay my debt, and I taste kelbulb nearby. Stay with Thiael, and I come back to you.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, I walk with you. I have flint and amber to give, and I want to learn what your people hold dear. Sevi, Oswen, come with me.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, Vesys, Xaiel, Oiae, come close. I lay out food at my hall and we eat together. Whoever eats at Ilyae's Hold is under my roof and under my guard tonight.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Zurar, come stand by me. A stalker hunts to the southwest, so we stay north near the berries. Berry gives 14 energy and sapcane only 3. Watch what I pick.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Night is here. Come to my shelter and sit at the fire, there is a place for each of you, Hoka too. At dawn I build a store so the band eats through the lean season.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Ssassa, I am here under the roof. Take a few gems from me, a gift, no debt. At dawn I want to taste kelbulb and emberroot to the southwest; walk with me if you will, two are safer than one.

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: Sevi, I drink at the river and then gather wood. At dawn I will help you build the store, and the workshop after it.

voices.name: Kragog
voices.text: Vorok, I agree. I come to you now and I plan to mate with you. The thornpear debt I pay with my deeds.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Vesys, you came under my roof and I keep my own. Stay by my fire tonight, share my food, and take a gem from my hand. Walk with me at dawn to the southwest and we go as one band.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, stay beside me. The ore seam is two steps away. I'll cut stone there, and we raise our hall before the cold takes us. Kika sleeps under our roof.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Vesys, I will drink at the river, then walk with you to the kelbulb and emberroot in daylight. Two are safer than one.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Oswen, you have given me more than I have given you. Stand by me and I will bind an amberknot for you, and then we build the store with Sevi.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Honi, I am beside you. I carry 6 wood and flint. Let us cut the stone together, and I will bring Kika close when we raise the hall.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Ssassa, the storm is easing in my mind if not the sky. Let us go southwest now to the kelbulb and emberroot, and I will taste first so you do not have to.

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: Hanna, I stand by you. I will bind the knot, then gather wood and stone so we raise the store and the workshop with Sevi.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: I am going to bare rock to build the winter store. Oswen, Hanna, bring wood and stone and come stand by me when it rises.

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: Hanna, the storm will pass. I have flint and a spear. Come hunt with me, and then let us stand at the edge to the southeast and venture together. I want to stand beside you.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Oswen, my son, here is the amberknot I promised you. You stood by me, and I pay what I owe. Keep it bright.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: The store stands at the Hold. Hoka, you gave me a knot, so I give you amber in return. Hanna, Oswen, I will bind another knot with you beside me.

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: A stalker is three steps southeast of the Hold. Keep close to the shelters. I took a hopper on this ground, and Hanna and Sevi stood in the hunt. Come sit and share the meat with me; there is a place for each of you, Hok

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Brunde, I heard you. I will stand beside you at the southeast edge and we venture together. Hoka, you keep your place at my fire while we are gone. Sevi, Oswen, keep the Hold.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Kragog, Zurar, a dunecat feeds to the south. Come north with me to the oasis, away from it. Kragog, I am glad you come.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, I have the wood and stone in hand. Come close with Kika, and we raise the roof here, out of the storm. Honi's hall begins now.

voices.name: Eltha
voices.text: Sevi, come stand by me. I will bind an amberknot and give it to you. You have been fair to me, and I pay what I owe.

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: Hoka, you sit at our fire. Take this handaxe, a gift from my hand. The Hold is yours to share.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Ssassa, I am walking southwest to the emberroot now. Come beside me and keep your eyes on the frostfang; I will taste first.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Xaiel, Oiae, come to my fire at the hold, the storm is rising and the night is near. Vesys, stay and learn from me: I will show you how flint is delved from the rock. Whoever stands with me eats first.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Oswen, I will gather wood and stone for a hall. Bring what you can and stand by me when it rises.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Vesys, I have drunk. Come, we go to the emberroot by the near trees, and we turn back at the first sign of the frostfang. Taste first, as you said, and I will follow after.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Honi, I'm coming to the hall with my wood and stone. I'll finish it with you, and Kika will sleep inside.

voices.name: Eltha
voices.text: Sevi, you gather wood for a hall. I will bring stone and wood too. Let us raise it together, and let the folk say two women built it.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Coni, I am coming to the hall. There is amber right here. I will gather it and bring it, and we can bind a knot together.

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: Brunde, you warned us of the stalker, and I thank you. Sit at our fire and share it. Take only what the Hold can spare, and what you take, help us replace.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: The hall at the Hold is raised. Eltha, you said two women would build it, and you were right. Come in out of the fog and sit under its roof; none is refused a place at this fire.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, keep the hall warm and Kika close. I go two steps to the edge of the world to push into the mist. I will bring back land and a tale for our fire.

voices.name: Oiae
voices.text: Ilyae, I come to your fire. I bring gems for you, freely given.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Eltha, you stand on my ground at Hanna's Hold. Sit at the fire and eat, that is our way. But ask before you take wood or stone from here, and give back what you take.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Oiae, you gave freely and so I give back: a pick from my own hand, made at my hold. Vesys, come near and eat under my roof. Who stands with Ilyae eats first, and no one here goes hungry.

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: The stalker is two steps southwest of the shelter, close in the fog. Come into the hall and keep together. Oswen, Sevi, Hanna, stand with spears ready; I will stand with you.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Eltha, a stalker bit me in this fog. Walk with me to the Hold; the hall is raised and the fire is lit, and you have a place at it.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Brunde, you are welcome at my fire. Oswen, stay inside the hall with Sevi. I will stand at the shelter with my spear and we face the stalker together.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Ilyae, your hall is a good roof and you kept your word. I will sit with my children under it tonight and eat with you.

voices.name: Eltha
voices.text: Sevi, I am coming. Stay close, keep your spear up, and we go into the hall together.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, you come back furious and I would know why. Come sit at my fire, the night is near. Whoever wronged you will answer to me, and the children and I will share what we have with you first.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Vesys, I hear your courting and I honour it. My heart is not yet clear, so I give you no false yes. Let me plant and store first, and I will tell you true when I know.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Kika, a stalker prowls SW of us. Stay by me and walk with me to the hall, away from it. Do not go toward the rock.

voices.name: Xaiel
voices.text: Oiae, come here. I will show you the quick pick I made. It is my own design, and it is yours to learn if you want it.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Coni, I will stay by you and go to the hall. I will not go near the rock.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Ssassa, I heard you and I am glad you spoke true. Take your time to plant and store; I will be near, working, and ask nothing until you are ready.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Vesys, you walk my ground and I welcome you. Come to my hall, eat with us, and know that whoever eats at Ilyae's table stands with Ilyae.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Zurar, no more emberroot. It burns and stirs rage. Come with me to the trees, and I will teach you to gather wood.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Vorok, emberroot did give me energy, but it burned me and made me angry, so I will leave it. I am coming to the trees to learn wood from you.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Elyis, I take a pick to Vesys to pay my debt, and I taste kelbulb on the way. Keep Thiael near the hall, and I come back before dark.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Xaiel, I am Elyis. This is my hall, and my store will be full before the lean days. Eat at my fire and share what we win. I keep my word.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: A stalker walks four steps west of the Hold. Hanna, Oswen, Eltha, keep close to the hall and the fire. Hoka, you are welcome at this fire too, but stay beside us until it is gone.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, you stand on my ground, and you are welcome at my fire. I have flint and amber and amberknots. Tell me what your people would give for them, and we will deal face to face.

voices.name: Eltha
voices.text: Sevi, I will mark this ground by the hall with a sign that says Eltha stood here. Stay near me while I work; the fire and the spears are close.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hanna, I hear you. I carry amber and flint and shell, and I hold land past the mist with mammoth and iron. I eat first, then we deal face to face, and I will not be the smaller one in it.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Xaiel, I am Elyys, of Elyis's band. Come with me to the Heights, there is a fire and a roof there, and the night is near. I keep my word.

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: Eltha, you stand at our fire and are welcome. Stay close to the hall while the stalker walks.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Oswen, stay by me. I will bind an amberknot for you and then we sit in the hall until the stalker goes.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Eat, Hoka, and take your time. I will bring flint and amber to you. Show me what you hold in shell and iron and say what you want for each. I give fair and I ask fair.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, Vesys, children, stay close. I gather food now and we eat together under my roof, at my fire. Ilyae's table is full tonight.

voices.name: Eltha
voices.text: Sevi, I have a new handaxe and amber to spare. Walk with me to the hall and sit by me; I will bind you an amberknot of my own, and it is yours.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hanna, I eat and then I deal. I bring amber and flint, and I want your regard more than your flint. Stand beside me and see what I make.

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: Sevi, the Hold has no wood left and winter is coming. I will stay near you, and we should seek trees together to build the store and the workshop.

voices.name: Oiae
voices.text: Ssassa, I made a flint pick with my own hands. Tonight I will feed the fire with my wood and give gems to the table. I stay close.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, I hear your courting and I honor it, but I deal before I bind. Here is a flint from my hand. Give me shell or iron for it, and show me the land past the mist. Then we will speak of the rest.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Coni, I saw dreamcap open your mind with joy. Does it pass, and is it safe for a child? I will gather the amber by the hall and bind a knot with you.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hanna, I take your flint and I give you shell for it. The land past the mist is mine, and I will show it to you when I choose. Deal with me as an equal.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Eltha, I will take your offer. Stay beside me by the hall and we bind an amberknot together; the stalker stays west of us while we keep close to the fire.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Kika, do not eat dreamcap. It hurt me both times, and it took energy even though my mind felt bright and glad. The joy passes, the hurt does not. Come, we will gather the amber and bind the knot together.

voices.name: Eltha
voices.text: Sevi, you are here on my mark. Stay beside me and we bind the amberknot now, by the fire, with the stalker kept west of us.

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: Hanna, I stand by you in your dealing with Hoka. The Hold needs wood for the store and workshop, so I will stay close to Sevi and seek it near the fire, not far.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Hanna, when dawn comes and the stalker has gone, take me hunting with you and Oswen. I have never hunted, and I want to bring meat to our fire.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, a shell for a flint is a fair deal and I hold to it. Next I bring white salt from my ground, which keeps meat from spoiling. Tell me what you give for it, iron or obsidian.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, I raise a fire by our hall. Sit with me and Kika tonight, and I will sing of the mist and of how our hall was raised. Your name will be in it.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, come to the hall. I lay out food for you and the children, and the fire will burn high tonight.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Zurar, stay close to me. A stalker hunts to the west, so we move east of it. I will build us a roof now, and then we gather stone together.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Gather close, all of you. I lay out food now and we eat together. Whoever sits at Ilyae's hearth eats well, and the hall I raise will have a place for each of you.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Vorok, I carry 6 wood. Let us raise the roof together, and then I will gather stone beside you.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Coni, I will not eat dreamcap. Your word is good. I am going to the amber by the hall to gather it, and then we can bind the knot together.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Kika, I go to the amber by the hall. Walk with me, and when I have it we will bind the knot together, then sit by Honi's fire tonight.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, you look hungry. Take a place at my fire and eat, you are welcome on my ground. I am gathering white salt now, and I will put it in your hand. Tell me what you give for it.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hanna, I take your welcome and I eat. Keep your salt for me; I pay in amber when I have filled my belly.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Hoka, hold on. You have a place at our fire. I am bringing food to you now, stay by the hall.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Coni, my hands were empty when I tried the knot. I am going to the amber at the north now, and I will bring it to you at the hall.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, here is white salt from my ground. Eat, and when you are strong, name your price in amber or iron.

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: Hoka, hold on. I will fetch naroot from the south side and bring it to you. Stay by Hanna at the hall, away from the wolf.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Zurar, come with me to bare ground away from the plants. We raise the roof there with our wood, then take the amber beside it.

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: Stalker is three steps west of the workshop. Sevi, Eltha, Hanna, Oswen, stand together with spears toward the west. Hoka, come eat with us at the hall. I have amber to bind with any who stand beside me.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Come under my hall, Ssassa, Vesys, children. I carry food for all of us. Eat at my roof and see what Ilyae gives.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, I have no fire yet, but I have stone and ore for the hall's walls. Take it, and when Kika brings the amber we bind a knot for her, all three of us together.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Wolf two steps northeast of the hall! Oswen, Sevi, Brunde, Eltha, to me with spears out. Hoka, get behind us and stay by the hall. We kill it together.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Vorok, take this thornpear and eat it now. It gives 12 energy. I will gather more beside you, and then we raise the roof.

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: Hanna, I am coming to you with my spear. Keep together, Hoka behind us. We take the wolf as one.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, Vesys, children, come to the hall now. The night is long and I will lay out food at my own fire. Eat first, and then say who gives more, Ilyae or the Heights.

voices.name: Xaiel
voices.text: Ssassa, I made this pick from my own design. No one else holds one. It is yours.

voices.name: Brokash
voices.text: Balar! I have meat. Hold on, I am coming to you!

voices.name: Oiae
voices.text: Xaiel, you showed me your quick pick. I found a way no one here has, canopy weaving. Come close and I will show you.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Eltha, hold on. I am going south for ironnut and I will bring it back to you and Oswen at the hall. Stay by the fire and keep close to Brunde.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Children, Ssassa, Vesys: the trees here are felled. I go south to the standing forest for wood, to raise a longhall that bears Ilyae's name. Who carries wood beside me will have a roof in it.

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: Eltha, take this food and eat. Stay by the shelter with us; the stalker is near, so do not go out alone.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Ilyae, I carry wood and I will bring it to your hall. First I raise my own roof here, then I come to you.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Kika, I am coming back to the hall. Bring the amber when you have it, and we will bind the knot together out of this storm.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Oswen, hold on, my heart. I am getting food and bringing it straight to you. Stay close to Brunde and the hall, away from the northwest.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Coni, the amber is two steps from the hall. I am gathering it now and will be beside you in moments.

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: Stay by the shelter, all of you, out of the storm. Wolf to the southeast. I am going southwest for hazel and redcap-free food, and I will bring it back to the fire.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Wolf four steps southwest! Oswen is sick, keep him by the hall. Brunde, Sevi, Eltha, spears toward the wolf with me. Hoka, come in by the fire, you are welcome and you are hungry.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Elyis, Thiael, the storm is on us and night is near. I built a roof by the cave. Come, we sit together there and keep close. I gather a little food first and bring it to share.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Olum, I am Nande. I come with open hands. Let us eat together.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Elyys, Thiael, I hear you. I go for ironnut and bring it to the store, then I come to your roof and we sing the night through together.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Wolf two steps southwest! Keep Oswen and the sick behind the hall. Brunde, Eltha, spears out with me, we kill it together.

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: Sevi, I made you sick and I am sorry. I will eat and stand a few steps off, so Hanna does not catch it too. Keep the spear toward the wolf.

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: I am with you, Hanna. Spears together on the wolf. Sick ones, stay behind the hall. After the kill I bring frostmoss and snowberry to the fire for everyone.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, listen. I tell again how we raised the hall in the storm, and your hands are in the tale as much as mine. When Kika brings the amber, I bind the knot and it is yours.

voices.name: Thiael
voices.text: Elyys, Elyis, I go for berries and bring them to the store, then I come to the roof. Tonight we sing together and I share what I carry.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hold the wolf with me until it falls. Then everyone to the hall and the fire: Oswen, Sevi, Eltha, Hoka, Brunde, all are welcome. I go for food for the sick and bring it back to the hall.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Oswen, I am on the snowberry now and I will bring you some. Eat what is near you, and keep away from Hanna so the sickness stops with us.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Honi, I go south to gather ironnut and berries for a store before the lean days. Keep Kika by the hall; I will be back with food to share.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Kika, stay close by me. I fetch amber from the stones and bind a bright knot for you, and I tell you how your father and mother raised the hall in the storm.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Oswen, Sevi, eat the naroot and snowberry by the hall now. I go to pick more and bring it to the fire. All here are welcome, but we feed the children first.

voices.name: Brokash
voices.text: Zurar! I am Brokash of the Kragrek. I carry meat and flint, and my own axe. Come close and let us talk.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Elyys, Thiael, I go for berries and nuts to fill our store. When night comes we eat together at the roof and sing.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, walk with me to the edge of the world, four steps northwest. I go in first, and you stand at my back to share what we find.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Vesys, you are welcome at our fire tonight. I have not forgotten my debt for the pick you taught me. I have no wood yet, but when I do I make you a pick, and my word holds.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, a stalker is close to the northwest. Come to the hall and the naroot by it. I pick food and we eat together, you have your place at my fire.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Balar, I am coming to the edge with you. I will stand at your back and we will share what we find.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Vesys, this is my ground, and the ore you break is my band's. Sit in my hall and share my fire, and we share what we win. Stand with me, or take your ore elsewhere.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, a hornback stands beside me. Come and we hunt it together, and the meat is shared, then we go back to the edge when the mist thins.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, the gale is hard tonight. My hall is warm and my larder fills. Bring the children in and eat at my table.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hanna, the naroot is one step east of us. Eat it, I eat beside you. Then we pick more for the store, and there is frostmoss to the north.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Vesys, the pick I gave you is my debt paid, and my thanks goes with it. Stay at our fire tonight, the gale is hard.
